日本古典文学大系 32-33: 平家物語

biblStruct.note: Based on the Kakuichi-bon (覚一本) textual lineage.

projectDesc.p: This text was converted to TEI P5 XML so that it could be digitally cited and aligned to additional resources (such as translations). I have added identifiers to each section, paragraph and (more tentatively) sentence.

editorialDecl.p: Text follows the division of scrolls (Book) and chapters found in the UVA edition.

div.p: [1.1.1] Gionshōja no kane no koe, shogyōmujō no hibiki ari. Sharasōju no hana no iro, jōshahissui no kotowari o arawasu. Ogoreru hito mo hisashikara zu, tada haru no yoru no yume no gotoshi. Takeki mono mo tsuini horobi nu, hitoeni kaze no mae no chiri ni onaji. Tōku ichō o toburae ba, shin no chōkō, kan no ōmō, ryō no shūi, tō no rokuzan, korera ha mina kyūshu senkō no matsurigoto ni mo shitagawa zu, tanoshimi o kiwame, isame o omoīre zu, tenka no midare n koto o satora zu shite, minkan no ureuru tokoro o shira zari shika ba, hisakara zu shite bōji shi mono domo nari. Chikaku honchō o ukagau ni, shōhei no masakado, tengyō no sumitomo, kōwa no yoshichika, heiji no nobuyori korera ha ogoreru kokoro mo takeki koto mo mina toridorini koso ari shika domo, majikaku ha rokuhara no nyūdō sakinodaijōdaijin tairanoason kiyomori kō to mōshi hito no arisama, tsutae uketamawaru koso kokoro mo kotoba mo oyoba re ne

[1.1.2] Sono senzo o tazunure ba, kanmutennō daigo no miko, ippon shikibukyō kazuraharashinnō kyūdai no kōin sanukinokami masamori ga mago, gyōbukyō tadamori ason no chakunan nari. Kano shinnō no miko, takashinnō mukan mui ni shite, use tamai nu. Sono miko takamochi no ō no toki hajimete taira no sei o tamaite, kazusanosuke ni nari tamaishi yori, tachimachini ōji o idete jinshin ni tsuranaru. 其子鎭守府將軍義茂後には國香とあらたむ。 國香より正盛に至る迄、六代は諸國の受領たりしかども、殿上の仙籍をばいまだゆるされず。

[1.2.1] しかるを忠盛備前守たりし時、鳥羽院の御願得長壽院を造進して三十三間の御堂をたて、一千一體の御佛をすゑ奉る。 供養は天承元年三月十三日なり。 勸賞には闕國を給ふべき由仰下されける。 境節但馬國のあきたりけるを給にけり。 上皇御感のあまりに内の昇殿をゆるさる。 忠盛三十六にて始て昇殿す。 雲の上人是を嫉み、同き年の十一月廿三日、五節豐明の節會の夜、忠盛を闇討にせむとぞ擬せられける。 忠盛是を傳へ聞て、「われ右筆の身にあらず、武勇の家に生れて、今不慮の恥にあはむ事、家の爲、身の爲、こゝろうかるべし。 せむずるところ、身を全して君に仕といふ本文あり。 」とて、兼て用意をいたす。 參内のはじめより大なる鞘卷を用意して束帶のしたにしどけなげにさし、火のほのくらき方にむかて、やはら、此刀をぬき出し、鬢にひきあてられけるが、氷などの樣にぞみえける。 諸人目をすましけり。 其上忠盛の郎等もとは一門たりし木工助平貞光が孫しんの三郎太夫家房が子、左兵衞尉家貞といふ者ありけり。 薄青の狩衣の下に萠黄威の腹卷をき、弦袋つけたる太刀脇はさんで、殿上の小庭に畏てぞ候ける。 貫首以下あやしみをなし、「うつぼ柱よりうち、鈴の綱のへんに布衣の者の候ふはなにものぞ。 狼藉なり。 罷出よ。 」と、六位をもていはせければ、家貞申けるは「相傳の主、備前守殿今夜闇討にせられ給べき由承候あひだ、其ならむ樣を見むとて、かくて候。 えこそ罷出まじけれ。 」とて畏て候ければ、是等をよしなしとやおもはれけん、其夜の闇討なかりけり。

[1.2.2] 忠盛御前のめしにまはれければ、人々拍子をかへて「伊勢平氏はすがめなりけり。 」とぞはやされける。 此人々はかけまくもかたじけなく柏原天皇の御末とは申ながら、中比は都の住居もうと／＼しく、地下にのみ振舞なて伊勢國に住國ふかかりしかば、其國の器に事よせて、伊勢平氏とぞ申ける。 其うへ忠盛目のすがまれたりければ、加樣にはやされけり。 いかにすべき樣もなくして、御遊もいまだをはらざるに、竊に罷出らるとて、よこたへさされたりける刀をば紫宸殿の御後にして、かたへの殿上人のみられける所にて、主殿司をめしてあづけ置てぞ出られける。 家貞待うけたてまつて、「さていかゞ候つる。 」と申ければ、かくともいはまほしう思はれけれども、いひつるものならば、殿上までもやがてきりのぼらんずる者にてある間、「別の事もなし。 」とぞ答られける。

[1.2.3] 五節には、「白薄樣、こぜむじの紙、卷上の筆、鞆繪ゑがいたる筆の軸」なんどさま％＼面白き事をのみこそうたひまはるるに、中比太宰權帥季仲卿といふ人ありけり。 あまりに色のくろかりければ、見る人黒帥とぞ申ける。 其人いまだ藏人頭なりし時、五節にまはれければ、それも拍子をかへて、「あなくろ／＼、くろき頭かな。 いかなる人のうるしぬりけむ。 」とぞはやされける。 又花山院前太政大臣忠雅公、いまだ十歳と申し時、父中納言忠宗卿におくれたてまつて孤にておはしけるを、故中御門藤中納言家成卿いまだ播磨守たりし時、聟に執て、聲花にもてなされければ、それも五節に「播磨米はとくさか、むくの葉か、人のきらをみがくは。 " to zo hayasare keru. Jōko ni ha kayō ni ari shika domo koto ide ko zu. Matsudai ikaga ara n zu ramu, obotsukanashi to zo hito mōshi keru.

[1.2.4] An no gotoku gosechi hate ni shika ba, tenjōbito ichidō ni mōsa re keru ha" sore yūken o taishi te kōen ni resshi, heijō o tamate, kyūchū o shutsunyū suru ha mina kakushiki no rei o mamoru rinmei yoshi aru senki nari." Shikaru o tadamori ason aruiha ha sōden no rōjū to gōshi te hoi no hei o tenjō no koniwa ni meshi oki te, aruiha ha koshi no katana o yoko he saite sechie no za ni tsuranaru. Ryōjō kitai imada kika zaru rōzeki nari. Koto sudeni chōjō se ri. Zaika mottomo monogare gatashi nari. Hayaku mifuda o kezutte kekkanteinin se raru beki yoshi" onōno uttae mōsare kere ba, jōkō ōini odoroki oboshimeshi, tadamori o meshite otazune ari. Chinji mōshikeru ha" mazu rōjū koniwa ni shikō no yoshi, mattaku kakugo tsukamatsura zu. Tadashi, kinjitsu hitobito aitakumaruru mune shisai aru ka no aida, nenrai no kenin, koto o tsutaekiku ka niyotte sono haji o tasuken ga tame ni, tadamori ni shirarezu shite hisokani sankō no jō chikara oyobazaru shidai nari. Moshi nao sono toga aru beku ba, ka mi o meshishinzu beki ka. Tsugini katana no koto, shudenshi ni azukeoki o wanu. Kore o meshīdasare katana no jitsuhi ni tsuite toga no sayū aru beki ka. " to mōshi. Shikarubeshi tote sonokatana o meshīdashite eiran areba ue ha sayamaki no kuroku nuritarikeru ga naka ha bokutō ni ginpaku o zo oshitarikeru. Tōza no chijoku o nogaren tame ni katana o taisuru yoshi arawasu toiedomo gojitsu no soshō o zonchishite bokutō o taishikeru yōi no hodo koso shinmyōnare. Kyūsen ni tazusawaramu mono no hakarigoto ha mottomo kō koso aramahoshikere. Kanete ha mata rōjū koniwa ni shikō no jō katsu ha bushi no rōdō no narai nari. Tadamori ga toga ni arazu. " tote kaette eikan ni azukashūte ha aete zaika no sata mo nakari keri.
[1.3.1] Sono kodomo ha shoe no suke ni nari, shōden se shi ni tenjō no majiwari o hito kirau ni oyoba zu.
[1.3.2] Sonokoro, tadamori, bizennokuni yori miyako he nobori tari keru ni, tobain" akashinōra ha ikani. " to otazune ari kere ba,

lg.l: あり明の月もあかしのうら風に、浪ばかりこそよると見えしか。

div.p: [1.3.3] To mōshi tari keru ni, gyokan ari keri. Kono uta ha kin'yōshū ni zo ira re keru.

[1.3.4] Tadamori mata sentō ni saiai no nyōbō o mote kayowa re keru ga, aru toki, sono nyōbō no tsubone ni, tsuma ni tsuki ide shi taru ōgi o wasure te ide rare tari kere ba, katae no nyōbō tachi" kore ha izuku yori no tsukikage zo ya. Dedokoro obotsukanashi. " nado warai aware kere ba, kano nyōbō,

lg.l: 雲井よりたゞもりきたる月なれば、おぼろげにてはいはじとぞ思ふ。

div.p: [1.3.5] To yomi tari kere ba, itodo asakara zu zo omowa re keru. Satsumanokamitadanori no haha, kore nari. Niru o tomo tokaya no fuzei ni tadamori mo suitari kereba, kano nyōbō mo yūnari keri. Kakute tadamori gyōbukyō ni nate, ninpei sannen shōgatsu jūgonichi sai gojūhachi nite useniki. Kiyomori chakunan taru niyote sono ato o tsugu.

[1.3.6] Hōgen gannen shichigatsu ni uji no safu dai o midari tamai shi toki, akinokami tote mikata nite kunkō ari shika ba, harimanokami ni utsute dō sannen dazainodaini ni naru. Tsugini heiji gannen jūnigatsu, nobuyorikyō ga muhon no toki, mikata nite zokuto o uchitairage, kunkō itsuni arazu, onshō kore omokarubeshi tote, tsuginotoshi shōsanmi ni joserare, uchitsuzuki, saishō, efunokami, kebīshinobettō, chūnagon, dainagon ni heagate, amatsusahe jōshō no kurai ni itari, sayū o hezushite naidaijin yori daijōdaijin juichī ni agaru. Taishō ni arane domo, heijō o tamahate zuijin o meshigusu. Gissha rensha no senji o kōmute, norinagara kyūchū o shutsunyūsu. Hitoheni shissei no shin no gotoshi. " daijōdaijin ha ichinin ni shihan toshite shikai ni gikei seri." Kuni o osame, michi o ronji, in'yō o yawarage osamu. Sonohito ni ara zu ba sunawachi kake yo. " to ie ri. Sareba sokketsu no kan tomo nazuke tari. Sonohito naradeha kegasu beki kan nara ne domo, ittenshikai o tanagokoro no uchi ni nigira re shi ue ha shisai ni oyoba zu.

[1.3.7] Heike kayōni hanjō se rare keru mo kumanogongen no gorishō to zo kikoe shi. Sono yue ha, inishie kiyomorikō, imada akinokami tari shi toki, ise no umi yori fune nite kumano he maira re keru ni, ōkinaru suzuki no fune ni odorīri tari keru o, sendatsu mōshi keru ha," kore ha gongen no gorishō nari. Isogi mairu beshi. " to mōshi kere ba, kiyomori notamai keru ha," mukashi, shū no buō no fune ni koso shirauo ha odorīri tari keru nare. Kore kichiji nari. " tote sabakari jikkai o tamochite shōjinkessai no michi nare domo chōmi shite ienoko samurai tomo kuwase rare keri. Sonoyue ni ya kichiji nomi uchitsuzuite daijōdaijin made kiwame tamae ri. Shison no kanto mo ryū no kumo ni noboru yori ha nao sumiyaka nari. Kyūdai no senshō o koe tamau koso medetakere.

[1.4.1] Kakute kiyomorikō nin'an sannen jūichigatsu jūichinichi sai gojūichi nite yamai ni okasare zonmei no tame ni tachimachini shukke nyūdō su. Hōmyō wa jōkai to koso nanorare kere. Sono shirushi ni ya, shukubyō tachidokoroni iete, tenmei o mattōsu. Hito no shitagai tsuku koto fukukaze no kusaki o nabikasu ga gotoshi Yo no amaneku aogeru koto furu ame no kokudo o uruosu ni onaji.

[1.4.2] Rokuharadono no goikke no kindachi to īte shikaba, kazoku mo eiyū mo omote o mukae kata o naraburu hito nashi. sareba nyūdōshōkoku no koshūto, tairanodainagontokitadakyō no notamaikeru ha" kono ichimon ni ara zara n hito ha mina ninpinin naru beshi." to zo notamaikeru. kakarishikaba, ikanaru hito mo aikamaete sono yukari ni musubōren to zo shikeru. emon no kakiyō eboshi no tameyō yori hajimete nanigoto mo rokuharayō toīte kereba, ittenshikai no hito mina kore o manabu.

[1.4.3] 又いかなる賢王聖主の御政も攝政關白の御成敗も世にあまされたるいたづら者な どの、人のきかぬ處にてなにとなうそしり傾け申事は常の習なれども、此禪門世ざか りの程は聊いるかせにも申者なし。其故は入道相國のはかりごとに十四五六の童部を 三百人そろへて、髮をかぶろにきりまはし、あかき直垂をきせて、めしつかはれける が、京中にみち／＼て、往反しけり。自ら平家の事あしざまに申者あれば、一人きゝ 出さぬほどこそありけれ、餘黨に觸廻して、其家に亂入し資材雜具を追捕し、其奴を 搦とて、六波羅へゐてまゐる。されば目に見、心に知るといへども、詞にあらはれて 申者なし。六波羅殿の禿と云ひてしかば、道をすぐる馬車もよぎてぞ、通りける。禁 門を出入すといへども姓名を尋らるゝに及ばず、京師の長吏これが為に目を側むとみ えたり。
[1.5.1] 吾身の榮花を極るのみならず、一門共に繁昌して、嫡子重盛、内大臣の左大將、次男宗盛、中納言の右大將、三男知盛、三位中將、嫡孫維盛、四位少將、すべて一門 の公卿十六人、殿上人三十餘人、諸國の受領、衞府、諸司、都合六十餘人なり。 世にはまた人なくぞ見えられける。

[1.5.2] 昔奈良の御門の御時、神龜五年、朝家に中衞の大將をはじめおかれ、大同四年に 中衞を近衞と改られしよりこのかた、兄弟左右に相並事僅に三四箇度なり。文徳天皇 の御時は左に良房右大臣左大將、右に良相、大納言の右大將、是は閑院の左大臣冬嗣 の御子なり。朱雀院の御宇には左に實頼、小野宮殿、右に師輔、九條殿、貞信公の御 子なり。御冷泉院の御時は、左に教通、大二條殿、右に頼宗、堀河殿、御堂の關白の 御子なり。二條院の御宇には左に基房、松殿、右に兼實、月輪殿、法性寺殿の御子な り。是皆攝祿の臣の御子息、凡人にとりては其例なし。殿上 の交をだにきらはれし人の子孫にて禁色雜袍をゆり、綾羅錦繍を身にまとひ、大臣大 將になて、兄弟、左右に相並事、末代とはいひながら不思議なりし事どもなり。

[1.5.3] 其外御娘八人おはしき。 Mina toridorini sachi tamae ri. Hitori ha sakuramachi no chūnagon shigenori kyō no kitanokata nite owasu bekari shi ga, hassai no toki yakusoku bakari nite heiji no ran igo hikichigae rare, kazan'in no sadaijin dono no midaibandokoro ni nara se tama te kindachi amata mashimashi keri.

[1.5.4] Somosomo kono shigenorikyō o sakuramachi no chūnagon to mōshi keru koto ha sugurete shinsuki tamaeru hito nite, tsuneha yoshinoyama o koi, machi ni sakura o uenarabe, sonōchi ni ya o tate, sumi tamai shika ba, kuru toshi no haru gotoni, miru hito sakuramachi to zo mōshi keru. Sakura ha saite shichikanichi ni chiru o, nagori o oshimi amaterasuōmikami ni inorimōsare kere ba, sanshichinichi made nagori ari keri. Kimi mo ken'ō nite mashimase ba kami mo shintoku o kagayakashi, hana mo kokoro ari kere ba, hatsuka no yowai o tamochi keri.

[1.5.5] Hitori ha kisaki ni tatase tamau. Ōji gotanjō ari te kōtaishi ni tachi, kurai ni tsukase tamaishika ba, ingō kōburase tamai te, kenreimon'in to zo mōshikeru. Nyūdōshōkoku no onmusume naru ue, tenka no kokumo nite mashimashikere ba tokō mōshi ni oyoba zu. Hitori ha rokujō no sesshōdono no kitanomandokoro ni narase tamau. Takakurain gozaī no toki mihahashiro tote jusangō no senji o kōburi, shirakawadono tote omoki hito nite mashimashikeri. Hitori ha fugenjidono no kitanomandokoro ni nara se tamau. Hitori ha reizeidainagontakafusakyō no kitanokata. Hitori ha shichijōshuridaibunobutakakyō ni aigushi tamae ri. Mata akinokuni itsukushima no naishi ga hara ni hitori owase shi ha, goshirakawanohōō he mairase tamai te nyōgo no yōni te zo mashimashi keru. Sonohoka kujōin no zōshi tokiwa ga hara ni hitori. Kore ha kazan'indono ni jōrōnyōbō nite rōnōnkata to zo mōshikeru.

[1.5.6] Nihon'akitsushima ha wazukani rokujūrokkakoku, heike chigyō no kuni sanjūyokakoku, sudeni hankoku ni koe tari. Sonohoka shōen tahata ikura to iu kazu o shira zu. Kira jūman shite, dōjō hana no gotoshi. Kenki gunshū shite, monzen ichi o nasu. Yōshū no kin, keishū no shu, gogun no aya, shokukō no nishiki, shitchinmanpō ichi toshite kaketaru koto nashi. Kadō bukaku no motoi, gyoryō shakuba no ganbutsu, osorakuha teiketsu mo sentō mo kore niha sugiji to zo mie shi.

div.head: 1.6. 祇王

div.p: [1.6.1] Nyūdōshōkoku, ittenshikai o tanagokoro no uchi ni nigiri tamai shi aida, yo no soshiri o mo habakara zu, hito no azakeri o mo kaerimi zu, fushigi no koto o nomi shi tamae ri. Tatoeba sonokoro miyako ni kikoetaru shirabyōshi no jōzu, giō ginyo tote kyōdai ari, toji to iu shirabyōshi ga musume nari. Ane no giō o nyūdōshōkoku saiai se rare kere ba, kore ni yote imōto no ginyo o mo yo no hito motenasu koto nanomenara zu. Haha toji ni mo yoki ya tsukute torase, maitsuki hyakkoku hyakkan o okurarekere ba, kanai fūki shite tanoshī koto nanomenara zu.

[1.6.2] Somosomo wagachō ni shirabyōshi no hajimari keru koto ha, mukashi tobain no gyō ni shima no chitose waka no mae tote korera futari ga mai idashitari keru nari. Hajime ha suikan ni tateeboshi, shirasayamaki o saite mai kere ba otokomai to zo mōshi keru. Saru o nakagoro yori eboshi, katana o noke rare, suikan bakari o mochī tari, sate koso shirabyōshi to ha nazuke re.

[1.6.3] Kyōchū no shirabyōshi domo giō ga kō no medetaki yō o kīte urayamu mono mo ari, sonemu mono mo ari keri. Urayamu monodomo ha" ana medetano giōgozen ga sachi ya. Onaji asobime to nara ba dare mo mina anoyō de koso ari takere. Ikasama kore ha gi to iu moji o na ni tsuite kaku ha medetaki yaran. Iza warera mo tsuite min. " tote aruiha gīchi to tsuki, gini to tsuki, aruiha gifuku gitoku nado iu mono mo ari keri. Sonemu mono domo ha" nan jō na ni yori, moji ni ha yoru beki. Sachi ha tada zense no umaretsuki nite koso an nare. " tote tsuka nu mono mo ōkari keri.

[1.6.4] Kakute sannen to mōshi ni mata miyako ni kikoetaru shirabyōshi no jōzu hitori shuttai tari. Kaganokuni no mono nari. Na o ba hotoke to zo mōshi keru. Toshi jūroku to zo kikoe shi. " mukashi yori ōku no shirabyōshi ari shika domo, kakaru mai ha imada mi zu. " tote kyōchū no jōge motenasu koto nanomenara zu. Hotokegozen mōshi keru ha" ware tenka ni kikoe tare domo, tōji sashimo medetō sakae sase tamau heike daijō nyūdō dono he mesare nu koto koso hoi nakere. Asobimono no narai, nanika wa kurushikaru beki. Suisan shi te mimu. " tote, arutoki nishihachijō e zo mairi taru. Hito maite" tōji miyako ni kikoe sō hotokegozen koso maite sōe. " to mōshi kere ba, nyūdō" nandō sayō no asobimono wa hito no meshi ni shitagaite koso maire. Sōnau suisan suru yō ya aru. Giō ga ara n tokoro he ha kami tomo ie, hotoke tomo ie, kanau majiki zo. Tōtō makarīde yo. " to zo notamai keru. Hotokegozen ha sugenau iware tatematsu te, sudeni ide n to shi keru o, giō, nyūdōdono ni mōshikeru ha" asobimono no suisan ha tsunenonarai de koso sōrae. Sonōe, toshi mo imada osanau sō naru ga, tamatama omoitatematsuri te sō o, sugenau ōserare te kaesase tamawa n koto koso fubin nare. Ikabakari hazukashū katawaraitaku mo sō ran. Waga tate shi michi nare ba, hito no ue tomo oboe zu. Tatoi mai o goranji, uta o kikoshimesa zu tomo, gotaimen bakari saburau te kaesase tamai tara ba, arigataki gonasake de koso sōwa nzure. Tada ri o mage te, meshikaeshi te gotaimen saburae. " to mōshikere ba nyūdō," ide／＼ wagagozen ga amarini iu koto nare ba genzanshite kaesa mu. " tote tsukai o tate zo mesare keru. Hotokegozen ha sugenō iware tatematsu te kuruma ni no te sudeni iden to shi keru ga mesare te kisanri tari. Nyūdō deai taimenshite" kyō no genzan ha arumajikari tsuru o giō ga nanto omō yaran amarini mōshi susumuru aida kayōni genzanshi tsu. Genzansuru hodoniteha ikade koe o mo kika de aru beki zo. Imayō hitotsu utae kashi. " to notamae ba, hotokegozen" uketamawari saburau. " tote imayō hitotsu zo utautaru.

lg.l: 君をはじめて見るをりは、千代も歴ぬべし姫小松、
御前の池なる龜岡に、鶴こそ群れ居て遊ぶめれ。

div.p: [1.6.5] Tōshi kaeshi／＼ sanben utasumashitari kere ba, kenmon no hitobito mina jimoku o odorokasu. Nyūdō mo omoshirogeni omoi tamai te," wagozen ha imayō ha jōzu de ari keru yo. Kono sadame de ha mai mo sadamete yokaru ran. Ichiban mi baya. Tsuzumiuchi mese. " tote mesare keri. Utasete ichiban mai tari keri.

[1.6.6] Hotokegozen wa kamisugata yori hajimete mimekatachi utsukushiku koe yoku fushi mo jōzude arikere ba najika wa mai mo sonzu beki. Kokoro mo oyobazu mai sumashi tarikere ba nyūdōshōkoku mai ni mede tamai te hotoke ni kokoro o utsusa re keri. Hotokegozen" kowa sareba nanigoto saburō zo ya. Motoyori warawa wa suisan no mono nite idasare mairase saburai shi o, giōgozen no mōshijō ni yote koso meshikaesare te mo sō ni, kayōni meshiokare naba, giōgozen no omoi tamawan kokoro no uchi hazukashū saburō. Haya／＼ itoma o tōde dasase owashimase. " to mōshikere ba, nyūdō," subete sonogi aru maji. Tadashi giō ga aru o habakaru ka. Sonogi nara ba giō o koso idasa me. " to notamai keru. Hotokegozen" sore mata ikadeka saru onkoto sōraubeki. Morotomoni meshiokare ndani kokorōu sōbeki ni, mashite giōgozen o idasase tamai te, warawa hitori meshiokare naba, giōgozen no kokoronōchi hazukashū sōbeshi. Onozukara nochi made wasurenu onkoto nara ba, mesarete mata mairu tomo, kyō ha itoma o tamara n. " to zo mōshikeru. Nyūdō" nandō sonogi arubeki. Giō tōtō makarīde yo. " to otsukai kasanete sando made koso taterarekere Giō motoyori omohimauketaru michi naredomo, sasugani kinō kyō toha omoyorazu. Isogi izubeki yoshi shikirini notamau aida, haki nugui, chiri hirowase, migurushiki monodomo torishitatamete izubeki ni koso sadamarikere Ichiju no kage ni yadoriai, onaji nagare o musubu dani wakare ha kanashiki narai zo kashi Mashite kono sannen ga aida suminareshi tokoro nareba, nagori mo oshū kanashikute, kainaki namida zo koborekeru Satemo aru beki koto nara ne ba, giō sudeni, ima ha kō tote ide keru ga, nakara n ato no wasuregatami ni mo to ya omoi kemu, shōji ni nakunaku isshu no uta o zo kakitsuke keru.

lg.l: 萠出るも枯るゝも同じ野邊の草、何れか秋にあはではつべき。

div.p: [1.6.7] Sate kuruma ni nori te shukusho ni kaeri, shōji no uchi ni taorefushi, tada naku yori hoka no koto zo ki. Haha ya imōto kore o mite" ikani ya ikani. " to toi kere domo, tokō no henji ni mo oyoba zu. Gushitaru onna ni tazunete zo saru koto ari to mo shiri te keru. Saruhodoni maitsukini okurare tsuru hyakkoku hyakkan o mo imaha todomerare te, hotokegozen ga yukari no monodomo zo, hajimete, tanoshimi sakae keru. Kyōchū no shōka," giō koso nyūdōdono yori itoma tamawa te ide tan nare. Iza kenzan shite asoba n. " tote, aruiha fumi o tsukawasu hito mo ari, aruiha tsukai o tatsuru mono mo ari. Giō sarebatote imasara hito ni taimen shite asobi tawaburu beki nimo ara ne ba, fumi o torīruru koto mo naku, mashite tsukai ni aishirau made mo nakari keri. Kore ni tsuke te mo kanashiku te itodo namida ni nomi zo shizumi keru.

[1.6.8] Kakute kotoshi mo kure nu. Akuru haru no koro, nyūdōshōkoku, giō ga moto he shisha o tate te" ikani sonogo nanigoto ka aru. Hotokegozen ga amarini tsurezuregeni miyuru ni, maite imayō o mo utai, mai nado o mo maite hotoke nagusame yo. " to zo notamai keru. Giō to kō no gohenji ni mo oyoba zu. Nyūdō" nado giō ha henji ha se nu zo. Mairu majī ka. Mairu majiku ba sonoyō o mōse. Jōkai mo hakarai mune ari. " to zo notamai keru. Haha toji kore o kiku ni kanashiku te [_] [1] ikanaru beshi tomo oboe zu naku／＼ kyōkunshi keru ha" ikani giō gozen, tomokakumo gohenji o mōse kashi, sayōni shikarare mairasen yori ha. " to ie ba, giō" maira n to omō michi nara ba koso yagate mairu to mo mōsa me. maira zara n mono yueni nani to gohenji o mōsu beshi tomo oboe zu. Maira zara n mono yueni nani to gohenji o mōsu beshi tomo oboe zu. Konotabi mesan ni maira zu ba hakarau mune ari to ōse raruru ha, miyako no soto he dasa ruru ka, sarazu ba inochi o mesa ruru ka, kore futatsu ni yomo sugi ji. Tatohi miyako o idasa ruゝ tomo, nageku beki ni ara zu. Tatohi inochi o mesa ruゝ tomo, oshikaru beki mata waga mi ka ha. Hitotabi uki mono ni omoha re mairase te nido omote o mukafu beki ni mo ara zu. " tote, naho gohenji o mo mausa zari keru o, haha toji kasanete keukunshi keru ha," amegashita ni suman hodo ha tomokaumo nifudaudono no ohose o ba somuku majiki koto ni te aru zo. Nanniyo no enishi sukuse ima ni hajime nu koto zo kashi. Sennen mannen to chigire domo, yagate hanaruru naka mo ari. Shiraji to omoe domo nagarae hataru koto mo ari. Yo ni sadamenaki mono ha nannyo no narai nari. Sore ni wagagozen ha kono sannen made omoware mairase tare ba, arigataki gonasake de koso are. Mesan ni maira ne ba tote inochi o ushinawa ruru made ha yomo ara ji. Tada miyako no hoka he zo idasare n zuran. Tatohi miyako o idasaru tomo, wa gozen tachi ha toshiwakakere ba, ikanara n ihaki no hazama ni temo sugosa n koto yasukaru beshi. Toshioi otorohe taru haha miyako no hoka he zo idasare n zuran. Naraha nu tabi no sumika koso kanete omofu mo kanashikere. Tada wa o miyako no uchi nite sumihatese yo. Sore zo konjō goshō no kōyō to omowa muzuru. " to ie ba, giō ushi to oboshi michi nare domo, oya no mei o somuka ji to, nakunaku mata shuttatsu keru kokoro no naka koso muzan nare. Hitori maira mu ha amarini monōshi to te imōto no gijo o mo aigushi keri. Sonohoka shirabyōshi futari, sōjite yonin ichisha ni nori te, nishihachijō he zo mairi taru. Sakizaki mesa retaru tokoro he ha ire rare zu shite, harukani kudari taru tokoro ni zashiki shitsurau te oka re tari. Giō" ko ha sareba nanigoto zo ya. Wagami ni ayamatsu koto ha nakere domo sute rare tatematsuru dani aru ni zashiki o sahe sage raru ru koto no kokorōsa yo. Ikani se mu. " to omō ni shirase ji to osauru sode no hima yori mo amarite namida zo kobore keru. Hotokegozen kore o mite amarini awareni omokere ba" are ha ikani higoro mesare nu tokoro nite mo sōrawa ba koso. Koko e mesare sōrae kashi. Sarazuba warawa ni itoma o tamabe. Ide te mimaisen. " to mōshikere ba, nyūdō" subete sonogi aru maji. " to notamau ma, chikara oyoba de ide zari keri. Sononochi nyūdō ha giō ga kokoro no uchi o mo shira tamawazu," ikani sononochi nanigoto ka aru. Sateha hotokegozen ga amarini tsurezurege ni miyuru ni, imayō hitotsu utae kashi. " to notamae ba, giō mairu hodo de ha, tomokōmo nyūdōdono no ōse o ba somuku maji to omoi kere ba, otsuru namida o osae te, imayō hitotsu zo utautaru.

lg.l: 佛も昔は凡夫なり、我等も遂には佛なり、
何も佛性具せる身を、隔つるのみこそ悲しけれ。

div.p: [1.6.9] To nakunaku nihen utautari kere ba, sonoza ni ikuramo narabītamaeru heikeichimon no kugyō, tenjōbito, shodaibu, samurai ni itaru made mina kanrui o zo nagasare keru. Nyūdō mo omoshirogeni omoi tamai te" toki ni tote ha shinmyōni mōshi tari. Sateha mai mo mi takere domo, kyō ha magiruru koto idekitari. Kononochi ha mesa zu tomo, tsuneni mai te imayō o mo utai, mai nado o mai te hotoke nagusame yo. " to zo notamai keru. Giō tokaku no henji ni mo oyoba zu, namida o osae te ide ni keri.

[1.6.10] " oya no mei o somuka ji to tsuraki michi ni omomui te, nido, uki me o mi tsuru koto no kokorōsa yo. Kakute konoyo ni aru nara ba mata ukime o mo mi muzura n. Ima ha tada mi o nage n to omō nari. " to ie ba imōto no gijo mo" ane mi o nage ba, ware mo tomoni mi o nagen. " to iu. Haha toji, kore o kiku ni kanashikute ikanaru beshi tomo oboe zu. Nakinaki mata kyōkun shi keru ha" makotoni wa gozen no uramuru mo kotowari nari. Sayō no koto aru beshi tomo shira zu shite kyōkun shite mairase tsuru koto no kokorōsa yo. Tadashi ware gozen mi o nage ha imōto mo tomoni mi nage n to iu Futari no musume tomoni okure nan nochi toshioiotoroetaru haha inochi ikite mo naniゝ ka ha se mu nare ba ware mo tomoni mi nage mu to omō nari Imada shigo mo kora nu oya ni mi o nage sase n koto gogyakuzai ni ya ara n zuramu Konoyo wa kari no yado nari. Hajite mo hajite mo nani nara zu. Tada nagaki yo no yami koso kokorōkere. Konjō de koso ara me. Goshō de dani akudō e omomuka nzuru koto no kanashisa yo. " to samezameto kakikudokere ba, giō namidao osae te" genimo sayōni saburawa ba gogyakuzai utagainashi. Saraba jigai ha omoitodomari sōrai nu. Kakute miyako ni aru nara ba, mata ukime o mo mi mu zu ran. Ima ha miyako no soto he ide n. " tote giō nijūichi nite ama ni nari, sagano no oku naru yamazato ni shiba no iori o hikimusubi nenbutsu shite koso i tari kere. Imōto no gijo mo" ane mi o nage ba, ware mo tomoni mi o nage n to koso chigiri shika, mashite yo o itoha n ni tare ka ha otoru beki. " tote jūku nite yō o kae, ane to issho ni rōkyo te gose o negau zo awarenaru. Hahatoji kore o mite wakaki musumedomo dani sama o kawaru yononaka ni toshioi otoroetaru haha shiraga o tsukete mo naninikaha semu tote shijūgo nite kami o sori, futari no musume morotomoni ikkōsenjuni nenbutsushite, hitoeni gose o zo negaikeru.

[1.6.11] Kakute haru sugi natsu takenu, aki no hatsukaze fukinureba, hoshiai no sora o nagametsutsu, amanoto wataru kajinoha ni omōkoto kaku koronareya. Yūhi no kage no nishi no yamanoha ni kakururu o mite mo, hi no iritamau tokoro ha saihōjōdo nite annari. Itsuka warera mo kashiko ni umarete monōomowadesugusanzuran to, kakaru nitsuketemo suginishikata no ukikotodomo omoitsuzukete, tada tsukusenu mono ha namida nari. Tasogaredoki mo suginureba take no amido o tojifusagi, tomoshibi kasukani kakitatete, oyakosannin nenbutsushite itaru tokoro ni, take no amido o, hotohototo uchitataku mono idekitari. Sonotoki amadomo kimōkeshi" aware, kore ha īkainaki warera ga nenbutsushite itaru o samatagen tote, maen no kitaru nitezoaruran. Hiru danimo hito no toikonu yamazato no shiba no iori no uchi nareba, yofukete dareka ha tazunubeki. Wazuka no take no amido nareba, akezutomo oshiyaburan koto yasukarubeshi. Nakanaka tada akete iren to omō nari. Sore ni nasake o kake zu shite, inochi o ushinau mono nara ba, toshigoro tano tatematsuru mida no hongan o tsuyoku shinji te, himanaku myōgō o tonae tatematsuru beshi. Koe o tazune te mukae tamau naru shōju no raigō nite mashimase ba, nadoka injō nakaru beki. Aikamae te nenbutsu okotari tamau na. " to, tagaini kokoro o imashime te, take no amido o ake tare ba, maen nite ha nakari keri, hotokegozen zo ideki taru. Giō" are ha ikani. Hotokegozen to mi tatematsuru ha yume ka ya, utsutsu ka. " to ī kere ba, hotokegozen namida o osae te," kayō no koto mōse ba, koto atarashū sōrae domo, mōsa zu ba, mata omoishira nu mi to mo nari nu bekere ba, hajime yori shite mōsu nari. Motoyori warawa suisan no mono nite, dasare mairase sōrai shi o, giō gozen no mōshijō ni yotte koso, meshikaesare te mo sōrō ni, onna no kainaki koto, wagami o kokoro ni makase zu shite, oshitodomerare mairase shi koto kokorōu saburai shi ga, itsuzoya mata mesare mairase te imayō utai tamai shi ni mo oboshirare te koso saburae. Itsuka wagami no ue nara n to omoe ba, ureshi to ha sarani omowa zu. Shōji ni mata,『 izure ka aki ni awa de ha tsu beki. 』 to kakioki tamai shi fude no ato, geni mo to omoi saburai shi zo ya. Sononochi ha zaisho o izuku tomo shiri mairase zari tsuru ni, kayōni sama o kaete, issho ni to uketamawate nochi ha, amarini urayamashikute tsuneha itoma o mōshi kadomo, nyūdōdono sarani goyōi mashimasa zu. つく％＼ mono o anzuru ni, shaba no eiga ha yume no yume, tanoshimi sakaete nani ka sen. Ninshin ha ukegataku, bukkyō ni ha aigatashi. Konotabi nairi ni shizumi te ha tashō kōgō o ba hedatsu tomo ukami agara n koto katashi. Toshi no wakaki o tanomu beki ni ara zu. Rōshōfujō no sakai, izuru iki no iru o mo matsu bekara zu. Kagerō inazuma yori mo nao hakanashi. Ittan no raku ni hokori te goshō o shira zara n koto no kanashisa ni kesa magire ideゝ kaku nari te koso mairi tare. " tote katsugitaru kinu o uchinoketaru o mireba, amani natezo idekitaru. " kayōni sama o kaete mairitareba, higoro no toga oba yurushi tamae. Yurusan to ōserareba, morotomoni nenbutsushite, ichiren no mi to naran. Soreni nao kokoroyukazuba, koreyori izuchihemo mayoīki, ikanaran koke no mushiro, matsugane nimo taorefushi, inochi no arankagiri nenbutsushite, ōjō no sokai o togen to omō nari. " to samezameto kakikudokikereba, giō namida o osaete," makotoni wagoze no korehodoni omoitamaikeru to ha. Yume ni dani shira zu, ukiyo no naka no saga nare ba, mi no u to koso omō beki ni, tomosureba, wagoze no koto nomi urameshiku te ōjō no sokai o togen koto kanau beshi tomo oboe zu, konjō mo goshō mo, namajīni shisonji taru kokochi nite ari tsuru ni, kayōni sama o kae te owashi tare ba, higoro no toga ha tsuyuchiri hodo mo nokora zu, ima ha ōjō utagai nashi. Konotabi sokai o toge n koso nani yori mo mata ureshikere. Warera ga ama ni nari shi o koso yo ni tameshi naki koto no yō ni, hito mo ī wagami ni mo mata omoi shika. Sore ha yo o urami mi o urami te nashi ka ba sama o kawaru mo kotowari nari. Ima wakoze no shukke ni kurabure ba koto no kazu ni mo ara zari keri. Wagoze wa urami mo nashi nageki mo nashi. Kotoshi wa wazukani jūshichi ni koso naru hito no, kayōni edo o itoi, jōdo o negawan to, fukaku omoīre tamau koso, makotono daidōshin to wa oboetare. Ureshikari keru zenchishiki kana. Iza morotomoni negawa n. " tote, yonin isshoni komorīte, asayū butsuzen ni hanakō o sonae, yonennaku negai kere ba, chisoku koso ari kere, yonin no amadomo mina ōjō no sokai o toge ru to zo kikoe shi. Sareba, goshirakawa no hōō no, chōkōdō no kakochō ni mo, giō, ginyo, hotoke, toji ra ga sonrei to yonin issho ni ire rare keri. Aware nari shi koto domo nari.

div.note: [_] [1] Nihon Koten Bungaku Taikei (Tokyo: Iwanami Shoten, 1957, vol. 32; hereafter cited as NKBT) reads いかなるべしともおぼえず。.
[_] [2] NKBT reads なげば.
[_] [3] NKBT reads わごぜ.

div.p: [1.7.1] Mukashi yori ima ni itaru made, genpeiryōshi chōka ni meshitsukaware te, ōka ni shitagawa zu, jichōken o karonzuru mono ni ha, tagaini imashime o kuwashika ba, yo no midare mo nakari shi ni, hōgen ni tameyoshi kirare, heiji ni yoshitomo chūserare te nochi ha, suezue no genji domo, aruiha nagasare, aruiha ushinaware, ima ha heike no ichirui nomi hanjōshi te, kōbe o sashidasu mono nashi. Ika nara n sue no yo made mo, nanigoto ka ara mu to zo mie shi. Saredomo tobain, goanga no nochi ha, heikaku uchitsuzuki, shizai, rukei, kekkan, teinin, tsuneni okonaware te, kaidai mo shizuka nara zu. Seken mo sueochī se zu. Nakanzuku ni eiryaku ōhō no koro yori shite, in no kinjūsha o ba, uchi yori mikaimashi ari, uchi no kinjūsha o ba, in yori imashime raruゝ aida, shōka osore nonoi te, yasui kokoro mo nashi. Tada shin'en ni nozonde hakuhyō o fumu ni onaji, shujō jōkō, fushi no on'aida ni ha nanigoto no onhedate ka aru beki nare domo, omoi no hoka no koto domo ari keri. Kore mo yo gyōki ni oyonde, hito kyōaku o saki to suru yue nari. Shujō in no ōse o tsuneni mōshi kaesase ohashimashi keru naka ni mo, hito jimoku o odorokashi, yo motte ōkini katamuke mōsu koto ari keri.

[1.7.2] Ko konoein no kisaki, taikōtaigōgū to mōshi ha ōimikado udaijin kin'yoshi kō no onmusume nari. Sentei ni okure tatematsura se tamai te nochi ha, kokonoe no soto, konoegawara gosho ni zo utsuri sumase tamai keru. Saki no kisaki no miya nite, kasukanaru on'arisama nite watarasetamai shi ga, eiryaku no korōi ha, ontoshi nijūnisan ni mo ya narasetamai ken, onsakari mo sukoshi sugosaseowashimasu hodo nari. Saredomo, tenka daīchi no bijin no kikoe mashikere ba, shujō iro ni nomi someru mikokoro nite, hisokani kōrikishi ni mikotonorishite, gegū ni hikimotomeshimuru ni oyonde, kono ōmiya he on'ensho ari. Ōmiya aete kikoshimeshi mo irezu. Sareba, hitasura haya honi arawarete, kisaki gojudai arubeki yoshi, udaijinke ni senji o kudasaru. Konokoto tenka ni oite, kotonaru shōji nareba, kugyō sengi ari, onōno iken o iu. " mazu ichō no senshō o toburau ni, shintan no sokutenkōgō ha, tō no taisō no kisaki, kōsōkōtei no mamahaha nari. Taisō hōgyo no nochi, kōsō no kisaki ni tachi tamaeru koto ari. Sore ha ichō no senki taru ue, betsudan no koto nari. Saredomo wagachō ni ha, jinmutennō yori ikō, jinnō shichijūyodai ni oyobumade, imada nidainokisaki ni tatasetamaeru rei o kika zu. " to, shokei ichidōni mōsare keri. Jōkō mo shikarubekara zaru yoshi, koshirae mōsase tamae ba, shujō ōsenari keru ha," tenshi ni fubo nashi, ware jūzennokaikō ni yotte, banjōnohōi o tamotsu, korehodonokoto, nadoka eiryo ni makase zaru beki. " tote, yagate gojudainohi, sengeserare keru ue ha, chikaraoyoba se tamawa zu.

[1.7.3] Ōmiya kakuto kikoshimesare keru yori, onnamida ni shizumase owashimasu. Sentei ni nochisasetatematsurase ni shi kyūju no aki no hajime, onaji nohara no tsuyu to kie, ie o mo ide, yo o mo nogare tari se ba, kakaru uki mimi o ba kika zara mashi to zo, ontame ari keru. Chichi no daijin, koshirae mōsa se tamai keru ha" yo ni shitagawa zaru o motte, kyōjin to su to mie tari. Sudeni shōmei o kudasa ru. Shisai o mōsu ni tokoro nashi. Tada sumiyakani maira se tamau beki nari. Moshi miko gotanjō ari te kimi mo kokubo to iwa re gurō mo gaiso to aogaru beki zuisō ni te mo ya sō ran. Kore hitoeni gurō o tasuke sase owashimasu gokōkō no goitari naru beshi. " to mōsase tamae domo gohenji mo nakari keri. Ōmiya sono koro nanitonaki otenarai no tsuide ni,

lg.l: うきふしにしづみもやらで河竹の、世にためしなき名をやながさん。

div.p: [1.7.4] Yo ni ha ikani shite more keru yaran awareni yasashiki tameshi ni zo hitobito mōshi aeri keru.

[1.7.5] Sudeni gojudai no hi ni nari shika ba chichi no otodo gubu no kandachime, shussha no gishiki nado kokorokotoni dashitate mairase tamai keri. Ōmiya monōki goshuttatsu nare ba tomini mo tatematsura zu. Harukani yo mo fuke, sayo mo nakaba ni nate nochi, mikuruma ni nukenose rare tamai keri. Gojudai no nochi ha reikeiden ni zo mashimashi keru. Hitasura, asamatsurigoto o susume mōsase tamau owashimasusama nari. Kano shishinden no kōkyo ni ha kenjō no shōji o tate rare tari. Ijin, teigorin, guseinan, taikōbō, rokurisensei, riseki, shiba, tenaga, ashinaga, umagata no shōji, oni no ma, rishōgun ga sugata o sanagara utsuseru shōji mo ari. Owarinokami ononomichikaze ga shichikaikenjō no shōji to kakeru mo ri to zo mie shi. Kano seiryōden no gato no oshōji ni ha mukashi kanaoka ga kaki tari shi tōyama no ariake no tsuki mo ari to ka ya. Koin no imada yōshu nite mashimashi keru sonokami nanto naki otemasaguri no tsugi ni kakikumorakasase tamai shi ga arishinagara ni sukoshimo tagawa nu o goranji te sentei no mukashi mo ya okoishiku oboshimesare ken.

lg.l: 思ひきや憂き身ながらにめぐり來て、おなじ雲井の月を見むとは。

div.p: [1.7.6] Sono aida no onnakarae, īshirazu awareni yasashikari shi onkoto nari.

[1.7.7] Saruhodoni, eiman gannen no haru no koro yori shujō gofuyo no onkoto to kikoe sase tamai shi ga, natsu no hajime ni nari shika ba, koto no hoka ni omora se tamau. Kore ni yotte, ōkura no taifu ikinokanemori ga musume no hara ni, kinjō no ichinomiya no nisai ni nara se tamau ga mashimashi keru o, taishi ni tatematsura se tamau beshi to kikoe shi hodo ni, dō rokugatsu nijūgonichi, niwakani shinnō no senji kudasa re te, yagate sono yoru juzen ari shika ba, tenka nantonau awate taru sama nari. Sono toki no yūsoku no hitobito mōshiaware keru ha, honchō ni, dōtei no rei o tazunure ba, seiwatennō kyūsai ni shite, montokutennō no gozen o ukesase tamau. Sore ha ka shūkōtan no seiō ni kawari, nanmen ni shite, ichinichi banki no matsurigoto o osame tamai shi ni nazorae te, gaiso chūjinkō, yōshu o fuchishi tamae ri. Kore zo sesshō no hajime naru. Tobain gosai, konoein sansai nite senso ari. Kare o koso itsushikanari to mōshi ni, kore ha nisai ni nara se tamau. Senrei nashi. Mono sawagashi tomo orokanari.

[1.8.1] Saruhodoni, dō shichigatsu nijūshichinichi, jōkō tsuini hōgyo nari nu. Ontoshi nijūsan. Tsubomeru hana no chireru ga gotoshi. Tama no sudare, nishiki no chō no uchi, mina onnamida ni musebase tamau. Yagate, sono yoru, kōryūji no ushitora, rendaino no oku, funaokayama ni osame tatematsuru. Gosōsō no toki, enryakuji, kōfukuji no daishu, gakūchiron to iu koto shīdashite, tagaini rōzeki ni oyobu. Itten no kimi hōgyo nate nochi, gobosho he watashi tatematsuru toki no sahō ha, nanboku ni kyō no daishu kotogotoku gubushite, gobosho no mawari ni, waga teradera no gaku o utsu koto ari. Mazu shōmutennō no gogan, arasō beki tera nakereba, tōdaiji no gaku o utsu. Tsugini tankaikō no gogan tote, kōfukuji no gaku o utsu. Hokukyō ni ha, kōfukuji ni mukaete enryakuji no gaku o utsu. Tsugini tenmutennō no gogan, kyōtaikashō, chishōdaishi no sōsō tote, onjōji no gaku o utsu. Saruo sanmon no daishu, ikaga omoiken, senrei o somuite, tōdaiji no tsugi, kōfukuji no ue ni, enryakuji no gaku o utsu aida, nanto no daishu, toyasemashikauyasemashi to sengisuru tokoroni, kōfukuji no saikondō no shū, kannonbō, seishibō tote kikoetaru daiakusō futari arikeri. Kannonbō wa kuroitōdoshi no haramaki ni, shiratsuka no naginata kukimijikani tori, seishibō wa, moegiodoshi no haramaki ni, kurōrushi no ōdachi mote, futari tsuto hashirīde, enryakuji no gaku o kiteotoshi, sanzanni uchiwari," ureshiya mizu, naru wa taki no mizu, hi wa terutomo, taezu tōtae. " to hayashitsutsu, nanto no shuto no naka he zo irinikeru.

[1.9.1] Sanmon no daishu, rōzeki o itasaba, tamukesubeki tokoro ni, kokorofukō nerau kata mo ya ariken. Isshi mo dasa zu. Mikado kakure sase tamai te ha, kokoronaki kusaki made mo, uree taru iro ni te koso aru beki ni, kono sōdō no asamashisa ni, takaki mo iyashiki mo, kimotama o ushinate shihō he mina taisansu. Dō nijūkunichi no uma no koku bakari, sanmon no daishu obitadashiku gerakusu to kikoe shika ba, bushi, kebīshi, nishisakamoto ni hasemukaite, fusegi kere domo, koto tomo se zu oshiyabutte rannyūsu. Nanimono no mōshīde tari keru yaran, ichīn, sanmon no daishu ni ōsete, heike o tsuitōse raru beshi to kikoe shi hodo ni, gunbyō dairi ni sanjite, shihō no jintō o keigosu. Heishi no ichirui, mina rokuhara he haseatsumaru. Ichīn mo, isogi rokuhara he gokō naru. Kiyomorikō sonokoro, imada dainagon nite ohashikeru ga, ōini osore sawagare keri. Komatsudono" nani niyotte ka, tadaima saru koto aru beki. " to, shizumerare kere domo, jōge no noshirisawagu koto obitadashī. Sanmon no daishu, rokuhara he ha yose zu shite, suzuronaru kiyomizudera ni oshiyosete, bukkaku sōbō ichiu mo nokosa zu yakiharau. Kore ha sannuru gosōsō no yo no kaikei no haji o susugan gatame to zo kikoeshi Kiyomizudera ha, kōfukuji no matsuji taru niyotte nari Kiyomizudera yake tarikeru ashita, nanimono no waza ni ya ariken," kannon kakyōhenjōchi ha ikani" to fuda ni kaite, daimon no mae ni tate tarikere ba, tsuginohi, mata" ryakkōfushigirikifukyū" to kaeshinofuda o zo uttarikeru

[1.9.2] Shuto kaerinobori kere ba, ichīn rokuhara yori kangyo naru Shigemorikyō bakari zo, otomo ni ha mairarekeru Chichi no kyō ha maira re zu. Nao yōjin no tame ka to zo kikoe shi. Shigemorikyō, ōkuri yori kaera re tari kere ba, chichi no dainagon no tamai keru ha," ichīn no gokō koso ōkini osore oboyure. Kanete mo oboshimeshi yori, ōseraruゝ mune no are ba koso kō ha kikoyu rame, sore ni mo uchitoku tamau maji. " to notamae ba, shigemorikyō mōsa re keru ha," kono koto yumeyume onkeshiki ni mo, onkotoba ni mo dasa se tamau bekara zu, hito ni kokorozuke gao ni, nakanaka ashiki onkoto nari. Sore ni tsuke te mo eiryo ni somuki tamawa de, hito no tame ni on nasake o hodokosa se sase mashimasa ba, shinmei sanbō kago aru beshi. Sara n ni tote ha, onmi no osore sōrō maji. " tote, tata re kere ba" shigemorikyō ha, yuyushiku ōyōnaru mono kana. " to zo chichi no kyō monotamai keru.

[1.9.3] Ichīn kangyo no nochi, gozen ni utokara nu kinjūshatachi amata sōwa re keru ni," satemo fushigi no koto o mōshīdashi taru mono kana. Tsuyu mo oboshimeshiyora nu mono o. " to ōsekere ba, inchū no kirimono ni saikōhōshi to iu mono ari. Kyōsetsu gozen chikō sōrai keru ga," ten ni kuchi nashi, hito o motte iwa seyo to mōsu. Heike igai ni kabun ni sōrōaida, ten no gohakarai ni ya. " to zo mōshi keru. Hitobito" kono koto yoshinashi. Kabe ni mimi ari, osoroshi osoroshi. " to zo mōshiaware keru.

[1.10.1] Saru hodo ni, sono toshi ha ryōan nari kere ba, gokei daijōe mo okonaware zu. Dō jūnigatsu nijūyokka, kenshunmon'in sono koro ha imada higashinōnkata to mōshi keru onhara ni, ichīn no miya mashimashi keru ga, shinnō no senji kudasare tamau.

[1.10.2] Akureba, kaigen arite nin'an to gōsu. Dōnen no jūgatsu yōka, kozo shinnō no senji kōmura se tamaishi miko, higashisanjō nite tōgū ni tata se tamau. Tōgū ha ōji rokusai, shujō ha oi sansai, izuremo shōboku ni aikanawazu. Tadashi kanna ninen, ichijōin nanasai nite gosokui. Sanjōin jūissai nite tōgū ni tatase tamau. Senrei naki ni shimo ara zu. Shujō ha nisai nite gozen o uke sase tamai, wazukani gosai to mōshi nigatsu jūkunichi, tōgū senso ari shika ba, kurai o suberase tamaite, shin'in to zo mōshi keru. Imada gogenpuku mo naku shite, daijōtennō no songō ari. Kanka honchō kore ya hajime nara mu.

[1.10.3] Nin'an sannen sangatsu hatsuka, shintei daigokuden nite gosokui ari. Kono kimi no kurai ni tsuka se tama nuru ha iyoiyo heike no eiga to zo mie shi. Omogi kenshunmon'in to mōsu ha heike no ichimon nite mashimasu ue toriwaki nyūdōshōkoku no kitanokata nīdono no otoimo nari. Mata heidainagontokitadakyō to mō mo nyoin no oani nareba uchi no ogaiseki nari. Naige ni tsuketaru shikken no shin to zo mie shi. Joi jimoku to mōsu mo hitoeni kono tokitadakyō no mama nari. Yōkihi ga saiwai shi toki, yōkokuchū ga sakae shi gotoshi. Yo no oboe, toki no kira medetakari ki. Nyūdōshōkoku tenka no daishōji o notamaiawaserare kere ba, toki no hito heikanpaku to zo mōshi keru.

[1.11.1] Saru hodo ni, kaō gannen shichigatsu jūrokunichi, ichīn goshukke ari. Goshukke no nochi mo, banki no matsurigoto o kikoshimesare shi aida, innai wakukata nashi. Inchū ni chikaku meshitsukawaruru kugyō tenjōbito, shōka no hokumen ni itaru made ni, kan'i hōroku, mina mi ni amaru bakari nari. Saredomo hito no kokoro no narai nareba, nao akitara de," aware sono hito no horobi tara ba, sono kuni ha aki na n, sono hito use tara ba, sono tsukasa ni ha nari na n." " nado, utokara nu dochi ha, yoriai yoriai sasayaki aeri. Hōō mo nainai ōse nari keru ha," mukashi yori daidai no chōteki o tairaguru mono ōshi to ie domo, imada kayō no koto nashi. Sadamori, hidesato ga, masakado o uchi, yoriyoshi ga sadatō, munetō o horoboshi, yoshīe ga takehira, iehira o seme tari shi mo, kanshō okonaware shi koto, zuryō ni ha sugi zari ki. Kiyomori ga kaku kokoro no mama ni furumau koso shikarubekara ne. Kore mo yomatsu ni nari te ōbō no tsuki nuru yue nari. " to ōsenari keredomo, tsuide nakereba on'imashime mo nashi. Heike mo mata besshite chōka o urami tatematsuru koto mo nakari shi hodo ni, yo no midare some keru konpon ha inji kaō ninen jūgatsu jūrokunichi ni, komatsudono no jinan shinsanmi chūjō sukemori kyō, sono toki ha imada echizennokami tote jūsan ni narare keru ga, yuki ha hadareni furi tari keri. Kareno no keshiki makotoni omoshirokarikere ba, wakaki samurai domo sanjukki bakari meshi gushi te, rendaino ya, murasakino, ukonnobaba ni uchīde te, taka domo amata sue sase, uzura, hibari o otate ／＼, hinemosu ni kari kurashi, hakubo ni oyobide rokuhara he koso kaerare kere. Sono toki no gosetsuroku ha matsudono nite mashimashi keru ga nakamikadohigashinotōin no gosho yori gosandai ari keri. Ikuhōmon yori nyūgo aru beki nite higashinotōin o minami he ōimikado o nishi he oide naru. Sukemori ason ōimikado inokuma nite denka no oide ni hanatsuki ni mairi au. Otomo no hitobito" nanimono zo rōzeki nari. Oide naru ni norimono yori ori sōrae／＼ " to īte keredomo amarini hokori isami yō yotomo se zari keru ue meshi gushitaru samurai domo mina nijū yori uchi no wakamono domo nari reigi koppō wakimaetaru mono hitori mo nashi. Denka no oide tomo iwazu issai geba no reigi nimo oyobazu kakeyabute tōramu to suru aida kurasa ha kurashi tsuyatsuya nyūdō no mago tomo shirazu. Mata shōshō ha shi tare domo, sora shirazu shite, sukemoriason o hajime to shite, samurai domo mina uma yori totte hikiotoshi, sukoburu chijoku ni oyobi keri. Sukemoriason, hauhau rokuhara he ohashite, ōji no shōkokuzenmon ni, kono yoshi o uttae mōsare kere ba, nyūdō ōkini ikatte," tatohi denka nari tomo, jōkai ga atari o ba habakari tamau beki ni, shōsha ni sōnaku, chijoku o atae rare keru koso ikon no shidai nare." Kakaru koto yori shite, hito ni ha azamuka ruru zo. Konokoto omoishirase tatematsura de ha e koso aru majikere Denka o uramitatematsura baya " to notamae ba, shigemorikyō mōsare keru ha" kore ha sukoshimo kurushū sōmaji Yorimasa, mitsumoto nado mōsu genji domo ni azamuka re te sōwa n ni ha makotoni ichimon no chijoku demo sō beshi Shigemori ga kodomo tote sōwa nzuru mono no, denka no oide ni mairiai te, norimono yori kudari sōwa nu koso birō ni sōe " tote sono toki koto ni ōtaru samurai domo meshiyose," jikon'igo mo nanjira yokuyoku kokoroe beshi, ayamatte denka he burei no yoshi o mōsa ba ya to koso omoe. " tote kaera re keri.

[1.11.2] Sonogo, nyūdōshōkoku komatsudono ni ha ōserare mo awase zu, katainaka no samurai domo no kowaraka nite, nyūdōdono no ōse yori hoka ha, mata osoroshiki koto nashi to omō mono domo, nanba senō o hajime toshite, tsugō rokujūyonin meshiyose," rai nijūichinichi, shujō gogenpuku no onsadame no tame ni denka onde aru bekan nari. Izuku nitemo machikake tatematsuri, zenku gozuijin domo ga motodori kite, sukemori ga haji susuge. " to zo notamai keru. Denka, kore o ba yume ni mo shiroshimesa zu, shujō, myōnen gogenpuku, gokakan, haikan no gojō no tame ni, gojikiro ni shibaraku goza aru beki ni te, tsune no goshutsu yori mo hikitsukurowa se tamai, kondo ha taikenmon yori nyūgo aru beki ni te, nakamikado o nishi he goshutsu naru. Inokumahorikawa no hotori ni, rokuhara no tsuwamono domo, hitatake sanbyakuyoki machiuke tatematsuri, denka o naka ni torikome mairase te, zengo yori ichido ni, toki o do to zo tsukuri keru. Zenku gozuijin domo ga kyō o hare to shi yō zo itaru o, asoko ni oikake, koko ni oitsume, uma yori tote hikiotoshi, sanzanni ryōreki shite, ichīchini motodori o kiru. Zuijin jūnin ga naka, migi no fushō takeki ga motodori mo kirare ni keri. Sono naka ni, tōkuraudonotaifu takayoshi ga motodori o kiru tote" kore ha nanji ga motodori to omō bekara zu, shū no motodori to omō beshi." " to īfukumete kite keri. Sononochi ni mikuruma no uchi he mo yumi no hazu tsukīre nado shite sudare kanaguriotoshi miushi no shirigai munagai kirihanachi sanzanni shichirashite yorokobi no toki o tsukuri rokuhara he koso mairi kere. Nyūdō" shinmyō nari. " to zo notamai keru. Mikurumazoi ni ha inaba no saitsukai toba no kunihisamaru to iu onoko gerō nare domo nasake aru mono ni te nakinaki mikuruma tsukamatsute nakamikado no gosho he kangyo nashi tatematsuru. Sokutai no onsode nite onnamida o osae tsutsu kangyo no gishiki asamashisa mōsu mo nakanaka orokanari. Taishokukan tankaikō no onkoto ha agete mōsu ni oyobazu chūjinkō shōsenkō yori ikō sesshō kanpaku no kakaru onme ni awase tamau koto imada uketamawari oyobazu. Kore koso heike no akugyō no hajime nare.

[1.11.3] Komatsudono koso ōini sawagare kere. Yukimukai taru samurai domo mina kandō se raru. Tatoi nyūdō ikanaru fushigi o gechishi tama tomo nado shigemori ni yume o ba mise zari keru zo. Oyoso ha sukemori kikkainari, sendan ha futaba yori kōbashi to koso mie tare. Sudeni jūnisansai ni nara muzuru mono ga ima ha reigi o zonchishite koso furumau beki ni kayōni birō o genjite nyūdō no akumyō o tatsu fukō no itari nanji hitori ni ari keri. Tote shibaraku ise no kuni ni oikudasa ru. Sareba kono taishō o ba kimi mo shin mo gyokan ari keru to zo kikoe shi.

[1.12.1] Kore ni yote shujō gogenpuku no onsadame, sonohi ha nobasasetamainu Onaji nijūgonichi, in no tenjō nite zo, gogenpuku no sadame ha arikeru Sesshōdono satemo watarasetamau beki nara ne ba, onaji jūnigatsukokonoka, kensenji o kōburi, jūyokka daijōdaijin ni agarasetamau Yagate onaji jūshichinichi keimōshi ari shika domo, yononaka ha niganigashū zo mie shi.

[1.12.2] Saruhodoni konsai mo kure nu. Akere ba kaō sannen shōgatsu itsuka, shujō gogenpuku ari. Dō jūsannichi chōkin no gyōkō ari keri. Hōō, nyōin, machiuke mairase sase tamate, uikōburi no miyosōi kabakari rōtaku oboshimesare ken. Nyūdōshōkoku no onmusume, nyōgo ni mairase tamai keri. Ontoshi jūgosai. Hōō go yūshi no gi nari.

[1.12.3] Sonokoro myōon'in no daijō no ōidono, sonotoki ha imada naidaijin no sadaishō nite mashimashi keru ga, daishō o jishi mōsa se tamau koto ari keri. Toki ni tokudaiji no dainagon sanesada kyō, sono jin ni atari tamau yoshi kikoyu. Mata kazan'in no chūnagon kanemasa kyō mo shomō ari. Sono hoka, ko nakamikado no fuji chūnagon ienari kyō no sannan, shin dainagon narichika kyō mo hirani mōsa re keri. In no mikeshiki yokarikere ba samazama no inori o zo hajime rare keru. Mazu hachiman ni hyakunin no sō o komete, shindoku no daihannya o nanuka yomase rare keru saichū ni, kōra no daimyōjin no mimae naru tachibana no ki ni, otokoyama no hō yori yamabato mittsu tobikite, kuiaite zo shini keru. Hato ha hachimandaibosatsu no daīchi shisha nari. Miyadera ni kakaru fushigi nashi tote, toki no kengyō kyōsei hōin sōmon su. Jingikan ni shite miura ari. Tenka no sawagi to uranaimōsu. " tadashi kimi no tsutsushimi ni arazu, shinka no tsutsushimi. " to zo mōshikeru. Shindainagon kore ni osore o mo itasare zu, hiru ha hitome no shigekere ba, yonayona kachi nite, nakamikadokarasumaru no shukusho yori, kamo no kami no yashiro he shichiya tsuzukete mairare keri. Shichiya ni mitsuru yo, shukusho ni gekō shite, kurushisa ni, uchifushi, chito madoromi tamaeru yume ni, kamo no kami no yashiro he mairitaru to oboshikute, gohōden no mito oshihiraki, yuyushiku kedakagenaru mikoe nite.

lg.l: 櫻花賀茂の川かぜうらむなよ、散るをばえこそとゞめざりけれ。

div.p: [1.12.4] Shindainagon nao osore o mo itasare zu, kamo no kami no yashiro ni, aru hijiri o komete, gohōden no gōshiro naru sugi no hora ni dan o tatete, dakini no hō o hyakunichi okonawaserare keru hodo ni, kano ōsugi ni kaminari ochikakari, raika obitadashiku moeagatte, kyūchū sudeni ayauku mie keru o, miyabito domo ōku hashiriatsumatte, kore o uchikeshitsu. Ka no gehō okonai keru hijiri o oidase n to shi kere ba," ware tōsha ni hyakunichi sanrō no taigan ari, kyō ha shichijūgonichi ni naru." Mattaku de maji " tote hataraka zu Kono yoshi o shake yori dairi he sōmonshi kere ba" tada hō ni makasete oidase yo. " to senji o kudasaru. Sono toki jinnin shakujō o motte, kano hijiri ga unaji o shirake, ichijō no ōji yori minami he oidashite keri. Kami wa hirei o uke tamawa zu to mōsu ni, kono dainagon, hibun no taishō o inori mōsare kere ba ni ya, kakaru fushigi mo ide ki ni keri.

[1.12.5] Sonokoro no joijimoku to mōsu ha, innai no onhakarai ni mo ara zu, sesshōkanpaku no goseibai ni mo oyoba zu, tattaikkō heike no mama ni te ari shika ba, tokudaiji, kazan'in mo nari tamawa zu, nyūdōshōkoku no chakunan komatsudono, udaishō nite owashi keru ga, hidari ni utsuri te, jinan munemori, chūnagon ni owase shi ga, suhai no jōrō o chōetsu shi te, migi ni kuwawara re keru koso, mōsu bakari mo nakari shika. Naka ni mo tokudaijidono ha, ichi no dainagon nite kazoku, eiyū, saikaku yūchō, kachaku nite mashi keru ga, koe rare tamai keru koso ikon nare. Sadamete goshukke nado ya ara muzura mu to, hitobito nainai ha mōshi ae ri shika domo, shibaraku yo no nara mu sama o mi n tote, dainagon o jishi mōshite, rōkyo to zo kikoe shi.

[1.12.6] Shindainagon narichikakyō notamai keru ha," tokudaiji, kazan'in ni koe rare tara mu ha, ikaga sen. Heike no jinan ni koe raruゝ koso yasukara ne. Kore mo yorozu omō sama naru ga itasu tokoro nari. Ikanimo shite heike o horoboshi honmō o toge mu. " to notamai keru koso osoroshikere. Chichi no kyō ha chūnagon made koso itara re shika. Sono basshi nite, kurai shōnī, tsukasa dainagon ni agari, taikoku amata tamawa te, shisoku shojū chōon ni hokore ri. Nani no fusoku ni, kakaru kokoro tsukare ken. Kore hitoeni tenma no shoi to zo mie shi. Heiji ni mo, echigonochūjō tote, nobuyorikyō ni dōshin no aida, sudeni chūserarubekari shi o, komatsudono yōyōni mōshite, kubi o tsugi tamaeri. Saruni sono on o wasurete, gaijin mo naki tokoro ni heigu o totonoe, gunpyō o katarahioki, sono itonami no hoka ha taji nashi.

[1.12.7] Higashiyama no fumoto shikanotani to iu tokoro ha, ushiro ha mīdera ni tsuzuite, yuyushiki jōkaku nite zo arikeru. Shunkansōzu no sansō ari. Kare ni tsuneha yoriai／＼, heike horobosamuzuru hakarigoto o zo megurashikeru. Arutoki hōō mo gokō naru. Koshōnagonnyūdōshinzei ga shisoku, jōkenhōin goku tsukamatsuru. Sono yo no shuen ni, kono yoshi o jōkenhōin ni ōseawaserare kere ba," ana asamashiya, hito amata uketamawarisōrō nu. Tadaima morekikoe te, tenka no daiji ni oyobi sōrai nanzu. " to ōini sawagi mōshikere ba, shindainagon keshiki kawari te, sato tatare keru ga, gozen ni sōrae ru heiji o, kariginu no sode ni kake te hikitaosare tari keru o, hōō" are ha ikani. " to ōse kere ba dainagon tachikaete," heishi taore sōrai nu. " to mōsa re keru. Hōō etsubo ni ira se owashimashi te," mono domo maite sarugaku tsukamatsure. " to ōsekere ba, heihōgan'yasuyori mairi te," ā amarini heiji no ōu sōrō ni, moteyoite sōrō. " to mōsu. Shunkansōzu" sate sore o ikaga tsukamatsura muzuru. " to mōsare kere ba, saikōhōshi" kubi o toru ni ha shikaji. " tote, heiji no kubi o totte zo iri ni keru. Jōgenhōin amari no asamashisa ni, tsuyatsuya mono mo mōsare zu. Kaesugaesu mo osoroshikari shi kotodomo nari. Yoriki no tomogara daredare zo. Ōmichūjōnyūdōrenjō zokumyō masanari, hosshōji no shugyō shunkansōzu, yamashironokamimotokane, shikibunotaifumasatsuna, tairanohōgan'yasuyori, sōnohōgannobufusa, shinpeihōgansukeyuki, settsunokuni genji tadanokurandoyukitsuna o hajime to shite hokumen no tomogara ōku yoriki shi tari keri.

[1.13.1] Kono hōshōji no shugyō to mōsu ha, kyōgoku no minamoto dainagon masatoshi no kyō no mago, kidera no hōin kanga ni ha ko nari keri. Ōji dainagon saseru yumiya o toru ie ni ha ara ne domo, amarini harāshiki hito nite, sanjōbōmonkyōgoku no shukusho no mae oba, hito o mo yasuku tōsa zu, tsuneha chūmon ni tatazumi, ha o kuishibari, ikatte zo owashi keru. Kakaru hito no mago nareba niya, kono shunkan mo sō naredomo, kokoro mo takeku ogoreru hito nite, yoshinaki muhon ni mo kumishi keru ni koso. Shindainagonnarichikakyō wa tada no kurandoyukitsuna o yobite," onbe o ba, ippō no taishō ni tanomu nari. Konokoto shiōsetsuru mono nara ba, kuni o mo shō o mo shomō ni yoru beshi. Mazu yumibukuro no ryō ni. " tote, shironuno gojittan okurare tari.

[1.13.2] Angensannensangatsuitsuka, myōon'indono, daijōdaijin ni tenji tamaeru kawari ni, dainagonsadafusakyō o koete, komatsudono, naidaijin ni nari tamau. Daijin no taishō medetakari ki. Yagate taikyō okonawaru. Sonja ni ha, ōimikado sadaijin tsunemune kō to zo kikoe shi. Ichi no kami koso sendo nare domo, chichi uji no akusafu no gyorei habakari ari.

[1.13.3] Hokumen ha jōko ni ha nakari keri. Shirakawain no ontoki, hajimeokarete yori ikō, efu domo amata saburahi keri. Tametoshi, morishige, waraha yori senjumaru, imainumaru tote, korera ha saunaki kirimono nite zo ari keru. Tobain no ontoki mo, suenori, sueyori fushi, tomoni chōka ni meshitsukaware tensō suru ori mo ari nado kikoe shika domo, mina mi no hodo oba furumau te koso ari shi ni, konotoki no hokumen no tomogara ha, igaini kabun nite, kugyō tenjōbito o mo mono tomo se zu, reigi reisetsu mo nashi. Shimohokumen yori kamihokumen ni agari, kamihokumen yori tenjō no majiwari o yurusa ruru mono mo ari. Kaku nomi okonawa ruru aida, ogoreru kokoro domo mo ide ki te, yoshinaki muhon ni mo kumishi keru ni koso. Naka ni mo ko shōnagon nyūdō shinzei ga moto ni meshitsukai keru moromitsu narikage to iu mono ari. Moromitsu ha awa no kuni no zaichō, narikage ha kyō no mono, jukkon iyashiki gerō nari. Ken'eidō, moshiha kakugonja nado nite meshitsukaware keru ga sakashigari shi niyorite moromitsu ha saemonnojō tote, narikage ha uemonnojō tote, futari ichidoni yugeinojō ni nari nu. Shinzei ga koto ni ai shi toki futari tomoni shukke shite, saemonnyūdō saikō, uemonnyūdō saikei tote, korera ha shukke no nochi mo, in no mikurāzukari nite zo ari keru.

[1.13.4] Kano saikō ga ko ni, morotaka toiu mono ari. Kore mo kirimono nite, kebīshi goinojō ni heagatte, angen gannen jūnigatsu nijūkunichi, tsuina no jimoku ni kaganokami ni zo nasarekeru. Kokumu o okonau aida, hihō hirei o chōkōshi, jinja butsuji, kenmon seika no shōryō o mottōshi, sanzan no kotodomo nite zo arikeru. Tatohi shōkō ga ato o hedatsu to iu tomo onbin no matsurigoto o okonau bekari shi ni kaku kokoro no mama ni furumai shi hodo ni dō ni nen natsu no koro kokushi morotaka ga otōto kondō hōgan morotsune kaga no mokudai ni buse raru. Mokudai gechaku no hajime kokufu no hotori ni ukawa to iu yamadera ari. Jisō domo ga sakahibushi yu o wakai te abi keru o rannyū shi te oiage wagami abi zōnin domo oroshi uma arawa se nado shi keri. Jisō ikari o nashite," mukashi yori koko ha kunikata no mono nyūbu suru koto nashi. Sumiyakani senrei ni makasete, nyūbu no ōbō o todomeyo. " to zo mōshikeru. " sensen no mokudai ha, fukaku de koso iyashimaretare. Tōmokudai ha sono gi aru maji. Tada hō ni makase yo. " to iu hodo koso ari kere, jisō domo ha, kunikata no mono o oidase n to su. Kunikata no monodomo ha tsugi o motte, rannyū se n to su. Uchiai hariai shi keru hodo ni, mokudai morotsune ga hizō shi keru uma no ashi o zo uchiori keru. Sonogo ha tagaini kyūsen heijō o taishite, iai kiriai sūkoku tatakau. Mokudai kanawa ji to ya omoi ken, yoru ni irite hikinoku. Sononochi tōgoku no zaichō domo moyōshi atsume, sono sei issen'yoki ukawa ni oshiyosete, bōsha ichiu mo nokosazu yakiharau. Ukawa to iu ha, hakusan no matsuji nari. Kono koto uttae n tote susumu rōsō daredare zo. Chishaku, gakumyō, hōdaibō, shōchi, gakuon, tosājari zo susumi keru. Hakusansansha, hachīn no daishu, kotogotoku okoriai, tsugō sono sei nisen'yonin, dō shichigatsukokonoka no kuregata ni, mokudaimorotsune ga yakata chikō koso oshiyose tare. Kyō ha higure nu. Asu no ikusa to sadamete, sono hi ha yosede yurae tari. Tsuyu fukimusubu akikaze ha, imuke no sode o hirugaeshi, kumoi o terasu inazuma ha kabuto no hoshi o kagayakasu. Mokudai kanawa ji to ya omoi ken, yonige ni shite kyō he noboru. Akuru unokoku ni oshiyosete, toki o doto tsukuru. Shiro no naka ni ha oto mo se zu. Hito o ire te mise kere ba, mina ochite sō to mōsu. Daishu chikara oyoba de hikinoku. Sara ba sanmon he uttae n tote, shirayamachūgū no shin'yo o kazari tatematsuri, hieizan he furiage tatematsuru. Dō hachigatsu jūninichi no umanokoku bakari, hakusan no shin'yo, sudeni hieizan higashisakamoto ni tsukase tamau to iu hodo koso ari kere. Hokkoku no hō yori kaminari obitadashiku natte, miyako o sashite narinoboru. Shirayuki kudarite chi uzumi, sanjō rakuchū oshinabete, tokoha no yama no kozue made mina shirotae ni nari keri.

[1.14.1] Shin'yo o ba, marōdo no miya he ire tatematsuru. Marōdo to mōsu ha, hakusan myōri gongen nite ohashimasu. Mōseba fushi no onnaka nari. Senzata no seihi ha shirazu, shōzen no goetsu, tada kono koto ni ari. Urashima ga ko no shichise no mago ni aerishi ni mo sugi, tainai no mono no ryōzen no chichi o mishi ni mo koetari. Sanzen no shuto kubisu o tsugi, shichisha no jinnin sode o tsurane, jijikokkoku no hōse, kinen, gongodōdan no koto domo nari.

[1.14.2] Sanmon no daishu, kokushi kaga no kami morotaka o ruzai ni shoserare, mokudai kondō hōgan morotsune o kingoku serarubeki yoshi sōmonsu. Gosaidan osokari kere ba, samo shikarubeki kugyō tenjōbito ha," aware toku gosaikyo aru beki mono o, mukashi yori sanmon no soshō ha ta ni kotonari, ōkurakyō tamefusa, dazai no gonnosochi suenaka ha, sashimo chōka no jūshin tari shika domo, sanmon no soshō ni yotte, ruzai se rare ni ki." Iwan'ya morotaka nado ha, koto no kazu ni ya ha aru beki ni, shisai ni ya oyobu beki. " to mōshi aware kere domo," daijin ha roku o omonji te isame zu, shōshin ha tsumi ni osore te mōsa zu. " to iu koto nare ba, onōno kuchi o toji tamae ri. " kamogawa no mizu, sugoroku no sai, yamahōshi, kore zo wagakokoro ni kanawa nu mono. " to shirakawain mo ōse nari keru to ka ya. Tobain no ontoki, echizen no heisenji o, sanmon he tsuke rare keru ni ha, tōzan o gokie asakara zaru ni yote," hi o mote ri to su. " to koso senge se rare te inzen o ba kudasa re kere. Gōsotsu masafusa kyō no mōsa re shi yō ni" shin'yo o jintō he furi tatematsu te utta mōsa n ni ha kimi ha ikaga onhakarai sō beki. " to mōsa re kere ba" geni mo sanmon no soshō ha modashi gatashi. " to zo ōse keru.

[1.14.3] Kyoji kahō ninen sangatsu futsuka, minokami minamotonoyoshitsuna ason, tōgoku shinryū no shō o taosu aida, yama no kujūsha en'ō o satsugaisu. Kore ni yote hiyoshi no shashi, enryakuji no jikan, tsugō sanjūyonin, mōshibumi o sasagete jintō he sanjikeru o gonijōkanpakudono, yamatogenjinakatsukasagonnoshōyūyoriharu ni ōsete fusegaseraru. Yoriharu ga rōdō ya o hanatsu. Yaniwa ni ikorosaruru mono hachinin, kizu o kōmuru mono jūyonin, shashi shoshi shihō he chirinu. Sanmon no jōkōra, shisai o sōmon no tameni geraku su to kikoe shika ba, bushi, kebīshi, nishisakamoto ni hasemukaite mina okaesu.

[1.14.4] Sanmon ni ha, gosaidan chichi no aida, shichisha no shin'yo o konponchūdō ni furiage tatematsuri, sono gozen nite, shindoku no daihannya o nanuka yode, kanpakudono o jusoshi tatematsuru. Kechigan no dōshi ni ha, chūinhōin, sono koro ha imada chūingubu to mōshi ga, kōza ni nobori, kane uchinarashi, hyōbyaku no kotoba ni ihaku" warera natane no futaba yori ofushitate tamau kamitachi, gonijō no kanpakudono ni kaburaya hitotsu hanachiate tamae, daihachiōjigongen. " to takarakani zo kiseishi tari keru. Yagate sono yo fushigi no koto ari. Hachiōji no goten yori, kaburaya no koe idete, ōjō o sashite nan iku to zo, hito no yume ni ha mi tari keru. Sono ashita, kanpakudono no gosho no mikōshi o age keru ni, tadaima yama yori tote kitaru yōni, tsuyu ni nuretaru shikimi, hitoeda tatari keru koso osoroshikere. Yagate sannō no otogame tote gonijōnokanpakudono omoki oyamai o uke sase tamai shika ba hahaue ōtononokitanomandokoro ōini nageka se sase tamai tsutsu on'yō o yatsushi iyashiki gerō no mane o shite hiyoshi no yashiro ni gosanrō ate nanuka nanayo ga aida inorimōsase tama keri. Arawarete no oinori ni ha hyakuban no shibadengaku, hyakuban no ichimotsu, kurabeuma, yabusame, sumō onōno hyakuban, hyakuza no niōkō, hyakuza no yakushikō, isshakutehan no yakushi hyakutai, tōshin no yakushi ittai narabini shaka, amida no zō, onōno zōryū kuyō se rare keri. Mata goshinchū ni mittsu no goryūgan ari. Mikokoro no uchi no koto nare ba hito ikade shiri tatematsuru beki. Sore ni fushigi nari shi koto ha, nanuka ni mitsuru yo, hachiōji no on'yashiro ni ikura mo ari keru mairibito domo no naka ni, michinoku yori harubaru to nobori tari keru warawamiko, yowa bakari ni niwakani taeiri keri. Haruka ni kakidashi te inori kere ba hodonaku ikide te yagate tate mai kanazu. Hito kidoku no omoi o nashi te kore o miru. Hantoki bakari mai te nochi, sannō ori sase tamai te yōyō no gotakusen koso osoroshikere. " shujōra tashikani uketamaware. Ōtono no kita no mandokoro, kyō nanuka waga gozen ni komora se tama tari. Goryūgan mittsu ari. Hitotsu ni ha kondo denka no jumyō o tasukete tabe, samo sōrawa ba, geden ni sōrō morono katawaudo ni majiwate, issennichi ga aida, asayū miyazukae mōsa n to nari. Ōtono no kitanomandokoro nite, yo o yo to mo oboshimesa de, sugosa se tamau mikokoro ni, ko o omō michi ni mayoi nure ba, ibuseki koto mo wasure te, asamashigenaru katawaudo ni majiwate, issennichi ga aida, asayū miyazukae mōsa mu to ōseraru ru koso, makotoni awareni oboshimese. Futatsu ni ha, ōmiya no hatodono yori hachiōji no oyashiro made, kairō tsukutte mairase n to nari. Sanzennin no daishu, furi ni mo teri ni mo, shasan no toki itawashū oboyuru ni, kairō tsukura re tara ba, ikani medetakara n. Mittsu ni ha kondo no denka no jumyō o tasuke sase tamawa ba, hachiōji no oyashiro nite, hokkemondōkō mainichi taiten naku okona beshi to nari. Izure mo orokanara ne domo, kami futatsu ha sa naku tomo ari na n. Mainichi hokkemondōkō ha, makotoni aramahoshū koso oboshimese. Tadashi kondo no soshō ha, mugeni yasukari nubeki koto nite ari tsuru o, gosaikyo nakushite, jinnin miyazukae ikorosare, kizu o kōmuri, nakunaku maite uttae mōsu koto no amarini kokorōte, ikanara mu yo made mo wasuru beshi tomo oboe zu. Sono ue karera ni ataru tokoro no ya ha, shikashinagara wakōsuijaku no ohada ni tata ru nari. Makoto ka soragoto ka kore o miyo. " tote, kata nuidaru o mire ba, hidari no waki no shita, ōnaru kawarake no kuchi bakari ugenoite zo mie tari keru. " kore ga amarini kokorōkere ba, ikani mōshi tomo, shijū no koto ha kanau maji. Hokkemondōkō ichijō aru beku ba, sannen ga inochi o nobe te tatematsura mu. Sore o fusoku ni oboshimesa ba, chikara oyoba zu. " tote sannō agarase tamai keri. Hahaue wa goryūgan no koto, hito ni mo katarase tamawa ne ba dare morashi tsuran to, sukoshimo utagau kata mo mashimasa zu. Mikokoro no uchi no koto domo o, ari no mama ni gotakusen ari kere ba shinkan ni sōte kotoni tōtoku oboshimeshi, nakinaki mōsase tamai keru wa" tatoi ichinichi katatoki nite sōrō tomo, arigatō koso sōrō beki ni, mashite sannen ga inochi o nobe te tamara n koto shikarubeu sōrō. " tote, nakinaki gogekō ari. Isogi miyako he irasetamaite, denka no goryō kīnokuni ni, tanakanoshō to iu tokoro o, hachiōji no on'yashiro he eitai kishin se raru. Sore yori shite hokkemondōkō, ima no yo ni itaru made mainichi taiten nashi to zo uketamawaru.

[1.14.5] Kakarishi hodo ni, gonijōkanpakudono, gobyō karomasetamaite, moto no gotokuni narasetamau. Jōge yorokobi awareshi hodo ni, sannen no suguru ha yume nare ya, eichōninen ni nari ni keri. Rokugatsu nijūichinichi, mata gonijō no kanpakudono, migushi no kiwa ni ashiki mikasa dekisase tamate, uchifusase tamahi shi ga, onaji nijūshichinichi, mitoshi sanjūhachi nite tsuini kakuresase tama nu. Mikokoro no takesa, kotowari no tsuyosa, sashimo yuyushiki hito nite mashimashi kere domo, mameyakani koto no kifuni nari shika ba, mīnochi o oshimase tamahi keru nari. Makotoni oshikaru beshi. Shijū ni danimo mitase tamawa de, ōtono ni sakidachi mairase tamai koso kanashikere. Kanarazushimo chichi o sakidatsu beshi to iu koto ha nakere domo, shōji no okite ni shitagau narai, mantokuenman no seson, jūjikukyō no daishi tachi mo, chikara oyobi tamawa nu koto domo nari, jihigusoku no sannō, rimotsu no hōben nite mashimase ba, otogame nakaru beshi tomo oboe zu.

[1.15.1] Saruhodoni sanmon no daishu, kokushi kaganokami morotaka o ruzai ni shoserare, mokudai kondōhangan morotsune o kingoku serarubeki yoshi, sōmon tabitabini oyobu to iedomo, gosaikyo nakarikere ba, hiyoshi no sairei o uchitodomete, angen sannen shigatsu jūsannichi tatsu no itten ni, jūzenji, kyakujin, hachiōji sansha no shin'yo kazari tatematsurite, jintō he furitatematsuru. Shimomatsu, kiretsutsumi, kamo no kawara, tadasu, umetada, yanagihara, tōhokuin no hotori ni, shiradaishu, jinin, miyazukae, sentō michimichite, ikura to iu kazu o shirazu, shin'yo ha ichijō o nishihe irase tamau. Goshinpō ten ni kagayaite, jitsugetsu chi ni ochi tama ka to odoroka ru. Kore ni yotte, genpei ryōke no daishōgun, shihō no jintō o katamete, daishu fusegu beki yoshi ōsekudasa ru. Heike ni ha, komatsu no naidaijin no sadaishō shigemori kimi, sono sei sanzen'yoki nite, ōmiyamen no yōmei, taiken, ikuhō, mittsu no mon o katame tamau. Otōto munemori, tomomori, shigehira, oji yorimori, norimori, tsunemori nado ha, seinan no jin o katame rare keri. Genji ni ha, daidaishugo no minamotonosanmiyorimasakyō, watanabenoshōjō o mune to shite, sono sei wazukani sanbyakuyoki, kita no mon, nuidono no jin o katame tamau. Tokoro wa hiroshi, sei wa sukoshi, mabarani koso mie tari kere.

[1.15.2] Daishu buzei taru ni yote, kita no mon, nuidono no jin yori, shin'yo o ire tatematsura n to su. Yorimasakyō saru hito nite, uma yori ori kabuto o nuide, shin'yo o haishi tatematsuru. Tsuwamonodomo mina kaku no gotoshi. Shuto no naka he shisha o tateゝ, mōshiokuru mune ari. Sono tsukai wa, watanabe no chōshichiton to iu mono nari. Ton sono hi wa, kichin no hitatare ni, kozakura o ki ni kaeitaru yoroi ki te, shakudōzukuri no tachi o haki, shiraha no ya oi, shigedō no yumi waki ni hasami, kabuto o ba nugi takahimo ni kake, shin'yo no gozen ni kashikomatte mōshikeru wa," shuto no onnaka e genzanmi dono no mōse to sō. Kondo sanmon no gososhō, riun no jō mochiron ni sō. Goseibai chichi koso yoso ni te mo ikon ni oboe sōrae. Sate ha shin'yo ire tatematsura n koto shisai ni oyobi sōrawa zu. Tadashi yorimasa buzei ni sōrō. Sonōe ake te ire tatematsuru jin yori ire tamaite sōrawa ba, sanmon no daishu ha metarigahoshikeri nado, kyōwarabe no mōshisōrawa n koto, gojitsu no nan ni ya sōrawa n zuran. Shin'yo o ire tatematsura ba, senji o somuku ni nitari. Mata fusegi tatematsura ba nenrai iō, sannō ni kubi o katamuke tatematsute sōrō mi ga, kyō yori nochi, kyūsen no michi ni wakare sōrai nanzu. Kare to ī, kore to ī, katagata nanji no yōni sōrō. Higashi no jin ha, komatsudono ōzei de katame rare te sōrō. Sono jin yori ira se tamau beu mo ya sōrō ran. " to, ī okuttari kere ba, shō ga kaku iu ni fusegare te, jinnin, miyazukae shibaraku yurae tari.

[1.15.3] Wakadaishudomo wa, nande uso no gi aru beki, tada kono jin yori mikoshi o ire tatematsure. " to iu yakara ōkari kere domo, rōsō no nakani, santōichi no sengisha to kikoe shi, settsu no kenja gōun susumīdete mōshikeru wa," mottomo saiwaiare tari. Mikoshi o sakidate mairasete, soshō o itasa ba, ōzei no naka o uchiyabute koso, kōdai no kikoe mo ara muzure. Nakanzukuni kono yorimasa no kyō ha, rokusonnō yori ikō, genji chakuchaku no seitō, yumiya o totte imada sono fukaku o kika zu. Oyoso bugei ni mo kagira zu, kadō ni mo sugure tari. Konoein go zaī no toki, tōza no gokai ari shi ni,『 miyamanohana』 to iu dai o dasa re tari keru ni, hitobito yomiwazurai shi ni, kono yorimasakyō,

lg.l: 深山木のその梢とも見えざりし、櫻ははなにあらはれにけり。

div.p: [1.15.4] To iu meika tsukamatsutte, gyokan ni azukaru hodo no yasashiki otoko ni, tokini nozonde, ikaga nasakenau chijoku o ba atau beki. Kono mikoshi kakikaeshi tatematsure ya. " to sengishi kere ba, sūsennin no daishu, senjin yori kōjin made, mina mottomo to zo onaji keru. Sate mikoshi o sakidate mairase te, higashi no jintō taikenmon yori ire tatematsura n to shi kere ba, rōzeki tachimachini shuttai te, bushi domo sanzanni i tatematsuru. Jūzenji no mikoshi ni mo ya domo amata ita tari. Jinnin miyazukae ikoro sa re, shūto ōku kizu o kōmuru. Omeki sakebu koe bonten made mo kikoe, kenrōjishin mo odoroku ran to zo oboe keru. Daishu mikoshi o ba, jintō ni furisute tatematsuri, nakunaku honzan he kaeri noboru.

[1.16.1] Kurōdo no sashōben kanemitsu ni ōse te, tenjō nite, niwakani kugyō sengi ari. Hōan yonen shichigatsu ni, shin'yo juraku no toki ha zasu ni ōse te, akayama no yashiro he ire tatematsuru. Mata hōen yonen shigatsu ni, shin'yo juraku no toki ha, gion no bettō ni ōse te, gion no yashiro he ire tatematsuru. Kondo wa hōen no rei taru beshi tote, gion no bettō gonnodaisōzu chōken ni ōsete, heishoku ni oyonde, gion no yashiro e iri tatematsuru. Mikoshi ni tatsu tokoro no ya o ba, jinnin shite kore o nuka se raru. Sanmon no daishu, hiyoshi no mikoshi o jintō e furi tatematsuru koto, eikyū yori ikō, jishō made wa rokkado nari. Maido ni bushi o meshi te koso fusega re kere domo shin'yo i tatematsuru koto, kore hajime to zo tatematsuru. " ryōjin ikari o nase ba, saigai chimata ni mitsu to ie ri. Osoroshi osoroshi. " to zo hitobito mōshiawa re keru.

[1.16.2] Dō jūyokka yoru bakari, sanmon no daishu, mata geraku su to kikoe shika ba, yonaka ni shujō yōyo ni meshi te, in no gosho hōjūjidono he gyōkō naru. Chūgū wa mikuruma ni tatematsuri te gyōkei ari. Komatsu no daijin, nōshi ni ya oi te gubu se raru. Chakushi gonnosuke shōshō koremori, sokutai ni hyōkoroku oi te maira re keri. Kanpakudono o hajime tatematsuri te daijōdaijin ika no kugyō, tenjōbito, waremowaremoto hasemairu. Oyoso kyōchū no kisen, kinchū no shōka, sawaginonoshiru koto obitadashi. Sanmon ni ha shin'yo ni ya tachi, jinnin miyazukae ikorosare, shuto ōku kizu o kōmuri shika ba, ōmiya, ninomiya ika, kōdō, chūdō, subete shodō ichiu mo nokosa zu mina yakiharate, san'ya ni majiwaru beki yoshi, sanzen ichidō ni sengishi keri. Kore ni yote daishu no mōsu tokoro, on hakarai aru beshi to kikoe shika ba, sanmon no jōkō ra, shisai o shuto ni fure mu to te, tozan shi tari keru o, daishu okote nishisakamoto yori mina okaesu.

[1.16.3] Tairanodainagontokitadakyō, sono toki ha imada saemonnokami nite ohashi keru ga, shōkei ni tatsu. Daikōdō no niwa ni santō egō shi te, shōkei o tori te hiharan to su. " shiya kanmuri uchiotose, sono mi o karame te, mizūmi ni shizume yo." " nado zo sengi shi keru. Sudeni kō to mie keru ni, tokitadakyō," shibaraku shizumara re sōrae. Shuto no onnaka e mōsu beki koto ari. " tote, futokoro yori kosuzuritatamigami o toridashi, ippitsu kaite daishu no naka e tsukawasu. Kore o hiraite mire ba," shuto no ran'aku o itasu ha maen no shogyō nari. Myōō no seishi o kuwauru ha zenzei no kago nari. " to koso kaka re tare. Kore o mite, hiharu ni oyobazu, mina mottomo to dōjite, tanitani he ori, bōbō he zo iri ni keru. Isshi ikku o mote, santō sanzen no ikidōri o yasume, kōshi no haji o nogare tamae ru tokitadakyō koso yuyushikere. Hitobito mo sanmon no daishu ha hokkō no kamabisushiki bakari ka to omo tare ba, ri mo zonjishi tari keri to zo kanze rare keru.

[1.16.4] Dō hatsuka, kazan'in gonchūnagon tadachika kyō o shōkei nite, kokushi kaganokami morotaka tsuini kekkan serare te, owari no idota he nagasare keri. Mokudai kondō hangan morotsune kingoku seraru. Mata saru jūsannichi shin'yo i tatematsuri shi bushi rokunin gokujō seraru. Saemonnojō fujiwara masazumi, uemonnojō masasue, saemonnojō ōe iekane, uemonnojō dō iekuni, sahyōenojō kiyohara yasue, uhyōenojō dō yasutomo, korera ha mina komatsudono no saburai nari.

[1.16.5] Dō shigatsu nijūhachinichi inokoku bakari ni, higuchi tominokōji yori hi shuttai te, tatsumi no kaze hageshū fuki kere ba, kyōchū ōku yakeni keri. 大なる車輪の如くなるほむらが、三町五町を隔てゝ、戌亥の方へすぢかへに、飛び越え／＼燒け行けば、怖しなどもおろかなり。 或は具平親王の千種殿、或は北野の天神の紅梅殿、橘逸勢のはひ松殿、鬼殿、高松殿、鴨居殿、東三條、冬嗣の大臣の閑院殿、昭宣公の堀川殿、これを始めて、昔今の名所三十餘箇所、公卿の家だにも、十六箇所まで燒にけり。 その外殿上人、諸大夫の家々は注すに及ばず。 はては大内に吹きつけて、朱雀門より始めて、應天門、會昌門、大極殿、豐樂院、諸司、八省、朝所、一時がうちに灰燼の地とぞなりにける。 家々の日記、代々の文書、 七珍萬寶さながら塵灰となりぬ。その間の費如何ばかりぞ。人の燒け死ぬること數百人、牛馬の類は數を知らず。これ徒事にあらず、山王の御咎とて、比叡山より大なる 猿共が、二三千おりくだり、手に手に松火をともいて、京中を燒くとぞ、人の夢には見えたりける。大極殿は清和天皇の御宇、貞觀十八年に始めて燒けたりければ、同十九年正月三日、陽成院の御即位は、豐樂院にてぞありける。元慶元年四月九日事始ありて同二年十月八日にぞ造り出されたりける。後冷泉院の御宇、天喜五年二月二十六日、又やけにけり。治歴四年八月十四日事始ありしかども、造りいだされずして、後冷泉院崩御なりぬ。後三條院の御宇、延久四年四月十五日造り出して、文人詩を作り奉り、伶人樂を奏して遷幸なし奉る。今は世末になて、國の力も皆衰たれば、その後 はつひに造られず。

[2.1.1] Jishō gannen gogatsu itsuka, tendaizasu myōun daisōjō, kushō o chōji se raruゝ ue, kurōdo o otsukai nite nyoirin no gohonzon o meshikaeshite, gojisō o kaieki se raru. Sudeni shichō no tsukai o tsukete, kondo shin'yo dairi he furitatematsuru shuto no chōhon o mesare keru. Kaganokuni ni zasu no gobōryō ari. Kokushi morotaka kore o teihai no aida, sono shukui ni yotte, daishu o katarahi soshō o itasa ru. Sudeni chōka no godaiji ni oyobu yoshi, saikō hōshi fushi ga zansō ni yote, hōō ōini gekirin ari keri. Kotoni jūka ni okonawaru beshi to kikoyu. Myōun ha hōō no mikeshiki ashikarikere ba, in'yaku o kaeshi tatematsurite, zasu o jishi mōsa ru. Dō jūichinichi tobain shichi no miya, kakukaihosshinnō, tendaizasu ni nara se tamau. Kore ha shōren'in no daisōjō gyōgen no odeshi nari. Onajiki jūninichi senzasu shoshiki o todomeraruゝ ue, kebīshi futari o tsukete, i ni futa o shi, hi ni mizu o kake, suika no seme ni oyobu. Kore ni yotte, daishu nao sanraku su beki yoshi kikoe shika ba, kyōchū mata sawagi aeri.

[2.1.2] Dō jūhachinichi daijōdaijin ika no kugyō jūsannin sandai shite, jin no za ni tsuki, saki no zasu zaika no koto gijō ari. Hachijō chūnagon nagakata kyō sono toki ha imada sadaiben saishō nite matsuza ni saburaware keru ga mōsare keru ha" hōka no kanjō ni makase te shizai ittō o genji te onru se rarubeshi to mie te saburae domo zenzasu myōun daisōjō ha kenmitsu kengaku shite, jōgyō jiritsu no ue, daijō myōkyō o kōke ni sazuke tatematsuri, bosatsu jōkai o hōō ni jise tatematsuru. Mikyō no shi, mikai no shi, jūka ni okonaware n koto ha, mei no shōran hakari katashi. Genzoku onru o yurusarubeki ka. " to, habakaru tokoro mo nō mōsarekere ba, tōza no kugyō mina nagakata no gi ni dōzu to mōshiawarekere domo, hōō no goikidōri fukakarishika ba, nao onru ni sadameraru. Daijōnyūdō mo konokoto mōsan tote, insan seraretari kere domo, hōō gofū no ke tote, gozen he mo mesare tamawa ne ba, hoinagenite taishutsuseraru. Sō o tsumisuru narai tote doen o meshikaeshi, genzoku sesase tatematsuri, dainagondaisuke, fujīmatsue to zokumyō o zo tsukerare keru. Kono myōun to mōsu ha, murakamitennō daishichi no miko, tomohirashinnō yori rokudai no onsue, kogadainagon'akimichikyō no miko nari. Makotoni musō no sekitoku, tenkadaīchi no kōsō nite mashimase ba, kimi mo shin mo tōtomi tamai te, tennōji, rokushōji no bettō o mo kake tamae ri. Saredomo onmyōnokami abenoyasuchika ga mōshikeru ha" sabakari no chisha no myōun to nanori tamau koso kokoroene. Ue ni tsukihi no hikari narabete, shita ni kumo ari. " to zo nanjikeru. Nin'an gannen nigatsu hatsuka, tendai no zasu ni narase tamau. Dō sangatsu jūgonichi gohaidō ari. Chūdō no hōzō o hirakare keru ni, shuju no jūhō domo no naka ni, hōisshaku no hako ari. Shiroi nuno de tsutsuma re ta ri, isshōfubon no zasu, ka hako o ake te mi tamau ni, kōshi ni kakaru fumi ikkan ari. Dengyōdaishi, mirai no zasu no myōji o kanete shirushi okare ta ri. Waga na no aru tokoro made ha mi te, sore yori oku o ba mi zu, moto no gotoku makikaeshi te okaruゝ narai nari. Sareba kono sōjō mo, sa koso mashike me. Tafutoki hito nare domo, sense no shukugō o ba manukare tamaha zu. Aharenari shi koto domo nari.

[2.1.3] Dō nijūichinichi haisho izunokuni to sadamara ru. Hitobito samazamani mōshi aharekere domo, saikōhōshi fushi ga zansō ni yotte, kayōni okonaware keri. Yagate kyō miyako no uchi o oidasa ru beshi tote, oitate no kanjin, shirakawa no gobō ni mukatte oi tatematsuru. Sōjō naku／＼ onbō o idete, awataguchi no hotori, issaikyō no bessho he ira se tamau. Sanmon ni ha, senzuru tokoro, warera ga kataki ha, saikōfushi ni sugitaru mono nashi tote, karera oyako ga myōji o kaite, konponchūdō ni imasu jūnishinshō no uchi, konpirataishō no hidari no on'ashi no shita ni fumase tatematsuri," jūnishinshō, shichisen'yasha, jikoku o megurasa zu saikōfushi ga inochi o meshitori tamae ya. " to, wameki sakede jusoshi keru koso kiki mo osoroshikere.

[2.1.4] Dō nijūsannichi issaikyō no bessho yori haisho he omomuki tamai keri. Sabakari no hōmu no daisōjō hodo no hito o, oitate no utsushi ga sakini ketatesase, kyō o kagirini miyako o ide, seki no higashi he omomukare ken kokoro no naka suiryōrare te aware nari. Ōtsu no uchīde no hama ni mo nari shika ba, monjurō no nokiba no shirajirato shite mie keru o, futame tomo mi tamawa zu, sode o kao ni oshiate, namida ni musebi tamai keri. Sanmon ni shukurō sekitoku ōku to ie domo, chōkenhōin, sonotoki ha imada sōzu nite mashi keru ga, amarini nagori o oshimi tatematsuri, awazu made okuri mairase, satemo aru beki nara ne ba, sore yori itoma mōshi te kaera re keru ni, sōjō kokorozashi no setsunaru koto o kanji te, nenrai goshinchū ni hise rare tari shi, isshinsangan no kechimyakusōjō o sazuke raru. Kono hō ha shakuson no fuzoku, haranakoku no memyōbiku, nantenjiku no ryūjubosatsu yori shidaini sōdenshi kitareru o konnichi no jō ni sazuke raru. Sasuga wagachō ha zokusanhenji no sakai, jokusematsudai to ī nagara chōken kore o fuzokushi te hōe no tamoto o shibori tsutsu miyako he kaerinoborare keru kokoro no naka koso tōtokere. Sanmon ni ha daishu tate sengisu. " somosomo gishinkashō yori ikō, tendaizasu hajimate, gojūgodai ni itaru made, imada ruzai no rei o kika zu. Tsuratsura koto no kokoro o anzuru ni, enryaku no korohoi, kōtei ha teito o tate, daishi ha tōzan ni yojinoborite, shimyō no kyōhō o koko ni hirome tamai shi yori ikō, goshō no nyonin todaete, sanzen no jōryo kyo o shimeta ri. Mine ni ha ichijō dokuju toshihete, fumoto ni ha shichisha no reigen hiaratanari. Kano gesshi no reizan ha, ōjō no tōhoku daishō no yūkutsu nari. Kono nichīki no eigaku mo, teito no kimon ni sobadate, gokoku no reichi nari. Daidai no ken'ō chishin, koko ni danjō o shimu. Matsudai nara n karani, ikanga tōzan ni kizu oba tsuku beki. Kokoro ushi. " tote, wameki sakebi to iu hodo koso ari kere, manzan no daishu, mina higashisakamoto he orikudaru.

div.head: 2.2. 一行阿闍梨之沙汰

div.p: [2.2.1] " somosomo warera awazu he yukimukaite, kanju o ubai todome tatematsuru beshi. Tadashi oitate no utsushi ryōsōshi ari nare ba, kotoyue nau shūtoku tatematsura n koto arigatashi. Sannōdaishi no michikara no hoka ha tanomikata nashi. " makotoni betsu no shisai naku, torie tatematsuru beku ha kokonite mazu zuisō o miseshime tamahe. " to rōsō domo kantan o kudaite kinenshi keri.
