[2.2.2] Kokoni mudōji no hōshi jōen risshi ga warawa, tsurumaru tote shōnen jūhassai ni naru ga, shinshin o kurushime, gotai ni ase o nagaite, niwakani kuruidetari. Waga jūzenji norī sase tamahe ri. Matsudai to iu tomo ikadeka waga yama no kanju o ba takoku he ha utsusa ru beki. Shōjōseze ni kokorōshi. Saramu ni totte ha waga kono fumoto ni ato o todome te mo nani ni ka ha se n. " tote sayū no sode o kao ni oshiate te, namida o harahara to nagasu. Daishu kore o ayashimi te," makotoni jūzenjigongen no gotakusen nite ara ba, warera shirushi o maira se n, sukoshimo tagae zu moto no nushi ni kaeshi tamae. " tote, rōsō domo shigohyakunin, tete ni mota ru juzu domo o, jūzenji no ōyuka no ue he zo nageage taru. Kono monogurui, hashirimawate, hiroiatsume, sukoshimo tagawazu, ichīchini mina motononushini zo hodokokeru. Daishu shinmei no reigen aratanaru koto no tōtosani, mina teoawasete, zuikinokanruio zo moyōkeru. " sonogi nara ba yukimukate ubairu tatematsure." " to iu hodo koso ari kere, unka no gotoku ni hakkō su. Aru ha shiga karasaki no hamaji ni ayumi tsuzukeru daishu mo ari. Aru ha yamada yabase no kojō ni fune oshidasu shuto mo ari. Kore o mi te, sashimo kibishigenari tsuru oitate no utsushi ryōsōshi, shihō he mina nigesari nu.

[2.2.3] Daishu kokubunji he sankō. Zenzasu ōini odoroi te" chokkan no mono ha tsukihi no hikari ni danimo atara zu to koso mōse. Ikani iwan'ya, isogi miyako no uchi o oidasa ru beshi to, inzen senji no nari taru ni, shibashimo yasurau bekara zu. Shuto tōtō kaeri nobori tamae. " tote, hashijikō idete notamaeru ha" sandaikaimon no ie o idete, shimeiyūkei no mado ni irishi yori ikō, hiroku enshū no kyōhō o gakushite, kenmitsuryōshū o gakuki. Tada wagayama no kōryū o nomi omoe ri. Mata kokka o inori tatematsuru koto orosokanara zu. Shuto o hagukumu kokorozashi mo fukakari ki. Ryōsho sannō sadamete shōranshi tamau ran. Wagami ni ayamatsu koto nashi. Mujitsu no tsumi ni yotte, onru no jūka o kōmureba, yo o mo hito o mo kami o mo hotoke o mo urami tatematsuru koto nashi. Kore made otozure ki tamau shuto no hōshi koso hōji tsukushi gatakere " tote kōzome no onzo no sode shibori mo ae sase tamawa ne ba daishu mo mina namida o zo nagashi keru Mikoshi sashiyose te" tōtō mesarubeu sō. " to mōshikere ba, mukashi koso sanzen no shuto no kanju tari shi ga, ima ha kakaru runin no mi to nari te, ikaga ga yagotonaki shugakusha, chiefukaki daishu tachi ni ha kakisasage rare te ha noboru beki. Tatoe noboru beki nari tomo, kutsu nado iu mono o shibari haki, dōyō ni arukitsuzuki ite koso nobora me. " tote nori tamawazu.

[2.2.4] Kokoni saitō no jūryo, kaijōbō no ajari yūkei to iu akusō ari. Take shichishaku bakari ari keru ga, kurokawaodoshi no yoroi no, ōarame ni kogane maze taru o, kusazuri nagani kinashite, kabuto o ba nugi hōshibara ni motase tsutsu, shirae no ōnaginata o tsue ni tsuki," akerare sōrae. " tote, daishu no naka o oshiwakewake saki zasu no ohashikeru tokoro he tsuto mairi tari. Ō no manako o mīkarashi, shibaraku niramae tatematsuri," sono mikokoro de koso, kakaru onme ni mo awase tamae. Tōtō mesu beu sōrō. " to mōshikere ba, kowasa ni isogi nori tamau. Daishu shutoku tatematsuru ureshisa ni iyashiki hōshibara ni ha ara de yangotonaki shugakusha domo kakisasage tatematsuri wamekisakende agekeru ni hito ha kaware tomo yūkei ha kawara zu maegoshi kakite naginata no tsuka mo koshi no nagae mo kudakeyo to torumama ni sashimo kewashiki higashizaka hirachi o iku ga gotoku nari. Daikōdō no niwa ni koshi kakiokite sengi shikeru ha somosomo warera awazu ni ikimukite kanju o ba ubai todome tatematsuri nu. Sudeni chokkan o kōmurite ruzai serare tamau hito o toritodome tatematsurite kanju ni mochimōsan koto ikaga aru bekara n. " to sengi su. Kaijōbō ajari, mata saki no gotoku ni susumīdete sengi shi keru ha" sore tōzan ha nihon musō no reichi, chingokokka no dōjō, sannō no goikō sakarini shite, buppō ōbō gokaku nari. Sareba shuto no ishu ni itaru made sōnaku, iyashiki hōshibara made mo yo motte karoshime zu. Iwan'ya chie kōki ni shite, sanzen no kanju tari. Ima ha tokugyō omōshite issan no oshō tari. Tsumi nakushite tsumi o kōmuru. Kore sanjōrakuchū no ikidōri, kōfukuonjō no azakeri ni arazu ya. Konotoki kenmitsu no shu o ushinaite, sūhai no gakuryo, keisetsu no tsutome okotara n koto kokorōkaru beshi. Senzuru tokoro, yūkei chōhon ni shōserare, kingokuruzai mo serare, kubi o hanerare n koto, konjō no menboku meido no omoide naru beshi. " tote, sōgan yori namida o haraharato nagasu, daishu mottomo to zo onajikeru. Sore yori shite koso, yūkei o ba ikamebō to ha iwa re kere. Sore deshi ni ekeirisshi o ba, toki no hito koikamebō to zo mōshi keru.

[2.2.5] Daishu senzasu o ba, tōtō no minamidani, myōkōbō he ire tatematsuru. Toki no ōsai ha, gonge no hito mono gare tamawa zaru yaran. Mukashi daitō no ichigyōajari ha, gensōkōtei no gojisō nite mashi keru ga, gensō no kisaki yōkihi ni na o tachi tamae ri. Mukashi mo ima mo taikoku mo shōkoku mo hito no kuchi no saganasa ha atokata naki koto nari shika domo sono utagai ni yotte karakoku he nagasare sase tamau. Kudan kuni he ha mittsu michi ari. Rinchidō tote gokōdō, yūchidō tote zōnin no kayō michi, anketsudō tote jūka no mono o tsukawasu michi nari. Sareba kano ichigyōajari ha taibon no hito nare ba tote anketsudō he zo tsukawashi keru. Nanuka nanayo ga aida tsukihi no hikari o mizu shite gyōdō nari. Meimei toshite hito mo naku, kōho ni zento mayohi, shinshin toshite yama fukashi. Tada kankoku ni tori no issei bakari nite, koke no nureginu hoshi ahezu, mujitsu no tsumi ni yotte, onru no jūka o kōmuru koto o, tendō awaremi tamai te, kuyō no katachi o genji tsutsu, ichigyōajari o mamori tamau. Tokini ichigyō migi no yubi o kamikitte hidari no tamoto ni kuyō no katachi o utsusare keri Wakan ryōchō ni shingon no honzon taru kuyō no mandara kore nari

div.note: [_] [1] The kanji in our copy-text is New Nelson 3330.

div.p: [2.3.1] Daishu senzasu o toritodomuru yoshi hōō kikoshimeshite itodo yasukarazu zo oboshimesare keru Saikōhōshi mōshikeru ha" sanmon no daishu, midagahashiki uttahe tsukamatsuru koto, ima ni hajimezu to mōshinagara, kondo ha inohokani oboesōrō. Korehodo no rōzeki imada uketamawarioyobisōrawazu. Yokuyoku mīmashime sōrae. " to zo mōshikeru. Mi no tadaima horobinzuru o mo kaerimizu, sannōdaishi no shinryo ni mo kakawarazu, kayōni mōshite shinkin o nayashitatematsuru. Zanshin wa kuni o midaru to ie ri. Jitsu naru kana," sōran shigekara n to sure domo, aki no kaze kore o yaburi, ōja mei nara n to sure ba, zanshin kore o kurasu." " tomo, kayō no koto o ya mōsubeki. Konokoto shindainagon narichikakyō ika kinju no hitobito ni ōseawase rare, yama seme raru beshi to kikoe shika ba, sanmon no daishu sanomi ōji ni haramare te, shōmei o somuku beki ni ara zu tote, nainai inzen ni shitagai tatematsuru shuto mo ari nado kikoe shika ba, zenzasu myōundaisōjō ha myōkōbō ni mashike ru ga, daishu futagokoro ari to kīte," tsuini ikanaru me ni ka awa muzuran. " to, kokorobosogeni zo notamaikeru. Saredomo ruzai no sata ha nakari keri.

[2.3.2] Shindainagon narichikakyō ha, sanmon no sōdō ni yotte, watakushi shukui oba shibaraku osae rare keri. Somo naigi shitaku ha samazama nari shika domo, gisei bakari nite ha, kono muhon kanau beu mo mie zari shika ba, sashimo tanomare tari keru tadanokurandoyukitsuna, muyaku nari to omō kokoro tsuki ni keri. Yumibukuro no ryō ni, okura re tari keru nuno domo o ba, hitatare katabira ni saihō se te, ienoko rōdō domo ni kise tsutsu, me uchi shibatataki te i tari keru ga, tsuratsura heike no hanjō suru arisama o miru ni, tōji tayasuku katamuke gatashi. Yoshi naki koto ni kumishi te keri. Moshi konokoto more nuru mono nara ba, yukitsuna mazu ushinaware nanzu Tanin no kuchi yori more nu saki ni kaichū shite, inochi shō to omō kokoro zo tsuki ni keru

[2.3.3] Onaji gogatsu nijūkunichi no sayo fukagata ni, tadanokurandoyukitsuna, nyūdōshōkoku no nishihachijō no tei ni mai te," yukitsuna koso mōshi beki koto sōrōaida mai te sōrae. " to, iwase kere ba, nyūdō" tsune ni mo maira nu mono ga mai ji taru ha nanigoto zo. Are kike. " tote, shumenohanganmorikuni o idasaretari. " hitozute ni ha mōsumajiki koto nari. " to iu ma, saraba tote, nyūdō chūmon no rō he ideraretari. " yoru ha harukani fukenuran, tadaima ikani, nanigoto zo ya. " to notamaeba," hiru ha hitome no shigeu sōrōma, yoru ni magire maite sōrō. Konohodo ni inchū no hitobito no hyōgu o totonoe gunbyō o mesare sō o ba nani to ka kikoshimesa re te sō. Sore ha yamazeme raru beshi to koso kike. To ito koto mo nageni zo notamai keru. Yukitsuna chikō yori kogoe ni natte mōshikeru ha sonogi ni te ha sōwazu ikkō goikke no on'ue to koso uketamawari sōe. Sate sore o ba hōō mo shiroshimesa re taru ka. Shisai ni ya oyobi sō. Narichikakyō no gunbyō moyōsare sō mo, inzen tote koso mesare sōe. Shunkan ga to furumaite, yasuyori ga kō mōshite, saikō ga to mōshite. Nado iu kotodomo, hajime yori arinomama niha sashisugite īchirashi, itoma mōshite tote ide ni keri. Nyūdō ōini odoroki ōgoe o mote, samuraidomo yobinonoshiri tamau koto kiki mo obitadashī. Yukitsuna namajīnaru koto mōshīdeshite shōnin ni ya hikarenzuran to osoroshisa ni, ōno ni hi o hanataru kokochi shite, hito mo owanu ni shūko shite, isogi mongai he zo nigeidekeru. Nyūdō, mazu sadayoshi o meshite," tōke katamukōtosuru muhon no tomogara, kyōchū ni manmantannari. to notamaeba, Ichimon no hitobito ni mo furemōshi, samurai moyōse. " to notamaeba, hasemawatte moyōsu. Udaishō munemorikyō, sanmichūjō tomomori, tōnochūjō shigehira, samanokami yukimori ika no hitobito, katchū o yoroi, kyūsen o taishi haseatsumaru. Sonohoka gunbyō unka no gotokuni hasetsudō. Sonoyo no nakani nishihachijō ni ha, tsuwamonodomo rokushichisenki mo ara n to koso mie tari kere. Akere ba rokugatsu tsuitachi nari. Mada kurakari keru ni, nyūdō, kebīshi abenosukenari o meshi te," kito in no gosho he maire. Nobunari o maneite mōsanzuru yō ha yona, kinju no hitobito, kono ichimon o horoboshite tenka o midarantosuru kuwadate ari. Ichīchini meshitotte, tazunesata tsukamatsuru beshi. Sore o ba kimi mo shiroshimesu majiu sō to mōse. " to koso notamaekere. Sukenari isogi hasemairi, daizennodaibu nobunari yobīdete, kono yoshi mōshi ni, iro o ushinau. Gozen he maite, kono yoshi sōmonshi kere ba, hōō," awa korera ga nainai hakarishi koto no morenikeru yo. " to oboshimeshi ni asamashi. Sarunitemo," kowa nanigoto zo. " to bakari ōserare te, bunmyō no gohenji mo nakari keri. Sukenari isogi hasekaeri te, nyūdōshōkoku ni konoyoshi mōse ba," sareba koso. Yukitsuna ha, jitsu o ī keri. Konokoto yukitsuna shirase zu ba, jōkai annonni aru beshi ya. " tote, hidanokami kageie, chikugonokami sadayoshi ni ōsete, muhon no tomogara karameto beki yoshi gechi se raru. Yotte nihyakuyoki, sanbyakuyoki, asoko kokoni oshiyose々 oshiyose々 karametoru.

[2.3.4] Daijōnyūdō mazu zōshiki omote, nakamikado karasumaru no shindainagon narichikakyō no moto he," mōshiawasu beki koto ari. Kito tachiyore tamae. " to notamai tsukawasare tari kere ba, dainagon wagami no ue to ha, tsuyu shira zu," aware kore ha hōō no yama seme raru beki yoshi, gokekkō ari o, mōshi todome rare nzuru ni koso. On ikidōri fukage nari. Ikanimo kanau majiki mono o. " tote, naikiyogenaru hoi taoyakani kinashi, azanaru kuruma ni nori, saburai san'yonin meshigushite, zōshiki ushikai ni itaru made, tsune yori mo hikitsukuroware tari. Somo saigo toha nochini koso omoishire kere. Nishihachijō chikō natte mitamaeba, shigochō ni gunbyō manmantari. Ana obitadashi. Ko ha nanigoto yaran to, mune uchisawagi, kuruma yori ori, mon no uchi ni sashīrete mitamaeba, uchi ni mo, tsuwamonodomo suki hazama mo na zo manmantaru. Chūmon no kuchi ni kowagenaru bushidomo, amata machiukete, dainagon no sayū no te o totte hippari," shibabeu sōran. " to mōshi, nyūdōshōkoku renchū yori mīdashite," aribeumo nashi. " to notamae ba, bushi domo zengosayū ni tachikakomi, en no ue ni hikinobose te, hitoma naru tokoro ni oshikomete keri. Dainagon yume no kokochi shite, tsuyatsuya mono mo oboe tamawa zu. Tomo nari tsuru samurai domo, oshihedaterare te, sanzan ni natta. Zōshiki ushikai iro o ushinai, gissha o sute nigeininu.

[2.3.5] Saru hodo ni, ōmichūjō nyūdō renjō, hosshōji shugyō shunkan sōzu, yamashironokami motokane, shikibunotaifu masatsuna, heihōgan yasuyori, sōhōgan nobufusa, shinheihōgan sukeyuki mo, toraware te dekitari.

[2.3.6] Saikōhōshi konokoto kikite wagami no ue to ya omoi ken muchi o age in no gosho hōjūjidono he hasemairu. Heike no samuraidomo michi nite hasemukai" nishihachijō he mesaruru zo. Kito maire. " to īkere ba" sōsu beki koto arite hōjūjidono he mairu. Yagate koso maira me. " to ihikere ba," warui nyūdō kana. Nanigoto o ka sōsu bekan naru. Sa nai hase so. " tote, uma yori totte hikiotoshi, naka ni shibatte, nishihachijō he sagete mairu. Hi no hajime yori kongen yoriki no mono nari kere ba, kotoni yō shibatte, tsubo no uchi ni zo hikī taru. Nyūdōshōkoku ōyuka ni tate," nyūdō katamukō to suru yatsu ga nareru sugata yo. Shatsu koko he hikiyose yo. " tote, en no kiwa ni hikiyosesase, mono haki nagara, sha hō o muzumuzuto zo fumare keru. " moto yori onorera ga yō naru gerō no hate o kimi no meshitsukawa se tamai te, nasarumajiki kanshoku o nashi tamabi, fushi tomoni kabun no furumai o suru to mishi ni awasete, ayamatanu tendaizasu ruzai ni mōshīkī, tenka no daiji o hikīdeite, amatsusae kono ichimon o horobosubeki muhon ni kumishite keru yatsu nari. Ari no mama ni mōse. " to koso notamai kere. Saikō moto yori suguretaru taigō no mono nari kere ba chito mo iro mo henze zu, warubiretaru keiki mo nashi. Inaori, azawaraite mōshikeru ha" samo sōzu, nyūdōdono koso kabun no koto o ba notamae. Tanin no mae ha shirazu, saikō ga kikan tokoro ni sayō no koto o ba, e koso notamau majikere. Inchū ni meshitsukaururu mi nare ba, shitsuji no bettō narichikakyō no inzen tote mo yohosare shi koto ni kumise zu to ha mōsubeki yō nashi. Sore ha kumishi tari. Tadashi mimi ni todomaru koto o mo notamau mono kana. Onhe ha ko gyōbukyō tadamori no ko de mashika domo, jūshigo made ha shusshi mo shi tamawa zu, ko nakamikado fuji chūnagon ienari kyō no he ni tachīri tamai shi o ba, kyōwarawabe ha takaheita to koso ī shika. Hōen no koro, daishōgun uketamawari kaizoku no chōhon sanjūyonin, karameshinze rare tari shi shō ni shihon shite, shī no hyōenosuke to mōshi shi o dani, kabun to koso toki no hitobito ha mōshiaware shika. Tenjō no majiwari o dani kiraware shi hito no shison nite daijōdaijin made nariagataru ya kabun naru ran. Saburaihon no mono no, zuryōkebīshi ni naru koto, senrei bōrei naki ni arazu. Najikaha kabun naru beki. " to, habakaru tokoro nau mōshikere ba, nyūdō amarini ikate, mono mo notamawa zu. Zanshi arite" shatsu ga kubi sōnau kirina. Yokuyoku imashimeyo. " to zo notamaikeru. Matsūratarōshigetoshi uketamawarite, ashite o hasami samazamani itaburu. Motoyori arasogai mōsa nu ue, kyūmon ha kibishikari keri. Nokorinau koso mōshikere. Hakujō shigomai ni shirusare, yagate, shatsu ga kuchi o sake tote, kuchi o sakare, gojōsuzaku nite, kirare ni keri. Chakushi zen kaganokami morotaka, owari no idota e nagasa re tari keru o, dōkoku no jūnin kogoma no gunji korekiyo ni ōsete utare nu. Jinan kondō hōgan morotsune kingoku se rare keru o, goku yori hikidasa re, rokujōgawara nite chūse raru. Sono otōto saemonnojō morohira, rōdō sannin, onajiku kubi o hanerare keri Korera ha iu kai naki mono no hīdete, irofu majiki koto ni irohi, ayamatanu tendaizasu ruzai ni mōshiokonai, kahō ya tsukini ken, sannō daishi no shinbatsu myōbatsu o tachidokoro ni kōmurite, kakaru me ni aeri keri

[2.4.1] Shindainagon ha hitoma naru tokoro ni oshikomerare, asemizu ni nari tsutsu, aware kore ha higoro no arimashi koto no morekikoe keru ni koso Dare morashi tsuran. Sadamete hokumen no monodomo ga naka ni koso ara mu nado, omowa ji koto nau anjitsuzuke te zake ru ni, ushiro no hō yori ashioto no takaraka ni shi kere ba, suwa tadaima wa inochi o ushinawa mu tote, bushidomo ga mairu ni koso to machitama ni, nyūdō mizukara itajiki takaraka ni fuminarashi, dainagon no zake ru ushiro no shōji o sato ake rare tari. Soken no kinu no mijirakanaru ni, shiroki ōkuchi fumikukumi, hijirizuka no katana oshikutsurogete sasu mama ni, inohokani ikareru keshiki nite, dainagon o shibaraku niramae," somosomo onhe ha heiji ni mo sudeni chūserarubekarishi o, naifu ga mi nikaete mōshiyurushi, kubi o tsugitatemashi ha ikani. Nani no ikon o motte, kono ichimon horobosubeki yoshi gokekkō ha sōrakeru yaran. On o shiru o hito to ha iu zo, on o shiranu o ba chikushō to koso ie. Saredomo tōke no unmei tsuki zaru ni yotte, mukae tatematsu tari. Higoro no go kekkō no shidai, jikini uketamawara n. " to zo notamaikeru. Dainagon" mattaku saru koto sōrawa zu. Hito no zangen nite zo sōra mu. Yokuyoku otazune sōrae. " to mōsare kere ba, nyūdō koto se mo hatasazu. " hito ya aru, hito ya aru. " to mesare kere ba, sadayoshi mairi tari. " saikō me ga hakujō mairase yo. " to ōserarekere ba, motemairi tari. Kore o totte nisanhen oshikaeshikaeshi yomikikase," ana nikuya, konōe ha nanto chinzu beki. " tote, dainagon no kao ni sato nagekake, shōji o chōto tatete zo derare keru. Nyūdō nao hara o ikanete," tsunetō, kaneyasu" to mese ba, seotarō, naniwajirō, mairi tari. " to notamae ba konokoto ashikari nan to ya omoi ken, futari no monodomo tachiagatte, dainagon o niwa he hikiotoshi tatematsuru. Sonotoki nyūdō kokochiyogenite," totte fusete, wamekaseyo. " to zo notamaikeru. Futari no mono domo, dainagon no sayū no mimi ni kuchi o ate," ikayō ni mo onkoe no de beu sō. " to sasayaite hikifushi tatematsure ba, nikoe sankoe zo wamekarekeru. Sonotei, meido nite shabasekai no zainin o, aruiha gō no hakari ni kake, aruiha jōharikyō ni hikimukaete, tsumi no keichō ni makase tsutsu, abōrasetsu ga kashaku suran mo, kore ni ha sugiji to zo mieshi. Shōhan toraware torawarete kanhō sokai tari. Chōsaku riku o uke te shūgi tsumi se raru. Tatoeba, shōka, hankai, kanshin, hōetsu, korera ha mina kōso no chūshin nari shika domo, shōnin no zan ni yotte, kahai no haji o uku tomo, kayō no koto o ya mōshi beki.

[2.4.2] Shindainagon wa wagami no kaku naru ni tsuke te mo shisoku tanba no shōshō naritsune ika osanaki hitobito ikanaru me ni ka awa n to omoiyaru ni mo obotsukanashi Sabakari atsuki rokugatsu ni shōzoku dani mo kutsuroge zu atsusa mo taegatakere ba mune sekiagaru kokochi shite ase mo namida mo arasoi te zo nagare keru. " sari tomo komatsudono wa oboshimeshi hanata ji mono o. " to notamae domo dare shite mōsubeshi to oboetamawazu.

[2.4.3] Komatsudaijin ha sononochi harukani hodohete, chakushi gonnosukeshōshō kuruma no shiri ni nose tsutsu, efu shigonin zuijin nisannin meshigushite, tsuwamono hitori mo meshiguserarezu, kotoni ōyōgede washimashitari. Nyūdō o hajimetatematsurite, hitobito mina omowazugeni zo mitamaikeru. Kuruma yori oritamau tokoro ni, sadayoshi tsuto mairite" nado korehodo no ōdaiji ni gunbyō o ba hitori mo meshiguserare sōrawa nu zo. " to mōse ba" daiji to ha tenka no daiji o koso ie, kayō no watakushigoto o daiji to īyō ya aru. " to notamae ba, hyōjō o taishi tari keru mono domo mo sozoroite zo mie keru. Somo dainagon o ba izuku ni oka re taru yaran to, kokokashiko no shōji hikiake／＼ mi tamae ba, aru shōji no ue ni kumode musu taru tokoro ari. Koko yaran to te akera re tare ba, dainagon mashi keri. Namida ni musebi utsubushite, me mo miawase tamawa zu. " ikani ya. " to notamae ba sono toki mitsuke tatematsuri ureshigeni omowa re taru keshiki jigoku nite zainin domo ga jizō bosatsu o mi tatematsuru ran mo kaku ya to oboe te awarenari. " nanigoto nite sō yaran, kakaru me ni ai sō. Sate watara se tamae ba sari tomo to koso tanoma irase te sōrae. Heiji nimo sudeni chūse raru beki nite sō shi ga gōn o motte kubi o tsuga re mairase shōnī no dainagon ni nobotte sai sudeni shijū ni amari sō. Gōn koso shōjōseze nimo hōji tsukushi gatō sōrae. Kondo mo onajiku ha kainaki inochi o tasuke sase imasase. Inochi dani ikite sōrawa ba, shukke nyūdō shite, kōyakokawa ni tojikomori, gose bodai no gon o itonami sōrawa n. " to zo mōsare kere ba," sa sō tomo, on'inochi ushinai tatematsuru made ha yomo sōrawa ji. Tatoe sa ha sō tomo, shigemori kōte sōrae ba, on'inochi ni mo kawari tatematsuru beshi. " tote ide rare keri. Chichi no zenmon no gozen ni zashite," ano narichikakyō useren koto, yokuyoku gohakarai sōbeshi. Senzo shuridaibu akisue, shirakawain ni meshitsukawarete yori ikō, ie ni sorei naki shōnī no dainagon ni nobotte, tōji kimi musō no goitōshimi nari. Yagate kubi o haneraren koto, ikaga saburaubekaran. Miyako no soto he dasaretaran ni kototari sōnan. Kitanotenjin ha tokihiradaijin no zansō nite, ukina o shikai no nami ni nagashi, nishinomiya no daijin ha, tadamitsunaka ga zangen nite, urami o san'yō no kumo ni yosu. Onōno mujitsu nari shika domo, ruzai se rare tamai ni ki. Kore mina engi no seidai, anna no mikado no onhigagoto to zo mōshitsutae taru. Jōko nao kaku no gotoshi. Iwan'ya matsudai ni oite o ya. Sudeni meshiokare nuru ue ha, isogi ushinaware zu domo, nani no kurushimi ka sōrae beki. 『 kei no utagawashiki o ba karonze yo. Kō no utagawashiki o ba omonze yo. 』 to koso mie sōrae. Koto atarashiku sōrae domo shigemori kano dainagon ga imōto ni aigushite sōrō. Koremori mata muko nari. Kayōni shitashiku natte sōrae ba mōshi to ya oboshimesare sōran Sonogi de ha sōwa zu Yo no tame kimi no tame ie no tame no koto o motte mōshi sō Ichinen ko shōnagon nyūdō shinzei ga shikken no toki ni atatte wagachō ni ha sagakōtei no ontoki uhyōenokami fujiwaranonakanari o chūrarete yori irai hōgen made ha kimi nijūgodai no aida okonawarezarishi shizai o hajimete shugyōi uji no akusafu no shigai o horiokoite jikkenseraretarishi koto nado ha amarunaru onmatsurigoto to koso oboe sōshika Sareba inishie no hitobito mo『 shizai o okonaeba kaidai ni muhon no yakara taezu to』 ī. 』 koso mōshitsutaete sōrae. Kono kotoba ni tsukete, naka ni toshi arite heiji ni mata yo midarete, shinzei ga uzumoretarishi o horidashi, kubi o hanete ōji o watasare sōraeniki. Hōgen ni mōshiokonaishi koto, ikuhodo mo naku, mi no ue ni mukawariniki to omoeba, osorō koso sōraeshika. Kore ha saseru chōteki ni mo arazu. Katagata osore aru beshi. Goeiga nokoru tokoro nakereba, oboshimesu koto aramajikere domo, shishisonson mademo hanjō koso aramahoshū sōrae. Fuso no zen'aku ha, kanarazu shison ni oyobu to miete sōrō. Sekizen ie kanarazu yokei ari sekiaku mon niha kanarazu yōu todomaru to koso uketamaware. Ikayō nimo, kon'ya kubi haneraren koto ha, shikarubeu sōrawazu. " to mōsarekereba, nyūdōshōkoku genimo to ya omowareken, shizai ha omoi todomarinu.

[2.4.4] Sononochi daijin chūmon ni ide te saburai domo ni notamaikeru ha" ōse nare ba tote dainagon sō nau ushinau koto aru bekara zu. Nyūdō hara no tachi no mama ni monosawagi koto shi tamaite ha nochini kanarazu kuyashimi tamau beshi. Higagoto shite ware uramina. " to notamae ba tsuwamonodomo, mina shita o furuite osoruononoku. " satemo tsunetō, kaneyasu ga kesa dainagon ni nasakenau atari keru koto kaesugaesumo kikkai nari. Shigemori ga kikan tokoro o ba nado ka ha habakara zaru beki. Katainaka no mono ha kakaru zo to yo. " to notamae ba, naniwa mo seo mo, tomoni osoreiritari keri. Daijin ha kayōni notamaite, komatsudono he zo kaerare keru. Saruhodoni dainagon no tomonaritsuru samurai domo, nakamikadokarasuma no shukusho he hashirikaerite, kono yoshi mōse ba, kitakata ika no nyōbōtachi, koe mo oshimazu nakisakebu. Sudeni bushi no mukai sō. Shōshōdono o hajimemairasete, kindachi mo toraresasetamau beshi to koso kikoe sōrae. Isogi izukata he mo shinobasetamae. " to mōshikere ba," imaha korehodo no mi ni natte, nokoritodomaru mi totemo, annonnite nanikaha sen. Tada onaji hitoyo no tsuyu tomo kien koto koso hoi nare. Satemo kesa o kagiri to shira zari keru kanashisa yo. " tote, fushimarobi te zo naka re keru. Sudeni bushi domo no chikazuki yoshi kikoe shika ba, kakute mata hajigamashiku utateki me o mi n mo sasuganareba tote, jū ni naritamau onnago, hassai no otokogo kuruma ni torinose, izuku o sashitomonaku yaridasu. Satemo arubekinaraneba, ōmiya o noborini, kitayama no hotori unrin'in he zo mashikeru. Sonohotori naru sōbō ni oroshiokitatematsurite, okurinomonodomo, mi no sutegatasa ni, itomamōshite kaerikeri. Ima wa osanaki hitobito bakari nokorī te, mata koto tofu hito mo naku shite ohashike n kitanokata no kokoro no naka, oshihakara re te awarenari. Kureyuku kage o mitamafu ni tsukete wa, dainagon no tsuyu no inochi, kono yufube o kagiri nari to, omohiyaru ni mo kienu beshi. Nyōbō saburai ōkari kere domo, mono o dani torishitatame zu, mon o dani oshimotate zu. Uma domo ha umaya ni narabitachi tare domo, kusa kau mono hitori mo nashi. Yoru akere ba basha mon ni tachinami, hinkyaku za ni tsuranete, yūgire maiodori, yo o yo to mo omoi tamawa zu, chikaki katawara no hito ha, mono o dani takaku iwa zu, fuite koso kinō made mo arishi ni, yoru no aida ni kawaru arisama, jōsha hissui no kotowari ha me no mae ni koso araware kere. Raku tsukite ai kitaru to kakaretaru kōshōkō no fude no ato, ima koso oboshirarekere

[2.5.1] Tanbanoshōshōnaritsune ha sonoyo shimo in no goshohōjūjidono ni noborifushite mada iderarezarikeru ni dainagon no saburaidomo isogi gosho he hasesanjite shōshōdono o yobīdashitatematsuri konoyoshi mōshini" nadoya saishō no moto yori imamade tsugejizaruran " to notamaimohateneba saishōdono yori tote tsukai ari Konosaishō to mōsuha nyūdōshōkoku no otōto nari shukusho ha rokuhara no sōmon no uchi nareba kadowaki no saishō to zo mōshikeru Tanbanoshōshō ni ha shūto nari " nanigoto nite sō yaran, nyūdōshōkoku no kito nishihachijō he gushi tatematsure to sō to mōse. " to i wase rare tari kere ba, shōshō konokoto kokoroe te, kinju no nyōbōtachi yobidashi tatematsuri," yobe nantonau yo no monosawagau sō shi o, rei no yamahōshi no kudaru ka to yoso ni omo te sō he ba, haya naritsune ga minōe nite sō hi keri. Dainagon yosari kira ru beu sōnare ba, naritsune mo dōzai nite koso sōwa nzurame. Imaichido gosho he maite, kimi o mimairase tō sōe domo, sudeni kakaru mi ni makarinate sōe ba, habakari zonjisō. " to zo mōsare keru. Nyōbōtachi gozen e mairi, kono yoshi sōse rare kere ba, hōō ōini odoroka se tamate, sareba koso kesa no nyūdōshōkoku ga tsukai ni haya gokokoroe ari. " awa korera ga nainai hakarigotoshi koto no moreni keru yo. " to oboshimesu ni asamashi. " sarunitemo kore e. " to mikeshiki arikere ba, mairare tari. Hōō mo onnamida o nagasase tamai te, ōsekudasaruru mune mo nashi. Shōshō mo namida ni musede mōshiaguru mune mo nashi. Yokuarite satemo arubekinaraneba shōshō sode o kao ni oshiatete, nakinaki makarīderarekeri. Hōō ha ato o harukani goranjiokurasetamaite, matsudai koso kokorōkere, kore kagiri de mata goranzenu koto mo ya aranzuran tote, onnamida o nagasasetamai zo katajikenaki. Inchū no hitobito, shōshō no sode o hikae, tamoto ni sugatte nagori o oshimi, namida o nagasanu ha nakarikeri.

[2.5.2] Shūto no saishō no moto he ide rare tare ba, kitanokata ha chikō sansu beki hito nite goza keru ga, kesa yori kono nageki o uchisoete, sudeni inochi mo kieiru kokochi zo se rare keru. Shōshō gosho o makaride tsuru yori, nagaruru namida tsuki se nu ni, kitanokata no arisama o mi tamai te ha itodo senkata nageni zo mie rare keru. Shōshō uba ni rokujō to iu nyōbō ari. " ochichi ni mairisome sō ra hi te kimi o chi no naka yori dakiage mai te tsukihi no kasanaru ni shitagai te wagami no toshi no yuki o ba nagezu shi te kimi no seijin shū nase tamau koto o nomi ureshū omoi tatematsuri shiraji to ha omoe domo sudeni nijūichinen katatoki mo hanare mairase zu. Innai he mairase tamai te osō desase tamau dani mo obotsukanau omoi mairasuru ni ikanaru onme ni ka awase tamawa n zu ran. " to naku. Shōshō," itana nageso. Saishō sate suware ba, inochi bakari ha sari tomo koiuke tamawa n zuran. " to, nagusame tamae domo, hitome mo shirazu, nakimodae keri.

[2.5.3] Nishihachijōdono yori, tsukai shikinamini arikere ba, saishō" yukimukau te koso, tomokaumo name. " tote idetamaeba shōshō mo saishō no kuruma no ushiro ni notte zo iderarekeru. Hōgen heiji yori irai, heike no hitobito, rakuei nomi atte, shūtan ha nakarishini, kono saishō bakari koso, yoshinaki muko yueni, kakaru nageki oba serarekere. Nishihachijō chikōnatte, kuruma o tome, mazu annai o mōshīrerarekereba, daijōnyūdō" tanbashōshō oba konōchi heha hairarubekarazu. " to notamauma, sonohen chikaki samurai no ie ni oroshiokitsutsu, saishō bakari zo mon no uchi heha iritamau. Shōshō oba, itsushika tsuwamonodomo uchikakonde shugoshitatematsuru. Tsukaretsuru saishōdono ni ha hanare tamai nu. Shōshō no kokoro no naka, sakoso ha binnari keme. Saishō chūmon ni i tamai tare ba, nyūdō taimen shi tamawa zu. Minamotonodaibuhangankanesada o mote mōshīrerare keru ha," yoshinaki mono ni shitaunate, kaesugaesu kuyashiu sōrae domo, kai mo sōrawa zu. Aigusesasete sōrō mono no, konohodo nayamu koto no sōnaru ga, kesa yori kono nageki o uchisoete ha sudeni inochi mo taenanzu. Nani ka ha kurushū sō beki. Shōshō o ba shibaraku norimori ni azuke sase owashimase. Norimori kōte sōe ba, najika ha higagoto se sase sō beki. " to mōsare kere ba, kiyosada maite kono yoshi mōsu. " aware reino saishō ga, mono ni kokoroe nu. " tote tomini henji mo shi tamawa zu. Yayārite nyūdō notamaikeru ha" shindainagonnarichika, kono ichimon o messhite tenka o midamuto suru kuwadate ari. Kono shōshō ha sudeni kano dainagon ga chakushi nari. Utō mo are, shitau mo are, e koso mōshinadamu majikere. Moshi kono muhon toge mashika ba, onhotori totemo odashiu ya owasu beki to mōse. " to koso notamai kere. Suesada kisan te kono yoshi saishōdono ni mōshikere ba, makotoni hoinageni te, kasanete mōsare keru ha" hōgen heiji yori ikō, tabitabino kassen ni mo, on'inochi ni kawari mairase n to koso zonjisōrae. Kononochi mo araki kaze oba mazufusegi mairase sōrawanzuru ni tatohi norimori koso toshioite sōrō tomo wakaki kodomo amata sōrae ba ippō no okatame ni ha nadoka narade sōrō beki Sore ni naritsune shibaraku azukarau to mōshi o oire naki ha norimori o ikkō futagokoroaru mono to oboshimeshi ni koso Korehodo ushirometau omoware mairasete ha yo ni arite mo nanini ka ha shi sōrō beki Ima ha tada mi no itoma o tamahite shukkenyūdōshi katayamazato ni komorite hitosujini gose bodai no tsutome o itonami saburahan Yoshinaki ukiyo no majihari nari. Yo ni areba koso nozomi mo are, nozomi no kanahaneba koso urami mo are. Shikaji ukiyo o itohi makoto no michi ni iranan ni ha. " to zo notamahikeru. Suesada maitte," saishaudono ha haya oboshimeshikitte sau zo. Tomokaumo yokiyau ni onhakarahi saurahe. " to maushikere ba, nyūdau, ohoini odoroi te," sarebatote shukkenyūdau made ha amarini keshikara zu. Sonogi nara ba, seushau o ba shibaraku onhe ni azuke tatematsuru to ihi beshi. " to koso notamahikere. Suesada kaeri maite, saishōdono ni kono yoshi mōse ba," aware hito no ko o ba mota majikari keru mono kana." Waga ko no enishi ni musubare zara n ni ha, kore hodo kokoro o ba kudaki mono o." " tote ide rare keri.

[2.5.4] Shōshō machiuke tatematsurite," sate ikaga sō tsuru," to mōsa re kere ba," nyūdō amarini hara o tatete, norimori niha tsuini taimen mo shi tamawa zu. Kanau majiki yoshi shikirini notamai tsure domo, shukke nyūdō made mōshi tare ba niya ran, shibaraku shukusho ni oki tatematsure to notamai tsure domo, shijū yokaru beshi tomo oboe zu. " shōshō, sa sōrae ba koso naritsune mo gōn o mote shibaraku no inochi mo nobusōrawa nzuru ni koso. Sore ni tsuki sōrate ha dainagon ga koto o ba ikaga kikoshimesare sōro zo. Sore made ha omoi mo yose zu. To notamae ba sonotoki namida o harahara to nagare te" makotoni gōn o motte shibashi no inochi mo iki sōrawa nzuru koto ha shikarubeu sōrae domo inochi no oshiu sōrō mo chichi o imaichido mi baya to omō tame nari. Dainagon ga kire sōrawa n ni oite ha naritsune totemo kainaki inochi o ikite nani ni ka ha shi sōrō beki. Tattahitotokoro de ikanimo naru yō ni mōshite tabase tamau beu ya sōran " to mōsare kere ba saishō yonimo nigagenite" isatoyo, onhe no koto o koso tokau mōshi tsure Sore made ha omoi mo yorane domo dainagondono no onkoto o ba kesa uchinōtodo no samazamani mōsare kere ba sore mo shibaraku ha kokoroyasui yō ni koso uketamaware " to notamae ba shōshō nakinaki te o awasete zo yorokobe keru " ko nara zara n mono ha tare ka tadaima wagami no ue o sashioite korehodo made ha yorokobi beki Jitsu no chigiri ha oyako no naka ni zo ari keru. Ko o ba hito no motsu bekari keru mono kana. " to yagate omoi zo kaesa re keru. Sate kesa no gotoku ni dōsha shite kaera re keri. Shukusho ni ha nyōbōtachi, shi daru hito no iki kaeri taru kokochi shite, sashi tsudoi te mina yorokobi naki domo se rare keri.

div.head: 2.6. 教訓状

div.p: [2.6.1] Daijōnyūdō wa kayōni hitobito amata karameokite mo nao kokoroyukazu ya omoware ken. Sudeni akaji no nishiki no hitatare ni, kuroitōdoshi no haramaki no, shiroganemono utaru munaita semete, sennen akinokami tarishi toki, jinpai no tsugi ni, reimu o kōmurite, itsukushima no daimyōjin yori geni tamawari tarikeru shirogane no hirumaki shitaru konaginata, tsuneno makura o hanasazu taterare tarishi o wakibasami, chūmon no rō e zo iderare keru. Sono keshiki ōkata yuyushū zo mie shi. Sadayoshi o mesu. [_] [2] chikugonokami sadayoshi ha mokuranji no hitatare ni hiodoshi no yoroi ki te, gozen ni kashikomatte sōrō. Yaya ate nyūdō notamakeru ha" sadayoshi, konokoto ikaga omō. Hōgen ni tairanōmanosuke o hajime toshite ichimon hansugite shin'in no onkata he mai ni ki. Ichinomiya no onkoto ha kogyōbukyōdono no yashinaigimi nite owaishikaba katagata mihanachi mairasekatakashidomo koin no goyuikai ni makasete mikata nite sakiokaketariki. Kore ichi no hōkō nari. Tsugini heiji gannen jūnigatsu nobuyori yoshitomo ga innai o toritatematsuri daidai ni tatekomori tenka kokuan to nashini nyūdō mi o sute kyōto o oiotoshi tsunemune korekata o meshikarashi ni itarumade sudeni kimi no ontame ni inochi o ushinawantosuru koto tabitabi ni oyobu. Tatoi hito nani to mōsu tomo, shichidai made ha kono ichimon o ba ikade ka sute sase tama beki. Sore ni narichika to iu muyō no adamono, saikō to iu gesen no futōnin me ga mōsu koto ni tsuka se tama te, kono ichimon o messu beki yoshi, hōō no gokekkō koso ikon no shidai nare. Kononochi mo zansō suru mono ara ba tōke tsuitō no inzen kudasare tsu to oboru zo. Chōteki to nate nochi ha ikani kuyu tomo yaku aru maji. Yo o shizume n hodo, hōō o toba no kitadono he utsu tatematsuru ka, shikarazu ha, kore he mare, gokō o nashi mairase n to omofu ha ikani. Sonogi nara ba, hokumen no tomogara, ya o mo hitotsu in zu ran. Samurai domo ni sono yōi se yo to fure beshi. Ōkata ha nyūdōin kata no hōkō omoikiri tari. Uma ni kura oka se yo. Kisenaga tori dase. " to zo notamaikeru.

[2.6.2] Shumehōganmorikuni, isogi komatsudono he hasesanjite" yo ha sudeni kō sōrō. " to mōshikereba, daijin kikimoaezu. " awa haya narichikakyō ga kubi o haneraretaru na. " to notamaeba," sawa sōrawanedomo, nyūdōdono gochakuseichō mesare sōrō. Samuraidomo mo mina uchitate hōjūjidono he yoran to idetachi sō. Hōō o ba tobadono he oshikome mairasen to sō ga, nainai ha chinzei no kata he nagashi mairasen to giserare sō. " to mōse ba, daijin, ikadeka saru koto ari beki to omohe domo, kesa no zenmon no keshiki, saru monoguruhoshiki koto mo aru ramu tote, kuruma o tobashite, nishihachijō he zo ohashitaru.

[2.6.3] Monzen nite kuruma yori ori, mon no uchi he sashīrete mitamahe ba, nyūdō haramaki o kitamafu uhe ha ichimon no keishō unkaku sūjūnin, onōno iroiro no hitatare ni, omoiomoi no yoroi kite, chūmon no rō ni nigyō ni chakuzase rare tari. Sonohoka shokoku no zuryō efu shoshi nado ha, en ni iafure, niwa ni mo hishito narabī tari. Hatazao domo hikisobame／＼ uma no haraobi o katame kabuto no o o chijime tadaima mina uchitatanzuru keshiki domo naru ni komatsudono eboshi nōshi ni ōmon no sashinuki no soba totte sayameki iritamae ba koto no hoka ni zo mierare keru.

[2.6.4] Nyūdō fushimeni natte, aware reino naifu ga, yo o hyōsuru yōni furumai, daini isamebaya to koso omoware kemedomo, sasuga konagaramo, uchini ha gokai o tamote jihi o sakitoshi, sotoni ha gojō o midarazu, reigi o tadashiushi tamau hito nareba, ano sugatani haramaki o kite mukawamu koto, omohayū hazukashiu ya omoware ken, shōji o sukoshi hikitate, soken no koromo o haramaki no ueni, shūshō kini kitamaitari keru ga, munaita no kanamono no sukoshi hazurete miekeru o kakusasō to, shikirini koromo no mune o hikichigae hikichigae zo shitamaikeru. Daijin wa shatei munemorikyō no zajō ni tsuki tamau. Nyūdō mo notamaidasa zu, daijin mo mōshīdasa ruru koto mo nashi.

[2.6.5] Yayārite nyūdō notamai keru wa," narichikakyō ga muhon wa koto no kazu ni mo ara zu. Ikkō hōō no gokekkō nite arike ru zo ya. Yo o shizume n hodo, hōō o toba no kitadono he utsushi tatematsuru ka, shikarazu ba, kore he mare, gokō o nashi mairase n to omō ha ikani. " to notamae ba, daijin kiki mo aezu, harahara to zo nakare keru. Nyūdō," ikani／＼. " to akire tamau. Daijin namida o osaete mōsarekeru ha" kono ōse uketamawarisōrō ni, gōn ha haya sue ni narinu to oboesōrō. Hito no unmei no katamukan tote ha, kanarazu akuji o omoitachisōrō nari. Mata goarisama, sara utsutsu tomo oboesōrawazu. Sasuga wagachō ha henji zokusan no sakai to mōshinagara, amaterasuōmikami no goshison, kuni no aruji toshite, amenokoyanenomikoto no sue, ashita no matsurigoto o tsukasadoritamaishi yori ikō, daijōdaijin no tsukasa ni itaru hito no, katchū o yorō koto reigi o somuku ni arazu ya. Nakanzuku ni goshukke no onmi nari. Sore sanze no shobutsu gedatsu dōsō no hōe o nugisute, tachimachini katchū o yoroi, kyūsen o taishi mashimasa n koto, uchini ha sudeni hakaimuzan no tsumi o maneku nomi nara zu, sotoni ha mata jingireichishin no hō ni mo somuki sō nan zu. Katagata osore aru mōshigoto nite sōrae domo, kokoro no soko ni shishu o nokosu beki ni arazu. Sense ni shion ari. Tenchi no on, kokuō no on, fubo no on, shujō no on kore nari. Sonōchi ni motto omoki ha chōon nari. Futen no moto ōji ni arazu to iu koto nashi. Sareba kano eisen no mizu ni mimi o arai, shuyōzan ni warabi o orishi kenjin mo, chokumei somukigataki reigi oba zonjisu to koso uketamaware. Izureni iwan'ya, senzo ni mo mikikazashi daijōdaijin o kiwamesase tamau. Iwayuru shigemori ga musai guan no mi o mote, renpukaimon no kurai ni itaru. Shikanominarazu kokugun hansugite ichimon no shoryō to nari, den'en kotogotoku ikka no shinshi tari. Kore kitai no chōon ni arazu ya. Ima korera no bakudai no gōn o oboshimeshiwasure te midarishiku hōō o katamuke mairase tamawa n koto, amaterasuōmikami, shōhachimangū no shinryo ni mo somuki sōrai nanzu. Nihon ha kore shinkoku nari. Kami ha hirei o uke tamawa zu. Sareba kimi no oboshimeshitachi tokoro, dōri hanmu ni arazu. Naka ni mo kono ichimon ha, daidai no chōteki o tairage te, shikai no gyakurō o shizumaru koto ha musō no chū nare domo, sono shō ni hokoru koto ha bōjakubujin tomo mōsu beshi. Shōtokutaishi jūshichikajō no gokenpō ni『 hito mina kokoro ari, kanarazu onōno shū ari, kare o zeshi ware o hishi, ware o zeshi kare o hisu. Zehi no ri tare ka yoku sadame beki. Ai tomoni kengu nari. Wa no gotoku shite hashi nashi. Koko o motte tatoihito ikaru to iu tomo kaete waga toga o osoreyo 』 to koso mie te sōrae Saredomo gōn tsuki zaru ni yotte gomuhon sudeni arawarenu Sonōe ōseawase raruru narichikakyō o meshiokare nuru ue ha tatoikimi ikanaru fushigi o oboshimeshitatase tamau tomo nani no osore ka sōrō beki Shotō no zaika okonaware n ue ha shirizoite koto no yoshi o chinjimōsase tamaite kimi no ontame ni ha iyoiyo hōkō no chūkin o tsukushi tami no tame ni ha masumasu buiku no airen o itasase tamawa ba shinmei no kago ni azukari budda no meiryo ni somuka bekara zu Shinmei budda kannō ara ba, kimi mo oboshimeshi naosu koto nadoka sōrawa zaru beki. Kimi to shin to o kuraburu ni shinso waku kata nashi. Dōri to higagoto o naraben ni, ikadeka dōri ni tsukazaru beki.

div.note: [_] [2] Nihon Koten Bungaku Taikei (Tokyo: Iwanami Shoten, 1957, vol. 32; hereafter cited as NKBT) reads 筑後守貞能、木蘭地の直垂に.

div.p: [2.7.1] Kore ha kimi no onkotowari nite sōrae ba, kanawa zara n made mo ingosho hōjūjidono o shugoshi mairase sōrō beshi. Sono yue ha shigemori joshaku yori ima daijin no taishō ni itaru made, subete kimi no gōn nara zu to iu koto nashi. Sono on no omoki koto o omohe ba, senkabanka no tama ni mo koe, sono on no fukaki iro o anzure ba, hitoshiofutashio no kurenai ni mo sugotara n. Sare ba inchū ni mairi komori sō beshi. Sonogi nite sōrawa ba shigemori ga mi ni kawari, inochi ni kawara n to chigiri taru samurai domo, shōshō sōra n. Korera o meshigushi te, in no gosho hōjūjidono o shugoshi mairase sōrawa ba, sasuga mottenohokano godaiji de koso sōrawa nzura me. Kanashīkana, kimi no ontame ni hōkō no chū o itasa n to sure ba, meiro hachiman no itadaki yori nao takaki chichi no on tachimachini wasure n to su. Itaikana, fukō no tsumi o nogare n to sure ba, kimi no ontame ni sudeni fuchū no gyakushin to nari nu beshi. Shintai koretani reri. Zehi ikanimo wakimae katashi. Mōshikōru shosen ha, tada shigemori ga kubi o mesare sōrae. Inchū o mo shugo shi mairasu bekara zu. Insan no otomo o mo tsukamatsuru bekara zu. Ka no shōka ha taikō katae ni koetaru ni yotte, kan daishōkoku ni itari, ken o taishi kutsu o haki nagara tenjō ni noboru koto o yurusare shika domo, eiryo ni somuku koto are ba, kōso omō imashimete, fukō tsumiserare ni ki. Kayō no senshō o omō ni mo, fūki to ī, eiga to ī, chōon to ī, jūshoku to ī, katagata kiwamesase tamaenure ba, gōn no tsukin koto katakaru beki ni arazu. Itsumade ka inochi ikite, midaren yo o mo mi sōrō beki. Tada matsudai ni shō o ukete, kakaru ukime ni ai sōrō shigemori ga kahō no hodo koso tsutanō sōrae. Tadaima saburai hitori ni ōsetsukete otsubo no uchi ni hikidasarete shigemori ga kubi no haneraren koto ha yasui hodo no koto de koso sōrae Kore onōno kikitamae. " tote nōshi no sode mo shiboru bakari ni namida o nagashi, kakikudokarekereba ichimon no hitobito, kokoroaru mo kokoronaki mo mina sode o zo shimerekeru

[2.7.2] Daijōnyūdō mo, tanomukittaru naifu ha kayōni notamau. Chikara mo nagenite," iyaiya koremade ha omoimoyosasōzu Akutōdomo ga mōsu koto ni tsukase tamai te, higagoto nado ya ideko muzuran to omō bakari de koso sōrae. " to notamae ba, daijin," tatoi ikanaru higagoto shuttai sōrō tomo, kimi o ba nantoka shi mairase tamau beki. " tote tsuitate chūmon ni ide saburai domo ni ōserare keru ha" tadaima shigemori ga mōshi tsuru koto o ba nanjira uketamawazu ya. Kesa yori koko ni sō te kayō no kotodomo mōshishizumu to zonji tsure domo amarini hitasawani mie tsuru aida kaeri tari tsuru nari. Inzan no otomo ni oite ha shigemori ga kubi no mesare mu o mite tsukamatsure. Saraba hito maire. " tote, komatsudono he zo kaerare keru. Shumehōgan morikuni o meshite," shigemori koso tenka no daiji o besshite kikīdashitare. Ware o ware to omowa n monodomo ha mina monogushite hasemaire to hirōseyo. " to notamae ba kono yoshi hirōsu. " oboroge nite ha sawaga se tamawa nu hito no, kakaru hirō no ari ha betsu no shisai no aru ni koso. " to, mina mononogu shite waremowaremo to hasemairu. Yodo, hazukashi, uji, okaya, hino, kanjuji, daigo, ogurusu, umezu, katsura, ōhara, shizuhara, seriu no sato ni afurei taru tsuwamonodomo aruiha yoroi ki te, ima kabuto o ki nu mo ari, aruiha ya oi te ima yumi o mo ta nu mo ari. Katābumi fumi ya fumi zu ni te, shūshō sawa ide hasemairu. Komatsudono ni sawagu koto ari to kikoe shika ba, nishihachijō ni sūsenki ari keru tsuwamonodomo, nyūdō ni kō tomo mōshi mo ire zu, sazameki tsurete, mina komatsudono he zo hase tari keru. Sukoshimo yumiya ni tazusawaru hodo no mono ha hitorimo nokorazu Sonotoki nyūdō ōini odoroki, sadayoshi o meshite," naifu ha nanto omohite, korera oba yobitoru yaran. Korede ihitsuru yōni, nyūdō ga moto he utte nado ya mukanzuran " to notamaheba, sadayoshi namida o haraharato nagaite" hitomo hitoni koso yose tamahi saurahe. Ikadeka saru onkoto saurafubeki. Kore nite mōsa se tamai tsuru kotodomo mo mina gokōkai zo sōran " to mōshikere ba nyūdō, naifu ni nakatagau te ha warukari nan to ya omowa re ken Hōō ōse mairase n koto mo haya omoitodomari haramaki nugioki soken no koromo ni kesa uchikake te saishin nimo okora nu nenju shite koso mashi kere

[2.7.3] Komatsudono ni ha morikuni uketamawa te chakutō tsuke ri Hasesan taru sei domo ichiman'yoki to zo chūitaru Chakutō hiken no nochi, daijin chūmon ni idete saburaidomo ni notamahikeru ha, higoro no keiyaku o tagahezu shite maittaru koso shinmyō nare. Ikoku ni saru tameshi ari. Shū no yūō, hōji to ifu saiai no kisaki o mochi tamaheri. Tenka daīchi no bijin nari. Saredomo yūō no mikokoro ni kanaha zari keru koto ha, hōji warai o fukumazu tote, sōjite kono kisaki warafu koto o shi tamaha zu. Ikoku no narai ni ha, tenka ni heikaku okoru toki, shosho ni hi o age, taiko o utte, hei o mesu hakarigoto ari. Kore o hōka to nazuke tari. Arutoki tenka ni heiran tate, hōka o age tari kere ba, kisaki kore o mi tamai te,『 ana fushigi, hi mo are hodo ōkari keru na. 』 tote, sonotoki hajimete warai tamae ri. Kono kisaki ichido warawaba hyaku kobi ari keri. Yūō ureshiki koto ni shite, sonokoto tonau, tsuneni hōka o age tamau. Shokō ki ni ada nashi. Ada nakereba sunawachi inu. Kayōni suru koto tabitabini oyobeba, mairu mono mo nashi keri. Arutoki ringoku yori kyōzoku tate, yūō no miyako o seme keru ni, hōka o agere domo, reino kisaki no hi ni narete, tsuwamono mo maira zu. Sono toki miyako katamukite, yūō tsuini useniki. Sate kono kisaki ha yakan to natte hashiriusekeru zo osoroshiki. Kayōno koto annareba, jikon'igo mo, kore yori mesanniha, mina kakunogotokuni mairubeshi. Shigemori fushigino koto o kikīdashite meshitsuru nari. Saredomo konokoto kikinaoshitsu, higagoto nitearikeri. Tō／＼ kaere. " tote mina kaesare keri. Jitsuniha saseru koto o mo kikīdasare zari kere domo chichi o isame kōmurimōshi tsuru kotoba ni shitagai wagami ni sei no tsukuka tsukanuka no hodo o mo shiri mata fushi ikusa o sen to niha ara ne domo kakushite nyūdōshōkoku no muhon no kokorozashi mo yawarage tamau to no hakarigoto nari. " kimi iedomo fukun shin ikashin fuka chichi iedomo fufu ko ifushi fuka. Kimi no tame niha chū arite chichi no tame niha kō are. " to bunsen'ō no notamaeru ni fui. Kimi no kono yoshi kikoshimeshite," ima ni hajimenu koto nare domo, naifu ga kokoro no naka koso hajishikere. Ata o ba on o motte hōzerare tari. " to zo ōsekeru. " kahō koso medetaute, daijin no taishō ni koso itara me. Yōgi taihai hito ni sugure, saichi saigaku sae yo ni koetaru beshi yawa " to zo toki no hitobito kanjiaware keru. " kuni ni isamuru shin are ba, sono kuni kokoro yasuku, ie ni isamuru ko are ba, sono ie kanarazu tadashi. " to ieri. Jōko ni mo matsudai ni mo arigatakarishi daijin nari.

[2.8.1] Dō rokugatsu futsuka, shindainagon narichikakyō o ba, kugyō no za he idashi tatematsute, omono mairase tari kere domo, mune seki futagate, ohashi o dani motaterare zu. Mikuruma o yosete, tōtō to mōse ba, dainagon kokoronarazu nori tamau. Gunbyō domo zengosayū ni uchikakomi tari. Wagahō no mono ha hitori mo nashi. " ima ichido komatsudono ni mie tatematsura baya. " to notamae domo, sore mo kanawa zu. " tatoe jūka o kōmutte ongoku he iku mono mo, hito hitori mi ni shitagae nu mono ya aru. " to kuruma no uchi nite kakikudokare kere ba, shugo no bushi domo mo mina yoroi no sode o zo nurashi keru. Nishi no suzaku o minami he ikeba, ōuchiyama mo ima ha yoso ni zo mitamai keru. Nenrai minare tatematsuri shi zōshiki ushikai ni itaru made, namida o nagashi sode o shibora nu ha nakari keri. Mashite miyako ni nokoritodomari tamau kitagata sukuki hitobito no kokoronōchi, oshihakararete aware nari. Tobadono o sugi tamau ni mo kono gosho he gokō nari shi ni ha ichido mo otomo ni ha hazure zari shi mono o tote waga yamazato suhamadono tote ari shi o mo yoso ni mite koso tōra re kere. Minami no mon he idete, fune oso to zo isogase keru. " kowa izuchi he yaran, onajiu ushinawarubekuba miyako chikaki konohen nite mo are kashi. " to notamaikeru zo semete no koto naru.

[2.8.2] Chikō soitaru bushi o" dare so" to totamae ba, nanbajirōtsunetō to mōsu. " moshi konohen ni wagakatasama no mono ya aru. Fune ni noranu saki ni īokubeki koto ari. Tazunete maiseyo. " to notamaikere ba, sonohen o hashirimawate tazunekere domo, ware koso dainagondono no onkata to iu mono hitori mo nashi. " wa yo nari shi toki ha, shitagai tsuki tari shi mono domo, ichi ni sen nin mo ari tsuran. Ima ha yoso nite dani mo kono arisama o miokuru mono no nakari keru kanashi sa yo. " to nakare kere ba, takeki bushi domo mo mina sode o zo nurashi keru. Mi ni sō mono tote ha tada tsukisenu namida bakari nari. Kumanomōde, tennōjimōde nado ni ha, nikawara no sanmune ni tsukuttaru fune ni nori, tsugi no fune nisanjissō kogitsuzukete koso arishi ni, ima ha ayashikaru kakisue yakatabune ni, ōmaku hikase, mimonarenu tsuwamonodomo ni guserarete, kyō o kagirini miyako o idete, namiji harukani omomukare ken kokoro no naka, oshihakararete awarenari. Sonohi wa settsunokuni ōmono no ura ni tsuki tamau.

[2.8.3] Shindainagon, sudeni shizai ni okonawaru bekari shi hito no, ruzai ni yurusare keru koto wa, komatsudono no yōyōni mōsare keru ni yotte nari. Konohito imada chūnagon nite owashi keru toki, minonokuni o chigyōshi tamai shi ni kaōgannen no fuyu, mokudai uemonnojō masatomo ga moto he sanmon no ryō hiranonoshō no jinnin ga kuzu o utte kitari keru ni, mokudai sake ni nomiyotte kuzu ni sumi o zo tsuke tari keru. Jinnin akkō ni oyobu aida, sa naiwaseso tote sanzanni ryōryakusu. Saruhodoni jinnindomo sūhyakunin, mokudai ga moto he rannyūsu. Mokudai hō ni makasete fusegikereba, jinin nado jūyonin uchikorosaru. Kore ni yote dōnen no jūichigatsu no mikka, sanmon no daishu obitadashiku hōkishite, kokushi narichikakyō o ruzai ni shoserare, mokudai uemonnojō masatomo o kingoku serarubeki yoshi sōmonsu. Sudeni narichikakyō bitchūnokuni he nagasarubeki nite nishinoshichijō made dasaretarishi o, kimi ikaga oboshimesareken nakaitsuka atte meshikaesaru. Sanmon no daishu obitadashū jusosu to kikoeshikadomo, dōninen shōgatsuitsuka, uemonnokami o kenshite, kebīshinobettō ni naritamau. Sonotoki, sukekata, kanemasakyō koeraretamaeri. Sukekatakyō wa furui hito otonanite owashi ki. Kanemasakyō wa eiga no hito nari. Kechaku nite koerare tama keru koso ikon nare. Kore wa sanjōdono zōshin no shō nari. Dō sannen shigatsu jūsannichi, shōnī ni jose raru. Sonotoki wa nakamikadochūnagonmuneiekyō koe rare tamae ri. Angengannen jūgatsu nijūshichinichi, sakinochūnagon yori gondainagon ni nobori tamau. Hito azakete," sanmon no daishu ni wa norowaru bekari keru mono o. " to mōshikeru. Saredomo, ima wa sonoyue ni ya, kakaru ukime ni ai tamae ri. Oyoso ha shinmei no bachi mo hito no juso mo, toku mo ari, osoku ki mo ari, fudō naru koto nari.

[2.8.4] Dō mikka, ōmono no ura he, kyō yori ontsukai ari tote hishimeki keri. Shindainagon" soko nite usehe to ni ya. " to kiki tamahe ba, sa ha naku shite, bizen no kojima he nagasu beshi to no ontsukai nari. Komatsudono yori onfumi ari. Ikanimoshite miyako chikaki katayamazato ni mo oki tatematsura baya to sashimo mōshitsure domo kanawa nu koto koso yo ni ari kai mo sōrawa ne. Sarinagaramo on'inochi bakari ha mōshiukete sōrō. " tote nanba ga moto he mo" kamaete yokuyoku miyazukae onkokoro ni tagauna. " to ōserare tsukawashi tabi no yosōi komagomato satashi okurare tari. Shindainagon ha sashimo katajikenō oboshimesare keru kimi ni mo hanare mairase tsukanoma mo sarigatō omoware keru kitagata sukunaki hitobito ni mo wakahatete" kowa izuchi he tote yuki yaran. Futatabi kokyō ni kaette, saishi o aimin koto mo arigatashi. Ichinen sanmon no soshō ni yotte, nagare shi o ba kimi oshimase tamai te, nishinoshichijō yori shōkansare nu. Kore ha sareba kimi no mikai ni mo arazu. Ko ha ikani shi tsuru koto zo ya. " to, ten ni aogi chi ni utsumuite, nakikanashime domo kai zo naki. Ake nure ba fune oshīdete kudari tamau ni, michisugara mo tada namida ni musende, nagarau beshi to ha oboe ne do, sasuga tsuyu no inochi ha kiyara zu. Ato no shiranami hedatsure ba, miyako ha shidaini tōzakari, hikazu yōyō kasanare ba, tōkuni ha chikazuke ri. Bizen no kojima ni kogiyose te, tami no ie no asamashigenaru shiba no iori ni okitatematsuru Shima no narai, ushiro ha yama, mae ha umi, iso no matsukaze, nami no oto, izuremo aware ha tsukuse zu

[2.9.1] Dainagon hitori nimo kagirazu, kei o kōmuru tomogara ōkari keri Ōminochūjōnyūdōrenshō sadonokuni, yamashironokamimotokane hōkinokuni, shikibunotaifumasatsuna harimanokuni, sōnohangannobufusa awanokuni, shinpeinohangansukeyuki wa mimasakanokuni to zo kikoe shi.

[2.9.2] Sonokoro nyūdōshōkoku, fukuhara no betsugyō ni owashikeru ga, onaji hatsuka, settsunosaemonmorizumi o shisha toshite, kadowaki no saishō no moto he," zonzuru mune ari. Tanbanoshōshō isogi koko he tabe. " to notamai tsukawasare tari kere ba, saishō," saraba, tada arishi toki tomokakumo nattari se ba ikaga sen. Imasara mono o omowa se n koso kanashikere. " tote fukuhara he kudaritamai beki yoshi notamae ba shōshō nakinaki shuttachitamai keri. Nyōbōtachi ha kanawazara n monoyue ni naomo tada saishō no mōsare yo kashi to zo nagekare keru. Saishō zonzuru hodo no koto ha mōshitsu. Yo o sutsuru yori hoka ha ima ha nanigoto o ka mōshi beki. Saredomo tatoe izuku no ura ni imasu tomo wagainochi no aran kagiri ha otonaitatematsuru beshi. " to zo notamaikeru. Shōshō ha kotoshi mittsu ni naritamau osanaki hito o mochitamaeri. Higoro ha wakaki hito nite kindachi nado no koto mo sashimo kokunimo mashimazarishika tomo, imahanotoki ni narishikaba, sasuga kokoroniya kakarareken. " kono sukunaki mono o imaichido mibaya. " to koso notamaikere. Uba idaki te mairi tari. Shōshō hizaue ni oki, kami kakinade, namida o haraharato nagashite," aware nanji shichisai ni naraba, otoko ni nashite kimi he mairasen to koso omotsure. Saredomo ima ha īkai nashi. Moshi inochi ikite, oitachitaraba, hōshi ni nari, wa gose tomurae yo. " to notamaeba, imada osanaki kokoro ni nanigoto oka kikiwaki tamau beki naredomo, uchiunazuki tamaeba, shōshō o hajimematsurite hahaue uba no nyōbō, sonoza ni narabītaru hitobito, kokoroari mo kokoronashi mo, mina sode o zo nurashi keru. Fukuhara no ontsukai, yagate kon'ya toba made ide sase tamau beki yoshi mōshi kere ba" ikuhodo mo nobi zara n mono yueni koyoi bakari ha miyako no uchi nite akasa baya. " to notamae domo shikirini mōse ba sonoyo toba he zo ide rare keru. Saishō amarini urameshisa ni kondo ha nori mo gushi tamawa zu.

[2.9.3] Dō nijūninichi fukuhara he gechaku tamai tari kere ba daijōnyūdō seotarōkaneyasu ni ōsete bitchūnokuni he zo nagasa re keru. Kaneyasu ha saishō no kanmon tamawa n tokoro o osore te michisugara mo samazamani itawari nagusame tatematsuru. Saredomo, shōshō sukoshi mo nagusami tamau koto mo nashi. Yachū tada hotoke no mina o nomi tonaete chichi no koto o zo nagekare keru. Shindainagon wa, bizen no kojima ni owashikeru o, azukari no bushi nanba jirō tsunetō kore wa nao funatsu chikōte warukari nan tote, chi e watashi tatematsuri, bizen bitchū ryōkoku no sakai, niwase no gō ariki no bessho to iu yamadera ni oki tatematsuru. Bitchū no seo to, bizen no ariki no bessho no aida ha wazuka gojitchō ni taranu tokoro nare ba tanbanoshōshō sonokata no kaze mo sasuga natsukashiu ya omoware ken, arutoki kaneyasu o meshite" kore yori dainagondono no owatari arunaru bitchū no ariki no bessho he ha ikahodo no michi zo. " to toi tamae ba jikini shirase tatematsurite ha warukari nan to omoi ken," katamichi jūnisan de sō. " to mōshi. Sonotoki shōshō namida o haraharato nagaite," nihon ha mukashi sanjūsankakoku nite ari keru o, nakagoro rokujūrokkakoku niha wakara re tan nari. Sa iu bizen bitchū bingo mo, moto ha ikkoku nite ari keru nari. Mata higashi ni kikoyuru dewamutsu ryōkoku mo, mukashi ha rokujūrokugun ga ikkoku nite arikeru o, sonotoki jūnigun o wariwakete, dewa no kuni to ha tateraretari. Sareba sanekatachūjō, ōshū he nagasaretarikeru toki, konokuni no meisho akoya no matsu to iu tokoro o mibaya tote, kunijū o tazune arikikeru ga, tazunekanete kaerikeru michi ni, rōō no hitori yukiaitarikereba『 yaya onbe ha furui hito to koso mitatematsure, tōgoku no meisho ni akoya no matsu to iu tokoro ya shiritaru. 』 to toi ni,『 mattaku tōgoku no uchi ni ha sōrawa zu, dewa no kuni ni ya sōra n. 』 to mōshikere ba,『 sateha onhe mo shirazari keri. Yosue ni natte, kuni no meisho o mo haya mina yobiushinai keru ni koso. 』 tote, munashiku sugin to shikere ba, rōō chūjō no sode o hikaete,『 aware kimi ha,

lg.l: みちのくの阿古耶の松に木隱て、出べき月の出もやらぬか。

div.p: [2.9.4] To iu uta no kokoro o motte, tōgoku no meisho akoya no matsu to ha ōserare sōrō ka. Sore ha ryōkoku ga ikkoku nari shi toki yomihaberu uta nari. Jūnigun o wariwakete nochi ha dewanokuni ni ya sōran. 』 to mōshikere ba saraba tote sanekatanochūjō mo dewanokuni ni koete koso akoyanomatsu o ba mitari kere. Tsukushi no dazaifu yori miyako he harāka no tsukai no noboru koso katamichi jūgonichi to ha sadametare. Sudeni jūnisannichi to iwa kore yori hotondo chinzei he gekō gozan nare. Tōshi to iu tomo, bizen bitchū no aida, ryōsannichi ni ha yomo sugi ji. Chikaki o tōu mōsu ha, dainagondono no owatari ari naru tokoro o naritsune ni shirase ji tote koso mōsura me. " tote, sononochi ha koishikere domo toi tamawa zu.

[2.10.1] Saruhodoni hosshōji no shugyō shunkansōzu, heihōgan'yasuyori, kono shōshō aigushite satsumagata kikaigashima he zo nagasare keru. Kanoshima ha, miyako o idete harubaruto namiji o shinoide yuku tokoro nari. Oborogeniteha fune mo kayowazu Shima ni ha hito marenari. Onozukara hito ha are domo, konodo no hito ni mo ni zu. Iro kurō shite, ushi no gotoshi. Mi ni ha shikirini ke oitsutsu, kotoba o mo kikishira zu. Otoko wa eboshi mo se zu, onna wa kami mo sage zari keri. Ishō nakere ba hito ni mo ni zu. Shokusuru mono mo nakere ba, tada sesshō o nomi saki to su. Shizu ga yamada o kaesa ne ba, beikoku no rui mo naku, sono no kuwa o tora zare ba, kenpaku no rui mo nakari keri. Shima no naka ni wa takaki yama ari. Chin ni hi moyu. Iō to iu mono jūman teri. Karu ga yue ni iō ga shima tomo nazuke tari. Kaminari tsuneni nariagari, narikudari, fumoto ni ha ame shigeshi. Ichinichi katatoki, hito no inochi taete aru beki yō mo nashi.

[2.10.2] Saruhodoni shindainagon ha sukoshiku tsurogu koto mo ya to omowa re keru ni, shisoku tanbanoshōshō naritsune mo, haya kikaigashima he nagasare tamawa nu to kīte, imaha sanomi tsurenaku nanigoto oka kisu beki tote, shukke no kokorozashi no sō yoshi, binni tsuite komatsudono he mōsare kere ba, konoyoshi hōōni ukagai mōshite, gomen ari keri. Yagate shukke shi tamai nu. Eiga no tamoto o hikikaete, ukiyo o yoso no sumizome no sode ni zo yatsure tamau.

[2.10.3] Dainagon no kitanokata ha, miyako no kitayama unrin'in no hotori ni shinobite zo owashikeru. Saranu dani, suminarenu tokoro ha monōki ni, itodo shinobare kere ba, sugiyuku tsukihi mo akashi kane kurashi wazurau sama nari keri. Nyōbō saburai ōkari keredomo, aruiha yo o osore, aruiha hitome o tsutsumu hodo ni, toburau mono hitori mo nashi. Saredomo sononaka ni, minamotonosaemonnojōnobutoshi to iu saburai hitori, nasake kotoni fukakari kere ba, tsuneni tobura tatematsuru. Arutoki kitanokata nobutoshi o meshite," makotoya kore ni ha bizen no kojima to kikoe shi ga, konohodo kikeba ariki no bessho tokaya ni owasu nari. Ikanimoshite imaichido hakanaki fude no ato o mo tatematsuri, otozure o mo kikabaya. " to koso notamai kere. Nobutoshi namida o osae mōshikeru ha" yōshō yori goawaremi o kōmutte katatoki mo hanare mairase sōrawazu. Okudari no toki mo nantomoshite otomotsukamatsurō to mōshisōraishi ga rokuhara yori irerareneba chikara oyobisōrawazu. Mesare sōraishi onkoe mo mimi ni todomari, isamerare mairaseshi onkotoba mo kimo ni meijite katatoki mo wasure mairase sōrawazu. Tatoe konomi ha ikanaru me ni mo aisōrae. Tokutoku onfumi tamawatte mairi sōrawan. " to zo mōshi keru. Kitanokata nanamenarazu yorokobide, yagate kaite zo tōdari keru. Shōninnin mo menmenni ofumi ari. Nobutoshi kore o tamawarite, harubaruto bizennokuni ariki no bessho he tazunekudaru. Mazu azukari no bushi naniwajirōtsunetō ni annai o ī kere ba, kokorozashi no hodo o kanjite, yagate kenzanni iri tari keri. Dainagonnyūdōdono wa tadaima mo miyako no koto o nomi notamaidashi nagekishizumide owashikeru tokoro ni" kyō yori nobutoshi ga mairite sō." to mōshīretari kere ba" yume ka ya." Yume ka ya. Tote kiki mo aezu okinaori" koko he／＼." To mesare kere ba nobutoshi mairite mitatematsuru ni mazu osumai no kokorōsa mo saru koto nite sumizome no otamoto o mitatematsuru ni zo nobutoshi me mo kure kokoro mo kiete oboe keru. Kitanokata no ōse kōmushi shidai komagomato mōshite ofumi torīdaite tatematsuru. Kore o ake te mi tamae ba, mizuguki no ato ha, namida ni kakikurete, sokoha mine domo," sukunaki hitobito no amarini koikanashimi tamau arisama, wagami mo tsukinu omoini taeshinobeumo nashi. " to kaka re tare ba, higoro no koishisa ha, kotonokazunarazu to zo kanashimi tamau. Kakute shigonichi sugikere ba, nobutoshi" kokoni sōte, gosaigo no goarisama misanzen. " to mōshikere ba, azukarinobushi nanbajirōtsunetō, kanamajiki yoshi shikirini mōse ba, chikaraoyobade," saraba nobore. " to koso notamaekere. Ware wa chikō ushinawarenzuran. Konoyo ni naki mono to kikaba, aikamaete wa gose toburae. " to zo notamaikeru. Gohenji kaite tōdarikereba, shinshun kore o tamaite," mata koso sansōwame. " tote itoma mōshite idekereba," nanji ga matakontabi o matsukubeshi tomo oboenu zo. Amarini shitawashiku oboyuru ni, shibashibashi. " to notamaite, tabitabi yobizo kaesarekeru. Satemo arubeki nara ne ba, nobutoshi namida o osaetsutsu, miyako he kaerinoborikeri. Kitanokata ni fumi mairasetari kere ba, kore o hiraite goranzuru ni, haya shukkeshi tamaitaru to obotsukanate, migushi no hitofusa fumi no oku ni aru keru o, futame tomo mitamawa zu. Katami koso nakanaka imaha atanare tote, fushimarobite zo nakarekeru. Sukunaki hitobito mo, koegoeni nakikanashimi tamai keri.

[2.10.4] Saruhodoni dainagon nyūdōdono o ba dō hachigatsu jūkunichi, bizen bitchū ryōkoku no sakai, niwase no gō, kibi no nakayama to iu tokoro nite tsuini ushinai tatematsuru. Sono saigo no arisama yōyōni kikoe keri. Sake ni doku o irete susume tari keredomo kanawa zari kere ba, kishi no nijō bakari ari keru shita ni hishi o uete, ue yori tsukiotoshi tatematsure ba, hishi ni tsuranukate use tamai nu. Mugeni utateki kotodomo nari hon sukunō zo oboe keru. Dainagon no kitanokata ha konoyo ni naki hito to kiki tamai te ikanimo shite mo imaichido kawaranu sugata o mi mo shi mie n to te koso kyō made sama o mo henzari tsure Ima ha nani ni ka ha se n to te bodaīn to iu tera ni owashi sama o kae katanogotoku no butsuji o itonami gose o zo toburai tamai keru Kono kitakata to mōsu ha, yamashironokami atsufusa no musume nari. Masaru bijin nite, goshirakawahōō no gosaiai narabinaki gōmoibito nite gozakeru o, narichikakyō arigataki chōai no hito nite, tamawari tari keru to zo kikoe shi. Osanaki hitobito mo hana o taori, aka no mizu o sukunde, chichi no gose o tomurai tamau zo awarenaru. Saru hodo ni toki utsuri koto satte yo no kawariyuki arisama ha tada tennin no gosui ni kotonara zu.

[2.11.1] Koko ni tokudaiji no dainagon sanesada kyō ha heike no jinan munemori kyō ni taishō o kosa re te shibaraku rōkyo shi tamae ri. Shukke se n to notamae ba, shodaibu saburai domo, ikaga se n to nagekiai ri. Sononaka ni fujinokurando shigekane to iu shodaibu ari. Shoji ni kokoroe taru hito nite, aru tsuki no yo, sanesadakyō nanmen no mikōshi ue sase, tadahitori tsuki ni usobukite owashikeru tokoro ni, nagusame mairase n to ya omoi ken, fujinokurando mairi tari. Tare so. Shigekane sō. Ikani nanigoto zo. To notamae ba, kon'ya ha tokuni tsuki saete banshin no sumi sō mama ni, maite sō. To zo mōshikeru. Dainagon," shinmyōni mai tari. Amarini nantoyaran kokorobosōte tsurezurenaru ni. " to zo ōserare keru. Sononochi nantonai kotodomo mōshite nagusame tatematsuru. Dainagon notamaeru ha," tsuratsura kono yononaka no arisama o miru ni, heike no yo ha iya sakannari. Nyūdōshōkoku no chakushi, jinan, sayū no taishō nite ari. Yagate sannan tomomori, chakuson koremori mo aru zo kashi. Kare mo kore mo shidaini nara ba, take no hitobito, taishō o itsu atetsubeshi tomo oboe zu. Sareba tsui no koto nari. Shukke se n. " to zo notamaikeru. Shigekane namida o harahara to nagaite mōshikeru ha" kimi no goshukke sōrawaba gonai no jōge mina madoimono ni narisōrainanzu. Shigekane, mezurashī koto o koso anshutsushite sōrae. Tatoeba aki no itsukushima o ba heike nanamenarazu sūkei hare sōrō ni nanikaha kurushū sōrōbeki, kanomiya he gosan ari gokisei sōrae kashi. Nanuka bakari gosanrō sōrawaba, kanoyashiro ni ha naishi tote yūnaru maihime domo ōku sōrō. Mezurashū oboshimeshite, motenashi sōrawa nzuran Nanigoto no gokisei ni gosanrō sōrō yaran to mōshi sōrawa ba, arinomamani ōse sōrae Sate onobori no toki onagorioshimi mairase sōrawa nzuran Munetono no naishi domo meshigushite miyako made onobori sōrae Miyako he nobora ba, nishihachijō he zo mairi sōrawa nzuran Tokudaijidono wa nanigoto no gokisei ni itsukushima e wa mairase tamai tari keru yaran. To tazunerare sōrawa ba naishidomo aru no mama ni mōshisōrawa muzuran. Nyūdōshōkoku wa kotoni monomedeshi tamau hito nite ware agame tamau onkami e maite inorimōsare keru koso ureshikere tote sukiyōnaru hakarai mo annu to oboe sōrō. To mōshikere ba tokudaijidono kore koso omoi mo yozari tsure. Arigataki saku kana. Yagate maira n. " tote, niwakani shōjin hajime tsutsu, itsukushima he zo maira re keru.

[2.11.2] Makotoni kano miya ni ha naishi tote iunaru onnadomo ohokari keri. Nanuka sanrō se rare keru ni, yoruhiru kisohe tatematsuri motenasu koto kagiri nashi. Nanuka shichiya no ahida ni bugaku mo sando made ari keri. Biwa, koto hiki, kagura, maiutai nado asobikere ba, sanesadakyō mo omoshiroki koto ni oboshimeshi, shinmeihōraku no tame ni imayō, rōei utai, fuzoku, saibara nado arigataki eikyoku domo ari keri. Naishidomo" tōsha he ha, heike no kindachi koso omairi sōrō ni, kono omairi koso mezurashū sōrae. Nanigoto no gokisei, gosanrō saburau yaran. " to mōshikere ba," taishō o hito ni koe rare taru aida, sono inori no tame nari. " to zo ōserare keru. Sate nanuka sanrō owatte, daimyōjin ni itoma mōshite miyako he nobora se tamau ni, nagori o oshimi tatematsuri, muneto no wakaki naishi jūyonin, fune oshitate ichinichiji o okuri tatematsuru. Itoma mōshi kere domo, saritoteha amarini nagori no oshiki ni, ima ichinichiji, ima futsukaji to ōserare te miyako made koso guse rare kere. Tokudaiji no yashiki he iri sase tamai te, samazama ni motenashi, samazama no onhikidemono domo tōde kaesa re keri.

[2.11.3] Naishi domo kore made noboru hodo de ha, warera ga shū no daijōnyūdō dono he ikade maira de aru beki to te nishihachijō he zo sanji taru. Nyūdōshōkoku isogi deai tamai te," ikani naishi domo ha nanigoto no ressan zo." Tokudaijidono no omairi sō te nanuka komorase tamai te onobori sō o ichinichiji okuri mairase te sōrae ba saritoteha amarini nagori no oshiki ni imaichinichiji futsukaji to ōserare te koremade meshiguse rare te sōrō Tokudaiji ha nanigoto no kisei ni itsukushima made ha maira re tari keru yaran Taishō no oinori no tame to koso ōserare sōrai shika Sonotoki nyūdō uchiunazui te anaitōshi ōjō ni sashimo tōtoki reibutsu reisha no iku mo goza o sashioki te waga agame tatematsuru onkami he mai te inori mōsa re keru koso arigatakere Korehodo kokorozashikiri nara n ue ha. " tote chakushi komatsudono naidaijin no sadaishō nite mashimashikeru o jisesase tatematsuri jinan munemori dainagon no udaishō nite owashikeru o kosasete tokudaiji o sadaishō ni zo nasarekeru. Aware medetakarikeru saku kana. Shindainagon mo, kayōni kashikoki hakarai o ba shi tamawa de, yoshinaki muhon okoite, wagami mo horobi, shisoku shojū ni itaru made, kakaru ukime o mise tamau koso utatekari kere.

[2.12.1] Saruhodoni, hōō ha mīdera no kōkensōjō o goshihan toshite, shingon no hihō o denju se sase mashi keru ga, dainichikyō, kongōchōkyō, soshitsujikyō, kono sanbu no hihō o uke sase tamai te, kugatsu yokka, mīdera nite gokanjō aru beshi to zo kikoe keru. Sanmon no daishu ikidō mōshi," mukashi yori gokanjō gojukai, mina tōzan nite toge sase mashimashi masu koto senki nari". Nakanzukuni sannō no kedō ha jukai kanjō no tame nari. Saruo ima mīdera nite togesasemashimasa ba tera o ikkō yakiharau beshi. " to zo mōshikeru. Kore muyaku nari tote okagyō o kechiganshite oboshimeshi todomarasetamai nu. Sarinagaramo nao hoi nare ba tote mīdera no kōkensōjō o meshigushite tennōji he gokōnate gochikōin o tate kamei no mizu o gobyō no chisui toshite buppō saisho no reichi nite zo denbōkanjō ha togesasemashimashikeru.

[2.12.2] Sanmon no sōdō shizumare n ga tame ni, mīdera nite gokanjō ha nakari shika domo, sanjō ni ha dōshu gakushō, fukai no koto shuttai te, kassen tabitabi ni oyobu. Maido ni gakuryo uchiotosa re te sanmon no metsubō, chōka no godaiji to zo mie shi. Dōshu to mōsu ha, gakushō no shojū nari keru warawabe ga hōshi ni naru taru ya, moshi ha chūgen hōshibara nite ari keru ga, kongōjuin no zasu, kakujin gonnosōjō jisan no toki yori, santō ni kechiban shite, geshu to gōsuru shite, hotoke ni hana shinzuru se shi mono domo nari. Kinnen gyōnin tote, daishu o mo kotodomo se zari shi ga, kaku tabitabi no ikusa ni uchikatsu nu. Dōshu ra shishu no mei o somuku ite, kassen o kuwadatsu tsu, sumiyaka ni chūbatsu se raru beki yoshi, daishu kuge ni sōmon shi, buke he fureuttae fu. Kore ni yotte daijōnyūdō inzen o uketamawari, kīnokuni no jūnin, yuasagonnokamimuneshige ika, kinai no tsuwamono nisen'yoki, daishu ni sashisoete, dōshu o semeraru Dōshu higoro ha tōyōbō ni ari shi ga, ōmi no kuni sanga no shō ni gekō shi te, amata no sei o hikīshi, mata tozan shi te, hayaosaka ni shiro o shi te tatekomoru

[2.12.3] Dō kugatsu hatsuka, tatsu no itten ni daishu sanzennin, kangun nisen'yoki, tsugō sono sei gosen'yonin, hayaozaka ni oshiyose tari. Kondo ha saritomo to omoi keru ni, daishu ha kangun o sakidaten to shi, kangun ha mata daishu o sakidaten to arasō hodo ni kokorogokoro nite, hakabakashū mo tatakawa zu. Shiro no uchi yori ishiyumi hikikake tari kere ba, daishu kangun kazu o tsukite utare ni keri. Dōshu ni katafu akutō to iha, shokoku no settō, gōtō, sanzoku, kaizoku nado nari. Yokushin shijō ni shite, shishō shirazu no yatsubara nareba, ware hitori to omohikitte tatakafu hodoni, kondo mo mata gakushōgun ni makenikeri.

[2.13.1] Sononochi ha sanmon iya arehatete, jūnizenshu no hoka ha, shijū no sōryo mo marenari, tanidani no kōen mametsushite, dōdō no gyōhō mo taitensu. Shugaku no mado o toji, zazen no yuka o munauseri. Shikyōgoji no haru no hana mo kabazu, santaisokuze no aki no tsuki mo kumoreri. Sanbyakuyosai no hōtō o kakaguru hito mo naku, rokujifudan no kō no kemuri mo tayashi nuran. Dōsha takaku sobiete, sanjū no kamae o seikan no uchi ni sashihasami, tōryō harukani hīte, shimen no en o hakumu no aida ni kakattari ki. Saredomo ima ha kubutsu o mine no arashi ni makase, kon'yō o kōreki ni nurasu. Yoru no tsuki tomoshibi o kakagete noki no suki yori mori, akatsuki no roshu o tarete renza no yosōi o soe tokaya. Sore matsudai no zoku ni itatteha, sangoku no buppō mo shidaini suibiseri. Tōku tenjiku ni busseki o tomurae ba, mukashi hotoke no hō o to tamai shi chikurinshōja, gikkodokuon mo konogoro ha korōyakan no sumika to na te, ishizue nomi ya nokoru ran. Byakurochi ni ha mizu taete, kusa nomi fukaku shigere ri. Taibongejō no sotoba mo koke nomi mushi te katamuki nu Shintan ni mo tendaisan, godaisan, hakubaji, gyokusenji mo, ima ha jūryo naku samazamani arehate, daishōjō no hōmon mo, hako no soko ni ya kuchi nuran Wagachō ni mo nantoshichidaiji arehate, hasshūkyūshū mo todae, atago takao mo mukashi ha dōtō noki o narabi tari shika domo, ichiya no naka ni are ni shika ba, tengu no sumika to narihate nu Sarebaniya, sashimo yangotonakari tsuru tendai no buppō mo, jishō no ima ni oyobide, horobihate nuru niya to, kokoro aru hito nagekikanashima zu to iukoto nashi. Rizan shi keru sō no bō no hashira ni, uta o zo isshu kai tari keru.

lg.l: 祈りこし我立杣のひきかへて、人なき嶺となりや果なん。

div.p: [2.13.2] Kore ha dengyōdaishi, tōzan sōsō no mukashi, anokutarasanmyakusanbodai no hotoke tachi ni, inorimōsa re keru koto o, omohīdete eijitari keru niya. Ito yū zo kikoe shi. Yōka ha yakushi no hi nare domo, namu to tonauru koe mo se zu. Uzuki wa suijaku no tsuki nare domo heihaku o sasaguru hito mo nashi. Shu no tamagaki kamusabite, shimenawa nomi ya nokoru ran.

[2.14.1] Sonokoro zenkōji enjō no yoshi sonokikoe ari. Kano nyorai to mōsu ha mukashi tenjiku shaekoku ni, goshu no akubyō okite, hito ōku messhi ni gatsugaichōja ga chishō ni yotte, ryūgūjō yori enbudagon o ete, shakuson, mokuren, chōja kokoro o itsuni shite, chūgenshi tamaeru isshaku tehan no mida no sanzon, enbudai daīchi no reizō nari. Hotoke metsudo no nochi, tenjiku ni todomarase tamau koto, gohyakuyosai, buppō tōzen no ri nite, kudarakoku ni utsurase tamaite, issensai no nochi, kudara no mikado seimeiō, wagachō no mikado kinmeitennō no gyō ni oyonde, kanokuni yori konokuni he utsurase tamaite, settsunokuni naniwa no ura nite, seisō o okurase tamai keri. Tsune ha konjiki no hikari o hanata se mashimashi kere ba, kore ni yotte nengō o, jinkō to gōsu. Dō sannen sangatsu jōjun ni shinanonokuni no jūnin, omi no hondazenkō to iu mono miyako he nobori tari keru ni, kano nyorai ni ai tatematsuri tari keru ni, yagate izanai mairase te, hiru ha zenkō, nyorai o oi tatematsuri, yoru ha zenkō, nyorai ni owa re tatematsuri te, shinanonokuni he kudari, minochigun ni anchi shi tatematsuri shi yori konokata, seisō sudeni gohyakuhachijūyosai, enjō no rei ha kore hajime to zo uketamawaru " ōbō tsukin tote ha, buppō mazu horobizu. " to ieri. Sarebaniya, sashimo yangotonakari tsuru reizan no ōku messhinuru ha, ōbō no sue ni narinuru senpyō yaran to zo mōshikeru.

[2.15.1] Saruhodoni kikaigashima no runin domo, tsuyu no inochi kusaba no sue ni kakete, oshimubeki to ni ha arane domo, tanbanoshōshō no shūto heisaishō norimori no ryō, hizennokuni kanose no shō yori, ishoku o tsuneni okurarekere ba, sore nite zo shunkansōzu mo yasuyori mo inochi o ikite sugoshikeru. Yasuyori ha, nagasarekeru toki, suō no murotsumi nite shukkeshite keri. Hōmyō wa shōshō to koso tsuke tari kere. Shukke wa motoyori no nozomi nari kere ba,

lg.l: つひにかくそむきはてける世の中を、とくすてざりし事ぞくやしき。

div.p: [2.15.2] Tanbanoshōshō, yasuyorinyūdō wa motoyori kumano shinjin no hito nare ba, ikanimoshite kono shima no uchi ni kumanosanshogongen o kanjō shi tatematsute kiraku no koto o inorimōsa baya to ī ni, sōzu wa tenshō fushin daīchi no hito nite kore o mochī zu. Futari ha onaji kokoro ni, wakakumano ni ni taru tokoro ya aru to, shima no uchi o tazunemawaru ni, aruiha rintō no myōnaru ari, kōkinshū no yosōi shinajinani, aruiha unrei no ayashimi ari, hekiraryō no iro hitotsu ni arazu Yama no keshiki ki no kodachi ni itaru made, soto yori mo nao sugure tari. Minami o nozome ba, umi manman toshite, kumo no nami kemuri no nami fukaku, kita o kaerimire ba, mata sangaku no gaga taru yori, hyakuseki no takimizu chōraku tari. Taki no oto kotoni susamajiku, matsukaze kamisabi taru sumika, hirōgongen no owasu nachi no miyama ni mo sa mo ni tari keri. Sate koso, yagate soko o ba nachi no miyama to ha nazuke re. Kono mine ha hongū, ano ha shingū, kore ha sonjō sono ōji, ano ōji nado, ōjiōji no na o mōshi te, yasuyori nyūdō sendatsu nite, tanba shōshō aigushi tsutsu, hi gotoni kumanomōde no mane o shi te, kiraku no koto o zo inori keru. " namu gongen kongōdōji, negai ha aware o tare sase owashi te, kokyō he kaeshi ire sase tamae, saishi domo o mo imaichido mise tamae." " to zo inorikeru. Hikazu tsumorite, tachikaubeki jōe mo nakereba, asa no koromo o mi ni matoi, sawabe no mizu o korinikaiteha, iwatagawa no kiyoki nagare to omoiyari, kōsho ni noboriteha, hosshinmon to zo kanjikeru. Mairu tabigoto ni ha yasuyorinyūdō, shūgen o mōshini, goheishi mo nakereba, hana o taotte sasagetsutsu,Koreatareru saiji, jishō gannen hinototori, tsuki no narabi jūgatsu nigatsu, hi no kazu sanbyakugojūyokabi, kichijitsu ryōshin o erabite, kakemaki mo katajikenaku, nihon daīchi daireigen, kumano sansho gongen, hirō daisatta no kyōryō, uzu no hiromae ni shite, shinjin no daiseshu, urin fujiwara naritsune, narabini shami shōshō, isshin shōjō no makoto o itashi sangō sōō no kokorozashi o nukite, tsutsushimite motte kyōbyaku su.Sore shōjō daibosatsu ha, saido kukai no kyōshu, sanjin enman no kakuō nari.Aruiha tōhō jōruri iō no nushi, shubyōshitsujo no nyorai nari.Aruiha nanpō fudaraku nōke no nushi, nyūjūgenmon no daishi, wakaōji wa shabasekai no honshu, semuisha no daishi.Chōjō no butsumen o genji te, shujō no shogan o mi te tamae ri.Kore ni yotte shōichinin yori shimobanmin ni itaru made, aruiha genzeannon no tame ni, aruiha goshōzensho no tame ni ashita ni ha jōsui o musunde, bonnō no aka o susugi, yūbe ni ha shinzan ni mukatte hōgō o tonauru ni, kannō okotaru koto nashi.Gagataru mine no taka o ba, shintoku no takaki ni tatoe, kenkentaru tani no fuka o ba, guzei no fukaki ni nazoraete, kumo o wakatte nobori, tsuyu o shinoide kudaru.Koko ni riyaku no chi o tanomazu nba, ikanga ho o kennan no michi ni hakoba n.Gongen no toku o aoga zu nba, nanzo kanarazushimo yūen no sakai ni mashimasa mu.Yotte shōjōdaigongen, hirōōsata, shōren jihi no hitomi o ainarabe, kojika no onmimi o furitateゝ, warera ga muni no tansei o chikenshi te, ichīchi no konshi o nōjushi tamae.Sareba sunawachi, yuihayatama no ryōshogongen, onōno ki ni shitagaite, uen no shujō o michibiki, muen no gunrui sukuwa n ga tame ni, shippōshōgon no sumika o suteゝ, hachimanshisen no hikari o yawarage, rokudōsan'u no chiri ni onaji tamae ri.Karugayueni jōgō mata yoku ten, motome chōju e chōju no raihai, sode o tsurane, heihaku raiden o sasaguru koto suki nashi.Ninniku no koromo o kasane, kakudō no hana o sasagete, shinden no yuka o dōshi, shinjin no mizu o sumashite, rishō no ike o tatahetari.Shinmei nōju shi tamaha ba, shogan nanzo jōju se zara n.Aogi negawakuha, jūnishogongen, rishō no tsubasa o narabete, harukani kukai no sora ni kakeri, sasen no urei o yamete, kiraku no honkai o togeshime tamahe.Saihai
[2.15.3] To zo yasuyori shūgen o ba mōshi keru.

[2.16.1] Tanbanoshōshō, yasuyorinyūdō, tsune ha sanshogongen no gozen ni mairi te tsuya suru ori mo ari keri. Arutoki futari tsuya shi te, yo mo sugara imayō o zo utai keru. Akatsukigata ni yasuyorinyūdō, chito madorotaru yume ni, oki yori shiroi ho kake taru kobune o issō kogiyose te, fune no naka yori kurenai no hakama kitaru nyōbō, nisanjūnin agari, tsuzumi o uchi koe o totonoe te,

lg.l: 萬の佛の願よりも、千手の誓ぞたのもしき、
枯れたる草木も忽に、花さき實なるとこそきけ。

div.p: [2.16.2] To sanpen uta sumashite, kakesuyōni zo usenikeru. Yume samete nochi, kīnōmoi o nashi, yasuyorinyūdō mōshikeru ha" kore ha ryūjin no kegen to oboe tari. Sanshogongen no uchi ni, nishinōnmae to mōshi ha, honji senjukannon nite ohashimasu. Ryūjin ha sunawachi senju no nijūhachibushū no sonohitotsu nareba, mote onnōju koso tanomoshikere. Mata aruyo futari tsuyashite onajiu menebutarikeru yume ni, oki yori fukuru kaze no, futari ga tamoto ni konoha o futatsu fukikaketarikeru o, nantonau totte mikereba, onkumano no nanboku no ha nite zo arikeru. Kano ni no minamigi no ha ni isshu no uta o mushikui ni koso shitari kere.

lg.l: ちはやぶる神にいのりの繁ければ、などか都へ歸らざるべき。

div.p: [2.16.3] Yasuyorinyūdō, kokyō no koishiki mama ni, semete no hakarigoto ni, senbon no sotoba o tsukuri, a ji no bonji, nengō tsukihi, kana, jitsumyō, nishu no uta o zo kaki tari keru.

lg.l: 薩摩潟沖の小島に我ありと、親には告よ八重の汐風。
思ひやれしばしと思ふ旅だにも、猶ふるさとはこひしき物を。

div.p: [2.16.4] Kore o ura ni moteidete," namukimyōchōrai, bonten taishaku, shitennō, kenrōjishin, ōjō no chinju shodaimyōjin, kotoniha kumanogongen, itsukushimadaimyōjin, semeteha ippon nari tomo, miyako he tsutaete tabe. " tote, okitsu shiranami no, yoseteha kaeru tabigotoni, sotoba o umi ni zo ukabe keru. Sotoba o tsukuridasu ni shitagaite, umi ni ire kereba, hikazu no tsumoreba, sotoba no kazu mo tsumori keri. Sono omō kokoro ya binnokaze to mo nari tari ken. Mata shinmei budda mo ya okura se tamai ken. Senbon no sotoba no naka ni, ippon, akinokuni itsukushima no daimyōjin no omae no nagisa ni uchiage tari.
