[2.16.5] Koko ni yasuyorinyūdō ga yukari ari keru sō, shikarubeki bin mo ara ba, ikanimo shite kanoshima he watatte, sono yukue o kikamu tote, saigoku shugyō ni ide tari keru ga, mazu itsukushima he zo mairi tari keru. Koko ni miyabito to oboshiku te, kariginushōzoku naru zoku, hitori shuttai tari. Kono sō nantonaki monogatari shikeru ni," sore wakōdōjin no rishō, samazamanari to mōse domo, ikaninarikeru innen o motte, kono onkami ha kaiman no uroko ni en o ba musuba se tamau ran. " to toi tatematsuru. Miyabito kotaekeru ha" kore ha yona, shakatsuraryūō no daisan no himemiya, taizōkai no suijaku nari. " konoshima he goeikō arishi hajime yori saidorishō no ima ni itaru made, jinjinkidoku no kotodomo o zo katarikeru. Sarebaniya, hassha no goten iraka o narabe, yashiro ha watatsumi no hotori nareba, shio no michihi ni tsuki zo sumu. Shio michikureba, ōtorī hinotamagaki ruri no gotoshi. Shio hikinureba, natsu no yoru naredo, gozen no shirasu ni shimo zo oku. Iyoiyo tafutoku oboete, hōse sanzete itarikeruni, zenzen higure tsuki sashīdete, shio no michikeruga, sokohakatonaki, mokuzu domo no yurarekeru naka ni, sotoba no katachi no miekeru o, nantonau totte mikereba, oki no kojima ni ware ari to, kakinagaseru kotoba nari. Moji oba horīre kizamitsuketarikereba, nami ni mo araharezu, azāzatoshite zo miekeru. " ana, fushigi. " tote kore o oi no kata ni sashi, miyako he nobori, yasuyori ga rōba no amagimi saishi domo ga, ichijō no kita, murasakino to iu tokoro ni shinobitsutsu sumi keru ni, mise tari kere ba," saraba kono sotoba ga kara no kata he mo yurare ika de, nanishini koremade tsutahi ki te, imasara mono o omoha su ran. " to zo kanashimi keru. Haruka no eibun ni oyobite, hōō kore o goranjite" ana muzan ya, sareba imada kono monodomo ha inochi no ikite ari ni koso. " to, onnamida o nagasase tamau zo katajikenaki. Komatsu no daijin no moto he okura se tamai tari kere ba, kore o chichi no nyūdōshōkoku ni mise tatematsuri tamau. Kakinomotonohitomaru wa, shima gakure yukufune o omoi, yamabenoakahito wa, ashibe no tazu o nagame tamau. Sumiyoshimyōjin wa, katasogi no omoi o nashi, miwamyōjin wa, sugi tateru kado o sasu. Mukashi susanōnomikoto, sanjūichiji no waka o hajime oki tamai shi yori irai, moro no shinmei budda mo, kano eigin o motte, hyakusenbantan no omoi o nobe tamau. Nyūdō mo iwaki nara ne ba, sasuga awaregeni zo notamai keru.

[2.17.1] Nyūdōshōkoku no awaremi tamau ue ha, kyōchū no shōka, oitaru mo wakaki mo, kikai ga shima no runin no uta tote, kuchizusama nu ha nakari keri. Satemo senbon made tsukurīdaseru sotoba nareba sakoso ha chīsau mo ari keme. Satsumagata yori harubaru to miyako made tsutaharikeru koso fushigi nare. Amarini omofu koto ha kaku shirushi ari ni ya.

[2.17.2] Inishihe kan'ō kokoku o semerarekeru ni hajime ha rishōkei o daishōgun nite sanjūmanki mukeraretarikeru ga kan'ō no ikusa yowaku kokoku no ikusa tsuyoshite kangun mina uchihorobosaru. Amatsusahe daishōgun rishōkei kōu no tameni ikedoraru. Tsugini sobu o taishōgun nite, gojūmanki o muke raru. Nao kan no ikusa yowaku ebisu no ikusa tsuyoshi kangun mina horobi keri. Tsuwamono rokusen'yonin ikedori raru. Sononaka ni taishōgun sobu o hajimetoshite, sōtonohei roppyakusanjūyonin, kachīde ichīchini katāshi o kitte, oiharau. Soku shisuru mono mo ari, hodohete shinuru mono mo ari. Sonōchi ni sare domo sobu ha shinazari keri. Katāshi naki mi to nate, yama ni nobote ha ki no mi o hiroi, haru ha sawa no nezeri o tsumi, aki ha tanomo no ochibo o hiroi nado shite tsuyu no inochi o sugoshi keri. Ta ni ikura mo ari keru kari domo, sobu ni minare te oso zari kere ba, korera ha mina wa kokyō he kayō mono zo kashi to natsukashisa ni, omō koto o ippitsu kaki te," aikamae te kore kan'ō ni nobore. " to īfukume, kari no hane ni musubitsuke te zo hanachikeru. Kaigaishikumo tanomo no kari, aki ha kanarazu koshiji yori miyako he kayō mono naru ni, kan no shōtei jōrin'en ni gyoyū ari shi ni, yūsare no sora usugumori, nanitonau monoaware nari keru orifushi, ikkō no kari tobiwataru. Sononaka yori kari hitotsu tobisagarite onore ga hane ni musubitsuketaru tamazusa o kuikirite zo otoshikeru. Kanjin kore o torite mikado ni noboru. Hirakite eiran areba," mukashi ha gankutsu no hora ni komorarete sanshun no shūtan o okuri, ima ha kōden no une ni suterarete koteki no issoku to nareri. Tatohi mukuro ha ko no chi ni chirasu to ifutomo tamashī ha nido kimihe ni tsukahen. " to zo kakitarikeru. Sore yori shite zo fumi o ba gansho tomo ī, gansatsu tomo nazuke taru. " ana muzan ya sobu ga homare no ato nari keri. Imada kokoku ni aru ni koso. " tote kondo ha rikō to iu shōgun ni ōsete, hyakumanki o sashitsukawasu. Kondo ha kan no ikusa tsuyoku shite, kokoku no ikusa yabure ni keri. Mikata ikusa kachi nu to kikoe shika ba, sobu ha kōya no naka yori haide te," kore koso inishie no sobu yo. " to nanoru. Jūkunen no seisō o okutte, katāshi ha kire nagara, koshi ni kakarete, kokyō he zo kaeri keru. Sobu jūroku no sai yori kokoku he mukerare keru ni, mikado yori tamawari tari keru hata o ba nani to shite ka kakushi tari ken, mi o hanatazu mochi tari keri. Ima toridashite mikado no kenzan ni iri tari kere ba, kimi mo shin mo kantan nanamenara zu. Kimi no tame taikō sō nakari shika ba, taikoku amata tamawari, sonōe tenzokukoku to iu tsukasa o kudasare keru to zo kikoe shi.

[2.17.3] Rishōkei ha, kokuni ni todomete, tsuini kaera zu. Ikanimo shite kanchō he kaera n to nomi nagekedomo, kōu yurusa ne ba kanawa zu. Kan'ō kore o ba shiri tamawa zu, kimi no tame ni fuchū no mono nari tote, hakanaku nareru futaoya no mukuro o horiokoite utase raru. Sonohoka rokushin o mina tsumise raru. Rishōkei konoyoshi o tsutekīte, urami fukō zo narinikeru. Sarinagara nao kokyō o koitsutsu, kimi ni fuchū naki yō o ikkan no sho ni tsukute mairasetarikereba," sateha fubin no koto gozannare. " tote fubo ga mukuro horīdaite utaseraretaru koto o zo kuyashimi tamai keru. Kanke no sobu ha fumi o kari no tsubasa ni tsukete kyūri he okuri, honchō no yasuyori ha nami no bin ni uta o kokyō ni tsutau. Kare ha ippitsu no susami, kore ha nishu no uta, kare ha jōdai, kore ha matsudai, kokoku, kikaigashima, sakai o hedate, yoyo ha kaware domo, fuzei ha onaji fuzei. Arigatakari shi koto domo nari.

[3.1.1] Jishō ninen shōgatsu tsuitachi, in gosho ni ha hairei okonaware te, yokka no hi chōkin no gyōkō ari keri. Nanigoto mo rei ni kawari taru koto ha nakere domo, kozo no natsu shindainagon narichikakyō ika, kinju no hitobito ōku use shi koto, hōō goikidōri imada yamazu, yo no matsurigoto mo monōku oboshimesa re te, mikokoro yokara nu koto ni te zo ari keru. Daijōnyūdō mo, tadanokurandoyukitsuna ga tsugeshirase te nochi ha kimi o mo on'ushirometaki koto ni omoitatematsurite, ue ni ha kotonaki sama nare domo, shimo ni ha yōjinshite, kushōshite nomi zo arikeru.
[3.1.2] Onaji shōgatsu nanoka suisei tōhō ni izu. Shiyūki to mo mōsu. Mata akaki tomo mōsu. Jūhachinichi hikari o masu.

[3.1.3] Saruhodo ni nyūdō shōkoku no onna kenreimon'in, sonokoro ha mada chūgū to kikoesasetamaishi ga gonō tote, kumo no ue, ama ga shita no nageki nite zo arikeru. Shoji ni godokyō hajimari, shosha he kanpeishi o tateraru, ika kusuri o tsukushi, on'yōjutsu o kiwame, daihō hihō hitotsu toshite nokoru tokoro nō shuserarekeri. Saredomo, gonō tadanimo watasetamawazu, gokainin to zo kikoeshi. Shujō kotoshi jūhachi, chūgū wa nijūni ni nase tamau. Saredomo, imada miko mo himemiya mo shuttaisase tamawa zu. Moshi miko nite watarase tamawa ba, ikani medetakara n to, heike no hitobito wa tadaima miko gotanjō no arisama ni, yūetsubi aware keri. Take no hitobito mo," heishi no gohanjō ori o e tari, miko gotanjō utagai nashi. " to zo mōshiaware keru. Gokainin sadamara se tamai shika ba, yūgen no kōsō kisō ni ōse te, daihō hihō o shūshi, seishuku butsubosatsu ni tsukete, ōji gotanjō to kisei se raru. Rokugatsu tsuitachi, chūgū gochakutai ari keri. Ninnaji no omuro shukakuhōshinnō, gosandai ari te, kujakukyō no hō o mote, gokaji ari. Tendai no zasu kakukaihōshinnō, onajū sanse tamai te, henjōnanshi no hō o shūse rare keri.

[3.1.4] Kakari shi hodo ni, chūgū ha tsuki no kasanaru ni shitagaite, onmi o kurushū se sase tamau. Ichido warawaba hyaku no kobi ari ken kan no rifujin, shōyōden no yamai no toko mo kaku ya to oboe, tō no yōkihi, rika isshi haru no ame o obi, fuyō no kaze ni shiore, ominaeshi no tsuyu omogenaru yorimo nao itawashiki onsama nari. Kakaru onnayami no orifushi ni awasete, kowaki onmononoke domo, torīri tatematsuru. Yorimashi myōō no baku ni kakete, rei arawaretari. Kotoniha sanukīn no goryō, ujiakusafu no okunen, shindainagonnarichika no shiryō, saikōhōshi ga akuryō, kikaigashima no runintomo no ikiryō nado zo mōshikeru. Kore ni yotte daijōnyūdō ikiryō mo shiryō mo yurusarubeshi tote sonokoro yagate sanukīn gotsuigō arite sutokutennō to gōsu. 宇治惡左府、贈官贈位行はれて、太政大臣正一位を贈らる。 勅使は少内記惟基とぞ聞えし。 件の墓所は、大和國添上の郡、 河上の村、般若野の五三昧也。保元の秋掘起して捨られし後は死骸道の邊の土となて、 年々に只春の草のみ茂れり。今勅使尋來て、宣命を讀けるに、亡魂いかに嬉とおぼし けん。怨靈はかく怖ろしき事也。されば早良の廢太子をば崇道天皇と號し、井上内親 王をば、皇后の職位に復す。是皆怨靈を宥められし策也。冷泉院の御物狂う坐し、花 山の法皇十善萬乘の定位をすべらせ給しは、基方民部卿が靈とかや。三條院の御目も 御覽ぜられざりしは、寛算供奉が靈也。

[3.1.5] 門脇宰相か樣の事共傳聞いて、小松殿に申されけるは、「中宮御産の御祈樣々に候也。 何と申候とも非常の赦に過たる事有るべし共覺え候はず。 Naka ni mo kikaigashima no runin domo shōkan se rare ta ra n hodo no kudoku zenkon, ikade ka sō beki. " to mōsa re kere ba, komatsudono chichi no zenmon no gozen ni za te," ano tanbanoshōshō ga koto o saishō no anagachi ni nage mōshi sō ga fubin ni sō. Chūgū gonau no onkoto, uketamahaoyobu gotokunba, kotosara narichikakyō ga shiryō nado to kikoe saurafu. Dainagon ga shiryō o nadamen to oboshimesan ni tsuke te mo, ikite saurafu shōshō o koso meshikahesare sauraha me. Hito no omohi o yasumase tamaha ba, oboshimesu koto mo kanahi, hito no negahi o kanahe sase tamaha ba, goguwan mo sudeni jōju shi te chūgū yagate, miko gotanjō ari te, kamon no eiguwa iyoiyo sakarini saurafu beshi. " nado mōsarekere ba, nyūdōshōkoku, higoro ni mo ni zu koto no hoka ni nagoide," sate shunkan to yasuyorihōshi ga koto ha ikani. " sore mo onajū meshi koso kaesare sōrawa me. Moshi hitori mo todomare n ha nakanaka zaigō taru beu sō. " to mōsa re tari kere ba," yasuyorihōshi ga koto ha saru koto nare domo, shunkan ha zuibun nyūdō ga kuchīre o motte, hito to na taru mono zo kashi. Sore ni tokoro shimo koso ōkere, waga sansō shishigatani ni jōkaku o kamae te, koto ni furete, kikkai no furumai domo ga ariken nare ba, shunkan o ba omo mo yora zu. " to zo notamaikeru. Komatsudono kaerite oji no saishōdono yobitatematsuri," shōshō ha sudeni shamen sōrawanzuru zo. Mikokoro yasū oboshimesare sōrae. " to notamaeba, saishō te o awasete zo yorokobarekeru. " kudashi toki mo nadoka mōshisōzezaran to omoitari ki nite, norimori o mi sōrō tabigoto ni ha namida o nagashi sōraishi ga, fubinni sōrō. " to mōsarekereba, komatsudono、「 makotoni sakosoha oboshimesare sōrame. Ko ha daretotemo kanashikereba, yokuyoku mōshisōrawan. " tote iritamainu.

[3.1.6] Saruhodoni kikaigashima no runintomo meshikaerubeku sadamerarete, nyūdōshōkoku moto fumi kudasarekeri. Otsukai sudeni miyako o tatsu. Saishō amari no ureshisa ni, ontsukai ni watakushi no tsukai o soe te zo kudasa re keru. " yoru o hiru ni shite isogi kudare. " to ari shika domo, kokoro ni makanu kaiji nare ba, namikaze o shinoi de kōtei ni, miyako o ba shichigatsugejun ni ide tare domo, nagatsuki hatsuka koro ni zo, kikai ga shima ni ha tsuki ni keru.

[3.2.1] Ontsukai ha tanzaemonnojō motoyasu to iu mono nari. Fune yori agatte" koko ni miyako yori nagasa re tamai shi tanbanoshōshōdono heinohangannyūdōdono ya owasuru. " to, koegoe ni zo tazune keru. Futari no hitobito ha, rei no kumanomōde shite nakari keri. Shunkansōzu hitori nokori keru ga, kore o kiki," amarini omohe ba yume yaran, mata tenmahajun no wagakokoro o taburakasan tote ihi yaran, utsutsu tomo oboenu mono kana. " tote, awate futameki hashiri tomonaku, taoru tomonaku, isogi ontsukai no mae ni hashirimukai," nanigoto zo, kore koso kyō yori nagasaretaru shunkan yo. " to nanori tamahe ba, zōshiki ga kubi ni kakesasetaru fumibukuro yori, nyūdōshōkoku no moto fumi torīdete tatematsuru. Hiraite mireba" jūka men onru, haya narubekikirakuomō. Yori chūgū gosan goki okonaware hijōsha. Shikaruaida kikaigashima runin shōshō naritsune, yasuyorihōshi shamen. " to bakarikakarete, shunkan to iumoji ha nashi. Raishi ni zo aran tote, raishi o miru nimo miezu. Oku yori hashi he yomi, hashi yori oku he yomi kere domo, futari to bakari kaka re te, sannin to ha kakare zu.

[3.2.2] Saru hodo ni shōshō ya hōgannyūdō mo shuttai tari, shōshō no totte yomu ni mo, yasuyorinyūdō ga yomikeru ni mo, futari to bakari kakarete, sannin to ha kakare zari keri. yume ni koso kakaru koto ha are, yume ka to omoi nasan to sureba utsutsu nari, utsutsu ka to omoe ba mata yume no gotoshi. sonōe futari no hitobito no moto he ha, miyako yori kotozukebumi domo, ikura mo arikere domo, shunkansōzu no moto he ha, kototoibumi hitotsu mo nashi. sareba waga yukari no monodomo ha miyako no uchi ni ato o todomezu nari ni keri to omoiyaru ni mo shinobi gatashi. Somosomo warera sannin ha tsumi mo onaji tsumi, haisho mo hitotsudokoro nari. Ikannareba shamen no toki, futari ha shōkan sarete, hitori koko ni nokoru beki. Heike no omoi wasure ka ya, shippitsu no ayamari ka. Ko ha ikani shi tsuru koto domo zo ya. " to, ten ni aogi chi ni fushi te, naki kanashime domo kai zo naki. Shōshō no tamoto ni suga te," shunkan ga kaku naru to iu mo, onbe no chichi, ko dainagon dono, yoshi naki muhon yue nari. Sareba yoso no koto to obosu bekara zu. Yurusare nakere ba, miyako made koso kanawa zu tomo, kono fune ni nose te, kyūkoku no chi he tsuke te tamabe. Onōno no kore ni mashimasutsuru hodo koso, haru ha tsubame, aki ha tanomo no kari no otozure ru yō ni, onozukara kokyō no koto o mo tsutekikitsure Ima yori nochi, nani to shite ka ha kikubeki " tote modaekogare tamahi keri. Shōshō," makotoni sa koso ha oboshimesare sōrame. Warera ga meshikaeruru ureshisa ha, sarukoto nare tomo, on'arisama o mioki tatematsuru ni, yukubeki sora mo oboezu. Uchinori tatematsurite mo nobottau sō ga, miyako no mitsukai mo kanau majiki yoshi mōsu ue, yurusare mo nakini, sannin nagara shima o ide tari nado kikoe ba, nakanaka warū sō nan. Naritsune mazu makarinoborite, hitobito ni mo mōshiawase, nyūdōshōkoku no keshiki o mo ukagaite, mukae ni hito o tatematsura n. Sonokan ha kono higoro mashimashi tsuru yō ni omoinashite machi tamae. Nantoshitemo inochi ha taisetsu no koto nareba, kondo koso morasase tamau tomo, tsui ni ha nadoka shamen naute sō beki. " to, nagusame tamae domo, hitome mo shirazu nakimodae keri. Sudeni fune dasu beshi tote hishimeki ae ba sōzu notte ha oritsu orite ha notsu aramashi koto o zo shi tamai keru. Shōshō no katami ni ha yoru no fusuma, yasuyorinyūdō ga katami ni ha, ichibu no hokekyō o zo todomeke ru. Tomozuna hodoite oshidaseba, sōzu tsuna ni toritsuki, koshi ni nari, waki ni nari, chō no tatsu made ha hika re te ide, chō mo oyoba zu nakere ba, fune ni toritsuki" sate ikani onōno, shunkan o ba tsuini sutehate tamau ka. Korehodo to koso omowa zari tsure. Higoro no nasake mo ima ha nani nara zu. Tada ri o magete nose tamae. Semeteha, kyūkoku no chi made. " to kudokare kere domo, miyako no mitsukai" ikanimo kanai sōmaji. " tote, toritsuki tamaeru te o hikinokete, fune ha tsuini kogidasu. Sōzu senkatanasani, nagisa ni nobori taorefushi, chīsakimono no uba ya haha nado o shitau yōni, ashizuri o shite," kore notte ike, gushite ike. " to wamekisakebe domo, kogiyuku fune no narai ni te, ato ha shiranami bakari nari. Imada tōkara nu fune nare domo, namida ni kurete mie zari kere ba, sōzu takaki tokoro ni hashiri agari, oki no kata o zo maneke ru. Kano matsurasayohime ga karafune o shitahitsutsu hire furiken mo kore ni ha sugiji to zo mieshi. Fune mo kogikakure hi mo kure tomo ayashino fushido he mo kaera zu nami ni ashi uchiarawase tsuyu ni shibomite sonoyo ha sokonite zo akasarekeru. Saritomo shōshō ha nasakebukaki hito nareba yoki yōni mōsu koto mo aranzuran to tanomiokake sonose ni mi o mo nagezarikeru kokoro no hodo koso hakanakere. Mukashi sōrisokuri ga kaiganzan he hanatare ken kanashimi mo ima koso omoishirare kere.

[3.3.1] Saruhodo ni kono hitobito ha kikaigashima o idete heisaishō no ryō hizennokuni kasenoshō ni tsuki tamau. Saishō kyō yori hito o kudashite" toshi no uchi ha namikaze mo hageshū michi no aida mo obotsukanau sōrō ni sore nite yokuyoku mi itawate haru ni nate nobori tamae. " to arikere ba shōshō kasenoshō nite toshi o kurasu.

[3.3.2] Saruhodo ni dōnen jūichigatsu jūninichi no tora no koku yori chūgū gosan no ke imasu tote kyōchū rokuhara hishimeki aeri. Gosanjo wa rokuharaikedono nite ari keru ni hōō mo gokō naru. Kanpakudono o hajime tatematsute, daijōdaijin ika no kugyō tenjōbito, subete yo ni hito to kazoherare, kan kakai ni nozomi o kake, shotai shoshiki o taisuru hodo no hito no, hitori mo moru wa nashi keri. Senrei mo, nyōgo, kisaki, gosan no toki ni nozonde taisha okonawaruru koto ari. Daiji ninen kugatsu jūichinichi, taikenmon'in gosan no toki, taisha ari ki. Sono rei tote kondo mo, jūka no tomogara ōku yurusare keru naka ni, shunkan sōzu hitori shamen nakari keru koso utatekere.

[3.3.3] Gosan heian ni ara ba, hachiman, hirano, ōharano nado he, gyōkei naru beshi to goryūgan ari keri. Sengenhōin, kore o keibyaku su. Jinja wa daijingū o hajime tatematsuri te nijūyokasho, butsuji wa tōdaiji, kōfukuji, ige jūrokkasho ni gozukyō ari. gozukyō no otsukai wa, miya no saburai no naka ni yūkan no tomogara kore o tsutomu. hiramon no kariginu ni taiken shitaru monodomo ga, iroiro no gozukyōmono, mitsurugi onzo mochitsuzuite, higashi no dai yori nantei o watatte, nishi no chūmon ni izu. Medetakari shi kenbutsu nari.

[3.3.4] Komatsudaijin ha reino zen'aku ni sawaga nu hito ni te mashikere ba sononochi harukani hodo he te chakushi gonnosukeshōshō ika kindachi no kuruma domo yaritsuzuke sase, iroirono onzo yosoji, ginken nanatsu, hirobuta ni oki se, onma jūnihiki hiki se te mairi tamai. Kankō ni jōtōmon'in gosan no toki ni midōdono on'uma o mairase rare shi sono rei to zo kikoe shi. Kono daijin ha chūgū no on'ani nite mashimashike ru ue, fushi no onchigiri nare ba on'uma mairase tamau mo kotowari nari. Gojō no dainagon kunitsunakyō, on'uma nihiki shinze raru. Kokorozashi no itari ka, toku no amari ka to zo hito mōshike ru. Nao ise yori hajimete, aki no itsukushima ni itaru made, shichijūyokasho he shinme o tate raru. Dairi ni mo ryō no mima ni shide tsuke te, sūjippiki hikitate tari. Ninnaji omuro ha, kujakukyō no hō, tendaizasu kakukaihosshinnō ha, shichibutsuyakushi no hō, tera no chōri enkeihosshinnō ha, kongōdōji no hō, sonohoka godaikokūzō, rokukannon, ichijikinrin, godan no hō, rokujikarin, hachijimonju, fugen'enmei ni itaru made, zansho nau shuse rare keri. Goma no kemuri goshochū ni michi, suzu no oto kumo o hibikishi, shuhō no koe mi no ke katate, ikanaru onmononoke nari tomo omote o mukau beshi tomo mie zari keri. Nao bussho no hōin ni ōsete, onmi tōshin no yakushi narabini godaison no zō o tsukurihajimaru.

[3.3.5] Kakarishikadomo, chūgū ha sukinaku shikirasetamau bakarinite, osan mo tomini nariyarazu. 入道相國、 二位殿、胸に手を置て、こはいかにせんとぞあきれ給ふ。人の物申しけれども、唯と もかくも好樣にとぞ宣ける。さり共「軍の陣ならば、是程淨海は臆せじ物を。」とぞ 後には仰られける。御驗者は、房覺性運兩僧正、春堯法印、豪禪、實專兩僧都、各僧 伽の句どもあげ、本寺本山の三寶、年來所持の本尊達、責ふせ々々々もまれけり。誠 にさこそはと覺えて尊かりける中に法皇は、折しも新熊野へ御幸なるべきにて、御精 進の次なりける間、錦帳近く御座有て、千手經を打上遊されけるにこそ、今一際事替 て、さしも躍狂ふ御よりまし共が縛も、暫打靜けれ。法皇仰なりけるは、「如何なる 御物氣なり共、此老法師がかくて候はんには、爭か近附奉るべき。就中に今現るる所 の怨靈共は、皆我朝恩によて、人と成し者共ぞかし。縱報謝の心をこそ存ぜず共、豈 障碍を成すべきや。速に罷退き候へ。」とて女人生産し難からん時に臨で、邪魔遮障 し、苦忍難からんにも、心を致して大悲呪を稱誦せば、鬼神退散して、安樂に生ぜん と遊いて、皆水精の御數珠を推揉せ給へば、御産平安のみならず、皇子にてこそ坐け れ。

[3.3.6] 頭中將重衡卿、其時は未中宮亮にておはしけるが、御簾の内よりつと出て、御産平安、皇子御誕生候ぞや。 」と、高らかに申されければ、法皇を始參せて、關白殿以下の大臣、公卿、殿上人、各の助修、數輩の御驗者、陰陽頭、典藥頭、惣て堂上堂下、一同にあと悦あへる聲は、門外までどよみて、暫は靜りやらざりけり。 入道餘りの嬉さに、聲をあげてぞ泣ける。 悦泣とは是を云べきにや。 Komatsudono, chūgū no onkata ni maise tamaite, kinsen kujūkumon, miko no mimakura ni oki," ten o motte chichi to shi, chi o motte haha to sadame tamae. Mīnochi ha hōshi tōbōsaku ga yowai o tamochi, mikokoro ni ha amaterasuōmikami irekawara se tamae. " tote, kuwa no yumi yomogi no ya o motte, tenchishihō o isase raru.

[3.4.1] Ochichi ni ha sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō no kitanokata to sadame rare tari shi ga, kyoshichigatsu ni nanzan o shite ushina tama shika ba, onba tairanodainagontokitadakyō no kitanokata, ochichi ni maise tama hi keri. Nochi ni ha sochinosuke to zo mōshi keru. Hōō yagate kangyo no mikuruma o, monzen ni tate rare tari. Nyūdōshōkoku ureshisa no amari ni, sakin senryō, fuji no wata nisenryō, hōō he shinjō se raru. Shikarubekara zu to zo hitobito nainai sasayakiaware keru.

[3.4.2] Kondo no gosan ni shōshi amata ari. Mazu hōō no gogenja, tsugi ni kisaki gosan no toki goten no mune yori koshiki o korogasu koto ari. Miko gotanjō ni ha minami he otoshi, miko tanjō ni ha kita he otosu o, kore ha kita he otoshitari kere ba, kowa ikani to sawagare te toriagete otonaoshi tari kere domo, ashiki onkoto ni hitobito mōshiaeri Okashikari shi ha nyūdōshōkoku no akire sama, medetakari shi ha komatsudaijin no furumai, hoinakari shi ha sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō no, saiai no kitanokata ni okure tatematsutte, dainagondaishō ryōshoku o jishite rōkyoserare shi koto, kyōdai tomoni shusshi ara ba, ikani medetakara n. tsugini shichinin no onmyōji o mesa rete, sendo no oharai tsukamatsuru ni, sononaka ni, kamonnokamitokiharu to iu rōsha ari. Shojū nado mo bōshō nari keri. Amarini hito ōku mairitsudoite, takannaokomi, tōmachikui no gotoshi. " yakunin zo, akerareyo. 」とて、押分々々參る程に、右の沓を踏拔れて、そこにて些立休ふが、冠をさへ突落されぬ。 さばかりの砌に、束帶正しき老者が、髻放てねり出たりければ、若き殿上人こらへずして、一度にどと笑ひあへり。 陰陽師など云は、返陪とて足をもあだにふまずとこそ承れ。 其に懸る不思議の有けるを、其時は何共覺えざりしか共、後こそ思合する事共も多かりけれ。 御産によて、六波羅へ參らせ給ふ人々、關白松殿、太政大臣妙音院、左大臣大炊御門、右大臣月輪殿、内大臣小松殿、左大將實定、源大納言定房、三條大納言實房、五條大納言國綱、藤大納言實國、按察使資方、中御門中納言宗家、花山院中納言兼雅、源中納言雅頼、權中納言實綱、藤中納言資長、池中納言頼盛、左衞門督時忠、別當忠親、左宰相中將實家、右宰相中將實宗、新宰相中將通親、平宰相教盛、六角宰相家通、堀川宰相頼定、左大辨宰相長方、右大辨三位俊經、左兵衞督重教、右兵衞督光能、皇太后宮大夫朝方、左京大夫長教、太宰大貳親宣、新三位實清、以上三十三人、右大辨の外は直衣なり。 Fusan no hitobito ni ha, kazan'in saki daijōdaijin tadamasa kō, ōmiya dainagon takasue kyō, ige jūyonin, gojitsu ni hoi chakushi te, nyūdō shōkoku no nishihachijō no tei he mukawa re keru to zo kikoe shi.

[3.5.1] Mishuhō no kechigan ni ha, kanshō tomo okonawa ru. Ninnaji no omuro ha tōji shūzō se raru beshi. Narabini goshichinichi no mishuhō, daigen no hō, kanjō kōgyō se raru beki yoshi ōsekudasa ru. Mideshi kakushō sōzu, hōin ni kyose raru. Zasu no miya ha, nihon narabini gissha no senji o mōsase tamau. Ninnaji no omuro sasae mōsase tamau ni yote, hōgen enryō, hōin ni nasa ru. Sonohoka no kanshō domo mo age ni itoma ara zu to zo kikoe shi. Chūgū ha hikazu he ni kere ba, rokuhara yori dairi he sanse tamai keri. Kono onmusume, kisaki ni tatase tamai shika ba, nyūdō shōkoku fūfu domo ni," aware, ikanimo shite mo ōji gotanjō are kashi." to zo ī keru. Kurai ni tsukimatsurite, gaisofu, gaisobo to ōsen." to negakeru. wa ga agamimatsuru aki no itsukushima ni mōsan tote, tsukimōde o hajimete, inori mōsarekereba, chūgū yagate, gokainin arite, omoi no gotoku miko nite mashikeru koso medetakere.

[3.5.2] Somosomo heike aki no itsukushima o shinji hajimerare keru koto ha ikani to iuni, tobain no gyō ni kiyomorikō imada akinokami tarishi toki, akinokuni o motte, kōya no daitō o shuri seyo tote, watanabe endō rokurō yorikata o zasshō ni tsukerare, rokunen ni shuri owanu. Shuri owatte nochi, kiyomori kōya e nobori, daitō ogami, okunoin e mairare tari kere ba, izuku yori kuru tomo naki rōsō no, mayu ni ha shimo o tare, hitai ni nami o tatami, kazue no futamata naru ni sugatte, ide tamae ri. Yaya hisashū onmonogatari se sase tamau. " mukashi yori ima ni itaru made kore ha misshū o hikae te taiten nashi. Tenka ni matamo sōrawa su. Daitō sudeni shuri owa sōrata ri. Sateha, aki no itsukushima, echizen no kehi nomiya ha ryōkai no suijaku de sōro ga, kehi nomiya ha sakaetare domo, itsukushima ha naki gagotokuni arehate sōro. Konotsugini, sōmon shite shuri se sase tamae. Sadanimo sōrawa ba, kankakai ha kataonaraburu hito, ari majiki zo. " tote tatere keri. Kono rōsō no iotamaheru tokoro ni ikō kunji tari. Hito o tsukete mise tamahe ba, sanchō bakari ha mitamate sononochi ha kakikesu yōni use tama nu. Kore tadabito ni ha arazu. Sunawachi daishi nite ohashikeri to, iyoiyo tafutoku oboshimeshi, shabasekai no omoide ni tote, kōya no kondō ni mandara o kakare keru ga, nishimandara o ba, jōmyōhōin to iu eshi ni kakase raru. 東曼陀羅をば、清盛書んとて、自筆にかゝれけるが、何とかおもはれけん、八葉の中尊の寶冠をば我首の血を出いて、書かれけるとぞ聞えし。

[3.5.3] さて都へ上り、院參して、此由奏聞せられければ、君もなのめならず御感有り。 猶任を延られて、嚴島を修理せらる。 鳥居を立替へ、社々を造りかへ、百八十間の廻廊をぞ造られける。 修理畢て、清盛嚴島へ參り、通夜せられたりける夢に、御寶殿の 内より、鬟結たる天童の出て、「是は大明神の御使なり。汝此劔を以て一天四海をし づめ、朝家の御まもりたるべし。」とて、銀の蛭卷したる小長刀を賜ると云夢を見て、 覺て後見給へば。現に枕上にぞ立たりける。大明神御託宣有て、「汝知れりや忘れり や、或聖を以て言せし事は。但惡行有らば、子孫迄は叶ふまじきぞ。」とて、大明神 あがらせ給ぬ。 Medetakari shi onkoto nari.

[3.6.1] Shirakawain gozaī no ontoki, kyōgokuōidono no onmusume no kisaki ni tatase tamaite, kenshi no chūgū tote gosaiai ari keri. Shujō kono onhara ni, ōji gotanjō aramahoshū oboshimeshi, sonokoro, yūgen no sō to kikoeshi mīdera no raigōajari o meshite," nanji kono kisaki no hara ni, ōji gotanjō inori mōse, gogan jōjuseba, kanshō ha kō ni yorubeshi. " to zo ōsekeru. " yasū sō" tote mīdera ni kaeri, hyakunichi kantan o kudakete inorimōsarekereba, chūgū yagate hyakunichi no uchi ni gokainin arite, jōhōgannen jūnigatsujūrokunichi. Gosan heian, miko gotanjō ari keri. Kimi nanomenarazu gyokan ari te mīdera no raigō ajari o meshi te" nanji ga shomō no koto ha ikani. " to ōsekudasare kere ba, mīdera ni kaidan konryū no koto o sōsu. Shujō" kore koso zonnohoka no shomō nare. Ikkai sōjō nado o mo mōshi beki ka to koso oboshimeshi tsure. Oyoso ha miko gotanjō ari te kōso o tsugi shime n koto mo kaidaimui o omō tame nari. Ima nanji ga shomō tasse ba sanmon ikidōte sejō mo shizuka naru bekara zu. Ryōmon kassen shite tendai no buppō horobina n zu" tote on'yurusare mo nakari keri.

[3.6.2] Raigō kuchioshī koto nari tote mīdera ni kaete hoshijini se n to su. Shujō ōini odoroka se tamaite gōnosochimasafusakyō sonokoro ha imada mimasakanokami to kikoe shi o meshite" nanji ha raigō to shidan no chigiri ari nari. Īte koshiraete miyo. " to ōsekereba, mimasakanokami ringen o kōmutte, raigōajari ga shukubō ni yukimukai, chokujō no omomuki o ōsefukuman to suru ni, inohokani fusubotaru jibutsudō ni tachikomotte, kowagenaru koe shite," tenshi ni ha tawamurenogen nashi, ringen ase no gotoshi to koso uketamaware. Korehodo no shomō kanawa zara n ni oite ha, ware inorīdashitaru ōji nareba, toritatematsutte madō he koso yukan zurame. " tote, tsuini taimen mo shi zari keri. Mimasakanokami kaerisande, kono yoshi o sōmonsu. Raigō wa yagate hiboshini shi keri. Kimi ikaga se nzuru to eiryo o odoroka se owashimasu. Miko yagate gonō tsuki se tama te, samazamano goki domo ari shi ka domo, kanau beshi domo mie se tama wa zu. Shiraga nari keru rōsō no, shakujō o motte, miko no mimakura ni tatazumi, hitobito no yume ni mo mie, maboroshi ni mo tachi keri. Kowa nado mo oroka nari.

[3.6.3] Saruhodoni jōryaku gannen hachigatsu muika, miko ontoshi yonsai nite tsuini kakusase tama nu. Atsufumi no shinnō kore nari. Shujō nanamenarazu ontame ari keri. Sanmon ni mata saikyō no zasu, ryōshin daisōjō, sonokoro ha en'yūbō no sōzu tote yūgensō to kikoe shi o dairi he meshi te" koha ikaga senzuru. " to ōsekere ba" nanimo, wagayama no chikara nite koso kayō no gogan ha jōju suru koto de sōrae. Kujōushōshō, jikeidaisōjō ni chigiri mōsa se tamawa shi ni yotte koso, reizeīn no miko gotanjō ha sō shi ka. Yasui hodo no onkoto sō. " tote, hieizan ni kaeri nobori, sannōdaishi ni, hyakunichi kantan o kudaite inorimōshikere ba, chūgū yagate hyakunichi no uchi ni gokainin atte, jōryaku sannen shichigatsu kokonoka, gosan heian, miko gotanjō ari keri. Horikawa no tennō kore nari. Onryō ha mukashi mo kaku osoroshikari shi koto nari. Kondo sashimo medetaki gosan ni, hijō no taisha okonaware tari to ie domo, shunkan sōzu hitori, shamen nakari keru koso utatekere.
[3.6.4] Dō jūnigatsu yōka. Miko tōgū ni tatase tamau. Fu ni ha, komatsunaidaijin, taifu ni ha ikenochūnagon'yorimorikyō to zo kikoe shi.

[3.7.1] Akere ba jishō sannen shōgatsu gejun ni tanbanoshōshōnaritsune, hizennokuni kasenoshō o tate, miyako he to isoga re kere domo yokan nao hageshiku kere ba, unakami mo itaku arekere ba, urazutai shimazutai shite, kisaragi tōka koro ni zo, bizen no kojima ni tsuki tamau. Sore yori chichi dainagon dono no sumi tamai keru tokoro o tazune iri te mi tamau ni, take no hashira, furu taru shōji nando ni kaki oki re taru fude no susabi o mi tamai te," hito no katami ni ha shuseki ni sugi taru mono zo naki." Kakioki tamawa zuba ikadeka kore o miru beki。」 tote, yasuyorinyūdō to futari, yomide ha naki, nai te ha yomu。「 angen sannen shichigatsu hatsuka shukke, onaji nijūrokunichi, nobutoshi gekō。」 tomo kaka re tari. satekoso minamotonosaemonnojōnobutoshi ga mairi tari keru mo shire kere. sobanaru kabe ni ha、「 sanzonraigō bin ari, kuhon'ōjō utagai nashi。」 tomo kaka re tari. kono katami o mi tamaite koso、「 sasuga gongujōdo no nozomi mo owashikeri. " to, kagirinaki nageki no naka ni mo isasaka tanomoshigeni ha notamaekere.

[3.7.2] Sono haka o tazunete mitamaeba, matsu no hitomura aru naka ni, kaigaishiu dan o kizukitaru koto mo nashi. Tsuchi no sukoshi takaki tokoro ni shōshō sodekakiawase, ikitaru hito ni mōsuyōni, nakinaki mōsarekeru ha、「 tōki onmori to nase gozashite sō koto o ba, shima nite kasukani tsutaeuketamawarishika tomo, kokoro ni makasenu ukiyo nareba, isogi mairu koto mo sōrawazu. Naritsune kanoshima e nagare te tsuyu no inochi no kieyarazu shite, ninen o okutte, shōkansaruru ureshisa ha, sarukoto nite sōrae domo, konoyo ni watase tamau o mimamiete sōrawa ba koso, inochi no nagaki kai mo ara me. Kore made ha isoga re tsure domo, kyō yori nochi ha, isogu beshi domo oboe zu to, kakikudoite zo naka re keru. Makotoni zonjō no toki nara ba, dainagonnyūdōdono koso, ikani tomo notamau beki ni, shō o hedataru narai hodo, urameshikari keru mono ha nashi. Koke no shita ni ha dare ka kotau beki. Tada arashi ni sawagu matsu no hibiki bakari nari.

[3.7.3] Sononochi ha yomosugara yasuyorinyūdō to futari, haka no mawari o gyōdō shite nenbutsu mōshi, akenureba aratau dan kizuki, kuginuki sesase, mae ni kariya tsukuri, shichinichishichiya, nenbutsu mōshi kyōshote kechigan ni ha dainaru sotoba o tate," kakoshōryō shutsurishōji, shōdaibodai" to kaite, nengōgappi no shita ni," kōshinaritsune" to kakaretareba, shizuyamashizu no kokoronashi mo, ko ni sugitaru takara ha nashi tote, namida o nagashi, sode o shiboranu ha nakarikeri. Toshi sari toshi kitare domo, wasuregataki ha buiku no mukashi no on. Yume no gotoku maboroshi no gotoshi. Tsukigataki ha renbo no ima no namida nari. Sanzejippō no budda no shōju mo awaremi tamai, bōkon sonrei mo, ikani ureshi to oboshi ken. " ima shibashi sōraite, nenbutsu no kō o mo tsumō sōrae domo, miyako ni matsu hitodomo mo kokoromotonau sōran. Mata koso maisōrawa. " tote, mōja ni itoma mōshitsutsu, nakinaki soko o zo tatare keru. Kusakage nite mo nagorioshiu ya omoware ken.

[3.7.4] Sangatsu jūrokunichi shōshōdono toba he akauzo tsukitamau. Kodainagondono no yamazato, suhamadono tote toba ni ari. Sumiarashite toshihenikereba, tsuiji ha ari domo ohohi mo naku, kado ha ari domo tobira mo nashi. Niha ni tachīri mitamaheba, hitoato taete koke fukashi. Ike no hotori o mimahaseba, aki no yama no harukaze ni, shiranami shikirini orikakete shien hakuō shōyōsu. Kyōzeshi hito no kohisa ni, tsukinu mono ha namida nari. Ie wa are domo, ranmon yabure, shitomi yarido mo taete nashi. " koko ni wa dainagon dono no to koso mashi ka, kono tsumado o ba kō koso shutsunyū tamai shi ka, ano ki o ba, mizukara koso ue tamai shi ka. " nado ī te, koto no ha ni tsuki te, chichi no koto o koishigeni koso notamai kere. Yayoi naka no muika nare ba, hana wa mada nagori ari. Yōbaitōri no kozue koso, ori shiri kao ni iroiro nare. 昔の主はなけれ共、春を忘れぬ花なれや。 少將花の下に立寄て、

lg.l: 桃李不言春幾暮、煙霞無跡昔誰栖。
故郷の花の言ふ世なりせば、如何に昔の事を問まし。

div.p:
[3.7.5] 此古き詩歌を口ずさみ給へば、康頼入道も折節哀に覺えて、墨染の袖をぞ濕しける。
暮る程とは待れけれ共、餘に名殘惜くて、夜更る迄こそ坐けれ。更行まゝに、荒たる 宿の習とて、古き軒の板間よりもる月影ぞ隈もなき。鷄籠の山明なんとすれ共、家路 は更に急がれず。さてしも有べき事ならねば、迎に乘物ども遣て、待らんも心なしと て、泣々洲濱殿を出つゝ、都へ歸り入給けん人々の心の中共、さこそは哀にも嬉しう も有けめ。康頼入道が迎にも乘物有けれ共其には乘らで、「今更名殘の惜に。」とて、 少將の車の尻に乘て、七條河原までは行く。其より行別れけるに、猶行もやらざりけ り。花の下の半日の客、月の前の一夜の友、旅人が一村雨の過行に、一樹の陰に立よ て、別るゝ名殘も惜きぞかし。 況や是は憂かりし島の栖、船の中、浪の上、一業所感の身なれば、前世の芳縁も不淺や思ひしられけん。

[3.7.6] Shōshō wa shūto heisaishō no shukusho e tachīri tamau. Shōshō no hahaue wa, reizan ni zakeru ga, kinō yori saishō no shukusho ni zate machire keri. Shōshō no tachīri tamau sugata o hitome mite," inochi are ba" to bakari zo notamai keru. Hikikazukite zo fushi tamau. Saishō no uchi no nyōbō saburai domo sashitsudoite, mina yorokobinaki tomoshi keri. Mashite shōshō no kitanokata, uba no rokujō ga kokoronōchi, sakoso ha ureshikari keme. Rokujō ha tsukusenu monōmoi ni kurokari shi kami mo mina shiroku nari, kitanokata, sashimo hanayakani utsukushiu mashimashika tomo, itsushika yaseotoroe te, sonohito tomo mie tamawa zu. Shōshō no nagasare tamai shi toki, sansai nite wakare tamai shi itokinaki hito, nagau nari te kami yū hodo nari. Mata sono katawara ni mittsu bakari naru sukunaki hito no mashikeru o, shōshō" are ha ikani. " to notamae ba, rokujō" kore koso" to bakari mōshi te, sode o kao ni oshiate, namida o nagashi keru ni koso," sateha kudari shi toki, kokorogurushigenaru arisama o mioki shi ga, kotoyue naku sodachikeru yo. " to omoīde te mo kanashikari keri. Shōshō ha moto no gotoku in ni meshitsukaware te, saishōchūjō ni agari tamau.
[3.7.7] Yasuyorinyūdō ha, tōzansōrinji ni, waga yamanoshō no arikere ba, soko ni ochitsukite, mazu omoitsuzuke keri.

lg.l: 故郷の軒の板間に苔むして、思し程は洩ぬ月かな。

div.p: [3.7.8] Yagate soko ni rōkyoshite, ukari shi mukashi o omoitsuzuke, hōbutsushū to iu monogatari o kake keru to zo kikoe shi.

[3.8.1] Saruhodo ni kikaigashima he sannin nagasare tari shi runin futari ha shōkansare miyako he nobori nu. Shunkansōzu hitori, ukari shi shima no shimamori to nari ni keru koso utatekere Sōzu no, sukō yori fubinni shite meshitsukaware keru warawa ari Na o ba ariō to zo mōshikeru Kikaigashima no runin, kyō sudeni kyōto he iri to kikoe shika ba, toba made yukimukō te mi kere tomo, wagashū ha mie tamawa zu " ikani" to toe ba," so ha nao tsumibukashi tote, shima ni nokosare tama nu" " to kiki te kokorō nado mo oroka nari. Tsune ha rokuharahen ni tatazumiarīte kike domo, shamen aru beshi tomo kikīdezu. Sōzu no onnago no shinobite mashikeru tokoro he maite," kono se ni mo morasase tamate, onobori mo sōrawazu. Ikanimoshite kano shima he watate, oyukuhe o tazunemairasen to koso omoitate sōrahe. Ofumi tamawaran. " to mōshikere ba, nakinaki kaite tamawari keri. Itoma o koi tomo, yomo yurusa ji tote, chichi ni mo haha ni mo shirase zu. Tōsen no tomozuna ha uzuki satsuki nimo toke nare ba, natsugoromo tachi o osoku ya omoi ken. Sangatsu no sue ni miyako o ide te, ōku no namiji o shinogi tsutsu, satsumagata he zo kudari keru. Satsuma yori kanoshima he wataru funatsu nite, hito ayashimi, ki taru mono o hagitori nado shi kere tomo, sukoshimo kōkai se zu, himegozen no ofumi bakari zo hito ni mise ji tote, motodori no naka ni kakushi tari. Sate shōnin fune ni nori te kudan no shima he watari te mi ni, miyako nite kasuka ni denbun shi ha, koto no kazu ni mo ara zu. Ta mo nashi. Hatake mo nashi. Mura mo nashi. Sato mo nashi. Onozukara hito wa ari domo, iu kotoba mo kikishira zu. Moshishika sama no monodomo no naka ni waga shū no yukusue shiri taru mono ya aran to," monomōsa u" to ie ba," nanigoto" to kotau. " koko ni miyako yori nagasare tamai shi hosshōjishugyō gobō to mōsu hito no on'yukusue ya shiri taru. " to toi ni, hosshōji tomo shugyō tomo shira tara ba koso henji mo se me. Tada kashira o furite" shiri zu" to iu. Sononaka ni arumono ga kokoroe te," isa toyo, sayō no hito ha sannin koko ni ari shi ga, futari ha shōkan sa re te miyako he nobori nu. Ima hitori ha nokori sa re te, asoko koko ni madoi aruke domo, yukue mo shira zu. " to zo ī keru. Yama no kata no obotsukanasa ni, harukani wakeiri, mine ni yoji, tani ni kudare domo, shirakumo ato o uzunde, ōrai no michi mo sadakanara zu, seiran yume o yabute sono omokage mo mi zari keri. Yama nite ha tsuini tazune mo awa zu, umi no he ni tsukite tazunuru ni, satō ni shirushi o kizamu kamome, oki no shirasu ni sudaku hamachidori no hoka ha, ato tō mono mo nakari keri.

[3.8.2] 或朝磯の方より、蜻蛉などの樣に痩衰たる者一人よろぼひ出來り。 本は法師にて有けりと覺て、髮は虚樣へ生あがり、萬の藻屑取附て、荊を戴たるが如し。 節見れて皮ゆたひ、身に著たる物は絹、布の分も見えず。 片手には荒海布を拾ひ持ち、片手には網人に魚を貰て持ち、歩む樣にはしけれ共、はかも行かず、よろ／＼として出來たり。
「都にて多くの乞丐人見しか共、かゝる者をば未見ず、『諸阿修羅等故在大海邊』と て、修羅の三惡四趣は深山大海の邊に有と、佛の説置給ひたれば、知らず、我餓鬼道 に尋來るか。」と思ふほどに、彼も此も次第に歩近づく「若か樣の者も、我主の御行 末知たる事や在ん。」と、「物申さう。」と言ば「何事」と答ふ。「是に都より流さ れ給し法勝寺の執行御房と申す人の御行末や知たる。」と問に、童は見忘たれ共、僧 都は何か忘べきなれば、「是こそ其よ。」と云も敢ず、手に持る物を投捨て、沙の上 に倒伏す。さてこそ我主の行末も知てけれ。軈て消入給ふを、膝の上に掻乘奉り「有 王が參て候。多くの浪路を凌て、是迄尋參りたる甲斐もなく、いかに軈て憂目をば見 せさせ給ふぞ。」と、泣々申ければ、良在て、少し人心地出來、扶起されて「誠に汝 が是まで尋來たる志の程こそ神妙なれ。明ても暮ても、都の事のみ思ひ居たれば、戀 き者共が面影は、夢に見る折も有り、幻に立つ時も有り。身も痛く疲弱て後は、夢も 現も思分かず。されば汝が來れるも唯夢とのみこそ覺れ。若この事夢ならば、覺ての 後は如何せん。」有王、「現にて候也。此有樣にて、今まで御命の延させ給て候こそ。 不思議には覺候へ。 " to mōse ba," sareba koso. Kozo shōshō ya hōgannyūdō ni sute rare te nochi no bin na sa, kokoro no naka o ba tada oshihakaru beshi. Sono se ni mi o mo nagen to se shi o, yoshinaki shōshō no,『 imaichido miyako no otozure o mo machi kashi. 』 nado nagusameoki shi o oroka ni wakaya to tanomi tsutsu korahen to ha se shika domo konoshima ni ha hito no shokumotsu taete naki tokoro nare ba mi ni chikara no arishi hodo ha yama ni noborite iō to iu mono o tori kuni yori kayō akindo ni ai mono ni kae nado se shika domo hi ni sohite yowariyuki ba ima ha sono waza mo se zu. Kayōni hi no nodokanaru toki ha, iso ni idete amibito tsuribito ni te o suri, hiza o kagamete, uo o morai, shiohi no toki ha kai o hiroi, arame o tori, iso no koke ni tsuyu no inochi o kakete koso, kyō made mo zonjitare. Saradeha ukiyo o wataru yosuga oba ikani shitsuran to omowan. " sōzu," kokonite nanigoto o mo iwabaya to omō domo, iza wagaie he. " to notamae ba, kono on'arisama ni te mo ie o mochi tamae ru fushigi sa yo. " to omoi te yuki hodo ni, matsu no hitomura aru naka ni, yori take o hashira to shi, ashi o musubi te, ketahari ni watashi, ue ni mo shita ni mo matsu no ha o hishito torikake tare ba, fūu tamaru beu mo nashi. Mukashi ha hosshōji no jimushoku ni te, hachijūyokasho no shōmu o tsukasadori shika ba, munemon hiramon no uchi ni, shigohyakunin no shojūkenzoku ni inyō se rare te koso owase shika. Me no atari kakaru ukime o mi tamai keru koso fushigi nare. Gō ni sama／＼ ari. Jungen, junshō, jungogō to ie ri. Sōzu ichigo no aida, mi ni mochīru tokoro, mina daigaran no jimotsu butsumotsu ni ara zu to iu koto nashi. Sareba kano shinsemuzan no tsumi ni yorite, konjō ni haya kanze rare keri to zo mie tari keru.

[3.9.1] Sōzu gen nite ari keri to omoisadame te" somosomo kozo shōshō ya hōgannyūdō ga mukae ni mo, korera ga fumi to iu koto mo nashi. Ima nanji ga bin ni mo, otozure no naki ha kō tomo iwa zari keru ka. Ariō namida ni musebi utsubushi te, shibaraku ha mono mo mōsa zu. Yomishite okiagari, namida o osaete mōshikeru ha" kimi no nishihachijō he idesase tamaishikaba, yagate tsuibu kanjin maite, miuchi no hitobito karametori, gomuhon no shidai o tazunete, usehate sōnu. Kitanokata ha sukunaki hito o kakushikane mairase tamaite, kurama no oku ni shinobase tamate sōshini, kono warawa bakari koso tokidoki maite miyazukae tsukamatsuri sōshiga, nanimo gonageki no orokanaru koto ha sōwazarishikadomo, itokinaki hito ha amarini koimairase tamate, mairi sō tabigotoni," ariō yo, kikaigashima tokaya he ware gushite maire. 』 to muzukara se tamawa sō shi ga sugi sō shi nigatsu ni mogasa to mōsu koto ni use sase tamawa nu. Kitanokata ha sono nageki to mōshi kore no onkoto to mōshi ippōnaranu on'omoi ni shizumi mase tamawa i, hi ni soe te yowa ra se tamawa sō shi ga onaji sangatsu futsuka no hi tsuini hakanaku nari se tamawa nu. Ima ha himegozen bakari, nara no obagozen no omoto ni owatari sō. Koko ni ofumi tamahate sō. " tote torīdete tatematsuru. Akete mitamaeba ariō ga mōshi ni tagawazu kakaretari. Oku ni ha" nadoya sannin nagasaretaru hito no, futari ha shōkansarete sō ni, imamade onobori sōwa nu zo. Aware takaki mo iyashiki mo, onna no mi bakari kokorōkarikeru mono ha nashi. Otoko no mi nite sōwa ba, watase tamau shima he mo, nadoka tazunemairade sō beki. Kono ariō otomo nite, isogi nobose tamae. " to zo kaka re taru. " kore miyo, ariō. Kono ko ga fumi no kakiyō no hakanasa yo. Onore o tomo ni te, isogi nobore to kaki taru koso urameshikere. Kokoro ni makase taru shunkan ga mi nara ba, nani tote ka sannen no shunjū o ba okuru beki. Kotoshi ha jūni ni naru to koso omō ni, korehodo hakanaku te ha, hito ni mo mie, miyazukae o mo shite, mi o mo tasuku beki ka." to te nakare keru ni koso, hito no oya no kokoro ha yami ni ara ne domo, ko o omō michi ni mayō hodo mo shire kere." konoshima he nagasare te nochi ha, koyomi mo nakere ba tsukihi no kawariyuku o mo shira zu, tada onozukara hana no chiri, ha no otsuru o mi te shunjū o wakimae, semi no koe bakushū o okure ba natsu to omoi, yuki no tsumori o fuyu to shiru. Shirotsuki kurotsuki no hengyō o mi te ha misoka o wakimae, yubi o ori te kazoe ba kotoshi ha roku ni nari to omo tsuru itokinaki mono mo haya sakidachi keru gozannare. Nishihachijō e ide shi toki, kono ko ga ware mo yu u to shita shi o, yagate kae uzuru zo to koshira e o shi ga, ima no yō ni obo ru zo ya. Sore o kagiri to omo ha mashika ba, ima shibara mo nado ka mi zara n. Oya to nari, ko to nari, fūfu no en o musu mo, mina konoyo hito ni kagi nu chigiri zo kashi. Nado saraba sorera ga sayōni sakidachikeru o imamade yumemaboroshinimo shirasezarikeru zo Hitome mo hazukashigarazu ikanimoshite inochi ikiyō to oboshi mo korera o imaichido mibaya to omō tame nari Hime ga koto bakari koso kokorogurushikere domo sore mo shōshin nareba nagekinagara mo suginzuran Sa nomi zonjite onoreni ukime misen mo wagami nagara mo tsuyogaokarubeshi " tote mizukara no shokuji o todome hitoeni mida no myōgō o tonaete rinjūshōnen o zo inorarekeru Ariō watatte nijūsannichi to iu ni sonoiori no uchi nite tsuini owari tamai nu. Toshi sanjūshichi to zo kikoe shi. Ariō akisugata ni toritsuki, ten ni aogi chi ni utsubushi, nakikanashime tomo kai zo naki. Kokoro no yukuhodo nakiakite," yagate gose no otomo tsukamatsuru beu sōrae domo, konoyo ni ha himegozen bakari koso owatari sōrae. Gose tomurai mairasu beki hito mo sōrawa zu. Shibarakuarite, toburai mairase sōrawa n tote, fushido o aratame zu, iori o kirikake, matsu no kareeda, ashi no kareha o toriōi, moshio no kemuri to nashi tatematsuri, dabiji tsuini kere ba, shirahone o hiroi, kubi ni kake, mata akibitobune no tayori ni, kyūkoku no chi he zo tsukini keru.

[3.9.2] Sōzu no onnago no suwarikeru tokoro ni maite, arishi sama hajime yori komagomato katarimōsu. " nakanaka fumi o goranji te koso itodo omoiha masa tamahite sōrai shika. Suzuri mo kami mo sōrawa ne ba gohenji ni mo oyoba zu. Oboshimesare sōrai shi mikokoro no naka sanagara munashikute yami sōrō ni ki. Ima ha shōjōseze o okuri, tashō kōgō o hedatsu tomo, ikadeka onkoe o mo kiki, onsugata o mo mimaise tama beki. " to mōshikere ba, fushimarobi koe mo oshimazu nakare keri. Yagate jūni no sai ama ni nari, nara no hokkeji ni yukizumi te, fubo no gose o tomurai tamai zo awarenaru. Ariō ha shunkansōzu no ikotsu o kubi ni kake, kōya he nobori, okunoin ni osame tsutsu, rengedani nite hōshi ni nari, shokoku shichidō shugyō shite, shū no gose o zo tomurai keru. Kayōni hito no shitan no tsumi nuru heike no sue koso osoroshikere.

[3.10.1] Dō gogatsu jūninichi umanokoku bakari, kyōchū ni ha tsujikaze obitadashiku fuki te, hitoya ōku tentō su. Kaze ha nakamikadokyōgoku yori oki te, hitsujisaru no hō he fuki te yuki ni, munemon hiramon o fukinuki te, shigochō jitchō fuki mote yuki, keta nageshi hashira nado ha kokū ni sanzai su. Hiwada, fukīta no tagui, fuyu no ki no ha no kaze ni midaru ga gotoshi. Oitadashū naridoyomu oto ha, ka jigoku no gōfū nari tomo, kore ni ha sugiji to zo mie shi. Tada shaoku no hason suru nomi nara zu, inochi o ushinau hito mo ōshi. Gyūba no rui kazu o tsukushite uchikorosaru Kore tadagoto ni arazu Miura aru beshi tote jingikan ni shite miura ari " ima hyakunichi no naka ni roku o omonzuru daijin no tsutsushimi, besshite ha tenka no daiji, narabini buppō ōbō tomoni katamukite heikaku aitsuzuku subeshi " tozo jingikan onmyōryō tomoni uranai mōshikeru

[3.11.1] Komatsudaijin, kayō no kotodomo o kikitamaite, yorozu kokorobosō ya omoware ken. Sonokoro kumanosankei no koto arikeri. Hongūshōjōden no gozen nite, yosugara kyōbyakuserarekeru ha" shinpunyūdōshōkoku no tei o miru ni, akugyakumudō ni shite, dōsureba kimi o nayashitatematsuru. Shigemori chōshi toshite, shikirini isame o itasu to iedomo, mi fushō no aida, kare motte fukuyōsezu. Sono furumai o miru ni, ichigo no eiga nao ayaushi. Shiyō renzoku shite, oya o arawashi na o agen koto katashi. Konotoki ni atatte, shigemori iyashikumo omoe ri. Namajīni resshite, yo ni fuchin se n koto, aete ryōshin kōshi no hō ni arazu. Shikaji, na o nogare mi o shirizoite, konjō no meibō o nagesute, raise no bodai o motome n ni ha. Tadashi bonbu hakuji, zehi ni madō ga yueni, nao kokorozashi o hoshīmamani se zu. Namu gongenkongōdōji, negawakuha shison sakae tae zu shite, tsukaete chōtei ni majiwaru beku ba, nyūdō no akushin o yawaragete, tenka no anzen o e shime tamae. Eiyō mata ichigo o kagirite, kōkon haji ni oyobu beku ba, shigemori ga unmei o tsuzumete, raise no kurin o tasuke tamae. Ryōko no gugan, hitoeni myōjo o aogu. " to, kantan o kudaite kinense rare keru ni, tōrō no hi no yōnaru mono no, daijin no onmi yori idete, hato kiyuru gagotoku shite usenikeri. Ninzūta mitatematsuri kere domo, osorete kore o mōsa zu.

[3.11.2] Mata gekō no toki, iwatagawa o watara re keru ni, chakushi gonnosukeshōshōkoremori ige no kindachi, jōe no shita ni usuiro no kinu o ki te, natsu no koto nare ba, nantonau kawa no mizu ni tawamure tamau hodo ni, jōe no nure te kinu ni utsutaru ga, hitoeni iro no gotokuni mikere ba, chikugonokamisadayoshi kore o mitogamete," nanto sō yaran, ano onjōe no yo ni imawashiki yōni mie sase zashi sō. Meshikaera ru beu ya sō ran. " to mōsarekere ba, daijin" wa shogan sudeni jōjushi ni keri. sono jōe aete aratamu bekara zu." tote, besshite iwatagawa yori, kumano he etsu no hōhei o zo taterare keru. hito ayashito omohi kere domo, sono kokoro o e zu. shikani kono kindachi, hodonaku, makoto no iro o kisetamaikeru koso fushiginare.

[3.11.3] Gekō no nochi iku no hikazu o he zu shite, yamai tsukitamau. Gongen sudeni gonaju aru ni koso tote, ryōji mo shitamawazu. Kitō o mo itasare zu. Sonokoro sōchō yori masaru meī watatte, honchō ni yasurau koto ari. Kyōsetsu nyūdōshōkoku, fukuhara no betsugyō ni zakeru ga, etchūnokamimoritoshi o tsukai de, komatsudono he ōserarekeru ha" shorō iyoiyo daijinaru yoshi sono kikoe ari. Kanete ha mata sōchō yori masaru meī watareri. Kyōsetsu yorokobitosu. Kore o meshishōji te iryō o kashime tamae. " to, notamawasare tari kere ba komatsudono fuki sare, moritoshi o gozen he meshi te" mazu iryō no koto, kashikomatte uketamawa sō nu to mōsubeshi. Tadashi nanji mo uketamaware. Engi no mikado ha sabaka no ken'ō nite watase mashi／＼ kere domo ikoku no sōnin o miyako no uchi he ire sase tamai tari keru o ba matsudai made mo ken'ō no on'ayamari honchō no haji to koso mie tare. Iwan'ya shigemori hodo no bonjin ga ikoku no ishi o ōjō he ire n koto kuni no haji ni arazu ya. Kankōso wa, sanjaku no tsurugi o hissagete tenka o osame kadomo, wainan no geifu o uteshi toki, ryūshi ni ate kizu o kōmuru. Kisakiryotaikō, ryōi o mukaete miseshimuru ni, i no iwaku『 kono kizu chishi tsubeshi. Tadashi gojikkin no kane o ataeba chisen. 』 to iu. Kōso no tamawaku,『 ware mori no tsuyokashi hodo wa, ōku no tatakai ni aite kizu o kōmuri shikadomo, sono itami nashi. Un sudeni tsuki nu. Inochi ha sunawachi ten ni ari. Tatohi henjaku to iu tomo, nani no eki ka aran. Shikaraba mata kane o oshi ni nitari. 』 tote, gojikkin no kane o ishi ni atahe nagara tsuini chise zari ki. Sengen mimi ni ari, ima mote kanshin su. Shigemori iyashikumo kyūkei ni resshi, sandai ni noboru. Sono unmei o hakaru ni, mote tenshin ni ari. Nanzo tenshin o sasse zu shite, guni iryō o itawashiu se mu ya. Moshi jōgō tara ba iryō o kuwau tomo yaku nakara n ka. Mata higō tara ba ryōji o kuwae zu tomo tasukaru koto o u beshi. Kano giba ga ijutsu oyoba zu shite daikakuseson, metsudo o batsudaiga no hotori ni tonau. Kore sunawachi jōgō no yamai, iyasa zaru koto o shimesa n ga tame nari. Jōgō nao iryō ni kakawaru beu sōrawa ba shakuson ani nyūmetsu ara n ya. Jōgō mata chisuru ni tae zaru mune akirakashi. Chisuru ha buttai nari. Ryōsuru ha giba nari. Sareba shigemori ga mi buttai ni arazu. Meī mata giba ni oyobekara zu. Tatoe shibu no sho o kangamite, hyakuryō ni chōzu to iu tomo ikade udai no eshin o guryōse n ya. Tatohi gokyau no setsu o kuhashiku ni shite, shubyau o iyasu to ifu tomo, ani zense no gofubyau o jise n ya. Moshi ka no ijutsu ni yotte zonmei se ba, honteu no idau naku ni ni tari. Ijutsu kōken nakunba, men'etsu shosen nashi. Nakanzukuni honchō teishin no gaishō o motte, ichō fuyū no raikyaku ni min koto, katsuha kuni no haji, katsuha michi no ryōchi nari. Tatohi shigemori inochi ha usezu to iu tomo, ikadeka kuni no haji o omō kokoro o zonze zara n. Kono yoshi o mōse. " to koso notamai kere.

[3.11.4] Moritoshi fukuhara ni kaeri maite kono yoshi nakinaki mōshikere ba nyūdōshōkoku" korehodo kuni no haji o omō daijin jōko ni mo mikika zu, mashite matsudai ni ari beshi tomo oboe zu. Nihon ni sōōse nu daijin nare ba ikayō ni mo kondo shitsu nan zu. " tote nakunaku isogi miyako he nobora re keri.

[3.11.5] Dō shichigatsu nijūhachinichi komatsudono shukke shi tamai nu. Hōmyō wa jōren to koso tsuki tamae. Yagate hachigatsu tsuitachi, rinjū shōnen ni jūshite tsuini use tamai nu. Ontoshi yonjūsan, yo wa sakari to koso mie tsuru ni, awarenarishi koto domo nari.

[3.11.6] Nyūdōshōkoku no, sashimo yokogami o yarare tsuru mo, konohito no naoshi nadamerare tsure ba koso, yo mo odayakari tsure. Kononochi tenka ni ikanaru koto ka shuttaisenzuran tote, kyōchū no shōka nagekiaeri. Sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō no katasama no hito ha, yo ha tadaima daishōdono he mairinanzu tozo yorokobikeru. Hito no oya no ko o omō narai ha, orokanaru ga sakidachi danimo kanashiki zo kashi. Iwan'ya kore ha tōke no tōryō tōsei no kenjin nite ohashikere ba, on'ai no wakare, ie no suibi, kanashidemo nao amari ari. Saraba yo ni ha ryōshin o ushinaeru koto o nageki, ie ni ha buryaku no sutarunuru koto o kanashimu. Oyoso ha kono daijin bunshō uruwashūshite, kokoro ni chū o zonshi, saigei sugurete, kotoba ni toku o kane tamae ri.

[3.12.1] Tensei kono daijin ha, fushigi no hito nite, mirai no koto o mo kanete satori tamaikeru niya, saru shigatsu nanoka hi no yume ni, mi tamaikeru koto koso fushigi nare. Tatoeba, izuku tomo shira nu hamaji o harubaruto ariki tamau hodo ni, michi no katawara ni ōnaru torī ari keru o," are ha ikanaru torī yaran. " to toi tamae ba," kasugadaimyōjin no ontorī nari. " to mōshi. Hito ōku gunjushi tari. Sononaka ni, hōshi no kashira o hitotsu sashiage tari. " sate ano kubi ha ikani. " to tohi tamahe ba, kore ha heike daijōnyūdōdono no onkashira o akugyō chōkashi tamahe ru ni yotte, tōsha daimyōjin no meshitorise tamahe te sō. " to mōshi to oboe te, yume uchiodoroki nu. Tōke wa hōgen heiji yori ikō, tabitabi no chōteki o tairagete, kanshō mi ni amari, katajikenaku itten no kimi no gogaiseki toshite, ichizoku no shōshin rokujūyonin. Nijūyonen no ikō wa, rakuei mōshi bakari mo nakaritsuru ni, nyūdō no akugyō chōkaseru ni yotte, ichimon no unmei sudeni tsukinzuru ni koso to, koshikata yukusue no kotodomo oboshimeshitsuzukete, onnamida ni musebasetamau.

[3.12.2] Orifushi tsumado o hotohototo uchitataku. Dare so. Are kike. " to notamae ba," seotarōkaneyasu ga maite sō. " to mōshi. " ikani, nanigoto zo. " to notamae ba," tadaima, fushigi no koto sōte, yoru no ake sōwa n ga osō oboe sōma, mōsa n ga tame ni maite sō. Gozen no hito o nozokare sōe. " to mōshikere ba, daijin hito o harukani nozokite taimen ari. Sate kaneyasu ga mi tari keru yume no sama o hajime yori owari made kuwashiu katari mōshike ru ga, daijin no goranji tari keru gomu ni sukoshimo chigawa zu. Satekoso seotarōkaneyasu o ba kami ni mo tsūji taru mono nite ari keri to daijin mo kanji tamai kere.

[3.12.3] Sono asa chakushi gonnosukeshōshōkoremori in no gosho he mairan tote ide sase tamai tari keru o daijin yobi tatematsute" hito no oya no mi toshite kayō no koto o mōse ba kiwamete okogamashikere tomo onhe no hito ha kodomo no naka ni ha kate mie tamau nari. Tadashi kono yononaka no ariyō ikaga ara muzuran to kokorobosō koso oboyure. Sadayoshi wa nai ka, shōshō ni sake susume yo. " to notamae ba, sadayoshi oshaku ni mairi tari. " kono sakazuki o ba mazu shōshō ni koso torase takere domo, oya yori saki ni wa yomo nomitamawa ji nare ba, shigemori mazu toriage te shōshō ni sasa n. " tote, sando ukete, shōshō ni zo sasare keru. Shōshō mata sando uke tamau toki," ikani sadayoshi hikidemono se yo. " to notamae ba kashikomatte uketamawari nishiki no fukuro ni iretaru ontachi o toridasu. " aware kore ha ie ni tsutawareru kogarasu to iu tachi yaran. " nado yoni ureshigeni omoite mitamau tokoroni sahanakushite daijinsō no toki mochīru mumon no tachi nite zo arikeru. Sonotoki shōshō keshiki ha tokawate yoni imawashigeni mitamaikere ba daijin namida o haraharato nagaite" ikani shōshō sore ha sadayoshi ga toga ni mo arazu. Sonoyue ha ikani to iuni kono tachi ha daijinsō no toki mochīru mumon no tachi nari. Nyūdō ikanimo owase n toki, shigemori ga obi te guse n tote mo tari tsure domo, ima ha shigemori, nyūdōdono ni sakidachi tatematsu nzure ba, onhotori ni tatematsuru nari. " to zo notamai keru. Shōshō kore kiki tamai te tokō no henji ni mo oyoba zu. Namida ni musebi utsubushi te, sonohi ha shusshi mo shi tamawa zu, hikazuki te zo fushiwatarō. Sononochi daijin kumano he mōderi gekō shi te yamai tsuki, ikuhodo mo naku shite tsuini use tamai keru ni koso jitsuni mo to omoi shira re kere.

[3.13.1] Subete kono daijin ha metsuzaishōzen no mikokorozashi fukō mashikere ba tōrai no fuchin o nageite higashiyama no fumoto ni rokuhachiguzei no gan ni nazoraete shijūhachiken no shōja o tate ikken ni hitotsuzutsu shijūhachiken ni shijūhachi no tōrō o kakerarekere ba kuhon no daimoku no mae ni kagayaki kōyō rankyō o migaite jōdo no migiri ni nozomeru ga gotoshi. Maitsuki jūyokka jūgonichi o tenjite, tōke take no hitobito no onkata yori, mimeyoku wakō sakannaru nyōbōtachi o ōku shōjiatsume, hitoma ni rokunin zutsu, shijūhachiken ni nihyakuhachijūhachinin, jishu ni sadamete, kano ryōjitsu ga aida ha, isshinshōmyō koe taezu, makotoni raigōinjō no higan mo, koko ni yōgō o tare, sesshufusha no hikari mo, konōtodo o terashi tamau ka to zo mie shi. Jūgonichi no nitchū o kechigan toshite, dainenbutsu ari shi ni, daijin mizukara kano gyōdō no naka ni majirite, saihō ni mukai," namu annyōsekaikyōshumidazenzei, sangairokudō no shujō o amaneku saidoshi tamae. " to, ekōhotsugan se rare kere ba, miru hito jihi o okoshi, kiku mono kanrui o moyōshikeri. Kakarishikaba kono daijin oba tōrōdaijin to zo hito mōshikeru.

[3.14.1] Mata daijin wagachō ni ha ikanaru daizengon o shioki tari tomo shison sōzoku de toburan koto ari gatashi Takoku ni ikanaru zengon o mo shite gose o toburawa re ba ya to angen no koro hoi chinzei yori myōten to iu sendō o meshinobose hito o harukani nozokete taimen ari Kane o sanzengohyakuryō meshiyose te" nanji ha daishōjiki no mono de an nare ba, gohyakuryō o ba nanji ni tamau. Sanzenryō o ba sōchō he watashi, ikuōzan he mairase te, senryō o ba sō ni hiki, nisenryō o ba mikado he mairase, tashiro o ba ikuōzan he mōshiyose te, wa ga gose tomurawa se yo. " to zo notamai keru. Myōten kore o tamaite, banri no enrō o shinogitsutsu, daisōkoku he zo watarikeru. Ikuōzan no hōjō, busshōzenjitokukō ni aitatematsuri, kono yoshi mōshitarikereba, zuikikantanshite, senryō o sō ni hiki, nisenryō o ba mikado he mairase, daijin no mōsarekeru mune o tsubusani sōmonseraretarikereba, mikado ōini kanjioboshimeshite, gohyakuchō no tashiro o ikuōzan he zo yorarekeru. Sareba nihon no daijin, tairanoasonshigemorikō no goshōzensho to inoru koto, imani taezu tozo uketamawaru.

[3.15.1] Nyūdōshōkoku komatsudono ni okure tamaite, yorozu kokorobosō ya omoware ken, fukuhara he hasekudari, heimon shite koso zakere. Dō jūichigatsu nanoka no yoru inunokoku bakari, daichi obitadashiku ugoite hisashi. 陰陽頭安倍泰親、急ぎ内裏へ馳參て、「今夜の地震、占文の指す所其愼輕からず。 當道三經の中に、坤儀經の説を見候に、『年を得ては年を出ず、月を得ては月を出ず、日を得ては日を出 ず。』と見えて候。以の外に火急候。」とて、はらはらとぞ泣ける。傳奏の人も色を 失ひ、君も叡慮を驚せ坐ます。若き公卿殿上人は「怪からぬ泰親が今の泣樣や、何事 の有るべき。」とて、笑合れけり。され共此泰親は、晴明五代の苗裔を請て、天文は 淵源を窮め、推條掌を指が如し。一事も違はざりければ、指神子とぞ申ける。雷の落 懸りたりしか共、雷火の爲に、狩衣の袖は燒ながら、其身は恙も無りけり。上代にも 末代にも、有がたかりし泰親なり。

[3.15.2] 同十四日、相國禪門此日比福原におはしけるが、何とか思ひなられたりけん。 數千騎の軍兵をたなびいて、都へ入給ふ由聞えしかば、京中何と聞わきたる事は無れ共、上下怖れおののく。 何者の申出したりけるやらん。 Nyūdōshōkoku chōka o uramitatematsubeshi to hirō o nasu. Kanpakudono, nainai kikoshimesuru mune ya ari ken, isogi gosandai arite," kondo shōkokuzenmon juraku no koto ha hitoeni motofusa horobosu beki kekkō nite sō nari. Ikanaru ukime ni ka au beki yaran. " to, sōsesasetamaeba, shujō ōini odorokasetamaite," sokoni ikanaru me nimo awan ha hitoeni tada ware au nite koso aranzurame. " tote, onnamida o nagasasetamau zo katajikenaki. Makotoni tenka no mimatsurigoto ha shujō setsuroku no mihakarigoto nite koso ari ni, ko ha ikani shi tsuru koto domo zo ya. Amaterasuōmikami kasugadaimyōjin no shinryo no hodo mo hakari gatashi.

[3.15.3] Dō jūgonichi, nyūdōshōkoku chōka o urami tatematsuru beki koto, hitsujō to kikoe shika ba, hōō ōini odorokase tamaite, ko shōnagon shinzei no shisoku jōkenhōin o mitsukai nite, nyūdōshōkoku no moto he tsukawasa ru. " kinnen chōtei shizukanara zu shite, hito no kokoro mo totonora zu, seken mo ochīse nu sama ni nariyuku koto, sōbetsu ni tsukete nagekioboshimese domo, sate soko ni are ba, banji ha tanomioboshimeshite koso ari ni, tenka o shizumaru made koso nakara me, gōgōnaru tei ni te, amatsusae chōka o uramu beshi nado kikoshimesu ha, nanigoto zo. " to ōseyarawasa ru. Jōkenhōin ontsukai ni nishihachijō no yashiki he mukau. Ashita yori yū ni oyobu made matsure kere domo buin nari kere ba saraba koso to muyakuni oboete minamotonodaibuhangankanesada o mote chokujō no omomuki īiresase" itomamōshite. " tote iderare kere ba sonotoki nyūdō" hōin yobe. " tote iderare tari. Yobikaei te" yaya, hōin no gobō, jōkai ga mōsutokoro ha higagoto ka. Mazu naifu ga mimakari sō nuru koto, tōke no unmei o hakari ni mo, nyūdō zuibun hirui o oshite koso makarisugi sōrae. Onbe no kokoro ni mo suisatsu shi tamae. Hōgen igo ha rangyaku uchitsuzuite, kimi yasui mikokoro mo watase tamawa zari shi ni, nyūdō ha tada ōkata o shigyōu bakari de koso sōrae. Naifu koso te o kudashi mi o kudaite, tabitabi no gekirin o ba yasume mairasete sōrae. Sonohoka rinji no ōdaiji, chōseki no seimu, naifu hodo no kōshin ha arigatō koso sōrame. Koko o motte inishie o omō ni, tō no taisō ha gichō ni okurete, kanashimi no amari ni,『 mukashi no insō ha yume no naka ni ryōhitsu o e, ima no chin ha samete no nochi kenshin o ushinau.』 to iu hibun o jishoshite, byō ni tate dani koso kanashimitamaikeru nare 』 to iu hibun o jishoshite, byō ni tate dani koso kanashimitamaikeru nare Wagachō ni mo, majikaku misōraishi koto zo kashi Akiyori minbukyō seikyoshitarishi o ba, koin kotoni onageki arite, hachiman no gyōkō en'inshi, gyoyū nakariki Subete shinka no shussuru o ba, daidai no mikado mina onageki aru koto de koso sōrae Sarebakoso oya yori mo natsukashū, ko yori mo mutsumajiki ha kimi to shin to no naka to ha mōshi koto nite sōrame Saredomo naifu ga chūin ni, hachiman no gokō ari te gyoyū ari ki. Ontameiki no iro ichiji mo kore o mi zu. Tatohi nyūdō ga kanashimi o on'awaremi naku tomo, nadoka naifu ga chū o oboshimeshi wasure sase tamau beki. Tatohi naifu ga chū o oboshimeshi wasure sase tamau tomo, ikadeka nyūdō ga nageki o on'awaremi nakaran. Fushi tomoni eiryo ni somuki sō nuru koto, ima ni oite menboku o ushinau. Kore hitotsu. Tsugini echizennokuni o ba, shishisonson made, gohenkai ari majiki yoshi, goyakusoku arite tamahate sō shi o, naifu ni nochite nochi, yagate mesare sō koto ha, nanno katai nite sō yaramu. Kore hitotsu. Tsugini chūnagon ketsu no sō shi toki, nīchūjō no shomō sō shi o, nyūdō zuibun shūshi shika domo, tsuini goshōin nakushite, kanpaku no musuko o nasa ruru koto ha ikani. Tatoi nyūdō ikanaru hikyo o mōshi okonau tomo ichido ha nadoka kikoshimeshīre deha sō beki. Mōshi sō wan ya, kechaku to ī, ikai to ī, riun sayū ni oyoba nu koto o hikichigae sase tamau ha, hoi naki onhakarai to koso zonji sō e. Kore hitotsu. Tsugini shindainagon narichika kyō ige, shishigatani ni yoriai te, muhon no kuwadate sō shi koto, mattaku watakushi no keiryaku ni ara zu. Shikashi kimi onkyoyō ari ni yotte nari. Imamekashiki mōshigoto nite sōrae domo, shichidai made ha kono ichimon oba ikadeka sute sase tamau beki. Sono ni nyūdō shichijun ni oyobite, yomei ikubaku nara nu ichigo no uchi ni danimo, yayamosureba horobosu beki yoshi onhakarai ari. Mōshi sōrawa n'ya, shison ai tsuide, chōka ni meshitsukaware n koto ari gatashi. Oyoso oite ko ushinau ha, kareki no eda na ni kotonara zu. Ima ha hodonaki ukiyo ni, kokoro o tsuiyashite mo nanika ha se n nareba, ikademo arana n to koso, omoinashite sōrae. " tote katsu ha haradachi shi, katsu ha rakurui shi tamae ba hōin kowau mo mata aware ni mo oboe te asemizu ni nari tama nu. Sonotoki ha ikanaru hito mo hitokoto no henji ni oyo gataki koto zo kashi. Sonōe ware mi mo kinju no jin nari. Shishigatani ni yoriai tari shi koto o tadashū mikikare shika ba sono ninzū tote tadaima mo meshi ya komerare n zuran to omō ni ryū no hige o nade tora no o o fumu kokochi ha se rare kere domo hōin mo saru kowai hito de isasaka mo sawaga zu mōsa re keru ha" makotoni tabitabi no gohōkō asakara zu. Ittan urami mōsa se imasu mune sono ī sōrō. Tadashi kan'i to ī hōroku to ī, onmi ni totte ha kotogotoku manzokusu. Sareba kō no bakudainaru koto o mo kimi gyokan atte koso sōrae. Shikaruni kinshin koto o midari, kimi gokyoyō ari to iu koto, bōshin no kyōgai nite zo sōran. Mimi o shinjite me o utagau ha zoku no tsune no hei nari. Shōnin no fugen o omōshite, chōon no ta ni kotonaru ni, kimi o somuki mairase tamawan koto to, myōken ni tsukete, sono osore sukunakarazu sōrō. Oyoso tenshin wa sōsōtoshite hakarigatashi, eiryo sadamete konogi de zo sōran. Shimo toshite kami ni sakafuru koto wa, ani jinshin no rei taran ya. Yokuyoku goshī sōbeshi. Senzuru tokoro konōmomuki o koso hirōtsukamatsuri sōwame. " tote iderarekere ba, ikuramo narabītaru hitobito," ana osoroshi. Nyūdō no arehodo ikari tamaeru ni, isasakamo osorezu, henji uchishite tateru koto yo. " tote, hōin o homenu hito koso nakari kere.

[3.16.1] Hōin gosho e mai te, kono yoshi sōmon se rare kere ba, hōō mo dōri shigoku shi te, ōsekuda ruru kata mo nashi. Dō jūrokunichi nyūdōshōkoku, konohi ki omoitachi tamaeru koto nare ba, kanpakudono o hajime tatematsuri te, daijōdaijin ika no kugyō, tenjōbito, yonjūsannin ga kanshoku o todome te, oikome raru. kanpakudono o ba, dazainosochi ni utsushi te, chinzei he nagashi tatematsuru. kakaran yo ni ha, totemo kakutemo ari nan tote, toba no hotori, furukawa to iu tokoro nite, goshukke ari. Ontoshi sanjūgo. 禮儀能く知めし、曇なき鏡にて渡せ給ひつる者をとて、世の惜奉る事斜ならず、遠流の人の道にて出家したるをば、約束の國へは遣ぬ事である間、初は日向國と定られたりしか共、御出家の間、備前の國府の邊、井ばさまと云ふ所に留め奉る。
[3.16.2] 大臣流罪の例は、左大臣蘇我赤兄、右大臣豐成、左大臣魚名、右大臣菅原、左大臣高明公、右大臣藤原伊周公に至る迄、既に六人。 され共攝政關白流罪の例は、是始めとぞ承る。

[3.16.3] 故中殿の御子二位の中將基通は入道の婿にておはしければ、大臣關白になし奉らる。
圓融院の御宇、天禄三年十一月一日、一條攝政謙徳公失給しかば、御弟堀川の關白忠 義公、其時は未從二位中納言にてましましけり。其御弟法興院の大入道殿其比は大納 言の右大將にておはしける間、忠義公は、御弟に越られ給しか共、今又越返し奉り、 内大臣正二位にあがて、内覽の宣旨蒙らせ給ひたりしをこそ、人皆耳目を驚したる御 昇進とは申しに、是は其には猶超過せり、非參議二位中將より大中納言を經ずして、 大臣關白になり給ふ事いまだ承り及ばず。普賢寺殿の御事也。上卿の宰相、大外記、 大夫史に至る迄、皆あきれたる樣にぞ見えたりける。

[3.16.4] Daijōdaijin moronaga wa tsukasa o todomete, higashi no kata e nagasare tamau. Inuru hōgen ni chichi akusadaijindono no enza ni yotte, kyōdai yonin ruzai serare tamai shi ga, on'ani udaishō kanenaga, on'otōto sachūjō takanaga, hanchōzenji sannin wa kiraku o matazu, haisho nite use tamai nu. Kore ha tosa no hata nite, kyūkai no shunjū o okurimukae, chōkan ninen hachigatsu ni shōkan sarete, hon'i ni fukushi, tsugi no toshi shōgatsu shōnī shite, nin'an gannen jūgatsu ni, sakinochūnagon yori gonnodainagon ni nobori tamau. Orifushi dainagon akezarikere ba, in no hoka ni zo kuwawarare keru. Dainagon rokunin ni naru koto kore hajime nari. Mata sakinochūnagon yori gondainagon ni naru koto mo, nochinoyamashinanōtodo mimorinokimi, ujinodainagon takakuninokyō no hoka ha, imada uketamaharioyoba zu. Kangen no michi ni tasshi, saigei sugurete mashimashikere ba, shidai no shōshin todokōra zu, daijōdaijin made kiwamesase tamahite, mata ikanaru tsumi no mukui ni ya, kasanete nagasare tamafu ran. Hōgen no mukashi ha nankai tosa he utsusare, jishō no ima ha mata tōkan owarikoku to kaya. Motoyori tsumi nakushite, haisho no tsuki o min to iu koto ha kokoroarikiwa no hito no negau koto nareba, daijin aete kotodomoshi tamawa zu. Kano tō taishihinkyaku hakurakuten, jin'yō no e no hotori ni yasurai tamai ken sono inishie o omoiyari, narumigata shioji harukani tōmishite, tsuneha rōgetsu o nozomi, urakaze ni usobuki, biwa o danji, waka o eijite, tōkan gatera ni tsukihi o okura se tamai keri. Arutoki tōgoku no daisan no miya atsutamyōjin ni sankei ari. Sonoyo shinmei hōraku no tame ni, biwa hiki rōei shi tamau ni, tokoro motoyori muchi no sakai nareba, jō o shireru mono nashi. Yūrō, sonjo, gyojin, yasō, kōbe o tare, mimi o sobadatsu to iedomo, sarani seidaku o wakete, ryoritsu o shiru koto nashi. Saredomo kohakin o danzeshikaba, gyorin yakuhotobashiri, gukō uta o hasseshikaba, ryōjin ugokiyuku. Mono no myō o kiwamaru toki ni ha, shizenni kan o moyōsu kotowari nareba, shonin mi no ke yodate, manza kī no omoi o nasu. Zenzen shinkō ni oyobide, fūkōchō no naka ni ha, hana funpuku no ki o fukumi, ryūsen no kyoku no aida ni ha, tsuki seimei no hikari o arasō. Negawakuha konjō sezoku moji no gō, kyōgenkigyo no byū o mote to iu rōei o shite, hikyoku o hikitamaeba, shinmei kannō ni taezushite, hōden ōini shindōsu. Heike no akugyō nakari se ba, ima kono zuisō o ikade ka ogamu beki tote, daijin kanrui o zo nagasa re keru.

[3.16.5] Azechidainagonsukekatakyō no shisoku ukon'enoshōshō kane sanukinokami minamotonosuketoki, futatsu no kan o todomera ru. Sangikōtaigōgūnogonnodaibuken'uhyōenokamifujiwaranomitsuyoshi, ōkurakyōukyōnodaibuken'iyonokamitakashinanoyasutsune, kurōdosashōbenkenchūgūnogonnodaishinfujiwaranomotochika, sankan tomoni todome ra ru. Azechidainagonsukekatakyō, shisoku ukon'enoshōshō, mago no ushōshōmasakata, kore sannin o yagate miyako no naka o oidasa ru beshi tote, shōkei ni ha tōdainagonsanekuni, hakasehangan nakaharanonorisada ni ōse te, yagate sonohi miyako no naka o oidasa ru. Dainagon notamaeru ha" sangai hiroshi to ie domo, goshaku no mi okidokoro nashi. Isshō hodonashi to ie domo, ichinichi kuregatashi. " tote, yonaka ni kokonoe no uchi o magiredete, yaetatsu kumo no soto he zo omomukare keru. Kano ōeyama, ikuno no michi ni kakari tsutsu, tanbanokuni murakumo to iu tokoro ni zo shibashi ha yasurai tamaeru ga, sore yori tsuiniha tazuneidasarete, shinanonokuni to zo kikoeshi.

[3.18.1] 同廿日、院御所法住寺殿には、軍兵四面を打圍む。 平治に信頼が、仕たりし樣に、火をかけて、人をば皆燒殺さるべしと聞えし間、上下の女房女童、物をだに打被かず、 遽て噪で走出づ。法皇も大に驚かせおはします。前右大將宗盛卿、御車を寄て、「と う／＼めさるべう候。」と奏せられければ、法皇「こはされば何事ぞや。御とがある べし共思召さず。成親俊寛が樣に遠き國遙の島へも、遷遣んずるにこそ。主上さて渡 せ給へば、政務の口入する計也。其もさるべからずば、自今以後さらでこそ有め。」 と仰ければ、宗盛卿「其儀では候はず。世を靜ん程、鳥羽殿へ御幸成參せんと、父入 道申候。」「さらば宗盛やがて御供に參れ。」と仰けれ共、父の禪門の氣色に畏を成 て、參られず。「哀れ是に附ても、兄の内府には事外に劣たる者かな。一念もかゝる 御目に逢べかりしを内府が身に代て制し停てこそ今日迄も心安かりつれ。 諫むる者無しとて、か樣にするにこそ。 行末とても憑しからず。 」とて御涙を流させ給ふぞ忝けなき。

[3.18.4] Mata jōkenhōin, nyūdōshōkoku no nishihachijō no yashiki ni ikite," yūbe hōō no tobadono he gokō natte sōnaru ni, gozen ni hito hitori mo sōwanu yoshi uketamawaru ga amarini asamashū oboe sō. nanika kurushū sōbeki, jōken bakari ha goyurusare sōe kashi. mairi tamawan." to mōsarekereba," tōtō, gobō ha koto ayamatsumajiki hito nareba." tote yurusarekeri. hōin tobadono he maitte, monzen nite kuruma yori ori, mon no uchi he sashīretamaeba, orishimo hōō, gokyō o uchiageage asobasarekeru gosei mo kotoni sugō kikoesasetamaikeru. Hōin no tsuto maira re tare ba, asobasa re keru mikyō ni, onnamida no harahara to kakara se tama o mimaise te, hōin yo no kanashisa ni, kawashiro no sode o kao ni oshiate, nakinaki gozen he zo maira re keru. Gozen ni ha amagoze bakari sōrawa re keri. " ikani ya hōin gobō, kimi ha kinō no asa, hōjūjidono nite, kugo kikoshimesa re te nochi ha, yobe mo kesa mo kikoshimeshi mo irazu. Chōya sugara mine mo nara zu. Mīnochi mo sudeni ayauku koso mie sase gozamase. " to notamae ba, hōin namida o oshite mōsare keru ha," nanigoto mo kagiri aru koto nite sōrae ba, heike tanoshimi sakaete nijūyonen. Saredomo akugyō hō ni sugite sudeni horobi sōrō nanzu. Nakanimo kimi no ontanomi aru hiesannōshichisha, ichijōshugo no onchikai aratamara zu ba, kano hokkehachijiku ni tachikakete koso, kimi o ba mamorimairase tamau rame. Shikareba seimu ha kimi no miyo to nari, kyōto ha mizu no awa to shōshitsu sōrō beshi. " nado mōsa re kere ba, kono kotoba ni sukoshi nagusamese mashima su.

[3.18.5] Shujō ha kanpaku no nagasa re tamai, shinka no ōku horobi nuru koto o koso onageki ari keru ni, amatsusae hōō tobadono ni oshikomera re sase tamau to kikoshimesa re te nochi ha tsuyatsuya kugo mo kikoshimere zu. [3.18.6] Hōō tobadono he oshikomerare sase tamahite nochi ha dairi ni ha rinji no goshinji tote shujō yogoto ni seiryōden no shikkui no dan nite isedaijingū o zo gohai ari keru. Nijōin ha, ken'ō nite watase tamaishika domo, tenshi ni fubo nashi tote, tsune ha hōō no ōse o mo mōshikaesase mashikeru yue ni ya, keitai no kimi nite mo mashimasa zu. Sareba oyuzuri o ukesase tamaitarishi rokujōin mo, angen ninen shichigatsu jūyokka ontoshi jūsan nite hōgyo narinu. Asamashikarishi onkoto nari.

[3.19.1] " hyakugyō no naka ni ha, kōkō o motte saki to su." Meiō wa kō o motte tenka o osamu. " to ieri. Sareba tōgyō wa oiotoroetaru haha o tōtobi, gushun wa katakunanaru chichi o uyamau to mietari. Kano ken'ōseishu no senki o owasemashikemu eiryo no hodo koso medetakere. [3.19.3] Hōō wa jōnan no rikyū ni shite, fuyu mo nakaba sugi sase tamae ba, noyama no arashi no oto nomi hageshikute, kantei no tsuki no hikari zo sayakeki. Niwa ni wa yuki nomi furi tsumore domo, ato fumi tsukuru hito mo naku, ike ni wa tsurara toji kasanete, mure i shi tori mo mie zari keri. Ōtera no kane no koe, iaiji no kiki o odorokashi, nishiyama no yuki no iro, kōrohō no nozomi o moyōsu. Yoshimo ni samuki kinuta no hibiki, kasukani mimakura ni tsutahi, akatsukigohori o kishiru kuruma no ato, harukani monzen ni yokohareri. Chimata o suguru kaujin, seiba no isogahashigenaru keshiki, ukiyo o wataru arisama mo oboshimeshishirarete aharenari. Kyūmon o mamoru ban'i no yachū keiei o tsutomeru mo, sakinoyo no ikanaru chigiri nite, ima en o musubu ran to ōse nari keru zo katajikenaki. Oyoso mono ni fure koto ni shitagaite, mikokoro o itamashime zu to iu koto nashi. Sarumama ni ha kano oriori no goyūran, shosho no gosankei, goga no medetakari shi kotodomo, oboshimeshitsuzuke te, kaikyū no onnamida osae katashi. Toshi sari toshi kite, jishō mo yonen ni nari keri.

[4.1.1] Jishō yonen shōgatsu tsuitachi no hi, tobadono ni ha, shōkoku mo yurusa zu, hōō mo osorosase mashi kere ba, ganjitsu gansan no aida, sannyū suru hito mo nashi. Dō shōgatsu hatsuka no hi tōgū onhakamagi, narabini onmanahajime tote, medetaki koto tomo shi kadomo hōō ha tobadono nite, onmimi no yoso ni zo kikoshimesu

[4.1.2] Nigatsu nijūichinichi, shujō kotonaru tsutsuga mo watase tamawa nu o oshikudashi tatematsuri, tōgū senso ari Kore ha nyūdōshōkoku, yorozu omō yō naru ga itasu tokoro nari Toki yoku nari nu tote hishimeki aeri. Naishidokoro shinji hōken watashi tatematsuru. Kandachime jin ni atsumete, koji tomo senrei ni makasete okonaishi ni, bennonaishi mitsurugi tote ayumīzu.
