Toshi sudeni nagatari. Nido sakari o kisu beki ni mo ara zu tote hitobito nikumi ae ri shi ni, bitchūnonaishi tote, shōnen jūrokusai, imada osanaki mi nagara, sono go ni wazato nozomi mōshite torīde keru, yasashikari shi sama nari. Tsuta ware ru gyobutsu domo shina％＼ tsukasatsukasa uketotte shintei no kōkyo gojōdairi he watashi tatematsuru. Kan'indono ni ha hi no kage mo kasukani keijin no koe mo todomari takiguchi no monjaku mo taeni kereba furuki hitobito kokorobosoku oboete medetaki iwai no nakani namida o nagashi kokoro o itamashimu Sadaijin jin ni ide gokuraiyuzuri no kotodomo ōseshi o kīte kokoroaru hitobito ha namida o nagashi sode o nurasu Ware to mikurai o chokun ni yuzuri tatematsuri, makoya no yama no naka mo, shizukani nado oboshimesu sakizaki dani mo, aware ha ōki narai zo kashi. Iwan'ya kore ha mikokoro nara zu, oshikudasare sase tamai ken awaresa, mōshi mo nakanaka oroka nari.

[4.1.3] Shintei kotoshi ha sansai, aware nanishika naru jōi kana to, toki no hitobito mōshiaware keri. Tairanodainagontokitadakyō wa uchi no onba, sochi no suke no otto taru ni yotte" kondo no jōi nanishika nari to, dare ka katabuke mōsu beki. Ikoku ni wa, shū no seiō sansai, shin no bokutei nisai, wagachō ni wa, konoein sansai, rokujōin nisai, kore mina mutsuki no naka ni tsutsuma re te, itai o tadau se zari shika domo, aruiha sesshō ōte kurai ni tsuke, aruiha bokō idakite chō ni nozomu to mie tari. Gokan no kōshōkōtei wa umarete hyakunichi to iu ni senso ari. Tenshī o fumu senshō, wakan kakunogotoshi. " to mōsarekere ba, sonotoki no yūsoku no hitobito," ana osoroshi, mono na mōsare so. Sareba sore ha kōrei domo ka ya. " to zo tsubuyaki aware keru. Tōgū kurai ni sokuse tamai shika ba, nyūdōshōkoku fūfu tomoni gaisofu gaisobo tote, jusangō no senji o kōmuri, nenkan nenshaku o tamawa te, jōjitsu no mono o meshitsukau. Egaki hana tsuketaru samurai domo deirite, hitoeni ingū no gotoku nite zo ari keru. Shukke nyūdō no nochi mo eiyō ha tsukuse zu to zo mie shi. Shukke no hito no jusangō no senji o kōmuru koto ha hōkōin no ōnyūdōdono kaneiekō no gorei nari.

[4.1.4] Onajiki sangatsu jōjun ni jōkō akinokuni itsukushima he gokō naru beshi to kikoe keri. Teiō kurai o suberase tamai te shosha no gokō no hajime ni ha hachiman kamo kasuga nado he koso nase tamau ni akinokuni made no gokō ha ikani to hito fushin o nasu. Aruhito no mōshikeru ha" shirakawain ha kumano he gokō, goshirakawa ha hiyoshi no yashiro he gokō naru. Sudeni shiranu, eiryo ni ari to iukoto o. " goshinchū ni fukaki goryūgan ari. Sonōe kono itsukushima oba heike nanamenarazu, sūkei tamau aida, kami niwa heike ni godōshin, shimo niwa hōō no nantonau tobadono ni oshikomerarete watarase tamau, nyūdōshōkoku no muhon no kokoro o mo yawage tamae to no gokinen no tame to zo kikoe shi Sanmon no daishu ikidōri mōsu. " iwashimizu, kamo, kasuga e nara zu ba, wagayama no sannō e koso gokō wa naru bekere Akinokuni e no gokō wa nani no narai zo ya Sonogi nara ba mikoshi o furioroshi tatematsutte, gokō o todome tatematsure. " to sengishi kere ba, kore ni yotte shibaraku goen'in ari keri. Nyūdōshōkoku yōyō ni nadametamae ba, sanmon no daishu shizumari nu.

[4.1.5] Dō jūshichinichi, itsukushima gokō no gokadode tote, nyūdōshōkoku no nishihachijō no tei he irase tamau. Sonohi no kuregata ni, sakinōdaishō munemorikyō o meshite," asu gokō no tsugi ni, tobadono he maitte, hōō no kenzan ni irabaya to oboshimesu ha ikani." Shōkokuzenmon ni shirase zu shite ha, warukari nan ya. " to ōsekere ba, munemorikyō namida o harahara to nagai te," nanjō koto ka sōrō beki. " to mōsarekere ba," saraba munemori sonoyō o yagate kon'ya tobadono he mōse kashi. " to zo ōsekeru. Sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō, isogi tobadono he mai te, kono yoshi sōmon se rarekere ba, hōō amarini oboshimesu onkoto nite, yume yaran to zo ōsekeru.

[4.1.6] Dō jūkunichi, ōmiyadainagon takasue kyō mada yofukō maite gokō moyōsare keri. Kono higoro kikoesase tamai tsuru itsukushima no gokō, nishihachijō yori sudeni togesase owasu. Sangatsu mo nakaba sugi nure do, kasumi ni kumoru ariake no tsuki ha nao oboro nari. Koshiji o sashite kaeru kari no kumoi ni otozure okonau mo, orifushi aware ni kikoshimesu. Mada yo no naka ni tobadono he gokō naru. Monzen nite mikuruma yori kudara se tamai, mon no naka he sashīre se tamau ni, hito mareni shite ki kuraku, mono sabishigenaru misumika, mazu awareni zo oboshimesu, haru sudeni kure nan to su, natsu kodachi ni mo nari ni keri. Kozue no hana no iro otoroe te, miya no uguisu koe oita ri. Kyonen no shōgatsu muika no hi, asagoto no tame ni, hōjūjidono he gyōkō ari shi ni ha, gakuya ni ranjō o sōshi, shokei retsu ni tate, shoe jin o hiki, inji no kugyō mairimukite, manmon o hiraki, kamonryō endō o shiki, tadakari shi gishiki ichiji mo nashi. Kyō ha tada yume to nomi zo oboshimesu.

[4.1.7] Shigenori chūnagon, mikeshiki mōshi tari kere ba, hōō shinden no hashikakushi no ma he gokō nari te, taisan sase tamai keri. Jōkō wa kotoshi ontoshi hatachi, akegata no tsuki no hikari ni hae sase tamai te, gyokutai mo itodo utsukushū zo misase owashimasu. Onhahagi kenshunmon'in ni, itaku nimaira se tamaitari kere ba, hōō wa senkonyoin no onkoto oboshimeshīdete, onnamida sekiaesase tamawa zu. Ryōin no omashi, chikaku shitsuraware tari. Onmondō wa hito uketamawaru ni oyoba zu. Onmae ni wa amagoze bakari zo sōraware keru. Hisashū onmonogatari se sase tamau. Harukani hi take te nochi, on'itoma mōsa se tamai, toba no kusatsu yori onfune ni mesa re keri. Jōkō ha hōō no rikyū no kotei, yūkansekibaku no onsumai, onkokorogurushiku goranjiokasetamae ba, hōō ha mata jōkō no ryohaku no angū, nami no ue, fune no naka no on'arisama, obotsukanaku zo oboshimesu. Makotoni sōbyō, hachiman, kamo nado o sashiokase tamaite, harubaruto akinokuni made no gokō oba, shinmei mo nadoka onnaju nakarubeki. Gogan jōju utagai nashi to zo mie tari keru.

[4.2.1] Dō nijūrokunichi, itsukushima e gosanchaku, nyūdōshōkoku no saiai no naishi ga shukusho, gosho ni naru. Naka futsuka gotōryū atte, kyōe bugaku okonaware keru. Dōshi ni ha, mīdera no kōkensōjō to zo kikoe shi. Kōza ni nobori, kane uchinarashi, hyōbyaku no kotoba ni iwaku" kokonoe no miyako o idete, yae no shioji o wakite mairase tamau mikokorozashi no katajikenasa. " to, takaraka ni mōsare tari kere ba, kimi mo shin mo kanrui o moyōsare keri. Ōmiya, marōdo o hajime maise te yashiroyashirotokorodokoro he mina gokō naru. Ōmiya yori gochō bakari, yama o mawatte, takinomiya he maise tamau. Kōkensōjō isshu no uta yonde haiden no hashira ni kakitsukerare tari.

lg.l: 雲居よりおちくる瀧のしらいとに、ちぎりをむすぶ事ぞうれしき。

div.p: [4.2.2] Kannushi saekikagehiro kakai, jūjōnogoi, kokushi fujiwaranoaritsuna, honjō agerare te kakai, jūgenoshihon, innotenjō yurusaru. Zasu son'ei, hōin ni nasaru. Shinryo mo ugoki, daijōnyūdō no kokoro mo hataraki nuran to zo mie shi.

[4.2.3] Dō nijūkunichi jōkō mifune kazarite kangyo naru. Kaze hagekari kere ba, mifune kogimodoshi, itsukushima no uchi, ari no ura ni todomara se tamau. Jōkō," daimyōjin no onnagori oshimini, uta tsukamatsure. " to ōsekere ba, takafusa no shōshō,

lg.l: 立かへる名殘もありの浦なれば、神もめぐみをかくる白浪。

div.p: [4.2.4] Yoha bakari ni nami mo shizuka ni kaze mo shizuka ni shizumari kere ba, mifune kogidashi, sonohi ha bingonokuni shikina no tomari ni tsukase tamau. Koko ha inuru ōhō no koro hodo, ichīn gokō no toki, kokushi fujiwaranotamenari ga tsuku taru gosho no ari keru o, nyūdōshōkoku goshitsurae ni shitsurawa re tari shika domo, jōkō soko he ha nobora se tamawa zu.

[4.2.5] Kyō wa uzuki tsuitachi koromogae to iu koto no aru zo kashi tote, onōno miyako no kata o omoiyari asobi tamau ni, kishi ni irofukaki fuji no matsu ni sakikakari tari keru o, jōkō eiran atte, takasue no dainagon o meshite," ano hana ori ni tsukawase. " to ōsekere ba, sashishō nakaharanoyasusada ga hashibune ni notte, gozen o kogitōri keru o meshite ori ni tsukawasu. Fuji no hana o taori, matsu no eda ni tsuke nagara, motte mairi tari. Kokorobase ari nado ōserare te, gyokan ari keri. " konohana nite uta aru beshi. " to ōsekere ba, takasue no dainagon,

lg.l: 千年へん君がよはひに藤なみの、松の枝にもかゝりぬる哉。

div.p: [4.2.6] Sononochi gozen ni hitobito amata saburawa se tamai te, ontawamure koto no ari shi ni, jōkō" shiroki koromo ki taru naishi ga kunitsunakyō ni kokoro o kake taru na. " tote, warawa se owashimashi kere ba, dainagon ōini arasogai mōsa ruru tokoro ni, fumi mochi taru binjo ga mai te," gojō no dainagon dono he. " tote sashiage tari. Sarebakoso tote manza kyōaru koto ni mōshiaware keri. Dainagon kore o tori te mi tamae ba,

lg.l: 白浪の衣の袖をしぼりつゝ、君故にこそたちもまはれね。

div.p: [4.2.7] Jōkō" yasashū koso oboshimese. Kono henji ha aru beki zo. " tote yagate osuzuri o kudasase tamau. Dainagon henji ni ha,

lg.l: おもひやれ君がおもかげ立つ浪の、よせくる度に濕るゝ袂を。

div.p: [4.2.8] Sore yori bizennokuni kojima no tomari ni chakuse tamau.

[4.2.9] Itsuka no hi tensei kaze shizukani, kaijō mo nodokakari kere ba, gosho no ofune o hajimemairase te, hitobito no fune tomo mina dashi tsutsu, kumo no nami kemuri no nami o wakesugosase tamai te, sonohi no yūkoku ni harimanokuni yamada no ura ni chakuse tamau. Sore yori mikoshi ni meshi te, fukuhara he irase imasu. Muika wa gubu no hitobito, ima ichinichi mo miyako e tokuto isoga re kere domo, shin'in gotōryū atte, fukuhara no tokorodokoro rekiran ari keri. Ikenochūnagon'yorimorikyō no sansō, arata made goranze raru.

[4.2.10] Nanuka, fukuhara o idesase tamani, takasue no dainagon chokujō o uketamahate, nyūdōshōkoku no ie no shō okonawaru. Nyūdō no yōshi, tanbanokamikiyokuni, shōgegoi, onaji nyūdō no mago, echizennoshōshōsukemori, shī no jūjō to zo kikoe shi. Sonohi terai ni tsukase tamafu. Yōka miyako e irase tamau ni, omukae no kugyō tenjōbito, toba no kusatsu e zo maira re keru. Kangyo no toki wa, tobadono e wa gokō mo nara zu, nyūdōshōkoku no nishihachijō no tei e irase tamau.

[4.2.11] Dō shigatsu nijūninichi shintei no gosokui ari. Daigokuden nite aru bekari shika domo, ichinen enjō no nochi ha imada tsukuri mo dasare zu. Daijōkan no chō nite okonawaru beshi to sadamerare tari keru o sonotoki no kujōdono mōsase tamai keru ha" daijōkan no chō ha bonnin no ie ni tora ba kumonjo tei no tokoro nari." Daigokuden nakara n ue ha, shishinden nite koso, gosokui ha aru bekere. " to mōsa se tamai kere ba, shishinden nite zo, gosokui ha ari keru. " inji kōhō yonen jūichigatsu tsuitachi, reizeīn no gosokui, shishinden nite ari shi ha, shujō gojake ni yotte, daigokuden he gyōkō kanawa zari shi yue nari. Sono rei ikaga aru bekara n. Tada gosanjōin no enkyū no karei ni makase, daijōkan no chō nite okonawaru beki mono o. " to hitobito mōshiawasare kere domo, kujōdono no onhakari no ue ha, sayū ni oyoba zu. Chūgū ha kokiden yori jijūden he utsura se tamai te, takamikura he mairase tamai keru on'arisama, medetakari keri. Heike no hitobito mina shusshi se rare keru naka ni, komatsudono no kindachi ha, kozo daijin use tamai shi aida, iro nite rōkyo se rare tari.

[4.3.1] Kurōdosaemonnogonnosukesadanaga, kondo no gosokui ni iran naku medetaki sama o, atsugami jūmai bakari ni komagomato shiruite, nyūdōshōkoku no kitanokata, hachijō no nīdono he mairase tari kere ba emi o fukunde zo yorokobare keru. Kayōni hanayakani medetaki koto domo arishika domo, seken ha nao shizukanara zu.

[4.3.2] Sonokoro ichīn dai ni no miko, mochihito no ō to mōshi ha, onhaha kaga dainagon suenari kyō no onmusume nari. Sanjō takakura ni mashimase ba, takakuranomiya to zo mōshikeru. Kyoji eiman gannen jūnigatsu jūrokunichi, ontoshi jūgo nite, shinobitsutsu, konoegawara no ōmiyagosho nite, gogenpuku ari keri. Onteseki utsukushū asobashi, onsaigaku sugurete mashimashikereba, kurai ni mo sokuse tamau beki ni, kokenshunmon'in no onnetami nite, oshikomerare sase tamatsuゝ, hana no shita no haru no asobi ni ha, shigō o furutte tekara onsaku o kaki, tsuki no mae no aki no en ni ha, gyokuteki o fuite mizukara gaon o ayatsuritamau, kakushite akashi kurashi tamau hodo ni, jishōyonen ni ha, ontoshi sanjū ni zo nase mashimashikeru.

[4.3.3] Sonokoro konoegawara ni sōrakeru gensanminyūdōyorimasa, aruyo hisokani konomiya no gosho ni maite, mōsarekeru koto koso osokere. Kimi wa amaterasuōmikami yonjūhassei no onsue jinmutennō yori nanajūhachidai ni tōse tamau. tōsetamau Taishi ni mo tachi, kurai ni mo sokuse tamau beki ni, sanjū made miya nite watase tamau onkoto o ba, kokorōshi to wa oboshimesa zu ya. Tōsei no tei o mi sō ni, kami ni ha shitagai taru sama nare domo, nainai ha heike o sonema nu mono ya sō. Gomuhon okosase tamai te, heike o horoboshi, hōō no itsutonaku tobadono ni oshikomerare te watase tamau mikokoro o mo yasume mairase, kimi mo kurai ni sokuse tamau beshi. Kore gokōkō no itari ni te koso sōwa nzure. 若思召し立せ給ひて、令旨を下させ給ふ物ならば、悦をなして馳參らむずる源氏共こそ多う候へ。 」とて申續く。 「先京都には、出羽前司光信が子共、伊賀守光基、出羽判官光長、出羽藏人光重、出羽冠者光能、熊野には、故六條判官爲義が末子、十郎義盛とて隱て候。 攝津國には多田藏人行綱こそ候へども、新大納言成親卿の謀反の時、同心しながら返り忠したる不當人で候へば申に及ばず。 さりながら、其弟多田次郎朝實、手島冠者高頼、太田太郎頼基、河内國には、武藏權守入道義基、子息石河判官代義兼、大和國には、宇野七郎親治が子ども、太郎有治、次郎清治、三郎成治、四郎義治、近江國には、山本、柏木、錦古里、美濃、尾張には山田次郎重廣、河邊太郎重直、泉太郎重光、浦野四郎重遠、安食次郎重頼、其子太郎重資、木太三郎重長、開田判官代重國、矢島先生重高、其子太郎重行、甲斐國には、逸見冠者義清、其子太郎清光、武田太郎信義、加々美次郎遠光、同小次郎長清、一條次郎忠頼、板垣三郎兼信、逸見兵衞有義、武田五郎信光、安田三郎義定、信濃國には、大内太郎維義、岡田冠者親義、平賀冠者盛義、其子の四郎義信、故帶刀先生義方が次男、木曽冠者義仲、伊豆國には流人前右兵衞佐頼朝、常陸國には、信太三郎先生義教、佐竹冠者正義、其子太郎忠義、同三郎義宗、四郎高義、五郎義季、陸奧國には故左馬頭義朝が末子、九郎冠者義經、是皆六孫王の苗裔、多田新發意滿仲が後胤也。 Chōteki o mo tairage, shukubō o toge shi koto ha genpei izure shōretsu nashi shika domo, ima ha undei majiwari o hedatete, shujū no rei ni mo nao otoreri. Kuni ni ha kokushi ni shitagai, shō ni ha ryōsho ni meshitsukaware, kuji zōji ni karitaterarete, yasui omoi mo sōrawazu. Ikabakari ka kokorōku sōran. Kimi moshi oboshimeshitase tamaite, ryōji o tamauzuru mono nara ba, yoru o hi ni tsuide hasenobori, heike o horobosan koto, jijitsu o megurasu bekara zu. Nyūdō mo toshi koso yotte sōrae domo, kodomo hikigushite sansōrō beshi. " to zo mōshi taru.

[4.3.4] Miya ha konokoto ikaga aru bekara n tote, shibaraku ha goshōin mo nakari keru ga, akomaru dainagon munemichi kyō no mago, bingo zenji suemichi ga ko, shōnagon korenaga to mōshi ha, suguretaru sōnin nari kere ba, toki no ninsō shōnagon to zo mōshi keru. Sonohito ga konomiya o mimairasete," kurai ni sokuse tamau beki sō imasu. Tenka no koto oboshimeshihanatase tamau bekara zu. " to mōshi keru ue, gensanmi nyūdō mo kayōni mōsa re kere ba," sateha saru beshi. Amaterasuōmikami no mitsuge yaran. " tote. Hishihishito oboshimeshitatase tamai keri. Kumano ni sōrō jūrōyoshimori o meshite, kurōdo ni nasaru. Yukīe to kaimeishite, ryōji no mitsukai ni tōgoku he zo kudasare keru.

[4.3.5] Dō shigatsu nijūhachinichi miyako o tate ōminokuni yori hajimete mino, owari no genji tomoni shidaini furete yukiteini, gogatsu tōka izu no hōjō ni oritsuki runin sakinohyōenosuke dono ni ryōji tatematsuru. Shidasaburōsenjōyoshinori ha ani nareba torasen tote, hitachinokuni shida no ukishima he kudaru. Kisonokanjayoshinaka ha oi nareba taban tote, yamamichi he zo omomukikeru.

[4.3.6] Sonokoro no kumanobettōtanzō ha heike ni kokorozashi fukakarikeru ga nantokashite morekikitariken, shingūnojūrōyoshimori koso takakuranomiya no ryōji tamahate minōwari no genji furemoyōshi sudeni muhon o okonare. Nachishingū no monodomo ha sadamete genji no kataudo o zo senzuran. Tanzō wa heike no gōn o, tenzan to kōmuri tare ba, ikade somuki tatematsuru beki. Nachishingū no monodomo ni ya hitotsu ikake te, heike e shisai o mōsa n tote, jikikō issennin, shingū no minato e hakkō su. Shingū ni ha torīhōgen, takabōhōgen, samurai ni ha, ui, suzuki, mizuya, kikkō, nachi ni ha shugyōhōgen ika, tsugō sono sei nisen'yonin nari. Toki tsukuri yāi shite, genji no kata ni ha to koso ire, heike no kata ni ha kō koso ire to, tagaini yatakebi no koe no taiten mo naku, kabura no nariyamu hima mo naku, mikka ga hodo koso tatakau tare. Kumanobettō tanzō, ie no ko rōdō ōku utase, wagami teoi, karaki inochi o ikitsutsu, hongū he koso nigeagari kere.

[4.4.1] Saru hodo ni hōō ha" tōki kuni he mo nagasare haruka no shima he mo utsunzuru ni ya. " to ōse keredomo, jōnan no rikyū ni shite kotoshi ha ninen ni nase tamau. Dō gogatsu jūninichi umanokoku bakari, goshochū ni ha itachi obitadakō hashiri sawagu. Hōō ōini odoroki oboshimeshi miurakata o asoite, ōminokami nakakane, sonokoro ha mada tsurunokuraudo to mesare keru o meshite" kono urakata mote yasuchika ga moto he yuki, kitto kansasete, kanjō o totte maire. " to zo ōsekeru. Nakakane kore tamawa te, onmyōnokami abenoyasuchika ga moto he iku, orifushi shukusho ni ha nakari keri. Shirakawa naru tokoro he to ie kere ba, soko he tazune yuki, yasuchika ni au te, chokujō no omomuki ōse re ba, yagate kanjō o sanse keri. Nakakane, tobadono ni kaeri maite mon yori mairau to sure ba, shugo no bushi domo yurusa zu. Annai ha shittari, tsuiji o koe ōyuka no shita o hatte, kirīta yori yasuchika ga kanjō o koso mairase tare. Hōō kore o akete goranzure ba," ima mikka ga uchi no goetsu narabini gotan." " to zo mōshi taru. Hōō" goetsu ha shikarubeshi. ōse keru Korehodo no onmi ni nari te mata ikanaru onnageki no ara nzuru yaran. " to zo ōse keru.

[4.4.2] Saruhodoni sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō, hōō no onkoto o tarifushi mōsare kere ba nyūdōshōkoku yōyaku omoinaoshi te dōjūsannichi tobadono o ide tatematsuri, hachijōkarasuma bifukumon'in no gosho he gokō nashi tatematsuru. Ima mikka ga naka no goetsu to ha yasuchika kore o zo mōshikeru

[4.4.3] Kakarikeru tokoro ni, kumanobettō tanzō, hikyaku o motte, takakuranomiya no gomuhon no yoshi miyako he mōshi tarikereba, sakinōdaishō munemorikyō ōini sawaide, nyūdōshōkoku orifushi fukuhara ni owashikeru ni, kono yoshi mōsaretarikereba, kiki mo aezu, yagate miyako he hasenobori," zehini oyobekarazu. Takakuranomiya karametotte, tosa no hata he nagase. " to koso notamaekere. Shōkei ha sanjōdainagonsanefusa, shikiji ha tōnobenmitsumasa to zo kikoeshi. Minamotonodaibuhōgankanetsuna, dewahōganmitsunaga uketamawatte miya no gosho e zo mukai keru. Kono minamotonodaibuhōgan to mōsu wa, sanminyūdō no jinan nari. Shikaruo kono ninzū ni irare keru koto ha, takakuranomiya no gomuhon o, sanminyūdō susume mōshi tari to, heike michizari keru ni yotte nari.

[4.5.1] Miya ha gogatsujūgoya no kumoma no tsuki o eisase tamai, nani no yukue mo oboshimeshiyora zari keru ni, gensanminyūdō no shisha to te, fumi mote sewashigeni dekitari, miya no onmenotogo, rokujōnosukenotaifumunenobu, kore o totte, gozen he mairi hiraite mi ni," kimi no gomuhon sudeni araware sase tamai te, tosa no hata he nagashi mairasu beshi tote, kanjin domo onmukae ni mairi sō. Isogi gosho o idesase tamaite, mīdera he irase mase. Nyūdō mo yagate mairi sō beshi. " to zo mōshi keru. " ko ha ikaga se n. " to sawagase ohashimasu tokoro ni, miya no samurai nagahyōenojō nobutsura to iu mono ari. " tada bechi no yō sō maji. Nyōbōshōzoku nite idesase tamahe. " to mōshikere ba," shikarubeshi. " tote, migushi o midashi, kasanetaru onzo ni, ichimegasa o zo mesare keru. Rokujōnosukenotaifumunenobu, karakasa mote otomotsukamatsuru. Tsurumaru to iu warawa, fukuro ni mono irete itadaitari, tatoheba aosaburai no onna o mukahete yukiyō ni shuttaise tamahi te, takakura o kita he otosase tamafu ni, ōnaru mizo no arikeru o, ito monokarō kosase tamahe ba, rokōjin tachidomate," hashitanano nyōbō no mizo no koshiyō ya. " tote ayashigeni mimaisekere ba itodo ashibayani sugisasetamau.

[4.5.2] Chōbeenojōnobutsura ha gosho no rusu ni zo okaretaru. Nyōbōtachi no shōshō owashikeru o achikochi he tachishinobasete migurushiki mono araba torinasamu tote miruhodoni miya no sashimo gohizōarikeru koeda to kikoeshi ofue o tadaimashimo tsunenogosho no omakura ni toriwasuresasetamaitarikeru zo tachikaettemo torimahoshiu oboshimesu. Nobutsura kore omitsukete" ana asamashi. Kimi no sashimo gohizōaru ofue o. " to mōshite, gochō ga uchini oitsuite mai tari. Miya nanamenarazu gyokan arite," ware shinaba, kono fue oba mihaka ni ire yo. " to zo ōsekeru. " yagate otomoni sōrae. " to ōsekereba, nobutsura mōshikeru ha," tadaima goshohe, kanjindomo ga omukaeni mairi sōrō naru ni, omaeni hito hitorimo sōrawa zara n ka, mugeni utateshū sōrō. Nobutsura ga kono gosho ni sōrō to ha jōge minashiri re taru koto nite sōrō ni kon'ya sōrō ha zara n ha sono mo sonoyo ha nige tari keri nado iwa re n koto yumiya toru mi ha kari nimo na koso oshū sōrae Kanjin domo shibaraku aishirai sōraite uchiyabutte yagate mairi sōrawa n " tote hashirikaeru

[4.5.3] Chōbee ga sonohi no shōzoku ni ha usuao no kariginu no shita ni moegiodoshi no haramaki o kite efu no tachi o zo obi tari keru Sanjōmen no sōmon o mo takakuramen no komon o mo tomoni hiraite machikake tari Minamotonodaibuhōgankanetsuna, dewahōganmitsunaga, tsugō sono sei sanbyakuyoki, jūgonichi no yoru no ne no koku ni miya no gosho he zo oshiyose taru. Minamotonodaibuhōgan ha, zonzuru mune ari to oboete, haruka no mongai ni hikae tari. Dewahōganmitsunaga ha, uma ni nori nagara mon no uchi ni uchīre, niwa ni hikae te daionjō o age te mōshikeru ha," gomuhon no kikoe sō ni yotte, kanjindomo bettō sen o uketamawari, omukae ni maite sō. Isogi oide sōrae. " to mōshikere ba, chōheie ōyuka ni tate," kore ha tōji ha gosho demo sōwa zu. Omonomōde sō zo. Nanigoto zo, koto no shisai o mōsare yo. " to ikere ba," nandeu kono gosho nara deha izuku he ka watase tamau bekan naru. Sa naiwase so. Shimobedomo maite, sagashi tatematsure. " to zo ī keru. Nagabeenojō kore kiki te," mono mo oboe nu kanjin domo ga mōshi yō kana. Uma ni nori nagara mon no uchi he mairu dani mo kikkainaru ni, shimobe domo mairi te sagashi mairaseyo to ha, ikade de mōshi zo. Sahyōenojō hasebenobutsura ga sō zo. Chikō yori te sugosu na. " to zo mōshikeru. Chō no shimobe no naka ni, kanetake to iu tairiki no gō no mono, chōbee ni me o kakete, ōyuka no ue he tobiagaru. Kore o mite dōreidomo jūshigonin zo tsuzuki taru. tsuzukitaru Chōbee ha kariginu no obihimo hikkitte suteru mamani, efu no tachi nare domo, mi oba kokoroete sakusetaru o nukiaite, sanzanni koso kittari kere. Kataki ha ōdachi ōnaginata de furumae domo, nobuyori ga efu no tachi ni kiritaterarete, arashi ni konoha no chirisama ni, niwa he satto zo oritari keru.

[4.5.4] Satsuki jūgoya no kumoma no tsuki no araware ide akari keru ni, teki ha muannai nari, nobutsura ha annaisha nari, asoko no omotemichi ni oikakete ha, hatato kiri, koko no tsume ni oitsumete ha chōto kiru. " ikani senji no mitsukai o ba, kō ha suru zo. " to ikkere ba," senji to ha nani zo. " tote, tachi magaba odori noki, oshinaoshi fuminaoshi, tachido ni kōja domo jūshigonin koso kirifushitare. Tachi no saki sanzun bakari uchiotte hara o kiran to koshi o sagure ba, sayamaki ochite nakeri. Chikara oyoba zu, ōte o hirote, takakuramen no komon yori hashiriden to suru tokoro ni, dainaginata mottaru otoko hitori yoriai tari, nobutsura naginata ni noran to, tonde kakaru ga, norisokonatte, momo o nui yōni tsuranukarete, kokoro ha takeku omoe domo, ōzei no naka ni torikomerarete, ikedori ni koso se rare kere.

[4.5.5] Sonogo gosho o sagase domo, miya watara se tamawa zu. Nobutsura bakari karamete, rokuhara he ite mairu. Nyūdōshōkoku ha renchū ni i tamae ri. Sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō, ōyuka ni tate, nobutsura o ōniwa ni hikīsase," makotoni wa otoko ha," senji toha nani zo. 』 tote kiri tari keru ka. Sonōe, chō no shimobe o, ninjōsatsugai shi tan nari. Senzurutokoro kyūmon shite, yokuyoku koto no shisai o tazunetoi, sononochi kawara ni hikīdete, kubi o hane sōrae. " to zo notamai keru. Nobutsura sukoshimo sawagazu azawaraite mōshikeru ha" konohodo yoyo ano gosho o, mono ga ukagai sōrō toki ni, nanigoto no aru beki to zonjite, yōjin mo tsukamatsuri sōrawa nu tokoro ni, yoroi kitaru monodomo ga uchītte sōrō o,『 nanimono zo. 』 to toisōrae ba,『 senji no ontsukai』 to nanori sōrō. Sanzoku, kaizoku, gōtō nado mōsu yatsubara ha, aruiha『 kindachi no irase tamau zo. 』 aruiha『 senji no ontsukai』 nado nanori sōrō to kanegane uketamawate sōrae ba,『 senji toha nani zo. 』 tote kittaru sōrō. Oyoso mononogu o mo omōyōni tsukamatsuri, tetsuyoki tachi o mo mote sōrawa ba, kanjindomo o yomo hitori mo annondeha kaeshi sōrawa ji. Mata miya no gozaisho ha izuku ni ka watase tamau ran. Shirase sōrawa zu. Tatoi shirase te sōrō tomo saburai honno mono no mōsa ji to omoikitte n koto kyūmon ni oyonde mōsube shi ya. " tote sononochi ha mono mo mōsa zu.

[4.5.6] Ikuramo narabī tari keru heike no samurai domo," aware gōnomono kana. Atara otoko o kirare n zuran muzan sa yo. " to mōshi ae ri. Sononaka ni aruhito no mōshikeru ha、「 are ha sennen tokoro ni ari shi toki mo ōbanshū ga todomekane tari shi gōtō rokunin ni tadahitori oikake te yonin kirifuse se ni nin ikedori ni shite sonotoki nari re keru sahyōenojō zo kashi. Kore o koso ichinintōsen no tsuwamono tomo ī bekere. " tote kuchiguchi ni oshimiai e ri kere ba nyūdōshōkoku ikaga omoi ha re ken hōki no hino he zo nagasa re keru. Genji no yo ni natte, tōgoku he kudari, kajiwaraheizakagetoki nitsuite, koto no kongen ichīchi shidaini mōshikere ba, kamakuradono shinmyōnari to kanji oboshimeshi te, notonokuni ni gōn kōmuri keru to zo kikoe shi.

[4.6.1] Miya ha takakura o kita he, konoe o higashi he, kamogawa o watase tamaite, nyoisan he irase owasu. Mukashi kiyomihara no tennō no imada tōgū no ontoki, zokuto ni osoware sase tamai te, yoshinoyama he irase tamai keru ni koso, otome no sugata o ba kase tamai keru nare. Ima kono miya no on'arisama mo, sore ni ha sukoshimo tagawase tamawa zu. Shiranu yamaji o yomosugara wakeirase tamau ni, nani narawashi no onkoto nare ba, on'ashi yori izuru chi ha, suna o somete kurenai no gotoshi. Natsukusa no shige ga naka no tsuyukesa mo, sa koso ha tokoroseu oboshimesare keme. Kakushite akatsukigata ni mīdera he irase owasu. " kainaki inochi no oshisa ni, shuto o tanonde, nyūgo ari. " to ōsekere ba daishu kashikomari yorokonde, hōrin'in ni gosho o kazari, soko ni ire tatematsurite katanogotoku no kugo shitatete mairase keri.

[4.6.2] Akere ba jūrokunichi, takakuranomiya no gomuhon okosase tamai te use sase tamai te nu to mōshi hodo koso ari kere, kyōchū no sōdō nanamenara zu. Hōō kore o kikoshimeshi te" tobadono o onshutsuzai ha on'yorokobi nari. Narabi ni onnageki. To yasuchika ga kanjō o mairase taru ha kore o mōshi keri. " to zo ōse keru.

[4.6.3] Somosomo gensanmi nyūdō toshigoro higoro mo araba koso arikeme. Kotoshi ikanaru kokoro nite muhon oba okoshi keru zo to iu ni heike no jinan sakinōdaishō munemorikyō sumajiki koto o shi tamai keru ni yotte nari, saraba hito no yo ni ari ba tote sumajiki koto o mo shi, za ni iumajiki koto o mo iu ha yokuyoku shiryo aru beki mono nari.

[4.6.4] Tatoeba, genzanminyūdō no chakushi, nakatsuna no moto ni, kokonoe ni kikoetaru meiba ari. Kage naru uma no sōnaki itsubutsu, norihashiri kokoromuki, mata arubeshi tomo oboezu Na o ba konoshita to zo iwarekeru. Sakinōdaishō kore o tsutekiki nakatsuna no moto he shisha o tate," kikoe sō meiba o mi sōwa baya." " to notamaiyarare kere ba, izunokami no henji ni ha," saru uma ha mote sō tsure domo, konohodo amarini norisokonatte sō tsuru aida, shibaraku rōse sō wamu tote inaka he yatte sō. " saran ni ha chikara nashi. " tote, sononochi sata mo nakari shi o, ōku narabītari keru heike no samurai domo," aware sonōma ha ototoi made ha sō shi mono o, kinō mo sō hi shi, kesa mo niwanori shi sō tsuru. " nado mōshikere ba," sateha oshimu gozan nare. Ashi, koe. " tote jishite hasesase, fumi nado shite, ichinichi ga naka ni gorokudo shichihachido nado koware kere ba, sanminyūdō kore o kiki, izunokami yobiyose," tatohi kogane o marotaru muma nari tomo, sonohodo ni hito no kō mono o oshibeki yō ya aru. Sumiyaka ni sonomuma rokuhara he tsukawase. " to zo notamaikeru. Izunokami chikara oyoba de isshu no uta o kakisoete, rokuhara he tsukawasu.

lg.l: 戀くば來ても見よかし、身にそへるかげをばいかゞ放ちやるべき。

div.p: [4.6.5] Munemorikyō, uta no henji o ba shi tamawa de," aware muma ya, muma ha makotoni yoi muma de ari keri. Saredomo amarini nushi ga oshitsuru ga nikuki ni, yagate nushi ga nanori o inshō ni seyo. " tote, nakatsuna to iu inshō o shite, umaya ni taterare tari. Kyakujin kite" kikoe sō meiba o mi sōwa baya. " to mōshikere ba," sono nakatsuna me ni kura oite hikidase. Nakatsuna me nore. Nakatsuna me ute, hare. " nado notamai kere ba, izunokami kore o tsutekiki," mi ni kaete omō uma nare domo, ken'i ni tsuite toruゝ dani mo ari ni, uma yue nakatsuna ga tenka no warawaregusa to nanzuru koto koso yasukara ne. " to, ōini ikidōrare kere ba, sanminyūdō kore o kiki izunokami ni mukaite," nanigoto no ari beki to omoi anadorite, heike no hitodomo ga, sayō no shiregoto o iu ni koso ari nare. Sonogi nara ba, inochi ikite mo nani ka sen, bingi o ukagau de koso ari me. " tote, watakushi ni ha omoi mo tata zu, miya o susume mōshike ru to zo nochi ni ha kikoe shi.

[4.6.6] Kore ni tsuki te mo, tenka no hito, komatsudaijin no onkoto o zo shinobi mōshi keru. Arutoki komatsudono sandai no tsugi ni, chūgū no onkata he maise tamai tari keru ni, hasshaku bakari ari keru hebi ga, daijin no sashinuki no hidari no wa o haimawari keru o, shigemori sawaga ba, nyōbōtachi mo sawagi, chūgū mo odorokase tamai nan zu to oboshimeshi, hidari no te de hebi no o o osae, migi no te de kubi o tori, nōshi no sode no naka ni hikīre, chittomo sawaga zu, tsuitate," rokui ya sō, rokui ya sō. " to mesare kere ba, izunokami, sonotoki ha mada efukuraudo de ohashi keru ka, nakatsuna to nanori te maire tari keru ni, kono hebi o tabu. Tamahi te yubadono o he te, tenjau no koniwa ni ide tsutsu, mikura no kodoneri o meshi te," kore tamahare. " to iware kere ba, ohoini kashira o furite nigesari nu. Chikara oyoba zu wa rōdō kisoi no takiguchi o meshite, kore o tamabu. Tamaite sute keri. Sono asa komatsudono yoi uma ni kura oite, izunokami no moto he tsukawasu tote" satemo kinō no furumai koso yūni sōshika. Kore ha norīchi no uma de sō. Yain ni oyonde jingai yori keisei no moto he tōre mu toki mochīraru beshi. " tote yarasa ru. Izunokami, daijin no gohenji nare ba," onma kashikomatte tamawari sō nu. Satemo kinō no gofurumai ha, genjōraku ni koso nite sō shika. " to zo mōsa re keru. Ikaninareba komatsudaijin ha, kayōni yuyushū owase shi ni, munemorikyō ha sakoso nakara me, amatsusae hito no oshimu uma koitotte, tenka no daiji ni oyo nuru koso utatekere.

[4.6.7] Dō jūrokunichi no yoru ni irite, minamotonosanminyūdōyorimasa, chakushi izunokami nakatsuna, jinan minamotonotayūhōgan kanetsuna, rokujōnokurōdo nakaie, sonoko kurōdonotarō nakamitsu ige, tsugō sonosei sanbyakuyoki, yakata ni hikake yakiagete, mīdera he koso mairare kere. Sanminyūdō no saburahi ni, watanabenogenzōtakiguchinokioi to ifu mono ari. Haseokurete todomaritari keru o, sakinōdaishō kiso o meshite" ikani nanji ha sanminyūdō no tomo o ba se de, todomareru zo. " to notamaeba kiso kashikomatte mōshikeru ha" jinen no koto sōrawa ba, massaki kakete, inochi o tatematsura u to koso higoro ha zonjite sōratsure domo, nanto omoware sōrakeru yaran, kō tomo ōserare sōrawa zu. "" somosomo chōteki yorimasa ni dōshin se n to ya omō. Mata kore ni mo kenzan no mono zo kashi. Sento goei o zonji te tōke ni hōkō itasa n to ya omō. Aru no mama ni mōse. " to koso notamai kere. Kisoi namida o harahara to nagai te" sōden no yoshimi ha saru koto de sōrae domo ikaga chōteki to nareru hito ni dōshin o ba shi sōrō beki. Denchū ni hōkō tsukōzuru sō. " to mōshikere ba," saraba hōkō seyo. Yorinorihōshi ga shiken on ni ha isasakamo otoramajiki zo. " tote iritamai nu.

[4.6.8] " samurai ni kisowa aru ka,"" sō." Kisoi ha aru ka. Sō. Tote ashita yori yū ni oyobi made jikō su. Yōyō hi mo kurekere ba taishō ide rare tari. Kisoi kashikomatte mōshikeru ha makoto ya sanminyūdōdono mīdera ni to kikoe sō. Sadamete utte mukerare sōrawa nzuran. Kokoronikū mo sōrawa zu. Mīderahōshi, sateha watanabe no shitashī yatsubara koso sōrame. Eramiuchi nado mo shi sōbeki ni, notte koto ni aubeki uma no sōtsuru o, shitashī yatsu me ni nusumarete sō. Onma ippiki kudashi azukaru beu ya sōran. " to mōshikere ba, taishō mottomo sarubeshi tote, shiroashige naru uma no nantei tote hizōse rare tari keru ni, yoi kura okite zo tamawari keru. Kioiyakata ni kaerite," hayahi no kure yokashi, konōma ni uchinorite, mīdera he hasemairi, sanminyūdōdono no massaki kakete uchishinise n. " to zo mōshi keru. Hi mo yōyaku kurekere ba, saishi domo o ba karekore he tateshinobase te, mīdera he to shuttachi keru kokoro no naka koso muzan nare.

[4.6.9] Hyōmon no kariginu no kikutoji ōrakani shitaru ni, jūdai no chakuseichō no hiodoshi no yoroi ni, hoshijiro no kabuto no o o shime, ikamonozukuri no ōdachi haki, nijūshi sashitaru ōnakaguro no ya ohi, takiguchi no koppō wasure ji to ya, taka no hane nite hagidari keru matoya hitote zo sashisoetaru. Shigetō no yumi mote, dantei ni uchinori, norikae ikki uchigushi, tonerionoko ni motatewaki hasamase, yakata ni hi kake yakiagete, mīdera he koso hasetari kere. Rokuhara ni ha, kiō ga shukusho yori hi shuttaishitari tote, hishimeki keri. Munemorikyō isogi idete," kiō ha aru ka. " to tazunetamau ni," sōrawazu. " to mōsu. " suwa kyatsume o tenobe ni shite tabakarare nuru ha. Are oikake te ute. " to notamae domo kioi ha motoyori suguretaru gōkyū seibyō yatsugibaya no tekiki dairiki no gōnomono nijūshi sashitaru ya de mazu nijūshinin ha ikorosare nan zu. Oto na se so tote mukō mono koso nakari kere. Mīdera ni ha orifushi kioi ga sata ari keri. Watanabetō" kioi oba meshigusu beu sōtsuru mono o, rokuhara ni nokoritodomate, ikanaru ukime ni ka ai sōran. " to mōshikere ba, sanminyūdō kokoro oshitte" yomo sonomono, mutaini torahekarare haseji. Nyūdō ni kokorozashibukai mono nari ima miyo. Tadaima mauzuru zo. " to notamamohatane ba, kioi tsuto shuttairi. " sareba koso. " to zo notamaikeru. Kisoi kashikomatte mōshikeru ha" izunokamidono no, konoshita ga shiro ni, rokuhara no dantei o koso totte maitte sōrae. Mairase sōrawan. " tote izunokami yowa bakari monnōchi he zo oiretaru. Umaya ni irite, umadomo ni kamiaikereba, toneri odorokiai" nantei ga maite sō. " to mōsu. Taishō isogi idete mi tamau ni," mukashi ha nantei, ima ha tairanomunemori nyūdō" to iu inshō o zo shitarikeru. Taishō" yasukara nu. Kisome o tenobe ni shite tabakarare nuru koto koso ikon nare. Kondo mīdera e yottara n ni, ikanimoshite mazu kisome o ikedorini seyo. Nokogiri de kubi kiran. " tote, odori ageageage okorare keredomo, dantei ga ohatsu o shōzu, inshō mo mata usezari keri.

[4.7.1] Mīdera ni ha kaigane nai te, daishu sengi su. Kinjitsu sejō no tei o anzuru ni, buppō no suibi, ōbō no rōrō masani konotoki ni atareri. kondo kiyomorinyūdō ga bōaku o imashime zu ba, nani no hi o ka kisu beki. miya kono ni nyūgo no onkoto, shōhachimangū no eigo, shinradaimyōjin no myōjo ni hi zu ya. tenshu chirui mo yōgō o tare, butsuriki shinriki mo gōbuku o kuwae imasu koto nado ka nakaru beki. somosomo hokurei ha enshū ichimi no gakuchi, nanto ha gerō tokudo no kaijō nari. Chōsō no tokoro ni, nadoka kumise zaru beki. " to, ichimidōshin ni sengi shite, yama he mo nara he mo, chōjō o koso tsukawashi kere. Mazu sanmon he no jō ni iu,Onjōji chōsu, enryakuji no ga.Tokuni gōriki o itashite, tōji no hametsu o tasuke rare n to omō jō u nyūdō jōkai hoshīmamani ōbō o ushinai, buppō o horobosan to hossu.Shūtan kiwami naki tokoro ni, saru jūgonichi no yoru, ichīn daini no ōji, hisokani nyūji se shime tamau.Kokoni inzen to gōshite, dashi tatematsuru beki yoshi, seme ari to ie domo, dashi tatematsuru ni atawa zu.Yotte kangun o hanachi tsukawasu mune, sono kikoe ari.Tōji no hametsu, masani konotoki ni atare ri.Shoshū nanzo shūtan se zara n ya.Nakanzukuni enryaku, onjō ryōji ha monzeki futatsu ni aiwakaru to iedomo gakusuru tokoro ha kore endon ichimi no kyōmon ni onaji.Tatoeba tori no sayū no hane no gotoshi.Mata kuruma no futatsu no wa ni nitari.Ippō kaken ni oite ha ikadeka sono nageki nakaran ya, shikareba tokuni gōriki o itashite tōji no hametsu o tasukerareba hayaku nenrai no ikon o wasurete jūzan no mukashi ni fukusen.Shuto no sengi kono gotoshi.Yotte chō okuri kudan no gotoshi.
[4.7.2] Jishō yonen gogatsu jūhachinichi daishu ra
[4.7.3] To zo kaki tari keru.

[4.8.1] Sanmon no daishu, kono jō o hiken shite, ko ha ikani, tōzan no matsuji de ari nagara, tori no sayū no hane no gotoku, mata kuruma no futatsu no wa ni ni tari to, somosomo te kaku jō, kikai nari. " tote, henchō o okura zu. Sonōe nyūdōshōkoku tendaizasu myōun daisōjō ni shūto o shizumarubeki yoshi notamawakereba zasu isogi tozanshite daishu o shizume tamau. Kakarishi ma miya no onkata he fujō no yoshi o zo mōshikeru. Mata nyūdōshōkoku ōmimai nimangoku hokkoku no orinobeginu sanzenbiki ōrai ni yoraru. Kore o tanitani minemine ni hikarekeru ni niwaka no koto deha ari hitorishite amata o toru daishu mo ari. Mata te o munaushite hitotsu mo toranu shūto mo ari. Nanimono no shiwaza ni ya ari ken, rakusho o zo shitari keru.

lg.l: 山法師織延衣うすくして、恥をばえこそかくさざりけれ。

div.p: [4.8.2] Mata kinu ni mo atara nu daishu no ei tari keru yaran.

lg.l: 織延を一きれも得ぬわれらさへ、薄恥をかくかずに入哉。

div.p: [4.8.3] Mata nanto he no jō ni iu,Onjōji chōsu, kōfukuji no ga.Tokuni gōriki o itashite, tōji no hametsu o tasuke rare n to kō jō u buppō no shushō naru koto ha, ōbō o mamora n ga tame, ōbō mata chōkyū naru koto ha, sunawachi buppō ni yoru.Koko ni nyūdōsakinodaijōdaijin taira ason kiyomori kō, hōmyō jōkai, hoshīmamani kokui o nusumini shi, chōsei o midari, uchi ni tsuke soto ni tsuke, urami o nashi nageki o nasu aida, kongetsu jūgonichi no yoru, ichīn daini no ōji, furyo no nan o nogare n ga tame ni, niwakani nyūji se shime tamau.Kokoni inzen to gōshite idashitatematsuru beki mune, seme ari to ie domo, shūto ikkō kore o oshimi tatematsuru.Yotte kano zenmon, bushi o tōji ni ire n to su.Buppō to iu, ōbō to iu, ichiji ni masani hametsu se n to su.Mukashi tō no kaishō tenshi, gunpyō o motte buppō o messa shime shi toki, seiryōzan no shū, kassen o itashite kore o fusegu.Ōken nao kaku no gotoshi.Nanzo iwan'ya muhon hachigyaku no tomogara ni oite o ya.Nakanzuku ni nankin ha reinaku shite tsuminaki chōja o hairu se raru.Kondo ni ara zu ba nan no hi ka kaikei o toge n.Negawaku ha shūto, uchi ni ha buppō no hametsu o tasuke, soto ni ha akugyaku no hanrui o shirizoke ba dōshin no itari, honkai ni taranu beshi.Shuto no sengi kaku no gotoshi.Yotte chō sō kudannogotoshi.
[4.8.4] Jishō yonen gogatsu jūhachinichi daishu ra
[4.8.5] To zo kaki tari keru.

[4.8.6] Nanto no daishu kono jō o hiken shite, yagate henchō o okuru. Sono henchō ni iu,Kōfukuji chōsu, onjōji no garaichō isshi ni noseraretariMigi nyūdōjōkai ga tame ni kiji no buppō o messan to suru yoshi no koto, chōsu, gyokusen, gyokka, ryōke no shūgi o tatsu to iedomo, kinshō, kinku, onajiku ichidai no kyōmon yori idetariNankyō hokkyō tomoni motte, nyorai no deshi tariJiji taji tagaini, chōdatsu ga mashō o fusubeshiSomosomo kiyomorinyūdō ha, heishi no sōkō, buke no jinkai nari.Sofu masamori, kurōdonogoi no ie ni tsukae te, shokoku zuryō no muchi o toru.Ōkurakyō tamefusa, kashūshishi no inishie, kebīshi ni fushi, shurinodaibu akisue, harimanodaishu tari shi mukashi, umayanobettōshiki ni ninzu.Shikaruo shinpu tadamori shōden o yurusare shi toki, tohi no rōshō mina hōko no kakin oshimi, naige no eikō onōno badai no shinbun naku.Tadamori seiun no hane o haku to iedomo, yo no tami nao hakuoku no tane karozu.Na o oshimu aozamurai sono ie ni nozomu koto nashi.Saruo saru heiji gannen jūnigatsu, daijōtennō, issen no kō o kanjite, fuji no shō o sazuke tamai shi yori ikō, takaku shōkoku ni nobori, kanete heijō o tamawaru.Danshi aruiha taikai o hazukashi, aruiha urin ni tsuranaru.Joshi aruiha chūgūshiki ni sonawari, aruiha jugō no sen o kōmuru.Guntei shoshi, mina kyokuro ni ayumi, sono mago, kano oi, kotogotoku chikufu o saku.Shikanominarazu kyūshū o tōryō shi, hyakushi o shintai shi te, nuhi mina bokujū to nasu.Ichimō kokoro ni tagahe ba, ōkō to ihe tomo kore o torahe, hengen mimi ni sakafure ba, kugyō to ihe domo kore o karamu.Kore ni yotte, aruiha ittan no shinmyō o noben ga tame, aruiha katatoki no ryōjū o nogaren to omotte, banjō no seishu nao menten no kobi o nashi, jūdai no kakun kaette shikkō no rei o itasu.Daidai sōden no karyō o ubau to iedomo, jōsai mo osorete shita o makimaki, miyamiya sōshō no shōen o toru to iedomo, ken'i ni habakatte mono iu koto nashi.Shō ni noru amari, kozo no fuyu jūichigatsu daijōkō no sumika o tsuibushi, hakurokukō no mi o oshinagasu.Hangyaku no hanahadashī koto, makotoni kokon ni taetari.Sonotoki warera subekaraku zokushū ni yukimukaite sonotsumi o tō beshi to iedomo aruiha shinryo ni aihabakari aruiha ringen to shōsuru ni yotte uttō o osae kōin o okuru aida kasanete gunpyō o okoshite ichīn daini no shinnōmiya o uchikakomu tokoro ni hachimansansho kasugadaimyōjin hisokani yōgō o tare senpitsu o sasage tatematsuri kiji ni okuritsukete shiragi no tobira ni azuke tatematsuru.Ōbō tsuku bekara zaru mune ake shi.Shitagaite mata kiji shinmyō o suteゝ shugo shi tatematsuru jō, ganshiki no rui dare ka zuiki se zara n.Warera en'iki ni atte, sono jō o kanzuru tokoro ni, kiyomorinyūdō nao kyōki o okoshite, kiji ni ira n to suru yoshi, honokani uketamawari oyobi o motte, kanete yōi o itasu.Jūhachinichi tatsu no itten ni daishu o okoshi, shoji ni chōsōshi, matsuji ni gechishi, gunshi o e te nochi, annai o tassen to suru tokoro ni, aojima tobikite hōkan o nagetari.Sūjitsu no utsunen ichiji ni kaisansu.Kano tōka shōryō issan no chōsū, nao busō no kanpei o kaesu.Iwan'ya wakoku nanboku ryōmon no shuto, nanzo bōshin no jarui harawazaran ya.Yoku ryōen sayū no jin o katamete, ubeku warera ga shinpatsu no tsuge o matsubeshi.Jō o sasshi te, gitai o nasu koto nakare.Motte chōsu.
[4.8.7] Jishō yonen gogatsu nijūichinichi daishu ra
[4.8.8] To zo kaki tari keru.

[4.9.1] Mīdera ni ha mata daishu tate sengi su. Sanmon wa kokorogahe shi tsu, nanto wa imada maira zu. Konokoto nobete wa ashikari ken. Rokuhara ni oshiyose te yōchi ni se n. Sonogi nara ba, rōshō futate ni wake te, rōsō domo wa nyoi ga mine yori karamete ni mukafu beshi. Ashigaru domo shigohyakunin sakidate te, shirakawa no zaike ni hi o kake yakiage ba, zaikyōnin rokuhara no bushi" awaya koto deki tari". " tote hasemukanzuran Sonotoki iwasaka, sakuramoto ni hikakehikake shibashisasaete tatakanma ni ōte ha izunokami o taishōgun nite akusōdomo rokuhara ni oshiyose kazakami ni hikake hitomomōde sen ni nadoka daijōnyūdō yakīdete utazaru beki. " tozo sengishikeru

[4.9.2] Sononaka ni heike no inorishikeru ichinyobōajarishinkai deshidōjukusūjūnin hikigushi senginoniwa ni susumīde mōshikeru ha" kō mōseba heike no kataudo toya oboshimesare sōran Tatohi sa mo sōrahe Ikaga shuto no gi o yaburi, wadera no na o mo oshi de ha sō beki. Mukashi ha genpei sayū ni arasoite, chōka no onmori tari shika domo, kinrai ha genji no un katamuki, heike yo o totte nijūyonen, tenka ni nabikanu kusaki mo sōwazu. Nainai no yakata no arisama mo, kozei nite ha tayasū semeotoshi gatashi. Yokuyoku soto ni hakarigoto o megurashite, sei o moyōshi, gojitsu ni yora ru beu ya sōran. " to, hodo o noben ga tame ni naganagato zo sengishi taru.

[4.9.3] Kokoni jōenbō ajari keishū to iu rōsō ari. Koromo no shitani haramaki o ki, ōnaru uchigatana maedareni sashihorashi, kashira tsutsunde, shiratsuka no ōnaginata tsueni tsuki, sengi no niwani susumīdete mōshikeruha" shōko o sotoni hiku bekara zu." Wagatera no hongan tenmutennō wa imada tōgū no ontoki, ōtomonōuji ni habakara se tamai te, yoshino no oku o ide sase tamai, yamatokoku udagun o sugi sase tamai keru ni wa, sono sei wazukani jūshichiki, saredomo iga ise ni uchikoe, mino owari no sei o motte, ōtomonōuji o horoboshi te, tsuini kurai ni sokuse tamai ki. 『 kyūchō futokoro ni iru. Jinrin kore o awaremu』 to iu honmon ari. Jiyo wa shirazu, keishū ga monto ni oite wa, kon'ya rokuhara ni oshiyosete, uchijini se yo ya. " to zo sengi shi keru. Enman'in daibu gengaku, susumīdete mōshikeru wa," sengi bashi ōshi, yoru no fukuru ni, isoge ya susume. " to zo mōshikeru.

[4.10.1] Karamete ni mukō rōsō domo daishōgun ni wa genzanminyūdōyorimasa, jōenbōajarikeishū ritsujōbōajarinichīn, sotsuhōinzenchi, zenchi ga deshi gihō, zen'yō o hajime toshite, tsugō sono sei issennin, tete ni takimatsu mote, nyoi ga mine e zo mukai keru. Ōte no daishōgun ni ha chakushi izunokami nakatsuna, jinan gendayūhōgan kanetsuna, rokujōkurōdo nakaie, sono ko kurōdotarō nakamitsu, daishu ni ha enman'indaisukegengaku, jōkīn'aratosa, risshōbōiganokō, hōrin'in'onisado, korera ha chikara no tsuyosa, yumiya uchimono mote ha, oni ni mo kami ni mo au to iu ichinintōsen no tsuwamono nari. Byōdōin ni ha, inabatatejāradayū, kakurokurōbō, shimājari, tsutsuihōshi ni, gōajari, akushōnagon, kitain ni ha, kinkōin no rokutengu, shikibunotaifu, noto, kaga, sado, bingo nado nari. Matsuihigo, shōnan'inchikugo, kayachikuzen, ōyatoshinaga, gochīntajima, jōenbōajarikeishū ga bōnin, rokujūnin no uchi ni ha, kagakōjō, gyōbushunshū hōshibara ni ha ikkaihōshi ni shikazari ki. Dōshū ni ha, tsutsuijōmyōmeishū, kozōsonzuki, son'ei, jikei, rakujū, tekkengen'ei, bushi ni ha, watanabenoshō harimanojirō, sazukesatsumanohyōe, chōshichishō, kisotakiguchi, yoemonnosuke, zokugenta, kiyoshi, susumu o saki to shite, tsugō sono sei issengohyakuyonin mīdera o koso uchitate kere.

[4.10.2] Miya iri se tamaite nochi ha ōzeki kozeki horikitte, hori hori sakamogi hiki itari kere ba, hori ni hashi watashi, sakamogi hikinoke nado shi keru hodo ni, jikoku oshiutsutte, sekiji no niwatori naki aeri. Izunokami notamaikeru ha" koko de tori naite ha rokuhara ha hakuchū ni koso yosenzure, ikaga sen. " to notamaeba, enman'indaibugenkaku mata saki no gotoku susumīdete sengishikeru ha" mukashi shinshōō no toki, mōshōkun meshitodomeraretarishi ni, kisaki no ontasuke ni yotte, tsuwamono sanzennin o hikigushite, nigenogarekeru ni, kankokukan ni itareri. Niwatori nakanu kagiri ha, seki no to o hiraku koto nashi. Mōshōkun ga sanzen no kyaku no naka ni, tenkatsu to iu tsuwamono ari. Niwatori no nakimane o arigataku shikereba keimei tomo iware keri. Ka keimei takaki tokoro ni hashirinobori, niwatori no nakimane o shi tari kere ba, sekiji no niwatori kikitsutaete mina nakinu. Sonotoki sekimori tori no sorane ni bakasare te, seki no to akete zo tōshi keru. Kore mo kataki no hakarigoto ni ya nakasu ran, tada yore yo. " to zo mōshi keru. Kakari shi hodo ni, satsuki no mijikayo honobono to koso ake ni kere. Izunokami notamaikeru ha" yōchi ni koso saritomo to omoitsure domo, hiruikusa ni ha ikanimo kanau maji. Are yobikaese ya. " tote, karamete ha nyoigamine yori yobikaesu. Ōte ha matsuzaka yori tottekaesu. Wakadaishudomo," kore ha ichinyobōajari ga chōsengi ni koso yo aketare. Oshiyosete sono bō kire." tote, bō o sanzanni kiru. fusegu tokoro no deshi dōshuku, sūjūnin utare nu. ichinyobō ajari hōhō rokuhara ni maite rōgan yori namida o nagaite kono yoshi o uttaemōshikere domo, rokuhara ni ha gunbyō sūmanki haseatsumete sawagu koto mo nakari keri.

[4.10.3] Dō nijūsannichi no akatsuki, miya ha kono tera bakari de ha kanau maji, sanmon ha kokorogaeshi, nanto ha imada maira zu. Gonichi ni natte ha warukari nan tote, mīdera o idesase tamai te, nanto he zo irase imasu. Konomiya ha semiore, koeda to kikoeshi kanchiku no fue o futatsu motase tamae ri. Kano semiore to mōsu ha, mukashi tobain no ontoki kin o senryō, sōchō no mikado he, okurase tamai tari kere ba, henpō to obokute, ikitaru semi no gotokuni, fushi no tsukitaru fuedake o, hitofushi okurase tamau. Ikaga korehodo no jūhō o ba sōnau haerasubeki tote, mīdera no daishinsōjōkakushū ni ōsete, danjō ni tate, nanuka kajishite, horase tamaeru onfue nari. arutoki takamatsuchūnagonsanehirakyō maite, kono onfue o fukarerukeru ni, jinjō no fue no yō ni omoiwasurete, hiza yori shimo ni okaretarikereba, fue ya mottomoken, sonotoki semiori ni keri. satekoso semiori to ha tsukeraretare. fue no gokiryō taru ni yotte, konomiya gosōden arikeri. saredomo ima o kagiri to ya oboshimesareken, kondō no miroku ni mairasase ohashimasu. Ryūge no akatsuki, chigū no ontame ka to oboete, aware narishi kotodomo nari.

[4.10.4] Rōsō domo ni ha mina itoma tamaide, todome sase imasu. Shikarubeki wakadaishu akusō domo ha mairi keri. Genzanminyūdō no ichirui hikigushite, sono sei issennin to zo kikoe shi. Jōenbō ajari keishū, hato no tsue ni sugari te, miya no gozen ni mairi, rōgan yori namida o harahara to nagai te mōshikeru ha" dokomade mo otomotsukamatsurō sōrae domo, yowai sudeni hachijun ni take te, gyōbu kanai gatō sōrō." Deshi de sōrō gyōbubō shunshū o mairase sōrō. Kore ha ichinen heiji no kassen no toki, ko samanokami yoshitomo ga te ni sōrai te, rokujōgawara de uchijinitsukamatsuri sōrōshi sagaminokuni jūnin yamanōchi sudō gyōbunojō toshimichi ga ko de sōrō. Isasaka en sōrō aida, atonatsukashide ōshitatete, kokoro no soko made yoku shitte sōrō. Dokomade mo meshiguse rare sōrō beshi. 」とて、涙を抑て留りぬ。 宮もあはれに思召て、何の好にかうは申らんとて、御涙せきあへさせ給はず。

[4.11.1] 宮は宇治と寺との間にて、六度迄御落馬有けり。 これは去ぬる夜、御寢の成ざりし故也とて、宇治橋三間引きはづし、平等院に入奉て、暫御休息有けり。 六波羅には、 「すはや宮こそ南都へ落させ給ふなれ。追懸て討奉れ。」とて、大將軍には左兵衞督 知盛、頭中將重衡、左馬頭行盛、薩摩守忠教、侍大將には、上總守忠清、其子上總太 郎判官忠綱、飛騨守景家、其子飛騨太郎判官景高、高橋判官長綱、河内判官秀國、武 藏三郎左衞門尉有國、越中次郎兵衞尉盛繼、上總五郎兵衞忠光、惡七兵衞景清を先と して、都合其勢二萬八千餘騎、木幡山打越て、宇治橋の詰にぞ押寄たる。敵平等院に と見てんげれば、閧を作る事三箇度、宮の御方にも、同う閧の聲をぞ合せたる。先陣 が、「橋を引いたぞ、過すな。」とどよみけれども、後陣に是を聞つけず、我先にと 進程に、先陣二百餘騎押落され、水に溺れて流けり。 Hashi no ryōhō no tsume ni uchitate yāwasu.

[4.11.2] Miya no onkata ni ha, ōyatoshinaga, gochīntajima, watanabeshōju, zokugenta ga i keru ya zo yoroi mo kakezu tate mo tamarazu tōkeru. Gensanminyūdō ha, chōken no yoroihitatare ni, shinakawaodoshi no yoroi nari. Sonohi o saigo to ya omoware ken. Wazato kabuto ha kisetamawazu. Chakushi izunokami nakatsuna wa, akaji no nishiki no hitatare ni, kuroitōdoshi no yoroi nari. Yumi o tsuyō hikan tote kore mo kabuto wa kizari keri. Kokoni gochīntajima, ōnaginata no saya o hazuite tadahitori hashi no ue ni zo susundaru Heike no kata ni ha kore o mite," are itore ya monodomo" tote kukkyō no yumi no jōzudomo ga yasaki o yonaete sashitsume hikitsume sanzanni iru Tajima sukoshimo sawagazu, agaru ya o ba tsui kuguri, kudaru ya o ba tobikoe, mukate kuru o ba naginata de kitte otosu Kataki mo mikata mo kenbutsu su. Sore yori shite koso, yagiri no tajima to ha iwa re kere.

[4.11.3] Dōshū no naka ni, tsutsui no jōmyōmeishū ha, kachi no hitatare ni, kurokawaodoshi no yoroi ki te, gomaikō no o o shime, kokushitsu no tachi o haki, nijūshi sashi taru kurohoro no ya oi, nurigomedō no yumi ni, konomu shirae no ōnaginata torisoe te, hashi no ue ni zo susun daru. Daionjō o age te na nori keru ha" higoro ha oto ni mo kiki tsuramu, ima ha me ni mo mi tamae. Mīdera ni ha sono kakure nashi. Dōshū no naka ni tsutsuijōmyōmeishū tote, ichinintōsen no tsuwamono zo ya. Ware to omowa mu hitobito ha yoriai ya, misanse mu. " tote, nijūshi sashitaru ya o sashitsume hikitsume sanzanni iru. Yaniwa ni jūninin ikoroshi te, jūichinin teowase tare ba, ebira ni hitotsu zo nokotaru. Yumi o bakara to nagesute, ebira mo hodote sute keri. Tsuranuki nuide hadashini nari, hashi no yukigeta o sarasarato hashiriwataru. Hito ha osorete watara ne domo, jōmyōbō ga kokochi ni ha ichijō nijō no ōji to koso furumai tare. Naginata de mukō teki gonin nagifuse, rokunin ni ataru teki ni aite, naginata naka yori uchiotte sute keri. Sononochi tachi o nuite tatakau ni, teki ha ōzei nari, kumode, kakujō, jūmonji, tonbogaeri, mizuguruma, happō sukasazu kittari keri. Yaniwa ni hachinin kirifuse, kunin ni ataru teki ga kabuto no hachi ni, amarini tsuyoku uchiate, menuki no moto yori chōto ore, kuto nuite, kawa he zabuto hairini keri. Tanomu tokoro ha koshigatana, hitoeni shinan to zo kuruikeru.

[4.11.4] Kokoni jōenbō ajari keishū ga meshitsukaikeru ikkaihōshi to iu dairiki no hayawaza arikeri. Tsuzuite atoni tatakau ga, yukigeta ha semashi, sobadōbeki yō ha nashi. Jōmyōbō ga kabuto no tesaki ni te o oite," warū sō, jōmyōbō" tote, kata o tsundo tobikoete zo tatakaikeru. Ikkaihōshi uchishinishite ngeri. Jōmyōbō wa hōhōkaette, byōdōin no mon no mae naru shiba no ue ni mononogu nugisute, yoroi ni tattaru yame kazoetarikereba rokujūsan, urakaku ya gosho, saredomo daiji no te nara ne ba, shosho ni kyūjishite, kubi karage jōe kite, yumi uchikiri tsue ni tsuki, hirāshida haki, amidabutsu mōshite, nara no hō e zo makakeru.

[4.11.5] Jōmyōbō ga wataru o tehon ni shite, mīdera no daishu, watanabetō hashiritsuzukitsuzuki, ware mo／＼ to yukigeta o koso watakere. Aruiha bunshu shite kaeru mono mo ari, aruiha itade ōte hara kakkiri kawa e tobīru mono mo ari, hashi no ue no ikusa, hi izuru hodo zo tatakai keru. Kore o mite heike no kata no samuraidaishō kazusanokami tadakiyo, daishōgun no gozen ni maite" are goran sōrae. Hashi no ue no ikusa, teitau sōrō. Ima ha kawa o watasu beki de sō ga, orifushi samidare no koro de, mizu masate sō. Watasa ba uma hito ōku ushina sō nanzu. Yodo imoarae ya mukai sō beki, kawachiji he ya mairi sō beki. " to mōshi tokoro ni shimotsukenokuni no jūnin, ashikagamatatarōtadatsuna, susumidete mōshi keru ha" yodo imoarai kawachiji o ba, tenjiku shintan no bushi o meshite muke rare sō hanzuru ka. Sore mo warera koso mukai sō hanzure. Me ni kaka taru kataki o uta zu shite nanto he nyūsan se sō na ba, yoshino to tsukawa no sei domo haseatsuma te, iya godaiji de koso sō han zu rame. Musashi to kōzuke no sakai ni, tonegawa to mō sō taiga sō. Chichibu, ashikaga, nakatagaete, tsuneha kassen'o nasōrōshini, ōteha nagaiwatashi, karameteha kogasugiwatashi yori yosesōroishini, kokoni kōzukenokunino jūnin, nittanyūdō, ashikagani katarawarete, suginowatariyori yosentote mōketaru funedomō chichibugakatayori minayaburete, mōshisōroishiha," tadaima kokō watasazuba, nagaki kyūsenno kizunarubeshi. Mizuni oborete shinaba shine, iza watasantote, umaikadao tsukute watasebakoso watashikeme. Bandōmushano naraitoshite, tekio menikake, kawao hedatsuru ikusani, fuchise kirauyōya aru. Kono kawa no fukasa, hayasa, tonegawa ni ikuhodo no otori masari ha yomo ara ji. Tsuzuke ya tonobara. " tote, massaki ni koso uchīttare. Tsuzuku hitodomo, ōgo, ōmuro, fukasu, yamagami, nawatarō, sanukihirotsunashirōdayū, onoderazenjitarō, hen'yagoshishirō, rōdō ni ha ubukatajirō, kiryūrokurō, tanakasōta o hajime toshite sanbyakuyoki zo tsuzukeru. Ashikaga daionjō o agete," tsuyoki uma o ba kamite ni tateゝ, yowaki uma o ba shimote ni nase. Uma no ashi no oyoba u hodo ha, tazuna o kurete hose yo. Hazuma ba kai ayatsute oyose yo. Shimō mono o ba yumi no hazu ni toritsukese yo. Te o torikumi, kata o narabete watasu beshi. Kuratsubo ni yoku norisadamete, abumi o tsuyō fume. Uma no kashira shizuma ba hikiage yo. Itau hīte hikikazuku na. Mizu tamara ba santō no ue norikakere. Uma ni yowau mizu ni tsuyō nakabeshi. Kachū nite yumi hiki na. Kataki i tomo aihiki su na. Tsuneni shikoro o katabuke yo. Itau katabukete tenpen i sa su na. Kane ni watatte oshiotoshi sa ru na. Mizu ni shinaute watase ya watase. " to okite, sanbyakuyoki, ikki mo nagasazu, mukō no kishi he satto watasu.

[4.12.1] Ashikaga ha, kuchiba no aya no hitatare ni, akagawaodoshi no yoroi kite, takatsuno utaru kabuto no o o shime, koganezukuri no tachi o haki, kirifu no ya ohi, shigedō no yumi mote, rensen'ashige naru uma ni, kashiwagi ni mimizuku utaru kinpukurin no kura okite zo nottarikeru. Abumi funbari tachiagari daionjō o agete nanori keru ha, tōku ha oto ni mo kiki, chikaku ha me ni mo mi tamae. Mukashi chōteki masakado o horoboshi, kanshō kōmurishi tawaratōtahidesato ni jūdai, ashikagatarōtoshitsuna ga ko, matatarōtadatsuna, shōnen jūshichisai, kayōni mukanmui naru mono no, miya ni mukai mairasete, yumi o hiki ya o hanatsu koto ten no osore sukunakarazu sōrae domo, yumi mo ya mo myōga no hodo mo, heike no on'ue ni koso sōrame. Sanminyūdōdono no onkata ni, ware to omowan hitobito ha, yoriai ya misansen. " tote byōdōin no mon no uchi he semeirīri tatakaekeri

[4.12.2] Kore o mitamaite, taishōgun sahyōenokami tomomori" watase ya watase. " to gechiserarekereba, nimanhassen'yoki, mina uchītte watashikeri. Uma ya hito ni fusagarete, sabakari hayaki ujigawa no mizu ha ue ni zo tataetaru Onozukara afururu mizu ni ha, nanimo taezu nagarekeri Zōnindomo wa, uma no shimote ni toritsukitsuki watari kere ba, hiza yori ue o ba nurasa nu mono mo ōkari keri. Ikaga shitari ken igaiseryōkoku no kanpei, umaikada oshiyaburare mizu ni obore te roppyakuyoki zo nagare keru. Moegi, hiodoshi, akaodoshi, iroiro no yoroi no ukanu shizunu yurarekeru ha, kannabiyama no momijiba no, mine no arashi ni izanawarete, tatsutagawa no aki no kure, iseki ni kakatte, nagare mo yaranu ni kotonarazu. Sononaka ni hiodoshi no yoroi kitaru musha ga sannin, ajiro ni nagarekakatte yonageru o, izunokami mitamaite,

lg.l: 伊勢武者はみなひおどしの鎧きて、宇治の網代にかゝりぬるかな。

div.p: [4.12.3] Korera ha sannin nagara isenokuni no jūnin nari. Kurodanogoshirō, hinojūrō, otobeyashichi to iu mono nari. Sonōchi ni hinojūrō ha, furumono nite arikere ba, yumi no hazu o iwa no hazama ni nejitate, kakiagari, futari no monodomo o mo hikiagete, tasuketari keru to zo kikoe shi. Ōzei mina watashite, byōdōin no mon no uchi he, irekae／＼ tatakai keri. Kono magire ni, miya o ba nanto he sakidate mairase, gensanminyūdō no ichirui, nokotte fusegiya i tamau.

[4.12.4] Sanminyūdō shichijū ni amatte ikusashite, yunde no hizakuchi o isase, itade nareba, kokoroshizukani jigaisen tote, byōdōin no mon no uchi he hikinoite, teki osoikakari kereba, jinan gendaibuhangankanetsuna, konji no nishiki no hitatare ni, karāyaodoshi no yoroi kite, shiroashige naru uma ni nori, chichi o nobasan tote, kaeriawase／＼ fusegitatakau. Kazusanotarōhōgan ga i keru ya ni kanetsuna uchikabuto o i sase te uzumu tokoro ni, kazusanokami ga warawa, jirōmaru to iu shitatakamono oshinamete hikikunde dōto otsu. Minamotonotayūhōgan ha, uchikabuto mo itade nare domo, kikoyuru tairiki nari kere ba, warawa o totte oshite kubi o kaki, tachiagara n to suru tokoro ni, heike no tsuwamonodomo, jūshigoki hishihishito ochikasanatte, kanetsuna o utte keri. Izunokami nakatsuna mo itade amata oi byōdōin no tsuridono nite jigai su. Sono kubi o ba shimokōbetōsaburōkiyochika totte, ōyuka no shita he zo nageire keru. Rokujōkurōdonakaie, sono ko kurōdotarōnakamitsu mo, sanzanni tatakai, bundori amata tashite, tsuini uchijini shite keri. Kono nakaie to mōsu ha ko tachihakinosenjō yoshikata ga chakushi nari. Ko ni te ari shi o, sanminyūdō yōshi ni shite, fubin ni shi tamai shi ga, higoro no chigiri o henze zu, issho nite shini keru koso muzan nare. Sanminyūdō wa watanabenochōshichishō o meshite," wa kubi ute." to notamaeba, shū no ikikubi utan koto no kanashisa ni, namida o harahara to nagaite," tsukamatsuru tomo oboe sōrawazu. gojigai sōraite, sononochi koso tamawari sōrawa me." to mōshikereba," makotoni mo. " tote nishi ni mukai, kōshō ni jūnen tonae saigo no kotoba zo awarenaru.

lg.l: 埋木の花さく事もなかりしに、みのなる果ぞかなしかりける。

div.p: [4.12.5] Kore o saigo no kotoba nite, tachi no saki o hara ni tsukitate, utsubushizama ni tsuranuite zo userarekeru. Sonotoki ni utayomi beu ha nakari shika domo, waka yori tsuyoni sukitaru michi nare ba, saigo no toki mo wasure tamawa zu. Sonokubi o ba tonaetotte nakinaki ishi ni kukuriawase teki no naka o magiredete, ujigawa no fukaki tokoro ni shizumete keri.

[4.12.6] Kisotakiguchi oba heike no samuraidomo, ikanimoshite, ikedorini sentōkagaikeredomo, kisomo sakini kokoroete, sanzanni tatakai, daijino teoi, harakakikitte zo shinikeru. Enman'innotaifugenkaku, imaha miyamo harukani nobasasetamainuran toya omoiken. Ōdachi ōnaginata sayūni motte, tekino nakao uchiyaburi, ujigawahe tondeiri, mononogu hitotsumo sutezu, mizuno sokō kugutte, mukōno kishini wataritsuki, takaki tokoroni nobori, daionjōo agete," ikani heikeno kindachi, koremadeha godaijikayō. " tote, mīdera he koso kaeri kere.

[4.12.7] Hidanokami kageie ha, furutsuwamono nite arikere ba, kono magire ni, miya ha nanto he ya sakitatase tamau ran tote ikusa o ba se zu, sono sei gohyakuyoki, muchi abumi o awase te oikake tatematsuru. Annogotoku, miya wa sanjukki bakari de otosase tamaikeru o, kōmyōzan no torī no mae nite oitsuki tatematsuri, ame no furu sama ni imairase kere ba, nani ga ya to wa oboene domo, miya no hidari no onsokufuku ni ya hitosuji tate kere ba, onma yori otosase tamaite, onkubi toresase tamai keri. Kore o mi te otomo ni sō keru onisado, aratosa, aradayū, richijōbō no iganokimi, gyōbushunshū, konkōin no rokutengu, nani no tame ni inochi o ba oshimu beki to te omeki saken de uchijini su.

[4.12.8] Sononaka ni miya no onmenotogo, rokujōnosukedayūmunenobu kataki ha tsuzuku, uma ha yowashi, nīno no ike he tondeiri, ukikusa kao ni toriōi, wananakiori tare ba, kataki ha mae o uchisugi nu. Shibashi arite tsuwamonodomo no shigohyakki, sazameite uchikaeru nakani, jōe kitaru shinin no, kubi mo nai o, shitomi no shitani kaite dekitarikeru o dare yaran to mi tatematsureba, miya nite zo mashimashikeru. Ware shinaba kono fue o ba mihaka ni ireyo to ōsekeru koeda to kikoeshi onbue mo imada onkoshi ni sasaretari. Hashirīdete torimotsuki mairase baya to omoedomo, kowashikereba sore mo kanawazu. Kataki mina kaete nochi, ike yori agari, nuretaru monodomo shiborikite, nakinaki kyō he nobotareba, nikumanu mono koso nakarikere.

[4.12.9] Saruhodoni nanto no daishu hitakabuto shichisen'yonin, miya no onmukae ni mairu. Senjin wa konatsu ni susumi, kōjin wa imada kōfukuji no nandaimon ni yurae tari. Miya wa haya kōmyōzan no torī no mae nite utare sase tama nu to kikoe shika ba, daishu mina chikara oyoba zu namida o osae te todomari nu. Ima gojitchō bakari machitsuke sase tamawa de, utare sase tamai ken miya no gōn no hodo koso utatekere.

[4.13.1] Heike no hitobito ha miya narabini sanminyūdō no ichizoku, mīdera no shuto, tsugō gohyakuyonin ga kubi, tachi naginata no saki ni tsuranuki, takaku sashiage, yū ni oyobide rokuhara he kaerīru. Tsuwamonodomo isaminonoshiru koto obitadashi. Osoroshi nado mo orokanari Sonōchi ni gensanminyūdō no kubi ha, chōshichishō ga totte ujigawa no fukaki tokoro ni shizumete kere ba, sore ha mi zari keri. Kodomo no kubi ha asokokoko yori mina tazuneidasa re tari. Naka ni miya no onkubi ha, nenrai mairiyoru hito mo nakere ba, mishirimaise taru hito mo nashi. Sennen ten'yakunokami sadanari koso, goryōji no tame ni meshi tari shika ba, sore zo mishirimaise taru ran to te mesare kere domo, genshorō to te maira zu. Miya no tsuneni mesare keru nyōbō tote rokuhara he tazuneidasa re tari. Sashimo asakara zu, oboshimesa re te, miko o sansanse te saiai ari shika ba, ikadeka misonji tatematsuru beki. Tada hitome misanse te, sode o kao ni oshiate, namida o nagasa re keru ni koso, miya no okubi to shi te kere.

[4.13.2] Kono miya ha, harabara ni miko no miyatachi amata watara se tamai keri. Hachijōnyoin ni iyonokami morinori ga musume, sanminotsubone tote sōrawa re keru nyōbō no hara ni, nanasai no wakamiya, gosai no himemiya owashi keri. Nyūdōshōkoku, otōto ikenochūnagon'yorimorikyō o motte, hachijōnyoin he mōsare keru ha," takakuranomiya no miko no miyatachi no amata watara se tamawa sō naru. Himemiya no onkoto ha mōsuni oyoba zu, wakamiya o ba, tō／＼ idashimaira se tamawa he. " to mōsa re tari kere ba, nyōin gohenji ni," kakaru kikoe no ari shi akatsuki, ochinohito nado ga, kokorosukunō gushi tatematsuri te ushina ni keru ni ya, mattaku kono gosho ni watase tamawa zu. " to ōseke re ba, yorimorikyō chikara oyoba de kono yoshi o nyūdōshōkoku ni mōsa re keri. " nandeu sono gosho nara deha, izuku he ka watase tamau bekan naru. Sonogi nara ba, bushi domo mai te sagashi tatematsure. " to zo notamahi keru. Kono chūnagon ha, nyōin no onba, saishōdono to mōsu nyōbō ni aigushite, tsune ha mairitohore kere ba, higoro ha natsukashiu koso oboshimeshitsuru ni, konomiya no onkoto o mōshini mairaretare ba, ima ha ara nu hito no sama ni utoshiu zo oboshimesare keru. Wakamiya, nyōin ni mōsase tamahi keru ha" korehodo no ondaiji ni oyobi sōrōue ha tsui ni ha nogare sōrō maji. Tō／＼ ide sase gozamase. " to mōsa se tamaikere ba, nyōin onnamida o harahara to nagasa se tamai te," hito no nanatsu yatsu ha, nanigoto o mo kikiwake nu hodo zo kashi. Sore ni ware yue, daiji no shuttai taru koto o, kataharaitaku omoi te, kayōni notamau itōshisa yo. Yoshinakari keru hito o, kono rokushichinen tenarashi te, kakaru ukime o miyo. " tote, onnamida sekiae sase tamawa zu. Yorimorikyō, miya idashimairasase tamau beki yoshi kasanete mōsare kere ba, nyōin chikaraoyoba se tamawa de, tsuini miya o idashimairasase tamau. Onhaha sanminotsubone, ima o kagiri no wakare nare ba, sakoso ha onnagorioshiu mo omoware keme. Nakinaki onzo ki tatematsuri, ongushi kakinade, idashimairase tamau mo, tada yume to nomi zo omoware keru. Nyōin o hajimemairasete, tsubone no nyōbō, menowarawa ni itaru made, namida o nagashi sode o shibora nu ha nakari keri.

[4.13.3] Yorimorikyō, miya uketorimairase, mikuruma ni nosetatematsurite, rokuhara he watashitatematsuru. Sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō konomiya o mimairasete, chichi no shōkokuzenmon no gozen ni zashite," nanto sō yaran, konomiya o mitatematsuru ga, amarini itau omoimairase sō." Ri o magete kono miya no on'inochi o ba munemori ni tama sōrae. " to mōsare kere ba, nyūdō" saraba tōtō shukke o se sase tatematsure. " to zo notama keru. Munemorikyō, kono yoshi o hachijōnyoin ni mōsare kere ba, nyoin" nani no yō mo aru bekara zu, tada tōtō. " tote hōshi ni nashi tatematsuri, shakushi ni sadamara se tamai te, ninnaji no omuro no ondeshi ni nashi maira se sase tamai keri. Nochi ni ha tōji no ichi no chōja, yasuinomiya sōjō dōson to mōshi ha kono miya no onkoto nari.

[4.14.1] Mata nara ni mo issho zashi keri. Onba sanukinokami shigehide ga goshukke se sase tatematsuri, gushi mairase te, hokkoku he ochikudari tari shi o, kiso yoshinaka jōraku no toki shu ni shi shinze n tote, gushi tatematsute miyako he nobori, gogenpuku se sase mairase tari shika ba, kiso ga miya tomo mōshi keri. Mata genzoku no miya tomo mōshi keri. Nochi ni ha saga no hotori, noyori ni watara se tamai shika ba, noyori no miya tomo mōshi keri.

[4.14.2] Mukashi tsūjō to iu sōnin ari. Ujidono nijōdono oba, kimi sandai no kanpaku, tomoni ontoshi hachijū to mōshi tari shi mo chigawa zu. Sochinonaidaijin oba, ruzai no sō imasu to mōshi tari shi mo chigawa zu. Shōtokutaishi no, sushuntennō o ōshi no sō imasu to mōshi sase tamai tari shi ga, umakodaijin ni korosa re tamai ni ki. Sa mo shikarubeki hitobito ha, kanarazu sōnin to shimo ara ne domo, kaku koso medetakari shika. Kore ha aishōnagon ga fukaku ni ha ara zu ya. Nakagoro kaneakirashinnō, tomohirashinnō to mōshi ha sakinochūshōu, nochinochūshōu tote, tomoni ken'ō seishu no ōji nite watase tamai shika domo, kurai ni mo sokuse tamawa zu. Saredomo nanikaha muhon o okosase tamahi shi. Mata gosanjōin daisan no miko, sukehitoshinnō mo gosaigaku sugurete ohashikere ba, shirakawain imada tōgū nite ohashimai shi toki" mikurai no nochi ha, konomiya o kurai ni ha tsukase tamahe." to, gosanjōin, goishō ari shika domo, Shirakawain ikaga oboshimesare ken, tsuini kurai ni mo tsuke mairasase tamahazu, semete no onkoto ni ha, sukehitoshinnō no miko ni, genji no sei o sazuke mairasase tamate, mui yori ichido ni sanmi ni joshite, yagate chūjō ni narimairasase tamahi keri. Issei no genji, mui yori sanmi suru koto sagakōtei no miko, yōin no dainagon sadakyō no hoka ha kore hajime to zo uketamawaru Hanazono sadaijin arihitokō no onkoto nari.

[4.14.3] Takakuranomiya no gomuhon no aida, chōbuku no hō uketamawate shuserarekeru kōsō tachi ni kanshō okonawaru. Sakinōdaishō munemorikyō no shisoku jijū kiyomune sanmi shite, sanmijijū to zo mōshikeru. Kotoshi wazukani jūnisai. Chichi no kyō mo kono yowai de ha hyōenosuke de koso owase shika. Tachimachi ni kandachime ni nobori tamau koto, ichi no hito no kindachi no hoka ha imada uketamawari oyoba zu. Minamotonomochihito, yorimasa hōshi fushi tsuitō no shō to zo josho ni ha ari keru. Minamotonomochihito to ha, takakuranomiya o mōshi keri. masani i daijōhōō no ōji o uchi tatematsuru dani ari ni, bonnin ni sae nashi tatematsuru zo asamashiki.

div.head: 4.15. ぬえ[_][1]]

div.p: [4.15.1] Somosomo gensanminyūdōyorimasa to mōshi ha, settsunokamiyorimitsu ni godai, mikawanokamiyoritsuna ga mago, hyōgonokaminakamasa ga ko nari. Hōgen no kassen no toki, mikata nite saki o kake tari shika domo, saseru shō ni mo azukara zu, mata heiji no gyakuran ni mo, shinrui o sute sanji tari shika domo, onshō kore utonari ki. Daidaishugo nite toshihisau ari shika domo, shōden o ba yurusare zu. Toshi take yowai katamuite nochi, jukkai no waka isshu yonde koso shōden o ba yurusare kere.

lg.l: 人しれず大内山の山守は、木隱てのみ月を見るかな。

div.p: [4.15.2] Kono uta ni yotte shōden yurusare, shōgeshī nite shibaraku ari shi ga, sanmi o kokoro ni kake tsutsu,

lg.l: のぼるべき便無き身は木の下に、しゐをひろひて世をわたるかな。

div.p: [4.15.3] Sate koso sanmi hashitari kere. Yagate shukke shi te gensanminyūdō tote kotoshi ha shichijūgo ni zo nare keru. Konohito ichigo no kōmyō to oboshi koto ha konoein gozaī no toki, ninpei no korōi, shujō yoyo obietamagirase tamau koto ari keri. Yūgen no kōsō kisō ni ōsete, daihō hihō o shuse rare kere domo, sono gen nashi. Gonō ha ushinokoku bakari de arikeru ni, higashisanjō no mori no kata yori, kurokumo hitomura tachikite, goten no ue ni ōe ba, kanarazu obiesase tamai keri. Kore ni yotte kugyō sengi ari. Saru kanji no korohohi, horikawatennō go zaī no toki, shika no gotoku, shujō yonayona obiesasetamau koto arikeri. Sonotoki no shōgun yoshīe ason, nanden no ōyuka ni saburawarekeru ga, gonō no kokugen ni oyobide, meigen suru koto sando no nochi, kōsei ni" sakinomutsunokami, minamotonoyoshīe" to nanoritarikereba, hitobito mina mi no ke katate, gonō okotasetamaikeri. Sareba sunawachi senrei ni makasete, bushi ni ōsete keigo ari beshi tote, genpeiryōke no tsuwamono no naka o erabase rare keru ni, kono yorimasa o erabīderare tari keru to zo kikoe shi. Konotoki ha imada hyōgonokami to zo mōshi keru. Yorimasa mōshi keru ha," mukashi yori chōka ni bushi o oki ruru koto ha, gyakuhan no mono o shirizoke, ichoku no tomogara o horobosan ga tame nari." Me ni mo mie nu henge no mono tsukamatsure to ōsekudasaruru koto, imada uketamawarioyoba zu. " to mōshi nagara, chokujō nare ba meshi ni ōji te sandai su. Yorimasa wa tsukikiri taru rōdō, tōtōminokuni no jūnin, inohayata ni, horo no kazakiri haidaru ya owase te, tadahitori zo gushi tari keru. Wagami wa futae no kariginu ni, yamadori no o o motte tsukudaru togariya futasuji, shigedō no yumi ni torisoete, nanden no ōyuka ni shikōsu. Yorimasa ya o futatsu tehasakeru koto wa, masayorikyō sonotoki wa mada sashōben nite mashikeru ga, henge no mono tsukamatsuranzuru jin wa yorimasa zo sō to erabimōsaretaru aida, ichi no ya ni henge no mono o isonzuru mono nara ba, ni no ya ni wa, masayori no ben no, shakubi no hone o in to nari. Higoro hito no mōshi ni chigawa zu, gonō no kokugen ni oyobide, higashisanjō no mori no hō yori, kurokumo hitomura tachikite, goten no ue ni tanabītari. Yorimasa kitto miagetareba, kumo no naka ni ayashiki mono no sugata ari. Kore o isonzuru mono nara ba, yo ni aru beshi to ha omowa zari keri. Sarinagaramo ya totte tsugai, namuhachimandaibosatsu to, kokoro no naka ni kinenshi, yokuhīte, hyōto iru. Tegotae shite, hatato ataru. " etariyaō" to, yatakebi o koso shitari kere. Ihayata tsuto yori, otsuru tokoro o tote osaete, tsuzukizama ni kutachi zo sashitari keru. Sonotoki jōge tete ni hi o moyaite, kore o goranji mi tamau ni, atama ha saru, mukuro ha tanuki, o ha hebi, teashi ha tora no sugata nari. Naku koe nue ni zo nitari keru. Osoroshi nado mo orokanari. Shujō gyokan no amari ni, shishiō to iu mitsurugi o kudasare keri. Ujisadaijindono kore o tamawari tsuide, yorimasa ni tamawan tote, gozen no kizahashi o nakabakari kudasase tamaeru tokoro ni, koro ha uzuki tōkāmari no koto nareba, kumoi ni hototogisu, futakoe mikoe otozurete zo tōrikeru. Sonotoki sadaijindono

lg.l: 時鳥名をも雲井にあぐるかな。

div.p: [4.15.4] To ōserare tari kere ba, yorimasa migi no hiza o tsuki, hidari no sode o hiroge, tsuki o sukoshi sobame ni kake tsutsu,

lg.l: 弓はり月のいるにまかせて。

div.p: [4.15.5] To tsukamatsuri, mitsurugi o tamaite makarīzu. Yumiya o totte narabinaki nomi nara zu, kadō mo masattari keri. " tote kimi mo shin mo gyokan arikeru. Sate kano henge no mono o ba, utsuobune ni irete nagasare keru to zo kikoe shi.

[4.15.6] Saru ōhō no korōi, nijōin gozaī no ontoki, nue to iu kechō, kinchū ni naite, shibashiba shinkin o nayamasu koto ariki. Senrei o motte, yorimasa o mesare keri. Koro ha gogatsu hatsuka amari no mada yoi no koto naru ni, nue tadahitokoe naite, futakoe tomo nakazari keri. Mezashi tomo shiranu yami de ha ari, sugatakatachi mo mie zare ba, yatsubo o nantomo sadame gatashi. Yorimasa saku ni mazu ōkabura o totte tsugahi, nue no koe shi tsuru dairi no ue he zo iage taru. Nue kabura no oto ni odoroite kokū ni shibashi hihimei tari. Ni no ya ni kokabura totte tsugahi, hīfutsuto ikitte, nue to kabura to narabete mae ni zo otoshi taru. Kinchū sazamekiai, gyokan nanamenarazu, gyoi o kazukesase tamaikeru ni, sonotoki ha, ōinomikado udaijin kinnō kō kore o tamawari tsuide, yorimasa ni kazukesase tamau tote" mukashi no yōyū ha, kumo no soto no kari o iki, ima no yorimasa ha, ame no naka no nue o itari. " to zo kanzerarekeru.

lg.l: 五月闇名をあらはせる今宵哉。

div.p: [4.15.7] To ōserare kake tari kere ba, yorimasa,

lg.l: たそがれ時もすぎぬとおもふに。

div.p: [4.15.8] To tsukamatsuri, onzo o kata ni kakete taishutsusu. Sononochi izunokuni tamawari, shisoku nakatsuna zuryō ni nashi, wagami sanmi shite, tanba no gokashō, wakasa no tōgūgawa o chigyōshite, sate mashi bekari shi hito no, yoshinaki muhon okote, miya o mo shissanse wagami mo shison mo usenuru koso utatekere.

div.p: [4.16.1] Higoro ha sanmon no daishu koso, midarigawashiki uttae tsukamatsuru ni, kondo ha onbin o zonji te oto mo se zu. Nanto mīdera aruiha miya uketoritatematsuri, aruiha miya no onmukae ni mairu. Kore motte chōteki nari. Sareba mīdera o mo nanto o mo semeraru beshi tote dō gogatsu nijūshichinichi, taishōgun niha nyūdō no yonan tōnochūjō shigehira, fukushōgun niha satsumanokami tadanori, tsugō sono sei ichiman'yoki de onjōji he hakkō su. Tera ni mo hori hori, kaidate kaki, sakamogi hīte machikake tari. ukoku ni yāi shite, ichinichi tatakai kurasu. fusegu tokoro no daishu ika hōshibara sanbyakuyonin made utare ni keri. Yoikusa ni natte, kurasa ha kurashi, kangun jichū ni semeitte, hi o hanatsu. Yakeru tokoro, hongakuin, jōkīn, shinnyoin, hanazonoin, fugendō, daihōin, seiryūin, kyōtaioshōhonbō, narabini honzon nado, hachikenshimen no daikōdō, shōrō, kyōzō, kanjōdō, gohōzenshin no shadan, imakumano no gohōden, sōjite dōshatōbyō roppyakusanjūshichiu, ōtsu no zaike issenhappyakugojūsan'u, chishō no watashitamaeru issaikyō shichisen'yokan, butsuzō nisen'yotai, tachimachini kemuri to nari koso kanashikere. Shoten gomyō no gaku mo, konotoki nagaku tsuki, ryūjin sannetsu no ku mo iya sakannaru ran to zo mie shi.

[4.16.2] Sore mīdera ha ōmi no gidairyō ga watakushi no tera tari shi o, tenmutennō ni yose tatematsuri te, gogan to nasu. Honbutsu mo ka mikado no gohonzon, saru o shōjin no miroku to kikoe tamai shi kyōtaioshō hyakurokujūnen okonai te, daishi ni fushoku shi tamae ri. Toshatatenjō manihōden yori amakudari, harukani ryūgegeshō no akatsuki o machise tamau to koso kikitsuru ni, kowa ikani shitsuru kotodomo zo ya. Daishi koko o denpōkanjō no reiseki toshite seikasui no mizu o musubi tamaishi yueni koso mīdera toha nazuketare. Kakaru medetaki seiseki naredomo imaha nani narazu. Kenmitsu shuyuni usete, garan sarani ato mo nashi. Sanmitsudōjō mo nakereba, suzu no koe mo kikoezu. Ichige no hana mo nakere ba, aka no oto mo se zari keri. Shukurōsekitoku no meishi ha, gyōgaku ni okotari, juhōsōjō no deshi ha, mata kyōgyō ni wakan tari. Tera no chōri enkeihōshinnō ha, tennōji no bettō o todome raru. Sonohoka sōgō jūsannin, kekkan se rare te, mina kenbīshi ni azukara ru. Akusō ha tsutsuijōmyōmeishū ni itaru made, sanjūyonin nagasa re keri. Kakaru tenka no ran, kokudo no sawagi adagoto tomo oboe zu, heike no yosue ni nari nuru senpyō yaran to zo hito mōshi keru.

[5.1.1] Jishō yonen rokugatsu mikka, fukuhara e gyōkō ari beshi tote kyōchū hishimeki aeri. Konohi kitaru miyakōtsuri aru beshi to kikoe shikadomo, tachimachini imāsu no hodo to ha omowa zari tsuru ni, koha ikani tote shōka sawagiaeri. Amatsusae mikka to sadame rare tari shi ga ima ichinichi hikiage te futsuka ni nari ni keri. Futsuka no unokoku ni sudeni gyōkō no mikoshi o yose tari kere ba shujō ha kotoshi sansai imada itonau owashimashi kere ba nanigokoro mo nau mesa re keri. Shujō sukunau watase tamau toki no godōyo ni ha hahakisaki koso maise tamau ni kore ha sonogi nashi. Onba heidainagontokitadakyō no kitanokata sochinosukedono zo hitotsu mikoshi ni maira re keru. Chūgū, ichīn, jōkō, gokō naru. Sesshōdono o hajimematsurite daijōdaijin ige no kugyō tenjōbito, waremowaremoto gubuse raru. Mikka fukuhara he irase tamau. Ikechūnagon'yorimorikyō no shukusho, kōkyo ni naru. Dō yokka yorimori ie no shō tote shōnī shi tamau. Kujōdono no miko, udaishō yoshimichi kyō koerare tamai keri. Setsuroku no omi no goshisoku, bonjin no jinan ni kakai koerare tamau koto, kore hajime to zo kikoeshi.

[5.1.2] Saruhodoni hōō o nyūdōshōkoku yōyō omohinahoshite, tobadono o dashi tatematsuri, miyako he ire mairase tari shi ga, takakuranomiya gomuhon ni yotte mata ohoini ikidohori, fukuhara he gokau nashi tatematsuri, shimen ni hashīta shite, kuchi hitotsu aketaru uchi ni sangen no itaya o tsukutte, oshikome mairase, shugo no bushi ni ha, harada no tayū tanenao bakari zo saburahikeru. Tayasū hito no mahikayofu beki koto mo nakereba ba, warahabe ha, kago no gosho to zo maushikeru. Kiki mo yuyushiu osoroshikari shi kotodomo nari. Hōō ima ha yo no matsurigoto shiroshimesa baya to ha tsuyu mo oboshimeshi yora zu, tada yamayama teradera shugyō shite mikokoro no mama ni nagusaba ya to zo ōse keru. Oyoso heike no akugyō ni oite kotogotoku kiwamari nu. Inuru angen yori ikō, ōku no keishō, unkaku, aruiha nagashi, aruiha ushinai, kanpaku nagashi tatematsuri, waga muko o kanpaku ni nashi, hōō o jōnan no rikyū ni utsushi tatematsuri, daini no ōji, takakuranomiya o uchi tatematsuri, ima nokoru tokoro no miyakōtsuri nareba kayōni shitamau niya to zo hito mōshikeru.

[5.1.3] Miyakōtsuri ha senshō naki ni arazu. Jinmutennō to mōsu ha chijingodai no mikado, hikohohodemi uga kusafukiawasezunomikoto no daiyon no ōji, mihaha ha tamayorihime, ama no musume nari. Kami no yo jūnidai no ato o uke, jindai hyakuō no teiso nari. Kanototori no toshi, hyūganokuni miyazakigun ni shite, kōō no hōso o tsugi, gojūkunen to īshi tsuchinotohitsujitoshi jūgatsu ni tōsei shite, toyoashiharanakatsukuni ni todomari, konokoro yamatonokuni to nazuketaru unebi no yama o tenjite, teito o tate kashihara no chi o kiriharaite, kyūshitsu o tsukuri tamaeri. Kore o kashihara no miya to nazuke tari. Sore yori ikō, daidai no teiō, miyako o takoku tasho he utsusa ruru koto sanjūdo ni amari, shijūdo ni oyobiri. Jinmutennō yori, keikōtennō made jūnidai ni ha, yamatokoku gungun ni miyako o tate, takoku he ha tsuini utsure zu. Saruo seimutennō gannen ni ōmikoku ni utsute, shigagun ni miyako o tatsu. Chūaitennō ninen ni, nagatonokuni ni utsurite, toyōragun ni miyako o tatsu. Sonokuni no kanomiyako nite, mikado kakuresasetamaishikaba, kisakijingūkōgō miyo o uketorasetamai, nyotai toshite, kikai, koma, keitan made, semeshitagaesasetamaikeri. Ikoku no ikusa o shizumesasetamaite, kichō no nochi chikuzennokuni mikasagun ni shite, miko gotanjō, sonotokoro oba uminomiya to zo mōshitaru. Kakemakumo katajikenaku, hachiman no onkoto kore nari. Kurai ni sokuse tamai te ha, ōjintennō to zo mōshikeru. Sononochi jingūkōgō ha, yamatonokuni ni utsurite, iwarenowakazakuranomiya ni owashimasu. Ōjintennō ha dōkoku karushimanoakarinomiya ni sumase tamau. Nintokutennō gannen ni, tsunokuni naniwa ni utsurite, takatsunomiya ni owashimasu. Richūtennō ninen ni, yamatokoku ni utsurite, tōchigun ni miyako o tatsu. Hanzeitennō gannen ni, kawachikoku ni utsurite, shibagakinomiya ni sumise tamau. Ingyōtennō yonjūninen ni mata yamatokoku ni utsurite, asuka no asukanomiya ni owashimasu. Yūryakutennō nijūichinen ni, dōkoku hatsuseasakura ni miyaishi tamau. Keitaitennō gonen ni, yamashirokoku tsuzuki ni utsurite, jūninen, sonogo otokuni ni miyaishi tamau. Senkatennō gannen ni, mata yamatokoku ni kaette, hinokumairinomiya ni owashimasu. Kōtokutennō taika gannen ni, settsukoku nagara ni utsutte, toyosakinomiya ni jūse tamau, saimeitennō ninen, mata yamatokoku ni kaette, okamotonomiya ni owashimasu.
