Tenjitennō rokunen ni, ōmikoku ni utsutte, ōtsunomiya ni jūse tamau, tenmutennō gannen ni, nao yamatokoku ni kaette, okamoto no minami no miya ni jūse tamau. Kore o kiyomigahara no mikado to mōshiki. Jitō, monmu nidai no seichō ha dōkoku fujiwaranomiya ni owashimasu. Genmeitennō yori, kōnintennō made shichidai ha, nara no miyako ni jūse tamau. Shika o kanmutennō, enryaku sannen jūgatsu futsuka, nara no kyō kasuga no sato yori, yamashironokuni nagaoka ni utsute, jūnen to ishi shōgatsu ni, dainagon fujiwaranokoguromaru, sangi sadaiben kinokosami, daisōzu genkei ra o tsukawashite, tōgoku kadonogun udamura o mise raruru ni, ryōnin tomoni sōshite ī, konochi no tei o miru ni, hidari seiryū, migi byakko, mae suzaku, ushiro genbu, shijin sōō no chi nari. Mottomo teito o sadamuru ni tareri to mōsu. Yotte otagigun ni owasu kamodaimyōjin ni tsugemōsasetamaite, enryakujūsannenjūichigatsunijūichinichi, nagaoka no kyō yori konokyō he utsusarete nochi, teiō sanjūnidai, seisō ha sanbyakuhachijūyosai no shunjū o okurimukau. Mukashi yori daidai no teiō, kunigunitokorodokoro ni, ō no miyako o taterareshikadomo, kakunogotokuno shōchi ha nashi tote, kanmutennō kotoni shūshioboshimeshi, daijinkugyōshodōnosaijintō ni ōseawase, chōkyūnarubekiyō tote, tsuchi nite hasshaku no hitogata o tsukuri, tetsu no gaikō o kise, onajiu tetsu no yumiya o motasete, higashiyama no mine ni, nishimuki ni tatete uzumarekeri. Matsudai ni kono miyako o takoku he utsusu koto ara ba, shugoshin to naru beshi to zo goyakusoku ari keru. Sareba tenka ni koto shuttai n tote ha, kono tsuka kanarazu meidō su. Shōgun ga tsuka tote ima ni ari. Kanmutennō to mōsu ha heike no nōso nite owasu. Naka ni mo kono kyō o ba heianjō to nazuke te tairaka ni yasuki miyako to kaki ri. Mottomo heike no agamubeki miyako nari. Senzo no mikado no, sashimo shūshi oboshimesaretaru miyako o, saseru yue naku, takoku tasho he utsusaruru koso asamashikere. Saga kōtei no ontoki heizei no sentei naishinokami no susume ni yotte yo o midari tamai shi toki, sudeni kono kyō o takoku he utsusan to se sase tamai shi o daijin kugyō shokoku no jinmin somuki mōshi ka ba, utsusare zu shite yamini ki. Itten no kimi banjō no nushi dani mo utsushi e tamawa nu miyako o, nyūdō shōkoku, jinshin no mi toshite, utsusare keru zo osoroshiki.

[5.1.4] Kyūto ha aware medetakari tsuru miyako zo kashi. Ōjōshugo no chinju wa, shihō ni hikari o yawarage, reigenshushō no teradera wa jōge ni iraka narabi tamai, hyakushōbanmin wazurai naku, gokishichidō mo bin ari. Saredomo ima wa tsujitsuji o mina horikitte, kuruma nado no tayasū ikikayō koto mo nashi. Kaikō ni iku hito mo, oguruma ni nori, michi o hete koso tōkere. noki o arasoishi hito no sumai, hi o hetsutsu areyuku. ieie ha kamogawa katsuragawa ni kowaire, ikada ni kumiukabe, shizaizatsugu fune ni tsumi, fukuhara he to hakobikudasu. tadanarini, hana no miyako, inaka ni naru koso kanashikere. nanimono no shiwaza ni ya ariken. furuki miyako no dairi no hashira ni nishu no uta o zo kaitarikeru.

lg.l: 百年を四かへり迄に過來にし、愛宕の里のあれやはてなん。
さきいづる花の都をふりすてて、風ふく原の末ぞあやふき。

div.p: [5.1.5] Onajiki rokugatsu kokonoka, shinto no kotohajime aru beshi tote, shōkei ni ha tokudaiji sadaishō sanesada kyō, tsuchimikado saishōchūjō michichika kyō, bugyō no ben ni ha, kurōdo sashōben yukitaka, kanjin tomo meshigushite, wada no matsubara no nishi no no o tenjite, kujō no chi o ware keru ni, ichijō yori shimo gojō made ha soko ate, gojō yori shimo ha nashi keri. Gyōjikan kaeri maite, kono yoshi o sōmon su. Saraba harima no inamino ka, nao settsunokuni no koyano ka nado iu kugyō sengi ari shika domo, koto yuku beshi tomo mie zari keri.

[5.1.6] Kyūto o ba sudeni ukare nu, shinto ha imada koto yuku ka zu, ari to shi aru hito ha mi o ukigumo no omoi o nasu. Moto koko ni sumu mono ha chi ushinate urehe, ima utsuru hitobito ha doboku no wazurai o nageki aeri. Sōte tada yume no yō nari shi kotodomo nari. Tsuchimikadosaishōchūjōmichichikakyō no mōsare keru ha ikoku ni ha sanjō no kōro o hiraite, jūni no tsūmon o tate to mie tari. 況や五條迄有ん都に、などか内裏を立ざるべき。
且々里内裏造るべき由、議定有て、五條大納言國綱卿、臨時に周防國を賜て、造進せ らるべき由、入道相國計ひ申されけり。此國綱卿は大福長者にておはすれば、造出れ ん事、左右に及ばねども、如何が國の費え民の煩ひ無るべき。指當る大事、大嘗會な どの行はるべきを差置いて、かゝる世の亂に遷都造内裏、少も相應せず。古の賢き御 代には、即内裏に茨を葺き、軒をだにも調へず、煙の乏きを見給ふ時は、限有る御貢 物をも許れき。是即民を惠み、國を扶け給ふに依て也。楚、章華臺を立て黎民をあら け、秦、阿房殿を起して、天下亂ると云へり。茅茨剪ず、采椽けづらず、舟車飾ず、 衣服文無ける世も有けん物を。 されば唐の太宗は、驪山宮を造て、民の費えをや憚せ給けん、遂に臨幸なくして、瓦に松生ひ、墻に蔦茂て止にけるには、相違かなとぞ人申ける。

[5.2.1] 六月九日、新都の事始、八月十日上棟、十一月十三日遷幸と定めらる。 舊き都は荒行ば、今の都は繁昌す。 Asamashikarikeru natsu mo sugi, aki ni mo sudeni narinikeri. Yōyō aki mo nakaba ni nariyukaba, fukuhara no shinto ni mashimasu hitobito, meisho no tsuki o min tote, aruiha genji no taishō no mukashi no ato o shinobitsutsu, suma yori akashi no ura tsutahi, awaji no seto o oshiwatari, ejima ga iso no tsuki o miru. Aruiha shirara, fukiage, wakanōra, sumiyoshi, naniwa, takasago, onoe no tsuki no akebono o yomite kaeru hito mo ari. Kyūto ni nokoru hitobito ha, fushimihirosawa no tsuki o miru.

[5.2.2] Sononaka ni mo tokudaijisadaishōsanesadakyō ha, furuki miyako no tsuki o koite, hachigatsutōkāmari ni, fukuhara yori zo nobori tamau. Nanigoto mo mina kawarihate, mareni nokoru ie ha, monzen kusa fukashite, teijō tsuyu shigeshi. Yomogi ga soma asaji ga hara, tori no fushido to arehate, mushi no koegoe uramitsutsu, kigiku shiran no nobe to zo narinikeru. Furusato no nagori tote ha, konoegawara no ōmiya bakari zo mashimashikeru. Taishō sono gosho ni maite, mazu zuijin ni, sōmon o tatakaseraruru ni, uchi yori onna no koe shite," tare so ya yomogiu no tsuyu uchiharau hito mo naki tokoro ni. " to togare ba," fukuhara yori taishōdono no omairi sō. " to mōsu. " sōmon wa kusari no sasare te sō zo. Higashiomote no komon yori irase tamae. " to mōshikere ba, taishō" saraba" tote, higashi no mon yori maira re keri. Ōmiya wa otsure％＼ ni mukashi o ya oboshimeshīdesase tamai ken, minamiomote no mikōshi akesase te gobiwa asobasare keru tokoro ni, taishō maira re tari kere ba," ikani yume ka ya utsutsu ka, kore e kore e. " to zo ōse keru. Genji no uji no maki ni ha, ubasokunomiya no onmusume, aki no nagori o oshimi, biwa o shirabete, yo mo sugara kokoro o sumashi tamaishi ni, ariake no tsuki no ide keru o, taezu ya obohoshi ken, kannagi nite maneki tamai ken mo, ima koso omoishirare kere.

[5.2.3] Matsuyoi no kojijū to iu nyōbō mo kono gosho nite zo sō keru. Kono nyōbō o matsuyoi to mōsu keru koto ha arutoki gosho nite" matsuyoi kaeru ashita izureka aware ha masaru. " to otazune ari kere ba,

lg.l: 待宵のふけゆく鐘の聲聞けば、歸るあしたの鳥はものかは。

div.p: [5.2.4] To yomi tari keru ni yorite koso, matsuyoi to ha mesare kere. Taishō kano nyōbō yobīdashi, mukashīma no monogatari shite, sayo mo yōyō fukeyuke ba, furuki miyako no areyuku o imayō ni koso utaware kere.

lg.l: 舊き都を來て見れば淺茅が原とぞ荒にける、 月の光はくまなくて秋風のみぞ身にはしむ。

div.p: [5.2.5] To santan utai sumasare kere ba, ōmiya o hajime mairasete, goshochū no nyōbōtachi, mina sode o zo nurasare keru.

[5.2.6] Saruhodo ni yo mo akere ba, taishō itoma mōshite, fukuhara he koso kaerare kere. Otomo ni sō kurōdo o meshite," jijū ga amarini nagorioshigeni omoi taru ni, nanji kaette nantomo itte koso." to ōse kere ba, kurōdo hashirikaette,"『 kashikomamōse』 to sō." " tote

lg.l: 物かはと君が云けん鳥の音の、今朝しもなどか悲かるらん。

div.p: [5.2.7] Nyōbō namida o osaete,

lg.l: またばこそ深行く鐘も物ならめ、あかぬわかれの鳥の音ぞうき。

div.p: [5.2.8] Kurōdo kaerimaite konoyoshi o mōshitarikereba" sarebakoso nanji oba yatsure. " tote, taishō ōini kanzerarekeri. Soreyorishitekoso monokawano kurōdo toha iware kere.

[5.3.1] 福原へ都を移されて後、平家の人々夢見も惡う、常は心噪ぎのみして、變化の者共多かりけり。 或夜入道の臥給へる所に、一間にはゞかる程の物の面出來て、覗奉る。 入道相國ちとも噪がず、ちやうとにらまへておはしければ、只消に消失ぬ。 岡の御所と申は、新しう造られたれば、然べき大木もなかりけるに、或夜大木の倒るゝ音して、 人ならば二三十人が聲して、どと笑ふ事ありけり。是は如何樣にも天狗の所爲と云ふ 沙汰にて、蟇目の當番と名附て、夜百人晝五十人番衆をそろへて蟇目を射させらるる に、天狗の在る方へ向いて射たる時は、音もせず、又無い方へ向いて射たるとおぼし き時は、はと笑などしけり。

[5.3.2] 又或朝入道相國帳臺より出で、妻戸をおしひらいて、坪の内を見給へば、死人の髑髏共が幾らと云ふ數も知らず、庭にみち／＼て、上に成り、下に成り、轉合轉退き、端なるは中へ轉び入り、中なるは端へ出づ。 Obitadashiku karameki aikere ba, nyūdōshōkoku、「 hito ya aru／＼ " to mesare kere domo orifushi hito mo maira zu. Kakushite ōku no dokuro domo ga hitotsu ni katamari ai, tsubo no uchi ni habakaru hodo ni natte, takasa jūshigojō mo ara n to oboyuru yama no gotoku ni narini keri. Kano hitotsu no ōgashira ni ikitaru hito no manako no yō ni ōkino manako domo ga senman dekite, nyūdōshōkoku o chōto niramaete, matataki mo se zu. Nyūdō sukoshi mo sawaga zu. Chōto niramaete tataretari Kano ōgashira amarini tsuyoku niramare tatematsuri, sōro nado no hini ate kiyuru yōni, atokatamo naku narini keri. Sonohokani ichino miumayani tatete, toneri amata tsukerare, asayū sukinaku nadekaware keru umano oni, hitoyono uchini nezumi suo kui, kō undari keru. Kore tadagotoni arazu tote onmyōjini uranawaserare kereba omoki gotsutsushimito zo mōshikeru. Kono ōmaha, sagaminokunino jūnin ōbasaburōkagechikaga, tōhakkakokuichino umatote, nyūdōshōkokuni mairase tari. Kuroki uma no hitai shirokari keri. Na o ba mochizuki to zo tsuke rare taru. Onmyōnokami abenoyasuchika tamawari keri. Mukashi tenjitennō no ontoki, ryō no on'uma no o ni, ichiya no naka ni nezumi su kui, ko undari keru ni ha, ikoku no kyōzoku hōki shi tari keru to zo, nihongi ni ha mie taru.

[5.3.3] Mata minamotonochūnagonmasayorikyō no moto ni saburai keru aosaburai ga mi tari keru yume mo, osoroshikari keri. Tatoheba ōuchi no jingikan to oboshiki tokoro ni, sokutai tadashiki jōrōtachi amata ohashite, gijō no yōnaru koto no arishi ni, matsuza naru hito no heike no kataudo suru to oboshiki o, sononaka yori oitateraruru Kano aozamurai yume no kokoro ni" are ha ikanaru jōrō nite mashimasu yaran. " to aru rōō ni toi tatematsure ba" itsukushima no daimyōjin to kotae tamau. Sononochi zajō ni kedakagenaru shukurō no mashimashi keru ga," konohi ki heike no azukari taru settō o ba ima ha izunokuni no runin, yoritomo ni tamabauzuru nari. " to ōserare kere ba, sono onsoba ni nao shukurō no mashi／＼ keru ga," sononochi ha wagamago ni mo tama sōrae. " to ōseraruru to iu yume o mi te kore o shidaini toi tatematsuru. " settō o yoritomo ni tamau to ōserare tsuru ha, hachimandaibosatsu, sononochi ni ha wagamago ni mo tamabi sōrae to ōserare tsuru ha, kasugadaimyōjin, kō mōsu rōō ha, takeuchi no daimyōjin. " to ōsera ruru to iu yume o mi te, kore o hito ni kataru hodo ni nyūdōshōkoku morekī te, minamotonodaibuhōgansuesada o motte masayorikyō no moto he," yumemi no aozamurai isogi kore he tamabe. " to notamai yara re tari kere ba, ka yumemi taru aozamurai, yagate chikudenshi tengeri. Masayorikyō, isogi nyūdōshōkoku no moto ni yukimuka te," mattaku saru koto sōrawa zu. " to chinjimōsarekereba, sononochi sata mo nakarikeri. Sore ni fushiginarishi koto ni ha kiyomorikō imada akinokami tarishi toki shinpai no tsuide ni reimu o kōbute itsukushima no daimyōjin yori utsutsuni tamawaretarishi shirogane no hirumakishitaru konaginata tsune no makura o hanatazu, tateraretarishi ga aruyo niwakani usenikeru koso fushiginare. Heike higoro ha chōka no mikatame nite tenka o shugo se shika domo ima ha chokumei ni somuke ba settō o mo meshikaesa ruru ni ya kokorobosō zo kikoe shi. Naka ni mo kōya ni mashi keru saishōnyūdōnariyori kayō no kotodomo o tsutaekiki te" suwa heike no yo ha yōyō sue ni nari nuru ha itsukushimadaimyōjin no heike no kataudo shi tamai keru to iu ha sono iware ari. Tadashi sore ha sagararyūō no daisan no himemiya nareba megami to koso uketamaware. Hachimandaibosatsu no settō o yoritomo ni tamau to ōse rare keru ha kotowari nari. Kasugadaimyōjin no sononochi ha wagason ni mo tamabi sōrae to ōserare keru koso kokoroe ne. Sore mo heike horobi, genji no yo tsuki nan nochi, taishokukan no onsue, shippeike no kindachi no, tenka no shōgun ni naritamai beki ka. " nado zo notamaikeru. Mata aru sō no orifushi kitari keru ga mōshikeru ha" sore shinmei ha wakōsuijaku no hōben kuku ni mashimase ba, arutoki ha zokutai to mo genji, arutoki ha megami to mo nari tamau. Makotoni itsukushima no daimyōjin ha megami to ha mōshi nagara, sanmyōrokutsū no reishin nite mashimase ba zokutai ni genji tamawa n mo katakaru beki ni ara zu. " to zo mōshikeru. Ukiyo o itoi makotonomichi ni irinureba, hitoeni gose bodai no hoka no yonoitonami arumajiki koto naredomo, zensei o kikite ha kanji, urei o kikite ha nageku, kore mina ningen no narai nari.

[5.4.1] Dō kugatsu futsuka, sagaminokuni no jūnin, ōbasaburōkagechika, fukuhara e hayauma o motte mōshikeru wa" inuru hachigatsu jūshichinichi, izunokuni no runin, sakinōhyōenosuke yoritomo, shūto hōjōshirōtokimasa o tsukawashite, izu no mokudai, izuminohangankanetaka o, yamaki no yakata nite yōchi ni uchisōrōnu. Sononochi doi, tsuchiya, okazaki o hajimetoshite sanbyakuyoki, ishibashiyama ni tatekomorite sōrōtokoro ni, kagechika, mikata ni kokorozashi o zonzuru monodomo issen'yoki o insotsushite, oshiyosesemesōrōhodo ni, hyōenosuke shichihachiki ni uchinare, ōwarawa ni tatakainate, doi no sugiyama e nigekomorisōrōnu. Sononochi hatakeyama gohyakuyoki de, mikata o tsukamatsuru. Miuraōsukeyoshiaki ga kodomo, sanbyakuyoki de genjigata o shite, yuikotsubo no ura de tatakau ni, hatakeyamagun ni makete, musashinokuni he hikishirizoku. Sononochi hatakeyama ga ichizoku, kawagoe, inage, oyamada, edo, kasai sōjite sonohoka shichitō no tsuwamonodomo, sanzen'yoki o aigushite, miurakinugasa no shiro ni oshiyosete semetatakau. Ōsukeyoshiaki utare sō nu. Kodomo ha mina kurihama no ura yori fune ni nori, awa, kazusa he watari sō nu. " to koso mōshi tare.

[5.4.2] Heike no hitobito, miyakōtsuri mo haya kyōzame nu. Wakaki kugyō tenjōbito ha" ā toku, koto no shuttai yo kashi, utte ni mukawa u. " nado ī zo hakanaki. Hatakeyama shōji shigeyoshi, oyamada bettō arishige, utsunomiya saemon tomotsuna, ōban'yaku nite, orifushi zaikyō shi tari keri. Hatakeyama mōshikeru ha" higagoto nite zo sōran. Oya u natte sōnare ba, hōjō ha shiri sōwa zu. Jiyo no tomogara ha, yomo chōteki ga kataudo o ba tsukamatsurisōwa ji. Ima kikoshimenaosanzuru mono o. " to mōshikere ba," jitsuni mo" to iuhito mo ari," iya／＼ tadaima tenka no daiji ni oyobi nanzu. " to sasayaku mono mo ōkari keri. Nyūdōshōkoku ikarare keru sama nanamenara zu. " yoritomo o ba sudeni shizai ni okonawaru bekari shi o, ko ikedono no shihini nageki notamahi shi ahida, ruzai ni yurume tari. Saruni sono on wasurete, tauke ni mukate yumi o hiku ni koso an nare. Shinmei sanpō mo, ikadeka yurusase tamafu beki. Tadaima ten no seme kōmura nzuru yoritomo nari. " to zo notamaikeru.

[5.5.1] Sore wagachō ni chōteki no hajime o tazunureba nihon'iwarehikonomikoto no gyō yonen, kishū nagusagun, takaomura ni hitotsu no kumo ari, mi mijikaku ashite nagakute, chikara hito ni suguretari. Jinmin ōku songai se shika ba, kangun hakkō shi te, senji o yomi kake, kuzu no ami o musubi de, tsuini ni kore o ōi i korosu. Sore yori ikō yashin o sebande, chōi o horobon to suru tomogara, ōishi no yamamaru, ōyama ōji, moriya no ōomi, yamada no ishikawa, soga no iruka, ōtomo no matori, fun'ya no miyata, tachibana no hayanari, hikami no kawatsugu, iyo no shinnō, dazainoshōni fujiwara no hirotsugu, emi no oshikatsu, sawara no taishi, inōe no kōgō, fujiwaranonakanari, tairanomasakado, fujiwaranosumitomo, abenosadatō, tsushimanokami minamotonoyoshichika, akusafu, akuemonnokami ni itaru made, subete nijūyonin. Saredomo hitori toshite, sokai o toguru mono nashi. Shikabane o san'ya ni sarashi, kaube o gokumon ni kakararu.

[5.5.2] Konoyo ni koso ōi mo mugeni karokere. Mukashi ha senji o mukate yomikere ba, karetaru kusaki mo hana saki mi nari, hichō mo shitagahi keri. Nakagoro no koto zo kashi, engimikado shinsen'en ni gyōkō arite, ike no migiwa ni sagi no itarikeru o, rokui o meshite," ano sagi totte mairaseyo. " to ōsekere ba ikadeka tora n to omoikere domo ringen nare ba ayumi mukō. Sagi mo hane tsukuroi shite tatan to su. " senji zo. " to ōsesure ba hirande tobisara zu. Kore o totte mairi tari. Nanji ga senji ni shitagaite, mairi taru koso shinmyō nare. Yagate goi ni nase. " tote, sagi o goi ni zo nasa re keru. " kyō yori nochi ha sagi no naka no ō taru beshi. " to iu fuda o asobashi, kubi ni kake te hanata se tamau. Mattaku sagi no goryō ni ha arazu, tada ōi no hodo o shiroshimesan ga tame nari.

[5.6.1] Mata senshō o ikoku ni tazunuru ni, en no taishitan to iu mono, shin no shikōtei ni toraware te, kai o kōmuru koto jūninen, taishitan namida o nagaite mōshikeru ha" wa hongoku ni rōbo ari, itoma o tamahate kare o min." " to mōse ba shikōtei azawarate," nanji ni itoma o tamawan koto ha uma ni tsuno oi, karasu no atama no shiroku naran o matsu beshi. " entan ten ni aogi chi ni fushite," negawakuha uma ni tsuno oi, karasu no atama shiroku naranu o matsu beshi. " entan ten ni aogi chi ni fushite," negawakuha uma ni tsuno oi, karasu no atama shiroku nashitabe. Kokyō ni kaeri te ima ichido haha o mi n. " to zo inori ke ru. Kano myōonbosatsu wa, ryōzenjōdo ni mōshite, fukō no tomogara o imashime, kōshi, gankai wa, shinashitan ni dete, chūkō no michi o hajime tamau. Myōken no sanbō, kōkō no kokorozashi o awaremi tamau koto nareba, uma ni tsuno haete kyūchū ni kitari, karasu no atama shiroku natte teizen no ki ni sumi keri. Shikōtei, utōbakaku no hen ni odoroki, ringen kaera zaru koto o shinjite, taishitan o yurushitsutsu, hongoku ni koso kaesare kere. Shikō nao kuyami te, shin no kuni to en no kuni no sakai ni, sokoku to iu kuni ari. Ōnaru kawanagare tari. Kano kawa ni wataseru hashi oba sokoku no hashi to ieri. Shikō kangun tsukawashite, entan ga watara n toki, kachū no hashi o fuma ba ochiru yō ni shitatame te, entan o watarase keru ni, nanika ha ochīra zaru beki. Kachū e ochīrinu. Saredomo chitomo mizu ni mo obore zu, heichi o yukugotokushite, mukō no kishi he tsuki ni keri. Ko ha ikani to omoi te, ushiro o kaerimikere ba, kamedomo ga ikura to iu kazu mo shira zu, mizu no ue ni ukareki te, kō o narabete zo arukase tari keru. Kore mo kōkō no kokorozashi o myōken awaremitamau ni yotte nari.

[5.6.2] Taishitan urami o fukunde, mata shikōtei ni shitagawazu. Shikō kangun o tsukawashite, entan o utantoshitamau ni, entan osoreononoki, keika to iu tsuwamono o kataraute, daijin ni nasu. Keika mata denkō sensei to iu tsuwamono o katarau. Kano sensei mōshikeru ha" kimi ha kono mi ga wakō sakari nashi koto o shiroshimesarete tanomōraruru ka. Kirin ha senri o tobedomo, oinureba doba ni mo otoreri. Ima ha ikanimo kanai sōmaji. Tsuwamono o koso katarōte maise me. " tote kaera n to suru tokoro ni, keika," konokoto anakashiko, hito ni hirōsu na. " to iu. Sensei mōshikeru ha," hito ni utagaware nuru ni sugotaru haji koso nakere. Konokoto morunuru mono nara ba, ware utagaware nanzu. " tote, monzen naru sumomo no ki ni kubi o tsukiate, uchikudaite zo shini keru. Mata han'oki to iu tsuwamono ari. Kore ha shinkoku no mono nari. Shikō no tame ni, chichi hakushuku kyōdai o metsusa re te, en no kuni ni nigekomore ri. Shinkō shikai ni senji o kudai te," han'oki ga kaube ha nete mairase tara n mono ni ha gohyakukin no kogane o atahe n. " to hirōse raru. Keika kore o kiki, han'oki ga moto ni yuite," ware kiku. Nanji ga kaube o gohyakkin no kane ni hōze raru. Nanji ga kubi ware ni kase, totte shikōtei ni tatematsura n. Yorokonde eiran o herare n toki, tsurugi o nuki mune o sasan ni yasukari nan. " to ī kere ba, han'oki tobiagari, ōiki tsuite mōshikeru ha" wa oya hakushuku kyōdai o shikō no tame ni messa re te, yachū kore o omō ni, kotsuzui ni tōtte shinobi gatashi. Genimo shikōtei o messu beku ba, kubi o atahe n koto, jinkai yori mo nao yasushi. " tote, tezukara kubi o kitte zo shini keru.

[5.6.3] Mata shinbuyō to iu tsuwamono ari. Kore mo shin no kuni no mono nari. Jūsan no toshi kataki o utte, en no kuni ni nigekomore ri. Narabinaki tsuwamono nari. Kare ga ikatte mukō toki ha, dainōtoko mo zetsunyūsu. Mata ende mukō toki ha, midorigo mo dakare keri. Kore o shinnomiyako no annaisha ni kataraute gushite yuku hodo ni, aru katayama no hotori ni shukushitarikeru yo, sonohotorichikaki sato ni kangen o suru o kīte, chōshi o motte hoinokoto o uranau ni, katakinokata ha mizu nari, wagakata ha hi nari. Saruhodoni ten mo akenu. Hakkō hi tsuranuite tōrazu. " warera ga hoi togen koto, arigatashi. " to zo mōshikeru.

[5.6.4] Sarinagara kaeru beki nimo ara ne ba, shikō no miyako kan'yōkyū ni itari nu. En no sashizu narabini han'oki ga kubi motte mairi taru yoshi o sōshi kere ba, shinka o motte uketora n to shi tamau. " mattaku hito shite ha mairase ji, jikini nobomatsura n. " to sōsuru aida," saraba. " tote, sechie no gi o totonoete, tsubame no tsukai o mesare keri. Kan'yōkyū ha, miyako no meguri ichimanhassensanbyakuhachijūri ni tsumore ri. Dairi o ba chi yori sanri takaku kizukiagete, sono ue ni tata ri. Chōshōden furōmon ari, kogane o motte hi o tsukuri, shirogane o motte tsuki o tsukure ri. Shinju no suna, ruri no suna, kogane no suna o shikimite ri. Shihō ni ha takasa shijūjō no tetsu no tsuiji o kizuki, tono no ue ni mo onajiku tetsu no ami o zo hari tari keru. Kore ha meido no tsukai o ireji to nari. Aki ha tanomo no kari, haru ha koshiji he kaeru ni mo, hikō jizai no sawari are ba, tsuiji ni ha ganmon to nazuke te, tetsu no mon o hiraki te zo tōshi keru. Sonōchi ni mo abōden tote, shikō no tsune ha gyōkō natte, seidō okonawase tamau den ari. Takasa ha sanjūrokujō, tōzai he kuchō, nanboku he gochō, ōyuka no shita ha, gojō no hatahoko o tatetaru ga, nao oyobanu hodo nari. Kami wa ruri no kawara o motte fuki, shimo wa kingin nite migaki keri. Keika wa en no sashizu o mochi, shinbuyō wa han'oki ga kubi o mote, tama no kizahashi o noboriagaru. Amarini dairi no obitadashī o mite, shinbuyō wanawanato furui kere ba, shinka ayashimite" buyō muhon no kokoro ari. Keinin o ba kimi no soba ni oka zu, kunshi ha keinin ni chikazuka zu, keinin ni chikazuku ha sunawachi shi o karonzuru michi nari. " to ie ri, keika tachikaeri te" buyō mattaku muhon no kokoro nashi. Tada inaka no iyashiki ni nomi narai te, kōkyo ni nare zaru yue ni, kokoro meiwaku su. " to mōshikere ba, shinka mina mazu shizumari nu. Yotte ō ni chikazuki tatematsuru. En no sashizu narabini han'oki ga kubi kenzan ni iru tokoro ni sashizu no iretaru hitsu no soko ni kōri no yōnaru tsurugi no miekere ba shikōtei kore o mite yagate nigen to shi tamau. Keika ō no onsode o muzuto hikaete, tsurugi o mune ni sashiatari. Ima ha kō to zo mietarikeru. Sūman no hei teijō ni sode o tsuranu to iedomo sukuwan to suru ni chikara nashi. Tada kimi gyakushin ni okasare tamawan koto o nomi kanashimi airi. Shikō no tamawaku," ware ni zanji no itoma o e sase yo. Chin ga saiai no kisaki no koto no ne o imaichido kika n. " to notamae ba, keika shibaraku ha okashi tatematsura zu. Shikō ha sanzennin no kisaki o mo tamae ri. Sononaka ni kayōfujin tote, suguretaru koto no jōzu owase ri. Oyoso kono nochi no koto no ne o kīte ha, takeki bushi no ikareru mo yawagi, hichō mo ochi, kusaki mo nabiku hodo nari. Iwan'ya ima o kagiri no eibun ni sonaen to, nakinaki hikitamai ken, sa koso ha omoshirokari keme. Keika mo kōbe o tare, mimi o sobadatete bōshin no omoi mo okotarini keri. Sono toki kisaki hajimete sarani ikkyoku o sōsu. " shichiseki no byōbu ha takaku tomo, toba ba nadoka koezara n." Ichijō no rakoku ha tsuyoku tomo, hika ba nadoka ha taezara n. " to zo hiki給u. Keika ha kore o kikishirazu, shikō ha kikishirite, onsode o hikikiri, shichishaku no byōbu o tobikoete, dō no hashira no kage ni nigekakure sase tamai nu. Keika ikarite, ken o nagekake tatematsuru. Orifushi gozen ni ban no ishi no sōrōkeru ga, kusuri no fukuro o keika ga ken ni nageawase tari. Ken'yaku no fukuro o kakerare nagara, kuchi rokushaku no dō no hashira o, nakabamade koso kiri tari kere. Keika mata ken o mota ne ba tsuzuite mo tōzu. Ō tachikaerite, waga ken o meshiyosete, keika o yatsuzaki ni koso shi tamai kere. Shinbuyō mo utare ni keri. Kangun o tsukawashite entan o horobosa ru. Sōten yurushi tamawa ne ba, hakkō hi o tsuranuite tōra zu, shinnoshikō ha nogarete, entan tsuini useni ki. Sareba ima no yoritomo mo sakoso ha ara n zurame to, shikitai suru hitobito mo ari keru tokaya.

[5.7.1] Somosomo kano yoritomo to mōsu ha, saru heiji gannen jūnigatsu, chichi samanokami yoshitomo ga muhon ni yotte, toshi jūyonsai to mōshi eiryaku gannen sangatsu hatsuka, izunokuni hirugashima he nagasarete, nijūyonen no shunjū o okurimukau Nenrai mo araba koso arikeme, kotoshi ikanaru kokoro nite muhon oba okosare keru zo to iu ni, takao no mongaku shōnin no mōsusume rare tari keru to kaya Kano mongaku to mōsu ha, moto ha watanabe no endō sakonnoshōgen moritō ga ko, endōnomusha moritō tote, jōsaimon'in no shū nari Jūku no toshi dōshin hosshi shukke shite, shugyō ni iden to shi keru ga" shugyō to iu ha ikahodo no daiji yaran, tameite min. " tote, rokugatsu no hi no kusa mo yurugazu hikari taru ni, katayama no yabu no naka ni haīri, aonoke ni fushi, abu zo, ka zo, hachi ari nado iu dokumushi domo ga mi ni hishito toritsuite sashikui nado shi kere domo, chitomo mi o ugokasa zu, nanuka made ha okiagara zu. Yōka to iu ni okiagatte," shugyō to iu ha, korehodo no daiji ka. " to hito ni toe ba," sonohodo nara n ni ha, ikade ka inochi mo iki beki. " to iu ma," sateha anpei gozannare. " tote, yagate shugyō ni zo ide ni keru.

[5.7.2] Kumano he mairi, nachi komose n to shi keru ga, gyō no kokoromi ni, kikoyuru taki ni shibaraku utare te mi n tote, takimoto he zo mairi keru. Koro wa jūnigatsu tōkāmari no koto nareba, yuki furitsumori, tsuraraite, tani no ogawa mo oto mo sezu, mine no arashi fukikōri, taki no shiraito taruhi to nari, mina shirotae ni oshinabete, yomo no kozue mo miewakazu. Saruni mongaku takitsubo ni shitahitari, kubigiwa hitashite, jiku no ju o mitekeru ga, nisannichi koso arikere, shigonichi ni mo narikereba, tahezushite mongaku ukiagari ni keri. Sūsenjō minagiriotsuru taki nareba, najikaha tamaru beki. Satōtosarete, katana no ha no gotokuni, sashimo kibishiki iwakado no nakao, ukanu shizunu, gorokuchō koso nagaretare. Tokini utsukushigenaru dōji hitori kite, monjō ga sayūnote o totte hikiage tamau. Hito kidoku no omoi o nashi, hi o yaki aburi nado shikereba, jōgō naranu inochi deha ari, hodonaku iki ide nikeri. Monjō sukoshi hitogokochi idekite, ōnomanako o mīkarashi" ware kono taki ni sanshichinichi utarete, jiku no sanrakusha o mitau to omō taigan ari. Kyō ha wazukani itsuka ninaru. Nanuka dani mo sugi zaru ni, nanimono ga koko he ha tote ki taru zo. " to i kere ba, miru hito mi no ke yodate mono iha zu. Mata takitsubo ni kaeri tate utare keri.

[5.7.3] Daininichi to i ni, hachinin no dōji ki te, hikiage n to shi tamae domo, sanzan ni tsumamiai u te agara zu. Daisannichi to i ni, bungaku tsui ni ha kanakunari ni keri. Takitsubo o kegasa ji to ya, wage yū taru tendō futari, taki no ue yori kudari, mongaku ga chōjō yori teashi no tsume saki shuri ni itaru made, yoni atatakani kanbashiki onte o motte, nadeoroshi tamau to oboe kere ba yume no kokochi shite iki idenu" somosomo ikanaru hito nite mashimase ba, kō ha awaremi tamau ran. " to toi tatematsuru. " ware ha kore daishōfudōmyōō no otsukai ni, kongara, seitaka to iu nidōji nari. Gakumon mujō no gan o hasshite yūmō no gyō o kuwadatsu, itte chikaraoawasu beshi to, myōō no choku ni yotte, kitareru nari. " to kotae tamau. Mongaku koe o ikarakashite," sate myōō ha izuku ni mashimasu zo. " tosotsuten ni. " to kotaete, kumoi haruka ni nobori tamai nu. Tanagokoro o awasete kore o haishi tatematsuru. " sareba, wa gyō o ba, daishōfudōmyōō made mo shiroshimeshitaru ni koso. " to tanomoshū oboete, nao takitsubo ni kaeritate utare keri. Makotoni medetaki zuisō domo arekere ba, fukikuru kaze mo mi ni irazu, ochikuru mizu mo yu no gotoshi. Kakute sanshichinichi no taigan tsuini toge ni kere ba, nachi ni sennichi komori, ōmine sando, katsuragi nido, kōya, kokawa, kinpusen, hakusan, tateyama, fuji no take, izu, hakone, shinano no togakushi, dewa no haguro, sōjite nihonkoku nokoru tokoro naku yukimegurite, sasuga nao furusato ya koishikari ken, miyako he kaerinoboritari kere ba, oyoso tobutori mo inoriotosu hodo no, yaiba no genja to zo kikoe shi.

[5.8.1] Nochi ni ha, takao to iu yama no oku ni, okonai sumashite zo itari keru. Kano takao ni jingoji to iu yamadera ari. Mukashi shōtokutennō no ontoki, wakenokiyomaro ga tate tari shi garan nari. Hisashiku shūzō nakari shika ba, haru ha kasumi ni tachikomerare, aki ha kiri ni majiri, tobira ha kaze ni taorete, ochiba no shita ni kuchi, iraka ha uro ni okasarete, butsudan sarani arawa nari. Jūji no sō mo nakere ba mareni sashīremono tote ha, tsukihi no hikari bakari nari. Bungaku kore o ikanimoshite, shūzō se n to iu taigan o okoshi, kanjinchō o sasagete, jippō danna o susume ariki keru hodoni, arutoki in no gosho hōjūjidono he zo mairi tari keru. Gohōga aru beki yoshi sōmon shi kere domo, gyoyū no orifushi de, kikoshimeshi mo ire rare zu. Mongaku wa tenshō futeki daīchi no arahijiri nari. Gozen no hone, naishō o ba shira zu, tada mōshīre nu zo to kokoroe te, zehinaku otsubo no uchi e yaburīri, daionjō o age te mōshi keru wa" daijidaihi no kimi nite owashimasu, nadoka kikoshimeshīre zaru beki." " tote, kanjinchō o hikihiroge, takarakani koso yomitari kere. Shami mongaku kyōhaku su.Kotoniha kisen dōzoku no josei o kōmurite, takaosan no reichi ni ichīn o konryūshi, nise anraku no dairi o gongyōsen to kō kanjin no jō sore mottereba, shinnyo kōdai nari.Shōbutsu no kemyō o tatsu to ie domo, hosshō zui mō no kumo atsuku ōite, jūnīnnen no mine ni narabīshi yori ikō, honnu shinren no tsuki no hikari yūni shite, imada santokushiman no taikyo ni araware zu.Kanashīkana.Butsunichi hayaku bosshite, shōjiruten no chimata meimeitari.Tada shiki ni fukeri sake ni fukeru.Tare ka kyōzō chōen no mei o shase n.Itazurani hito o soshiri hō o soshiru.Ani enragokusotsu no seme o manukare n ya.Kokoni bungaku tamatama zokujin o uchiharaite, hōe o kazari to ie domo, akugyō nao kokoro ni takumashikushite, nichiya ni tsukuri, zenmyō mata mimi ni sakate, chōbo ni sutaru.Ita kana.Saido sanzu no kakyō ni kaerite, nagaku shishō no kurin ni megura n koto o.Kono yue ni muni no kenshō senmanjiku, jikujiku ni busshu no in o akasu, zuien shisei no hō, ichi toshite bodai no higan ni itara zu to iu koto nashi.Yue ni bungaku mujō no kanmon ni namida o otoshi, jōge no shinzoku o susume te, jōbon rendai ni ho o hakobi, tōmyōkakuō no reijō o taten to nari.Somosomo takao ha yama uzutakaku shite, jubusen no kozue o arawashi, tani shizukani shite, shōzandō no koke o shikeri.Gansen musende nuno o hiki, reien sakende eda ni asobu.Hitozato tōu shite gōjin nashi, shiseki yoshishite shinjin nomi ari.Chikei sugure tari, mottomo butten o agamu beshi.Hōga sukoshiki nari, dare ka josei se zara n.Kaze ni kiku, shusha shi buttō kudoku tachimachini butchin o kanzu.Iwan'ya isshi hansen no hōzai ni oite oya.Negawakuha konryū jōju shite kinketsu hōreki gogan enman, naishi tohi enkin rinmin shinso, gyōshun mui no ka o utai, chin'yō saikai no emi o hiraka n.Kotoni ha mata shōryō yūgi sengo daishō, sumiyakani ichibutsu shinmon no dai ni itari, kanarazu sanjin bantoku no tsuki o moteasoba n.Yotte kanjin shugyō no omomuki, kedashi motte kakunogotoshi.
[5.8.2] Jishō sannen sangatsu hi bungaku
[5.8.3] To koso yomiage tare.

[5.9.1] Orifushi gozen ni ha, daijōdaijin myōon'in, biwa kakinarashi rōei medetō se sase tama. Azechidainagonsukekatakyō hyōshi totte fūzoku, saibara utaware keri. Umanokamitokitada, shīnojijūmorisada, wagon kakinarashi, imayō toridorini utai, tamanosudare, nishikinotobari no naka sazamekiai, makotoni omoshirokarikere ba, hōō mo tsukeuta se sase owashimasu. Soreni bungaku ga daionjō dekite, chōshi mo chigai, hyōshi mo mina midareni keri. " nanimono zo. So kubi tsuke. " to ōsekudasaruru hodo koso ari kere. Hayari no wakamonodomo, ware mo ware mo to susumekeru naka ni, sukeyukihōgan to iu mono, hashirīde te," nanijō koto mōsu zo. Makarīde yo. " to iekere ba," takao no jingoji ni shō issho yorare zara n hodo ha mattaku bungaku izu maji. " tote ugoka zu. Yotte so kubi o tsukō to shikereba, kanjinchō o torinaoshi, sukeyukihōgan ga eboshi o, hatato utte uchiotoshi, kobushi o nigitte, sha mune o tsuite, aomukeni tsukidōsu. Sukeyukihōgan ha, motodori hanatte, omeometo ōyuka no ue he nigeagaru. Sononochi mongakunofutokoro yori uma no o de tsukamaki taru katana no kōri no sama naru o nukīde te yorikitaru n mono o tsukō to koso machikake tare. Hidari no te ni ha kanjinchō, migi no te ni ha katana o nuki te hashiri mawaru ma, omoimōke nu niwakagoto de ha ari, sayū no te ni katana o mochi taru sama ni zo mie tari keru. Kugyō tenjōbito mo, kowa ikani／＼ to sawage kere ba, gyoyū mo haya are ni keri. Inchū no sōdō nanamenara zu. Shinanonokuni no jūnin, andōmushauemune, sonokoro tōshoku no mushadokoro de arike ru ga," nanigoto zo. " tote, tachi o nuite hashirīde tari. Bungaku yorokonde kakaru tokoro o, kitte ha warukari nan to ya omoi ken, tachi no mine o torinaoshi, bungaku ga katana mota ru hiji o shitatakani utsu. Utare te chito uzumu tokoro ni tachi o sutete" etariyaō. " to, kumidarikeru Kumimarenagara bungōandōmusha ga migi no hiji o tsuku Tsukarenagara shimetarikeri Tagaini otoranu tairiki narikereba, ueni nari shitani nari, korobiau tokoroni, kashikogaoni, ueshitayotte, bungō ga ugoku tokoro no jō o gaushitekeri Saredomo, kore o kototomosezu, iyoiyo akkōhōgensu Mongai e hikīdei te, chō no shimobe ni tabu. I te hiharu. Hihara re te tachi nagara, gosho no kata o niramae, daionjō o age te," hōga o koso shi tamawa zara me. Korehodo bungaku ni tsurai me o mise tamai tsure ba, omoishirase mōsa nzuru mono o. Sangai wa mina kataku nari. Ōkyū to iu tomo sono nan o nogaru bekara zu. Jūzen no teī ni hokotau tomo yomi no tabi ni ide nan nochi ha gozumezu no seme oba manukare tamawa ji mono o. " to, odoriagari odoriagari zo mōshikeru. Kono hōshi kikkai nari tote yagate gokujō se rare tari. Sukeyuki hōgan ha eboshi uchiotosa re te hajigamashisa ni shibaraku ha shusshi mo se zu. Andōmusha wa, bungakugumi daru kanshō ni, ichirō o hezu shite, umanojō ni zo nasare keru. Saruhodoni sonokoro bifukumon'in kakure sase tamai te, taisha ari shika ba, bungaku hodonaku yurusare keri. Shibaraku ha doko ni mo okonau bekari shi ga, sa ha naku shite, mata kanjinchō o sasagete, susume keru ga, saraba tada mo nashishite," aware kono yononaka ha, tadaima midare, kimi mo shin mo mina messhinzuru mono o. " nado, kowaki koto nomi mōshi ariku aida," kono hōshi miyako ni okite ha kanau maji, onru se yo. " tote izunokuni he zo nagasare keru.

[5.9.2] Gensanminyūdō no chakushi, nakatsuna no sonokoro izunokami nite ohashikere ba sonosata toshite, tōkaidō yori fune nite kudasu beshi tote, isenokuni he mote makarikeru ni, hōmen ryōsannin zo tsuke rare taru. Korera ga mōshikeru ha," chō no shimobe no narai, kayō no koto nitsuite koso onozukara no eko mo sōrae." Ikani hijiri no gobō, korehodo no koto ni aite, tōkuni he nagasare tamau ni, chijin ha mochi tamawa nu ka, miyage ryōryō gotoki no mono o mo koi tamae kashi. " to ī kere ba, bungaku ha" sayō no yōji iu beki tokui mo mota zu, higashiyama no hotori ni zo tokui ha aru. Ide saraba fumi o tsukawau. " to ikkere ba, ayashikaru kami o tazunete, esase tari. " kayō no kami de mono kaku yō nashi. " tote, nagekaesu. Saraba tote, atsugami o tazunete esase tari. Bungaku waratte" hōshi ha mono o e kakanu zo, saraba orera kake. " tote shosuru yō," bungaku koso, takao no jingoji zōryū kuyō no kokorozashi ate susume sōtsuru hodoni, kakaru kimi no yo ni shimo aite shogan o koso jōju se zara me. Kingoku se rarete amatsusae izunokuni he ruzai se rare sō. Enro no aida de sō. Miyage ryōryō gotoki no mono mo, taisetsuni sō. Kono tsukai ni tabeshi. " to kake to īkereba, iu mama ni kaite," sate dare dono he to kaki sōrō zo. " kiyomizu no kannonbō he to kake. " kore ha chō no shimobe o azamuku ni koso. " to mōseba" saritoteha mongaku ha kannon o koso fukō tanomōtatematsuritare. Saradeha dare ni ka ha yōji o ba iu beki. " to zo mōshi keru.

[5.9.3] Isenokuni anō no tsu yori fune ni nori te kudari keru ga, tōtōminokuni tenryūnada nite, niwakani ōkaze fuki ōnami tate, sudeni kono fune o uchikutsugaesa n to su. Kako kajitori domo, ikanimoshite, tasukarantoshikeredomo, namikaze iya arakereba, aruiha kannon no myōgō o tonae, aruiha saigo no jūnen ni oyobu. Saredomo, bungaku ha kore o kototomosezu. Takaibiki kaite fushitarikeruga, nantokaomoken, imahakōtōboekerutoki, kawato oki, fune no he ni tate, oku no hō o nirae daionjō o agete" ryūō yāru, ryūō yāru. " to zo wamekitari keru. " ikani korehodo no taigan okoshitaru hijiri ga nottaru fune o ba sugū to ha suru zo. Tadaima ten no seme kōmunzuru ryūjin domo kana. " to zo mōshikeru. Sono yue ni ya namikaze hodonaku shizumarite, izunokuni he tsukini keri. Mongaku kyō o ide keru hi yori kisei suru koto ari. " ware miyako ni kaeri te takao no jingoji zōryū kuyō subeku ba shinu bekara zu. Kono gan munashikaru beku ba michi nite shinu beshi. " tote kyō yori izu he tsukeru made orifushi junpū nakari kere ba urazutai shimazutai shite sanjūichinichi ga aida ha ikkō danjiki nite zo ari keru. Saredomo kiryoku sukoshimo otorohe zu yukiuchi shite i tari keri. Makotoni naobito tomo oboenu kotodomo ōkari keri. Kondōshirōkunitaka to iu mono ni azukerare te, izunokuni nagoya ga oku ni zo sumi keru.

[5.10.1] Saruhodoni hyōenosukedono he tsuneha maite, mukashīma no monogatari domo mōshite nagusamu hodoni, arutoki bungaku mōshi keru ha" heike ni ha komatsunodaijindono koso, kokoro mo gōni saku mo masatte mashimashika. Heike no unmei ga sue ni nari yaran, kyonen hachigatsu kōzerare nu. Imaha genpei no naka ni, wado no hodo shōgun no sō mottaru hito ha nashi. Sōsō muhon okoshite, nihonkoku shitagahe. " hyōenosuke," omoimo yoranu koto notamau hijirigobō kana. Ware ha koikenoamagozen ni kainaki inochi o tasukerare tatematsurite sōrae ba, sono gose o tomurawan tame ni, mainichi ni hokekyō ichibu tendokusuru hoka ha taji nashi. " to koso notamaekere, mongaku kasanete mōshikeru ha" ten no atauru o torazareba, kaette sono toga o uku. Toki itarite okonawazareba, kaette sono wazawai o uke to iu honmon ari. Kayōni mōseba, onhe no kokoro o mintote mōshi nado omoitamai ka Onhe ni kokorozashi no fukai iro o mitamae kashi " tote, futokoro yori shiranuno ni uradaru dokuro o hitotsu torīdasu. Hyōenosukedono," are ha ikani. " to notamaeba," kore koso wadono no chichi, ko samanokamidono no kashira yo. Heiji no nochi, gokusha no mae naru koke no shita ni uzumore te, gose tomurau hito mo nakari shi o, mongaku zonzuru mune arite, gokumori ni koite kono jūyonen kubi ni kake, yamayama teradera ogami mawari, tomurai tatematsure ba, ima ha sadamete ichigō mo tasukari tamai nuran. Sareba, mongaku ha kotōdono no ontame ni mo, hōkō no mono de koso sōrae. " to mōshikere ba, hyōenosukedono, ichijō to ha oboene domo, chichi no kashira to kiku natsukashisa ni, mazu namida o zo nagasa re keru. Sononochi ha uchitokete monogatari shi tamau. " somosomo yoritomo chokkan o yururizu shite ha, ikadeka muhon o ba okosu beki. " to notamae ba" sore yasui koto, yagate nobotte mōshiyuruite tatematsura n. "" samo sōzu, gobō mo chokkan no mi de hito o mōshiyurusa u to notamau, ategaiyō koso, ōini makotoshikara ne. "" wagami no chokkan o yurū to mōsa ba koso higagoto nara me. "" wadono no koto mōsa u ha, nanika kurushikaru beki. Ima no miyako fukuhara no shinto he nobora u ni, mikka ni sugimaji. Inzen ukagawa u ni ichinichi ga tōryū zo ara nzuru. Tsugō nanuka yōka ni sugu bekara zu. " tote tsukidashi nu. Nagoya ni kaette, deshi domo ni ha, izu no oyama ni hito ni shinonde, nanuka sanrō no kokorozashi ari tote de ni keri. Jitsu ni mo mikka to iu ni, fukuhara no shinto he nobori tsutsu sakinōhyōenokami mitsuyoshikyō no moto ni, isasaka en are ba, soko ni okonai te," izunokuni no runin, sakinōhyōenosuke yoritomo koso chokkan o yurusare te, inzen o dani mo tamawa ba, hakkakoku no kenin domo moyōshi atsume te, heike o horoboshi, tenka o shizun to mōshi sōrae. " hyōenokami," isatoyo, wagami mo tōji ha sankan tomoni todomerarete, kokorogurushī orifushi nari. Hōō mo oshikomerarete watase tamaeba, ikaga aranzuran. Sarinagara ukagaute koso mime. " tote, konoyoshi hisokani sōserarekereba, hōō yagate inzen o koso kudasarekere. Hijiri kore o kubi ni kake, mata mikka to iu ni izunokuni he kudaritsuku. Hyōenosuke" aware, kono hijiri no gobō ha namajīni yoshinaki koto mōshīdeshite yoritomo mata ikanaru ukime ni ka awanzuran. " to, omowajikotonau anjitsuzukete mashikeru tokoro ni yōka to iu umanokoku bakari ni kudaritsuite" suwa inzen yo. " tote tatematsuru. Hyōenosuke inzen to kiku katajikenasa ni temizūgai o shi atarashiki eboshi jōe kite inzen o sando haishite hirakarekeri. Shikirinotoshi yori ikō heishi ōka o betsujoshi seidō ni habakarukoto nashi.Buppō o hametsu shite chōi o horobosan tosu.Sore wagachō ha shinkoku nari, sōbyō ainarande shintoku ishin nari.Yueni chōtei kaiki no nochi, sūsen'yosai no aida, teiyū o katamuke, kokka o ayabumen to suru mono, mina motte haiboku se zu to iu koto nashi.Shikaraba sunawachi, katsuha shintō no myōjo ni makase, katsuha chokusen no shishu o mamotte, hayaku heishi no ichirui o chūshite, chōka no onteki o shirizokeyo.Fudai kyūsen no heiryaku o tsugi, ruiso hōkō no chūkin o nukinde, mi o tate ie o okosu beshi, tehereba, inzen konogotoshi.Yotte shittatsu gotoku kudan.
[5.10.2] Jishō yonen shichigatsu jūyokka saki uhyōenokami mitsuyoshi tatematsuru
[5.10.3] Tsutsushinde tatematsuru saki uhyōenosuke dono
[5.10.4] To zo kaka re taru. Kono inzen o ba, nishiki no fukuro ni ire te, ishibashiyama no kassen no toki mo, hyōenosuke dono kubi ni kake rare tari keru to ka ya.

[5.11.1] Saru hodo ni, fukuhara ni ha sei no tsuku nu saki ni, isogi utte kudasubeshi to kugyō sengi ari te, taishōgun ni ha komatsunogonnosukeshōshōkoremori, fukushōgun ni ha satsumanokamitadanori, tsugō sono sei sanman'yoki, kugatsu jūhachinichi ni shinto tate, jūkunichi ni ha kyūto ni tsuki, yagate hatsuka tōgoku he koso uttate kere Taishōgun gonnosukeshōshōkoremori ha, shōnen nijūsan, yōgi taihai e ni kaku tomo fude mo oyobu katashi. Jūdai no yoroi karakawa to iu kise osa o ba, karabitsu ni irete kakase raru. Dōchū ni ha, akaji no nishiki no hitatare ni, moegītōdoshi no yoroi kite, rensen'ashige naru uma ni, kinpukurin no kura okite nori tamae ri. Fukushōgun satsumanokami tadanori ha, konji no nishiki no hitatare ni, kuroitōdoshi no yoroi kite, kuroki uma no futō takumashini ikakeji no kura okite nori tamae ri. Bān gaikō kyūsen tachi katana ni itaru made, hikarikagayaku hodo ni idetatere tari shika ba, medetakari shi kenbutsu nari. Satsumanokami tadanori ha, nenrai aru miyabara no nyōbō no moto he kayoware keru ga, arutoki zatari keru ni, sono nyōbō no moto he, yangotonaki nyōbō marōdo ni kite, hisashiu monogatari shi tamau. Sayo mo harukani fukeyuku madeni marōdo kaeri tamawa zu. Tadanori nokibani shibashi yasurai te ōgio araku tsukawasare kere ba miyaharano nyōbō," nomoseni sudaku mushino ne yo. " to yūni yasashiku kuchizusami tamae ba satsumanokami yagate tsukai yamete kaera re keri. Sononochi mata mashimashitari keru ni, miyabara no nyōbō" satemo hitohi, nanitote ōgi oba tsukaiyamini shi zo ya. " to tohare kere ba," isa, kashigamashi nado kikoe sōshika ba, satekoso tsukaiyami sōshika. " to zo notamai keru. Kanonyōbō no moto yori tadanori no moto he, kosode hitoe tsukawasu tote, senri no nagori no kanashisa ni, isshu no uta o zo okurare keru.

lg.l: 東路の草葉をわけん袖よりも、たゝぬ袂の露ぞこぼるゝ。

div.p: [5.11.2] Satsumanokami henji niha

lg.l: 別路を何かなげかんこえて行く、關もむかしの跡とおもへば。

div.p: [5.11.3] Seki mo mukashi no ato to yomeru koto ha, tairanoshōgunsadamori, masakado tsuitō no tame ni, tōgoku he gekō se shi koto o, omohīdete yomitari keru ni ya, mottomosugurete zo kikoe shi.

[5.11.4] Mukashi ha chōteki o tairageni gaido he mukafu shōgun ha, mazu sandai shite settō o tamaharu. Shingi nanden ni shutsugyo shite, konoe kaika ni jin o hiki, naiben geben no kugyō sanretsu shite, chūgi no sechie o okonawa ru. Daishōgun fukushōgun onōno reigi o tadakō shite, kore o tamawa ru. Jōhei tengyō no shōseki mo, toshihisakō natte nazorae katashi tote, kondo ha sanukinokami masamori ga, sakinotsushimanokami minamotonoyoshichika tsuitō no tame ni, izumonokuni he gekō se shi rei tote, suzu bakari tamaite, kawa no fukuro ni irete, zōshiki ga kubi ni kakesasete zo kudara re keru. Inishie chōteki o messan tote, miyako o izuru shōgun ha, mittsu no zonchi ari. Settō o tamawaru hi ie o wasure, ie o izuru tote saishi o wasure, senjō ni shite teki ni tatakau toki mi o wasuru. Sareba ima no heishi no daishōgun koremori tadanori mo, sadamete kayō no koto o ba zonchi se rare tari ken. Awarenari shi koto domo nari.

[5.11.5] Dō nijūichinichi shin'in mata akinokuni itsukushima he gokō naru. Saru sangatsu ni mo gokō ari ki. Sono yue ni ya, naka ichiryōgetsu yo mo medetaku osamarite, tami no wazurai mo nakari shi ga, takakuranomiya no gomuhon ni yorite, mata tenka midarete, sejō mo shizukanara zu. Kore ni yorite, katsu ha tenka seihitsu no tame, katsu ha seidai fuyo no gokinen no tame to zo kikoe shi. Kondo ha fukuhara yori no gokō nare ba, tosō no wazurai mo nakari keri. Te kara onozukara goganmon o asobaite, seisho o ba sesshōdono se sase ohashimasu. Kedashi kiku, hosshō kumo shizukanari.Jūshijūgo no tsuki takaku hare, gonge chi fukaku ichīn'ichiyō no kaze katawara aogu.Sore itsukushima no yashiro ha shōmyō amaneku kikoyuru ba, kōgen musō no migiri nari.Yōrei no shadan o meguru, yori daiji no takaku sobadatsu o arawashi, kyokai no shiu ni oyobu, sora ni guzei no jinkōnaru koto o arawasu.Sore mottereba sho yōmai no mi o motte katajikenaku kōō no kurai o fumu.Ima ken'yū o reikyō no mure ni moteasonde kanpō o shazan no kyo ni tanoshimu.Saruni hisokani isshin no seisei o nukinde kotō no yūshi ni mōde, zuiri no moto ni meion o aogi, konnen o korashite ase o nagashi, hōgū no uchi ni reitaku o tare.Sono tsuge no kokoro ni meisuru ari.Nakanzuku ni tokuni fuikinshin no ki o sasu ni, moppara kika shoshū no kō ni ataru.Byōa tachimachini okashi, nao ijutsu no ken o hodokosu koto nashi.Heikei shikirini tenzu.Iyoiyo shinkan no munashikaruzaru koto o shiranu.Kitō o motomu to iedomo, muro sanjigatashi.Shikaji, shinpu no kokorozashi o nukidete, kasanete tosō no gyō o kuwadaten to omō.Bakubakutaru kanran no soko, ryohaku ni fushite yume o yaburi, seiseitaru biyō no mae, enro ni nozomide manako o kiwamu.Tsuini fun'yu no migiri ni tsukite, uyamaite shōjō no mushiro o nobe, shosha shitate tatematsuru shikishi bokuji no myōhōrengekyō ichibu, kaiketsu nikyō, amida, hannyashingyō nado no kyō, onōno ikkan.Tezukara mizukara shosha shimatsuru kindei no daibabon ikkan.Tokini sōshō sōhaku no kage, tomoni zenri no tane o soe, chōkyo chōrai hibiki sora ni bonbai no koe ni wasu.Deshi hokketsu no kumo o jishite hachigai, ryōiku no ōku meguru koto nashi to iedomo, saikai no nami o shinogu koto nido, fukaku kien no asakara zaru koto o shirinu.Ashita ni inoru kyaku hitotsu ni arazu.Yū ni saishi suru mono katsu sen nari.Tadashi sonki no kigyō ōshi to ie domo inchū no ōkei imada kika zu.Zenjōhōō hajimete sono gi o okonai tamau.Deshi byōshin fukaku sono kokorozashi hakobi, kano sūkōzan no tsuki no mae ni ha kanbu imada wakō no kage o haise zu.Hōraidō no kumo no soko ni mo tensen munashiku suijaku no chiri o hedatsu.Aoginegawakuha daimyōjin, fushikorakuha, ichijōkyō, aratani tanki o terashite, yuītsuno gennō o taretamae.
[5.11.6] Jishōyonen kugatsu nijūhachinichi daijōtennō
[5.11.7] To zo asobasaretaru.

[5.11.8] Saruhodoni kono hitobito ha kokonoeno miyako o tate, senrino tōkai ni omomukarekeru. Tairakani kaerinoboran koto mo, makotoni ayauki arisama domo nite, aruiha noharano tsuyu ni yado o kari, aruiha takamineno koke ni tabine o shi, yama o koe kawa o kasane, hikazu hereba, jūgatsujūrokunichi niha, suruganokuni kiyomigaseki ni zo tsukitamau. Miyako o ba sanman'yoki de ide shi ka do, roji no tsuwamono meshigu shi te, shichiman'yoki to zo kikoe shi. Zenjin ha kanbara fujikawa ni susumi, kōjin ha ima tegoshi utsuya ni sasae tari. Daishōgun gonnosuke shōshō koremori, saburaidaishō kazusanokami tadakiyo o meshite" tada koremori ga zonji ni ha, ashigara o uchikoete bandō nite ikusa o sen. " to hayararekeru o kazusanokami mōshikeru ha、「 fukuhara o tatasetamaishi toki, nyūdōdono no onsadame ni ha, ikusa o ba tadakiyo ni makasesasetamaen to ōsesōraishi zo kashi. Hakkakoku no tsuwamonodomo mina hyōenosuke ni shitagaitsuite sōranareba, nanjūmanki ka sōrawan. Mikata no misei ha shichiman'yoki to ha mōse domo, kuniguni no kakemusha domo nari. Uma mo hito mo semefusete sō. Izu suruga no sei no mairu beki dani mo imada mie zu sō. Tada fujikawa o maeni atete, mikata no misei o machise tamau beu ya sōran. " to mōshikere ba, chikara oyoba de yurae tari.

[5.11.9] Saru hodo ni, hyōenosuke ha ashigara no yama o uchikoe te, suruganokuni kisegawa ni koso tsuki tamae. Kai shinano no genji domo haseki te hitotsu ni naru. Ukishima ga hara nite, seita ari. Nijū manki to zo shirushī taru. Hitachi genji sataketarō ga zōshiki, shū no tsukai ni fumi mote kyō he noboru o, heike no senjin kazusanokami tadakiyo kore o todomete, motaru fumi o ubaitori akete mire ba, nyōbō no moto he no fumi nari. Kurushikaru maji tote torase te keri. " somosomo hyōenosukedono no sei, ikahodo ari zo. " to toe ba," oyoso yōka kokonoka no michi ni, hatato tsuzuite, no mo yama mo umi mo kawa mo musha de sō. Gerō ha shigohyakusen made koso, mononokazu o ba shitte sōrae domo sore yori ue ha shira nu sō. Ōi yarō sukunai yarō o ba shi sō ha zu. Kinō kisegawa nite hito no mōshitsuru ha genji no gosei nijūmanki to koso mōshisōtsure. Kazusanokami kore o kīte" aware daishōgun no mikokoro no nobasasetamaitaru hodo kuchioshīkoto sōrawazu. Ima ichinichi mo sakini utte o kudasasetamaitaraba ashigara no yama koete hakkakoku he oidesōrawaba hatakeyama ga ichizoku ōbakyōdai nadoka mairadesōbeki. Korera danimo mairinaba bandō niha nabikanu kusaki mo sōmaji. To kōkaisuredomo kai zo naki.

[5.11.10] Mata daishōgun gonnosuke shōshō koremori, tōgoku no annaisha tote, nagai saitō bettō sanemori o meshite," yaya sanemori, nanji hodo no gōkyū seihyō, hakkakoku ni ikahodo ari zo. " to toi tamae ba, saitō bettō azawaraite mōshikeru ha" sasōrae ba, kimi ha sanemori o ōya to oboshimeshi sōrō ka. Wazukani jūsanzoku koso tsukamatsuri sōrae. Sanemori hodo isōrō mono ha hakkakoku ni ikura mo sōrō. Ōya to mōsu jōno mono no, jūgozoku ni ototte hiki ha sōrō hazu, yumi no tsuyosa mo, shitatakanaru mono gorokunin shite hari sōrō. Kakaru seibyō domo ga i sōrae ba, yoroi no nisanryō o mo kasane te, tayasū i te tōshi sōrō nari. Daimyō hitori to mōshi ha sei no sukunai sadame, gohyakki ni otoru ha sōrawa zu. Uma ni notsure ba ochiru michi o shira zu. Akusho o hasere domo, uma o taosa zu. Ikusa ha mata oya mo utare yo, ko mo utare yo, shinure ba norikoenorikoe tatakau sōrō. Saigoku no ikusa to mōsu ha oya utare nure ba kōyō shi, imi akete yose, ko utare nure ba sono omoinageki ni yose sōrawa zu. Hyōrōmai tsuki nure ba haru ha tazukuri shi, aki ha kariosamete yose, natsu ha atsushi to ī, fuyu ha samushi to kirai sōrō. Tōgoku ni ha sōjite sonogi sōrawa zu. Kai shinano no genji domo, annai ha shitte sōrō. Fuji no suso yori karamete ni yamawari sōran. Kō mōse ba, kimi o obosesase mairase n tote mōshi to ya oboshimeshi sōran. Sonogi ni ha sōwa zu. Ikusa ha sei ni ha yora zu, saku ni yoru to koso mōshitsutaete sōrae. Sanemori kondo no ikusa ni inochi ikite saito he mairu beshi tomo oboe sōwa zu. " to mōshikere ba, heike no tsuwamonodomo kore o kikite, mina furui wananaki aeri.

[5.11.11] Saru hodo ni, jūgatsu nijūsannichi ni mo nari nu. Asu ha genpei fujikawa nite, yāi to sadame tari keru ni, yoru ni iri te, heike no kata yori genji no jin o miwatase ba, izu suruga no jinmin hyakushō ra ga, ikusa ni osori te, aru ha no ni iri yama ni kakure, aru ha fune ni torinori te, umi kawa ni ukabi, ei no hi mie keru o, heike no tsuwamono domo" ana obitadashi no genji no jin no tōbi no ōsa yo. Geni mo makotoni no mo yama mo umi mo kawa mo, mina teki de ari keri. Ikan se n. " to zo awate keru. Sono yo no yoha bakari, fuji no numa ni ikura mo mure i tari keru mizutori domo ga, nani ni ka odoroki tari ken, tada hitotabi ni ha to tate keru haoto no, ōkaze kaminari nado no yō ni kikoe kere ba, heike no tsuwamono domo," suwa ya genji no ōzei no yosuru ha. Saitōbettō ga mōsutsuru yō ni, sadamete karamete mo mawaru ran. Torikomerarete ha kanau maji. Koko o ba hīte, owarigawa, sunomata o fusege ya. " tote, toru mono mo toriaezu, waresakini to zo ochiyukeru. Amarini awatete sawaide yumi toru mono ha ya o shira zu, ya toru mono ha yumi o shira zu, hito no uma ni ha ware nori, waga uma o ba hito ni nora ru. Aruiha tsunai daru uma ni notte kuize o meguru koto kagiri nashi. Chikaki yadoyado yori mukae totte asobi keru yūkun yūjo domo, aruiha kashira keyabure, koshi fumiorete, wamekisakebu mono ōkari keri.
[5.11.12] Akuru nijūyokka unokoku ni, genji taisei nijūmanki, fujikawa ni oshiyosete, ten mo hibiki daichi mo yurugu hodoni, toki o zo sankado tsukuri keru.

[5.12.1] Heike no kata ni ha, oto mo se zu. Hito o tsukawashite mise kere ba," mina ochite sō. " to mōsu. Aruiha teki no wasuretaru yoroi totte mairitaru mono mo ari. Aruiha teki no sutetaru ōmaku totte mairitaru mono mo ari. " teki no jin ni ha hae dani mo kakeri sōwa zu. " to mōsu. Hyōenosuke, uma yori ori, kabuto o nugi, chōzu ukai o shite, ōjō no kata o fushiogami、「 kore ha mattaku yoritomo ga watakushi no kōmyō ni arazu, hachiman dai bosatsu no onhakarai nari. " to zo notamai keru. Yagate uchitoru tokoro nareba tote, suruganokuni o ba ichijōjirōtadayori, tōtōmi o ba yasudasaburōyoshisada ni azukeraru. Heike tsuzuite mo seme keredomo ushiro mo sasuga obotsukanashi tote ukishimagahara yori hikinoki, sagaminokuni he zo kaerare keru. Kaidō shukujuku no yūkun yūjo domo," ana imaimashi. Ite no daishōgun no ya hitotsu dani izushite nigeagari tamau utatesa yo. Ikusa ni ha minogashi to iukoto o dani kokorōki koto ni koso suru ni kore ha kiki nigeshi tamai tari. " to warai aeri. Rakusho domo ōkari keri. 都の大將軍をば宗盛と云ひ、討手の大將をば權亮と云ふ間、平家をひら屋によみなして、

lg.l: ひらやなるむねもりいかにさわぐらん、柱とたのむすけをおとして。
富士河の瀬々の岩こす水よりも、はやくもおつるいせ平氏かな。

div.p: [5.12.2] 上總守たゞきよが、富士河に鎧を捨たりけるを讀めり。

lg.l: 富士河に鎧はすてつ、墨染の衣たゞきよ後の世のため。
たゞきよはにげの馬にぞのりにける、上總鞦かけてかひなし。

div.p: [5.12.3] 同十一月八日、大將軍權亮少將維盛、福原の新都へ上りつく。 入道相國大に怒て、 「大將軍權亮少將維盛をば鬼界が島へ流すべし、侍大將上總守忠清をば死罪に行へ。」 とぞ宣ひける。同九日平家の侍共、老少參會して、「忠清が死罪の事、いかゞ有ら ん。」と評定す。中に主馬判官盛國進出でて申けるは、「忠清は昔より不覺人とは承 り及ばず、あれが十八歳と覺え候、鳥羽殿の寶藏に五畿内の惡黨二人、迯籠て候しを、 寄て搦めうと申す者候はざりしに、此忠清白晝に唯一人築地を越え、はね入て、一人 をば討取り、一人をば生捕て、後代に名を揚たりし者にて候。今度の不覺は、徒事と も覺え候はず。 是に附ても、能々兵亂の御愼候べし。 " to zo mōshikeru.

[5.12.4] Dō tōka, taishōgun gonnosuke shōshō koremori, ukon'enochūjō ni nari tamau. " utte no taishō to kikoe shika domo, saseru shīdetaru koto mo owase zu. Kore ha nanigoto no kanshō zo ya. " to hitobito sasayakiaeri.

[5.12.5] Mukashi masakado tsuitō no tame ni, tairanoshōgunsadamori, tawaranotōtahidesato, uketamaharite bandō he hakkōshi tari shika domo, masakado tayasū horobigatakari shika ba, kasanete utte o kudasu beshi to, kugyō sengi atte, ujiminbukyōtadafumi, kiyoharanoshigefuji, gungen to iu kan o tamaharite kudarare keri. Suruganokuni kiyomigaseki ni yadoshi tari keru yoru, kano shigefuji, manmantaru kaijō o tōmishite," gyoshū hokage samūshite nami o yaki, ekiro reisei yoruyama o sugu" to iu karauta o takarakani kuchizusami tamahe ba, tadafumi yūni oboete, kanrui o zo nagasare keru. Saruhodoni masakado o ba, sadamori hidesato ga tsui ni uchitori te keri. Sono kashira o mochi se te noboru hodo ni, kiyomigaseki nite yukiai u tari. Sono yori sengo no daishōgun uchitsure te jōraku su. Sadamori hidesato ni kanshō okonaware keru toki, tadabumi shigefuji ni mo kanshō aru beki ka to, kugyō sengi ari. Kujō ushōjō morosuke kō no mōsase tamai keru ha" bandō he utte ha mukō tari to ie domo, masakado tayasū horobi kataki tokoro ni, kono hitodomo ōse o kōmutte, seki no higashi he omomuku toki, chōteki sudeni horobi tari." Sareba nadoka kanshō nakaru beki. " to mōsa se tamahe domo, sonotoki no shippei ononomiyadono,"『 utagashiki o ba nasu koto nakare』 to raiki no fumi ni saburahe ba. " tote tsuini nasa se tamaha zu. Tadabumi kore o kuchioshikoto ni shite," ononomiyadono no onsue o ba, yatsuko ni minasan. Kudeudono no onsue ni ha, nani no yo made mo shugoshin to naran. " to chikahi tsutsu, hoshijini koso shi tamahi kere. Sareba kudeudono no onsue ha, medetau sakaesase tamahe domo, ononomiyadono no onsue ni ha, shikarubeki hito mo mashimasa zu, ima ha taehatetamahi keru ni koso.

[5.12.6] Saruhodoni nyūdōshōkoku no yonan, tōnochūjau shigehira, sakon'enochūjau ni naritamafu. Dō jūichigatsu jūsannichi fukuhara ni ha, dairi tsukurīdashite, shujō gosenkō ari. Daijōe aru bekari shika domo, daijōe ha jūgatsu no sue, higashikawa ni gokōshite, gokei ari. Ōuchi no kita no no ni saijōsho otsukute, shinpuku shingu o totonō. Daigokuden no mae, ryūbidō no danka ni, kairyūden o tate, miyu o mesu. Dō dan no narabi ni, daijōgū o tsukute, shinzen o sonau. Shin'en ari. Gyoyū ari. Daigokuden nite tairei ari. Seishodō nite gokagura ari. Burakuin nite enkai ari. Shikaredomo kono fukuhara no shinto ni ha, daigokuden mo nakereba ba, tairei okonau beki tokoro mo nashi. Seishodō nakereba ba, mikagura sōsu beki yō mo nashi. Burakuin mo nakere ba, enkai mo okonaware zu. Kotoshi ha tada nīnamee gosechi bakari aru beki yoshi, kugyō sengi ari te, nao nīname no matsuri o ba, kyūto no jingikan ni shite togerare keri.

[5.12.7] Gosechi ha, jōgen no tōji, yoshinonomiya ni shite, tsuki shiroku kaze hageshikari shi yoru, mikokoro o sumashi tsutsu koto o hiki tamai shi ni, kamime amakudari, godo sode o hirugaesu. Kore zo gosechi no hajime naru.

[5.13.1] Kondo no miyakōtsuri o ba, kimi mo shin mo ontameiki ari. Yamatonara o hajimete, shoji shosha ni itaru made, shikarubekarazaru yoshi ichidō ni uttaemōsu aida, sashimo yokogami o yabururu daijōnyūdō mo, saraba miyakogaeri arubeshi tote kyōchū hishimeki aeri.

[5.13.2] Dō jūnigatsu futsuka, niwakani miyakogaeri arikeri. Shinto ha kita ha yama ni soite takaku, minami ha umi chikaku shite kudareri. Nami no oto tsune ha kamabisushiku, shiokaze hageshiki tokoro nari. Sareba shin'in itsutonaku, gonō no mi shigekari kere ba, isogi fukuhara o ide sase tamau. Sesshōdono o hajime tatematsuri te, daijōdaijin ika no kugyō tenjōbito waremowaremoto gubu se raru. Nyūdōshōkoku o hajime to shite heike ichimon no kugyō tenjōbito waresakini to zo nobora re keru. Dare ka kokorōkari tsuru shinto ni, katatoki mo nokoru beki. Saru rokugatsu yori yadomo kowayose, shizaizatsugu hakobioroshi, katachi no gotoku toritatetarutsuru ni, mata monoguruwashiu, miyako kaeriarikere ba, nani no sata ni mo oyobazu, uchisutesute noborarekeri. Onōno sumika mo nakushite, hachiman, kamo, saga, uzumasa, nishiyama, higashiyama no katahe ni tsuite, midō no kuwairō, yashiro no haiden nado ni, tachiyadote zo shikarubeki hitobito mo mashimashikeru.

[5.13.3] Kondo no miyakōtsuri no hoi o ikani to iu ni, kyūto ha nanto hokurei chikaku shite, isasaka no koto ni mo kasuga no shinboku, hiyoshi no mikoshi nado īte midarigawashi Fukuhara ha yama hedatari e kasanete, hodo mo sasuga tōkere ba, sayō no koto tayasukara ji tote, nyūdōshōkoku no hakaraidasaretarikeru tokaya

[5.13.4] Dō jūnigatsu nijūsannichi, ōmigenji no somukishi o semen tote, taishōgun ni ha sahyōenokami tomomori, satsumanokami tadanori, tsugō sono sei niman'yoki de, ōminokuni he hakkōshite, yamamoto, kashiwagi, nishikikori nado iu afuregenji domo ichīchini mina semeotoshi, yagate minōwari he koetamau.

[5.14.1] Miyako ni ha mata takakuranomiya onjōji he nyūgo no toki, nanto no daishu dōshin shi te amatsusae omukae ni mairu sōrō, kore o motte chōteki nari. Sareba nanto o mo mīdera o mo semeraru beshi to iu hodo koso arekere, nara no daishu obitadashiku hōki su. Sesshōdono yori" zon no mune ara ba, ikudo mo sōmon ni koso oyoba me. " to ōsekudasare kere domo issai yō tatematsura zu. Ukan no bettō tadanari o otsukai ni kudasa re tari kere ba," shiya norimono yori totte hikiotose, motodori kire. " to sōdō suru aida, tadanari iro o ushinate nigeagaru. Tsugini uemonnosuke chikamasa o kudasaru. Kore o mo" motodori kire. " to daishu hishimekikere ba, toru mono mo toriaezu, nigeagaru. Sonotoki ha kangakuin no zōshiki futari ga, motodori kire keri.

[5.14.2] Mata nanto ni ha ōnaru gitchō no tama tsukutte, kore ha heishōkoku no kashira to nazukete," ute, fume. " nado zo mōshikeru. " kotoba no morashiyasu ha wazawai o maneku nakadachi nari. Kotoba no tsutsushimazaru ha yabure o toru michi nari. " to ieri. Kono nyūdōshōkoku to mōsu ha kakemakumo katajikenaku tōgin no gaiso nite imasu. Sore o kayōni mōshi keru nanto no daishu, oyoso ha tenma no shoi to zo mie tari keru.

[5.14.3] Nyūdōshōkoku kayō no kotodomo denbun tamai te ikade ka yoshi to omowa ru beki. Katsugatsu nanto no rōzeki shizume n tote bitchūnokuni no jūnin seotarōkaneyasu, yamatonokuni no kebisho ni fuse raru. Kaneyasu gohyakuyoki de nanto he hakkō su. 「相構て、衆徒は狼藉を致すとも、汝等は致すべからず。 物具なせそ。 弓箭な帶しそ。 」とて向はれたりけるに、大衆かゝる内議をば知らず、兼康が餘勢六十餘人搦取て、一々に皆頸を斬て、猿澤の池の端にぞ懸竝べたる。 入道相國大に怒て、 「さらば南都を攻よや。」とて、大將軍には頭中將重衡、副將軍には中宮亮通盛、都 合其勢四萬餘騎で南都へ發向す。大衆老少嫌はず七千餘人甲の緒をしめ、奈良坂、般 若寺、二箇所の路を掘切て、堀ほり垣楯かき、逆茂木引て待かけたり。平家は四萬餘 騎を二手に分て、奈良坂、般若寺、二箇所の城郭に押寄て、鬨をどとつくる。大衆は 皆歩立打物なり。官軍は馬にてかけまはしかけまはし、あそここゝに追懸／＼指つめ 引つめ散々に射ければ、防ぐ所の大衆數を盡いて討れにけり。卯刻に矢合して一日戰 ひ暮す。夜に入て、奈良坂、般若寺、二箇所の城郭共に破れぬ。落行く衆徒の中に、 坂四郎永覺と云ふ惡僧あり。打物持ても弓箭を取ても力の強さも七大寺十五大寺に勝 たり。萌黄威の腹巻の上に、黒絲威の鎧を重てぞ著たりける。帽子甲に五枚甲の緒を しめて、左右の手には茅の葉の樣に反たる白柄の大長刀、黒漆の大太刀持つまゝに、 同宿十餘人前後にたて、てがいの門より打て出でたり。 Kore zo zanshi taru. Ōku no kanpei, uma no ashi nagire te utare ni keri. Saredomo kangun ha ōzei nite, irekae irekae semekere ba, eikaku ga zengosayū ni fusegu tokoro no dōshuku mina utare nu. Eikaku tadahitori takekere domo, ushiro arawani narikere ba, minami o saite ochi zo iku.

[5.14.4] Yoikusa ni natte, yami ha kurashi, daishōgun tōnochūjō shigehira, hannyaji no mon no mae ni uttate," hi o dase." " to notamau hodo koso arikere. Heike no sei no naka ni harimanokuni no jūnin fukuinoshō no geshi, jirōtayūtomokata to iu mono, tate o yaburi tsuimatsu ni shite, zaike ni hi o zo kake tari keru. Jūnigatsunijūhachinichi no yoru nari kere ba, kaze ha hageshiゝ, himoto ha hitotsu nari kere domo, fukimayō kaze ni, ōku no garan ni fukikake tari. Haji o mo omoi, na o mo oshimu hodo no mono ha, narazaka nite uchijini shi, hannyaji nite utare ni keri. Gyōbu ni kanae ru mono ha, yoshino totsukawa no hō he ochiyuku. Ayumi mo e nu rōsō ya, jinjō naru shugakusha, chigo domo, menowarawabe ha, daibutsuden, yamashinadera no uchi he waresaki ni to zo nigeyuki keru Daibutsuden no nikai no ue ni ha, sen'yonin noboriagari, teki no tsuzuku o nobose ji to kizahashi o ba hiki te keri Mōka ha masani oshikakari tari Wamekisakebu koe, shōnetsu, daishōnetsu, muken'abi no honō no soko no zainin mo, kore ni ha sugi ji to zo mie shi

[5.14.5] Kōfukuji ha tankaikō no gogan, tōshi ruidai no tera nari Higashikondō ni imasu buppō saisho no shaka no zō, nishikondō ni imasu jinen'yushutsu no kanzeon, ruri o narabeshi shimen no rō, shutan o majiheshi nikai no rō, kurin sora ni kagayakishi niki no tō, tachimachini kemuri to naru koso kanashikere. Tōdaiji ha jōzaifumetsu, jippōjakkō no shōjin no mihotoke to obomeshi nazorahete, shōmukōtei, tezukara mizukara migakitatetamahishi kondō jūrokujō no rushanabutsu, usha takaku arawarete, hanten no kumo ni kakure, byakugō aratani ogamare給hishi mangetsu no son'yō mo, mikashira ha yakeochite daichi ni ari, mimi ha tokeaite yama no gotoshi. Hachimanshisen no sōgō wa, aki no tsuki hayaku gojū no kumo ni ōikakure, shijūichiji no yōraku wa, yoru no sora munashiku jūaku no kaze ni tadayō. Kemuri wa chūten ni michimichite, honō wa kokū ni suki mo nashi. Manoatarini mitatematsuru mono, sarani manako atezu, harukani tsutekiku hito wa, kimotama o ushinaeri. Hossōsanron no hōmonshōgyō, subete ikkan mo nokorazu. Wagachō ha iu ni oyobazu, tenjiku shintan ni mo, korehodo no hōmetsu aru beshi tomo oboezu. Udendaiō no shimagon o migaki, bishukatsuma ga shakusendan o kokuji mo, wazukani tōshin no mihotoke nari. Iwan'ya kore ha nan'enbudai no naka ni ha, yuītsumusō no mihotoke, nagaku kyūson no ki aru beshi tomo oboe zari shi ni, ima dokuen no chiri ni majirite, hisashiku kanashimi o nokoshi tamae ri. Bonshakushiō, ryūjinhachibu, myōkanmyōshu mo, odoroki sawagi tamau ran to zo mie shi. Hossōyōgo no kasugadaimyōjin, ikanaru koto o ka oboshi ken. Sareba kasugano no tsuyu mo irokawari, mikasayama no arashi no oto, uramuru sama ni zo kikoe keru. Honō no naka nite shōshi nuru ninzū o shirui tarikere ba, daibutsuden no nikai no ue ni ha issennanahyakuyonin ari, yamashinadera ni ha happyakuyonin ari, aru midō ni ha gohyakuyonin ari, aru midō ni ha sanbyakuyonin ari, tsubusa ni shirui tarikere ba, sanzengohyakuyonin nari. Senjō ni shite utaruru daishu sen'yonin, shōshō ha hannyaji no mon ni kirikake, shōshō ha kubi tomo motase te miyako he nobori tamau.

[5.14.6] Nijūkunichi, tōnochūjō, nanto horoboshite hokukyō he kaeri iraru. Nyūdōshōkoku bakari zo ikidōri harete yorokobare keru. Chūgū ichīn jōkō sesshō ika no hitobito ha" akusō o koso messu tomo garan o hametsusu beshi ya" to zo ontameiki ari keru. " to zo ontameiki ari keru. Shuto no kubi domo moto ha ōji o wataite gokumon no ki ni kakeraru beshi to kikoe shika domo tōdaiji kōfukuji no usenuru asamashisa ni sata ni mo oyoba zu. Asoko koko no mizo ya hori ya ni zo suteoki keru. Shōmukōtei no shinpitsu no gokibun ni ha," wagatera kōfuku se ba, tenka mo kōfuku shi, wagatera suibi se ba, tenka mo suibi su beshi. " to asobasa re tari. Sareba tenka no suibi se n koto, utagai nashi to zo mie tari keru. Asamashikari tsuru toshi mo kure, jishō mo gonen ni nari ni keri.

[6.1.1] Jishō gonen shōgatsu tsuitachi no hi, dairi ni ha, tōgoku no heikaku, nanto no kasai ni yotte, chōhai todomerare, shujō shutsugyo mo nashi. Mono no oto mo fukinarasazu, bugaku mo sōzezu, yoshino no kuzu mo mairazu, tōshi no kugyō ichinin mo sanzerarezu, ujidera shōshitsu ni yotte nari. Futsuka no hi tenjō no ensui mo nashi. Nannyo uchihisomete, kinchū yuyushiu zo miekeru. Buppō ōbō tomoni tsukinuru koto zo asamashiki. Ichīn ōse nari keru ha" ware jūzen no yokun ni yotte banjō no hōi o tamotsu. Yondai no teiō, omoe ba ko nari mago nari. Ika nare ba banki no seimu o todome rare te munashiku toshitsuki o okura n. " to zo onageki ari keru.

[6.1.2] Onaji itsuka no hi, nanto no sōgō ra kekkan se rare, kujō o chōji shi, shoshiki o bosshū se raru. Shuto wa oitaru mo wakaki mo, aruiha ikorosare, aruiha kirikorosare, aruiha kemuri no naka o idezu, honō ni musende ōku usenishikaba, wazukani nokoru tomogara wa sanrin ni majiri, ato o todomaru mono hitori mo nashi. Kōfukujibettō karin'insōjō eien wa, butsuzō kyōkan no kemuri to noborikeru o mite, anāsamashi to kokorōchisawagi, kokoro o kudakarekeru yori yamaitsukite, ikuhodomonaku tsuini usetamainu. Kono sōjō wa yūni nasakefukaki hito nari. Arutoki kakkō no naki o kīte,

lg.l: 聞く度にめづらしければほとゝぎす、いつも初音の心地こそすれ。

div.p: [6.1.3] To iu uta o yomite, hatsunesōjō to zo iwaretamaikeru.

[6.1.4] Tadashi kata no yōni temo gosaie ha ari beki nite sōmyō no sata ari shi ni, nanto no sōgō ha kekkan se rare nu, hokukyō no sōgō o motte okonawa ru beki ka to kugyō sengi ari. Sareba tote nanto o mo sutehate sase tamau beki nara ne ba, sanronshū no gakushō, jōhōikō ga kajūji ni shinobitsutsu kakurei tari keru o meshīdasa re te, gosaie kata no gotoku ni okonawa ru. Jōkō wa, kozokozo hōō no tobadono ni oshikomerare sase tamai shi onkoto, kozo takakuranomiya no utare sase tamai shi on'arisama, miyakōtsuri tote asamashikari shi tenka no midare, kayō no kotodomo onkokorogurushū oboshimesare keru yori onnō tsukase tamai te, tsune wa wazurawashū kikoesase tamai shi ga, tōdaiji kōfukuji no horobi nuru yoshi kikoshimesare te, onnō iyoiyōmorase tamau. Hōō nanamenarazu onnageki ari shi hodo ni, onaji shōgatsu jūyokka rokuhara ikedono nite, jōkō tsuini hōgyo nari nu. Gyō jūninen, tokusei senbantan, shisho jingi no sutanuru michi o okoshi, risei anraku no tataru ato o tsugi tamau. Sanmyōrokutsū no rakan mo manukare tamawa zu, genjutsuhenge no gonja mo nogare nu michi nare ba, uimujō no narai nare domo, ri sugite zo oboe keru. Yagate sono yo higashiyama no fumoto, seikanji he utsushi tatematsuri, yū no kemuri to tague, haru no kasumi to nobora se tamai nu. Chōgenhōin gosōsō ni sankai n to, isogi yama yori kudara re keru ga, haya munashiki kemuri to nara se tamau o misanse te,

lg.l: 常に見し君が御幸をけふ問へば、かへらぬ旅ときくぞ悲き。

div.p: [6.1.5] Mata aru nyōbō, kimi kakusase tamai nu to uketamawate, kō zo omoitsuzukeru.

lg.l: 雲の上に行末遠く見し月の、光きえぬときくぞかなしき。

div.p: [6.1.6] Ontoshi nijūichi. Uchi ni ha jikkai o tamochi, soto ni ha gojō o midarazu, reigi o shōsesase tamai keri. Matsudai no ken'ō ni te imashikere ba, yo no oshimi tatematsuru koto, tsukihi no hikari o ushinaeru ga gotoshi. Kayōni hito no negai mo kanawazu, tami no kahō mo tsutanaki ningen no sakai koso kanashikere.

[6.2.1] " yūni yū hito no omoitsuki mairasuru kata mo osoroshiku ha engi tenryaku no mikado to mōsu tomo, ikadeka kore ni ha masaru beki. " to zo hito mōshikeru. Ōkata ha ken'ō no na o age, jintoku no gyō o hodokosase mashimashi koto mo, kimi goseijin no nochi seidaku o wakata se tamai te no ue no henji ni te koso aru ni, kono kimi ha mugeni yōshu no ontoki yori, shō o nyūwani ukesase tamae ri. Inuru jōan no korohoi, gozaī no hajimetsukata, ontoshi jussai bakari ni mo nase tamai ken, amarini momiji o aise sase tamai te, kita no jin ni koyama o tsukase, haze kaede no, iro utsukushū momiji shitaru o ue sase te, momiji no yama to nazuke te, hinemosu ni eiran ari ni, nao akitase tamawa zu. Shika o aru yo nowaki hashitanau fuki te momiji o mina fukichirashi ochiba sukoburu rōzeki nari. Tonomori no tomo tsukuri ashita giyome su tote kore o kotogotoku hakisute te keri. Nokoreru eda chireru konoha o ba kakiatsume te kaze samujikari keru ashita nare ba nuidono no jin nite sake atatame tabe keru maki ni koso shitengere. Bugyō kurōdo, gyōkō yori saki ni to, isogi itte miru ni, atokata nashi. " ikani. " to toe ba," shika％＼. " to iu. Kurōdo ōkini odoroki," ana asamashi. Kimi no sashimo shūshi oboshimesare tsuru momiji o kayōni shi keru asamashisa yo. Shirazu, nanjira, tadaima kingoku ruzai ni mo oyobi, wagami mo ikanaru gekirin ni ka azukara n zuran. " to nageku tokoro ni, shujō itodoshiku yoru no otodo o idasase tamahi mo ahezu, kashiko he gyōkō natte, momiji o eiran naru ni, nakari kere ba," ikani. " to otazune ari ni, kurōdo sōsu beki kata ha nashi, ari no mama ni sōmon su. Tenki kotoni mikokoroyogeni uchiwarawase tamahi te,"『 rinkan ni sake o atatame te momiji o yaku』 to iu shi no kokoro o ba, sorera ni ha dare ga oshie keru zo ya. Yū mo tsukamatsuri keru mono kana. " tote, kaette eikan ni azukarishi ue ha, aete chokkan nakari keri.

[6.2.2] Mata angen no korohoi, onkatatagae no gyōkō ari shi ni, saradedani keijin gyōshō koe, meiō no nemuri o odorokasu hodo ni mo nashi ka ba, nanimo onezame gachi nite, tsuyatsuya one mo nara zari keri. Iwan'ya iteru shimoyo no hageshiki ni ha, engi seidai, kokudo no tami domo ikani samukaru ran tote, yoru no otodo ni shite, onzo o dasse tamai keru koto nado made mo oboshimeshīdashite, waga teitoku no itaranu koto o zo onnageki ari keru. Yaya shinkō ni oyonde, hodo tōku hito no sakebu koe shi keri. 供奉の人々は聞附られざりけれども、主上聞召て、 「今叫ぶ者は何者ぞ。きと見て參れ。」と仰ければ、上臥したる殿上人、上日の者に 仰す。走り散て尋ぬれば、或辻に、怪の女童のながもちの蓋提て泣にてぞ有ける。「いかに。」と問へば、「主の女房の、院の御所に侍はせ給ふが、此程やうやうにし て、したてられつる御裝束が持て參る程に、只今男の二三人詣來て、奪取て罷りぬる ぞや。今は御裝束が有ばこそ、御所にもさぶらはせ給はめ。はかばかしう立宿せ給ふ べき親い御方も坐さず。此事思ひつゞくるに泣也。」とぞ申ける。さて彼女童を具し て參り、此由奏聞しければ、主上聞召て、「あな無慚。如何なる者のしわざにてか有 らん。堯の代の民は、堯の心のすなほなるを以て心とするが故に皆すなほ也。今の代 の民は、朕が心を以て心とするが故に、かたましき者朝に在て罪を犯す。此吾恥に非 ずや。」とぞ仰ける。「さて取られつらん衣は何色ぞ。」と御尋あれば、「然々の 色。 」と奏す。 建禮門院の未中宮にておはしましける時なり。 其御方へ、「さやうの色したる御衣や候。 」と仰ければ、先のより遙に美きが參たりけるを、件の女童にぞ賜せける。 " imada yo fukashi, mata saru me ni mo ya au. " tote, jōjitsu no mono o tsukete, nushi no nyōbō no tsubone made okurase mashimashi keru zo katajikenaki. Sareba ayashi no shizu no otoko, shizu no onna ni itaru made, tada kono kimi senshūbanzei no hōsan o zo inori tatematsuru.

[6.3.1] Naka ni mo awarenaru onkoto ha, chūgū no onkata ni saburawa se tamau nyōbō no meshitsukaeru uewarawa, omowa zaru hoka, ryūgan ni shiseki suru koto ari keri. Tada jinjō no shiroji ni te mo nakushite shujō tsune ha mesare keri. Mameyakani mikokorozashi fukakarikere ba aruji no nyōbō mo meshitsukawa zu, kaette aruji no gotokuni zo itsukimotenashi keru. Sonokami yōei ni ieru koto ari. " onna o unde mo hīsansuru koto nakare. Otoko o unde mo kikansuru koto nakare. Otoko ha kō ni danimo hōzerare zu, onna ha kisaki tari. " tote kisaki ni tatsu to ieri. Kono hito nyōgo kisaki tomo motenasare, kokumo sen'in tomo aogare nan zu. Medetakarikeru sachi kana tote sono na oba aoinomae to ikereba, nainai ha aoinyōgo nado zo sasayakikeru. Shujō kore o kikoshimeshite, sono nochi ha meshizarikeri. Mikokorozashi no tsukinuru ni ha arazu, tada yo no soshiri o habakase tamau ni yotte nari. Sareba tsuneni gyoei gachi nite yoru otodo ni nomi zo irase tamau.

[6.3.2] Sonotoki no kanpaku matsudono, mikokorogurushiki koto ni koso an nare. Mōshinagusame mairase n tote, isogi gosandai arite," sayōni eiryo ni kakara se masan koto, nanjō koto ka sō beki. Tomo no nyōbō toku／＼ mesa ru beshi to oboe sō. Shinadazune raruru ni oyoba zu, motofusa yagate yūshi ni tsukamatsuri sōwa n. " to sōse sase tamae ba, shujō" isa to yo. Soko ni mōshi koto ha saru koto nare domo, kurai o shirizoki te nochi ha aida saru tameshi mo an nari. Shōu zaī no toki, sayō no koto ha kōdai no soshiri naru beshi. " tote, kikoshimeshi mo ira zari keri. Kanpakudono chikara oyoba se tamawa zu, onnamida o osae te, gotaishutsu ari. Sononochi shujō midori no usuyō no kotoni nioifukakarikeru ni furuki koto nare domo oboshimeshīdete asobarekeru

lg.l: しのぶれど色に出にけり我戀は、物や思ふと人のとふまで。

div.p: [6.3.3] Kono ontenarai o reizeishōshōtakafusa tamawari tsuide kudanno aoinomae ni tamawasetareba kao uchiakame reinaranu kokochi shuttaishitari tote satohe kaeri uchifusu koto gorokunichi shite tsuiniha hakanaku narinikeri " kimi ga ichinichi no on no tame ni warawa ga hyakunen no mi o ayamatsu. " tomokayō no koto o ya mōsubeki Mukashi tōtaisō no teijinki ga musume o genkanden ni iren to shi tamaishi o gichō" kanomusume sudeni rikushi ni yakuseri. " to isamemōshikaba tono ni iruru koto o yamerarekeru ni ha sukoshimo tagawasetamawanu mikokorobase nari.

[6.4.1] Shujō koishitau no miomoi ni shizumase owashimasu. Mōshinagusamemairasen tote, chūgū no onkata yori kogōdono to mōsu nyōbō o maiseraru. Kono nyōbō ha, sakuramachi chūnagon shigenorikyō no onmusume, kyūchū ichi no bijin, koto no jōzu nite owashikeru. Reizei dainagon takafusakyō, imada shōshō narishi toki, misometarishi nyōbō nari. Shōshō hajime ha uta o yomi fumi o tsukushi koikanashimi tamae domo, nabiku keshiki mo nakari shi ga, sasuga nageki ni yowaru kokoro ni ya, tsui ni ha nabiki tamai keri. Saredomo ima ha kimi ni mesare mairase te, shikata mo naku kanashisa ni, akanu wakare no namida ni ha, sode shiotare te hoshiae zu. Shōshō yosonagaramo kogōdono mitatematsuru koto moya to tsuneha sandai serarekeri Owashikeru tsubone no hotori, misu no atari o achikochihe yukitōri tatazumi arikitamaedomo, kogōdono wagimini mesaren ueha, shōshō ikani iutomo, kotoba o mo kawashi fumi omibekinimoarazu tote, tsute no nasake o danimo kakararezu Shōshō moshiya to, isshu no uta o eide, kogōdono no owashikeru misu no naka he nageiretaru

lg.l: 思かね心は空にみちのくの、ちかの鹽釜近きかひなし。

div.p: [6.4.2] Kogōdono, yagate henji mo se baya to omowa re kere domo, kimi no ontame, on'ushirometau ya omowa re ken, te ni dani tori te mo mi tamawa zu. Yagate uewarawa ni torase te, tsubo no uchi he zo nagedasu. Shōshō nasakenau urameshikere domo, hito mo koso mire to, soraosoroshiu omowa re kere ba, isogi kore o tori te futokoro ni ire te zo iderare keru. Nao tachikaeri te,

lg.l: 玉章を今は手にだにとらじとや、さこそ心に思ひすつとも。

div.p: [6.4.3] Ima ha konoyo nite aimin koto mo katakere ba, ikite mono o omowan yori, shinan to nomi zo negaware keru.

[6.4.4] Nyūdōshōkoku kore o kiki, chūgū to mōshi mo onnago nari, reizeishōshō mo muko nari. Kogōdono ni, futari no muko o tora re te," iyaiya kogō ga ara n kagiri ha yononaka konoma ji. Meshīdashi te ushinawa n. " to zo notamai keru. Kogōdono morikī te," wagami no koto ha ikade demo ari nan, kimi no ontame onkokorogurushi. " tote aru kuregata ni dairi o idete, yukuhe mo shirazu usetamahinu. Shujō on nageki nanamenarazu, hiru ha yorunōtodo ni irasetamahite, onnamida ni nomi musebi, yoru ha nanden ni shutsugyonatte, tsuki no hikari o goranjite zo nagusamesetamahikeru. Nyūdōshōkoku kore o kiki," kimi ha kogō yueni oboshimeshishizumesetamahitan nari. Saramuniha. " tote, onkaishaku no nyōbōtachi o mo mairasezu, sandaishitamafu shinka o mo sonemitamaheba, nyūdō no ken'i ni habakatte, kayō hito mo nashi. Kinchū iyoiyo yuyushiu zo mie keru.

[6.4.5] Kakute hachigatsu tōka amari ni nari ni keri. Sashimo kumanaki sora nare do, shujō ha onnamida ni kumori tsutsu, tsuki no hikari mo oboro ni zo goranze rare keru. Yaya shinkō ni oyobide," hito ya aru／＼. " to mesare kere domo, oirae mōsu mono mo nashi. Danjōshōhitsu nakakuni sonoyo shimo ontonoi ni maite harukani tōu sō ga" nakakuni" to on'irae mōshi tare ba" chikō maire. Ōsekudasa ru beki koto ari. " nanigoto yaran tote onmae chikō sanji tare ba" nanji moshi kogō ga yukue ya shi taru. " nakakuni" ikadeka shiri mairase sō beki. Yumeyume shiri mairase zu sō. Makoto yaran, kogō ha saga no hotori ni kataorido tokaya shitaru uchi ni ari to mōsu mono no ari zo to yo Nushi ga na o ba shira zu tomo, tazune te mairase nan ya Nushi ga na o shiri sōrawa de ha, ikade ka tazunemaira se sōrō beki Jitsu ni mo. Tote, ryūgan yori onnamida o nagasa se tamau

[6.4.6] Nakakuni tsuku to mono o anzuru ni, makoto ya, kogōdono ha, koto hiki tamai shi zo kashi. Kono tsuki no akasa ni, kimi no onkoto omoīdemairase te, koto hiki tamawa nu koto ha yomo ara ji. Gosho nite hiki tamai shi ni ha, nakakuni fue no yaku ni mesa re shika ba, sono koto no ne ha, izuku nari tomo kikishiran zuru mono o. Saga no zaike ikuhodo ka aru beki. Uchimawate tazune n ni, nadoka kikīde zaru beki to omoi kere ba," sa sōrawa ba, nushi ga na ha shira zu tomo, moshiya to tazunemairase te mi sōrawa n." Tadashi tazuneai mairasete sō tomo onsho o tamawara de mōsan ni ha uwanosora ni ya oboshimesare sōwanzuran Onsho o tamawate mukai sōwan " to mōkere ba makotoni mo tote onsho o asobaite tamōdari keri " ryō no onma ni notte ike " to zo ōsekeru Nakakuniryō no mima tamahate, meigetsu ni muchi o age, soko shirazu akugareyuku Kojika naku kono yamazato to eijiken, saga no hotori no aki no koro, sakosoha aharenimo oboekeme Orikatado shitaru ya o mitsukete ha konōchi ni ya owasuran to hikaehikae kikeredomo koto hiku tokoro mo nakarikeri Midō nado he mairi tamaeru koto mo ya to shakadō o hajimete dōdō mimawaredomo kogōdono ni nitaru nyōbō dani mie tamawazu Munau kisan taran ha nakanaka maira zaran yori ha ashikaru beshi Kore yori mo izuchi he mo mayoīka baya to omoe domo, izuku ka ōchi nara nu, mi o kakusu beki yado mo nashi. Ikan se n to omoiwazurau. Makoto ya, hōrin ha hodochikakere ba, tsuki no hikari ni izanaware te, mairi tamae ru koto mo ya to, sonohō ni mukaite zo ayumase keru.

[6.4.7] Kameyama no katawarachikaku, matsu no hitomura aru kata ni, kasukani koto zo kikoe keru. Mine no arashi ka matsukaze ka, tazunuru hito no koto no ne ka, obotsukanaku ha omoe domo, koma o hayame te iku hodo ni, kataorido shitaru uchi ni, koto o zo hikisumasa re taru. Hikaete kore o kikere ba, sukoshimo magōmo naki kogōdono no tsumaoto nari. Gaku ha nanizo to kikere ba, tsuma o omoite kōru to yomu sōfuren to iu gaku nari. Sareba koso, kimi no onkoto omoīde mairasete, gaku koso ōkere, konogaku o hiki tamai keru yūsa yo. Arigatō oboete koshi yori yōdeょu nukidashi, chito naite, mon o hotohototo tatakeba, yagate hikiyami tamai nu. Kōshō ni" kore ha dairi yori nakakuni ga ontsukai ni maite sōrō, akesase tamae." 」とて、たゝけども／＼、咎る人も無りけり。
