やゝ有て、内より人の出る音のしければ嬉う思て待つ所に、鎖子をはづし、門を細目 に開け、いたいけしたる小女房、顏ばかり指出いて、「門違にてぞ候らん。是には、 内裏より御使など給はるべき所にても候はず。」と申せば、中々返事して門たてられ、 鎖子さゝれては惡かりなんと思ひて、押開てぞ入にける。妻戸の際の縁に居て、「い かにか樣の所には御渡候やらん。君は御故に思召沈ませ給ひて、御命も既に危うこそ 見えさせ御坐し候へ。只うはの空に申とや思召され候はん。御書を給て參て候。」と て、取出て奉る。 有つる女房取次で、小督殿に參せたり。 開て見給へば、誠に君の御書也けり。 軈て御返事書き引結び、女房の裝束一重添て出されたり。 Nakakuni, nyōbō no shōzoku oba kata ni uchikake mōshikeru ha" yo no ontsukai de sōrawaba gohenji no ue ha tokō mōshini oyobi sōrawanedomo, higoro dairi nite okotoasobishi toki, nakakuni fue no yaku ni mesare sōroishi hōkō oba ikadeka owasure sōrobeki. Jiki no gohenji o uketamawarade kaerimairan koto koso yoni kuchiō sōrae. " to mōshikere ba, kogōdono jitsu mo to ya omowa re ken, mizukara henji shi tamai keri. Sore ni mo kikase tamai tsuran. Nyūdōshōkoku no amarini osoroshiki koto o nomi mōsu to kikishikaba asamashisa ni, dairi oba nigeidete, konohodo ha kakaru sumika nareba, koto nado hiku koto nakaritsuredomo, satemo arubeki naraneba, asu yori ha ōhara no oku ni omohitatsu koto no saburaheba, aruji no nyōbō no kon'ya bakari no nagori o oshiude, ima ha yo mo fukenu, tachikiku hito mo araji nado susumereba, sazona mukashi no nagori mo sasuga yukashikute, tenarashi koto o hiku hodoni, yasūmo kikīdasarekerina. " tote namida mo sekiae tamawa ne ba, nakakuni mo sode o zo nurashi keru. Yaya arite, nakakuni namida o osaete mōshikeru ha" asu yori ōhara no oku ni oboshimeshitatsu koto to sōrawa, on'yō nado o henjisase tamau beki ni koso. Yumeyume aru beu mo sōrawa zu. Sate kimi no onnageki o ba nantoka shi mairase tama beki. Kore bashi dashi mairasu na. " tote tomo ni meshigushitaru mebu kichijō nado tomeoki, sono ya o shugosesase, ryō no mima ni uchinotte, dairi he kisanritareba, hono to akenikeri. " ima ha nyūgo mo nari nuran. Tare shite mōshīre beki. " tote ryō no mima tsunase, aritsuru nyōbō no shōzoku oba haneuma no shōji ni uchikake, nanden no kata he maireba shujō ha imada yahen no goza ni zo mashikeru. " minami ni kake kita ni muka, kan'on o akitaka ni tsuke katashi. Higashi ni ide nishi ni nagare, tada senbō o akatsuki no tsuki ni yosu " to, uchinagame sase tamau tokoro ni, nakakuni tsuto mairi tari Kogōdono no gohenji o zo mairase taru. Shujō nanomenara zu gyokan nashite," nanji yagate yosari gushite maire. " to ōsekere ba, nyūdōshōkoku no kanbun tamawa n tokoro ha osoroshikere domo, kore mata ringen nare ba, zōshiki ushikai gissha kiyogeni satashite, saga he yukimukai, mairu majiki yoshi yōyōni notamae domo, samazamani koshiraete, kuruma ni torinose tatematsuri, dairi he maitari kere ba, kasukanaru tokoro ni shinobasete, yoyo mesare keru hodo ni, himemiya goissho shuttaisase tamai keri. Kono himemiya to mōsu ha bōmon no nyoin no onkoto nari. Nyūdōshōkoku nantoshite ka morikiki tari ken. " kogō ga use tari to iu koto ha atokata mo naki kyogen nari keri. " tote kogōdono o torae tsutsu, ama ni natte zo hanataru. Kogōdono shukke ha moto yori no nozomi nari kere domo, kokoro narazu ama ni nasa re te, sai nijūsan, kozumizome ni yatsure hate te saga no hotori ni zo sumare keru. Utatekari shi koto domo nari. Shujō ha kayō no kotodomo ni gonau hatsukase tamaute tsuini onkakure ari keru to zo kikoe shi.

[6.4.8] Hōō ha uchitsuzuki gotan nomi zo shigekari keru. Saru eiman ni ha daīchi no onko, nijōin hōgyo nari nu. Angen ninen no shichigatsu ni ha onmago rokujōin kakure sase tamai nu. Ten ni suma ba hiyokuchō, chi ni suma ba renrishi to naran to, kanga no hoshi o sashite, michigiri asakara zari shi kenshunmon'in, aki no kiri ni okasa rete, ashita no tsuyu to kie sase tamai nu. Toshitsuki ha kasanare domo, kinōkyō no miwakare no sama ni oboshimeshi te, minamida mo madatsukise nu ni, jishō yonen gogatsu ni ha, dainiōji takakuranomiya uta re sase tamai nu. Genze goshō tanomi oboshimesare tsuru shin'in sae sakidachi se tamai nure ba, tonikakuni, kakotsu kata naki onnamida nomi zo susumi keru. " kanashimi no itatte kanashiki ha, oite nochi ko ni okuretaru yori mo kanashiki ha nashi. Urami no itatte urameshiki ha, wakōshite oya ni sakidachi yori mo urameshiki ha nashi. " to kano asatsuna shōkō no shisoku sumiaki ni okurete kaki tari ken fude no ato ima koso oboshimeshishirare kere Saru mama ni ha kano ichijōmyōten no godokuju mo okotara se tamaha zu sanmitsugyōhō no gokunju mo tsumora se tama keri Tenka ryōan ni nashi ka ba, ōmiyabito mo oshinabete, hana no tamoto ya yatsuke n.

[6.5.1] Nyūdōshōkoku, kayōni itau nasakenau furumaokare shi koto o sasuga kowato ya omoware ken, hōō nagusame mairase n tote, aki no itsukushima no naishi ga hara no onmusume, shōnen jūhachi ni naritamau ga, yūni hanayakani ohashikeru o hōō he mairase raru. Jōrōnyōbōtachi amata erabare te, mairare keru. Kugyō tenjōbito ōku gubu shi te hitoeni nyōgo san no gotoku ni te zo ari keru. Jōkō kakusase tamaite nochi, wazukani futananuka dani mo sugizaru ni, shikarubekara zu to zo hitobito nainai ha sasayaki aware keru.

[6.5.2] Saruhodoni, sonokoro shinanonokuni ni, kisonokanja yoshinaka to iu genji ari to kikoe keri. Ko rokujōhōgan tameyoshi ga jinan tachihakinosenjō yoshikata ga ko nari. Chichi yoshikata ha, kyūju ninen hachigatsu jūrokunichi kamakura no akugenta yoshihira ga tame ni chūse raru. Sonotoki yoshinaka nisai nari shi o, haha nakinaki kakae te shinano he koe, kisochūzakanetō ga moto ni iki," kore ikanimo shite sodate, hito ni natte mise tamae. " to ī kere ba, kanetō uketotte kaigaishū nijūyonen yōiku su. Yōyō chōdai suru mama ni, chikara mo yo ni sugure te tsuyoku, kokoro mo sōnaku kannari keri. Arigataki gōkyū seihyō, uma no ue, kachitachi, subete jōko no tamura,, toshihito, yogoshōgun, muneyori, yasumasa, senzo yorimitsu, yoshīe ason to iu tomo, ikadeka kore ni ha katsu beki to zo hito mōsu keru.

[6.5.3] Arutoki uba no kanetō o mesu te notamai keru. Hyōenosuke yoritomo sudeni muhon o okoshi, higashi hakkakoku o uchishitagahete, tōkaidō yori nobori, heike o ohiotosan to suru nari. Yoshinaka mo tōsan hokuriku ryōdō o shitagahe, ima ichinichi mo sakini heike o semeotoshi, tatoheba nihonkoku ni, futari no shōgun to iha re ba ya. " to honomekashi kere ba, nakasaburō kanetō ōkini kashikomari yorokobide," sonoryō ni koso, kimi o ba imamade yōikushi tatematsure. Kō ōsera ruru koso makotoni hachimandono no onsue tomo oboe sase tamahe. " tote, yagate muhon o kuwadate keri.

[6.5.4] Kanetō ni guse rare te tsune ha miyako he nobori heike no hitobito no furumai arisama o mo miukagai keri. Jūsan de genbukushi keru mo, hachiman he mairi hachimandaibosatsu no gozen nite" waga yondai no sofu yoshīe ason ha kono onkami no miko to natte na oba hachimantarō to gōshi ki." Katsu ha sono ato o oi beshi. " tote hachimandaibosatsu no gohōzen nite motodori toriage, kisojirōyoshinaka to koso tsuke tari kere. Kanetō, mazu megurashi fumi sō beshi tote, shinanonokuni ni ha, neinokoyatashigenoyukichika o katarau ni, somuku koto nashi. Kore o hajimete, shinano ikkoku no tsuwamonodomo, nabika nu kusaki mo nakari keri. kōzukenokuni ni ha ko tachihaki senjō yoshikata ga konominite tagogun no tsuwamonodomo, mina zuifu ni keri. Heike no sue ni naru ori o ete, genji no nenrai no sokai o togen to su.

[6.6.1] Kiso to iu tokoro ha, shinano ni tottemo minami no hashi, mino sakai nareba miyako mo mugeni hodochikashi. Heike no hitobito morekīte," tōgoku no somuki dani ari ni hokkoku sae, kowa ikani. " to zo sawage keru. Nyūdōshōkoku ōserare keru ha" sonomono kokoronikukara zu. Omoe ba shinano ikkoku no tsuwamonodomo koso, zuifu to iu tomo, echigonokuni ni ha, yogoshōgun no sueha, jōtarōsukenaga, dōshirōsukemochi, korera ha kyōdai tomoni tazei no mono nari. Ōsekudashi tara n zuru ni, yasū ute mairase te n zu. " to notamai kere ba," ikaga aran zura mu. " to nainai ha sasayaku mono ōkari keri.

[6.6.2] Nigatsu tsuitachi, echigonokuni jūnin, jōtarōsukenaga, echigonokami ni ninzu. Kore ha kiso tsuitō se rare nzuru hakarigoto to zo kikoe shi. Dō nanuka daijin ika ieie nite, sonshōdarani, fudōmyōō, shokuyō se raru. Kore ha mata heiran no tsutsushimi no tame nari.

[6.6.3] Dō kokonoka, kawachinokuni ishikawagun ni kyojūshi tari keru musashinogonnokaminyūdōgiki, shisoku ishikawahangandaiyoshikane, heike o somukite, hyōenosukeyoritomo ni kokoro o tōshi sudeni tōgoku he ochiyuki beki yoshi kikoe shika ba, nyūdōshōkoku yagate utte o tsukawasu. Utte no taishō ni ha minamotonodaibuhangansuekata, settsuhanganmorizumi, tsugō sono sei sanzen'yoki de hakkō su. Jōnai ni ha musashinogonnokaminyūdōyoshimoto, shisoku hangandaiyoshikane o saki to shite, sono sei hyakki bakari ni ha sugizari keri. Toki tsukuri yāi shite, irikaekae sūkoku tatakau. Shiro no uchi no tsuwamonodomo, te no kiwa tatakai, uchijini suru mono ōkari keri. Musashinogonnokaminyūdōyoshimoto uchijini su. Shisoku ishikawahōgandaiyoshikane wa itade ōte ikedorini seraru. Dō jūichinichi yoshimotohōshi ga shuto e irite ōji o watasaru. Ryōan ni zokushu o watasaruru koto, horikawatennō hōgyo no toki, sakinotsushimanokami minamotonoyoshichika ga kubi o watasareshi rei to zo kikoeshi.

[6.6.4] Dō jūninichi, chinzei yori hikyaku tōrai, usadaigūjikinmichi ga mōshikeru wa, kyūshū no monodomo, ogatasaburō o hajimetoshite, usuki, hegi, matsuratō ni itaru made, ikkō heike o somuite genji ni dōshin no yoshi mōshitarikereba," tōgoku hokkoku no somuki dani aruni, kowa ikani. " tote te o utte azamiaeri.

[6.6.5] Dō jūrokunichi ni, iyonokuni yori hikyaku tōrai, kozo no fuyu koro yori, kōnoshirōmichikiyo o hajime toshite, shikoku no mono domo mina heike o somuite, genji ni dōshin no aida, bingonokuni no jūnin, nukada no nyūdō saijaku, heike ni kokorozashi fukakarikere ba, iyonokuni he oshiwatari, dōzen dōgo no sakai, takanaojō nite, kōnoshirōmichikiyo o uchisōrō nu. Shisoku kōnoshirōmichinobu chichi ga utare keru toki, akinokuni no jūnin nutajirō ha hahakata no oji narikere ba, sore he koete ariawazu. Michinobu chichi o utase te yasuranu mono nari. Ikanimo shite saijaku o uttoramu to zo ukagahi keru. Nukuinyūdōsaijaku kōnoshirōmichikiyo o utte nochi, shikoku no rōzeki o shizume, kotoshi shōgatsu jūgonichi ni bingo no tomo he oshiwatari, yūkun yūjo domo atsumete, yūgire sake mori shi keru ga, zengo mo shirazu suigashitaru tokoro ni, kōnoshirō omohikitaru mono domo hyakuyonin ahikatatte, hato oshiyosu. Saijaku ga kata ni mo sanbyakuyonin ari keru monodomo, niwaka no koto nare ba omoi mo mōke zu awatefutameki keru o tachiau mono o ba ifuse kirifuse, mazu saijaku o ikedori shi te iyonokuni he oshiwatari, chichi ga utare taru takanaojō he sage te yuki, nokogiri de kubi o kiri tari tomo kikoe keri. Mata haritsuke ni shi tari tomo kikoe keri.

[6.7.1] Sononochi shikoku no monodomo mina kōnoshirō ni shitagaitsuku. Kumanobettōtanzō mo heike no jūon no mi nari shi ga sore mo somui te genji ni dōshin no yoshi kikoe keri. Oyoso tōgoku hokkoku kotogotoku somuki nu. Nankai saikai kaku no gotoshi. Iteki no hōki mimi odorokashi, gyakuran no senpyō shikirini sōsu. Shī tachimachini okoreri. Yo ha tadaima usenanzu tote kanarazu heike no ichimon nara nedomo kokoroaru hitobito no nagekikanashimanu ha nakarikeri.

[6.7.2] Dō nijūsannichi, kugyō sengi ari. Sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō mōsarekeru ha bandō he utte ha mukaitari to iudomo, saseru shīdashitaru koto mo sōrawazu. Kondo ha munemori daishōgun o uketamawate, mukubeki yoshi mōsarekere ba shokei shikitaishite," yuyushū sōrannan. " to mōsarekeri. Kugyō tenjōbito mo, bukan ni sonawari, kyūsen ni tazusawaran hitobito ha, munemorikyō o daishōgun nite, tōgoku hokkoku no kyōtora tsuitōsubeki yoshi ōsekudasaru.

[6.7.3] Dōnijūshichinichi sakinōdaishōmunemorikyō genji tsuitō no tame ni, tōgoku he sudeni kadode to kikoeshi ga, nyūdōshōkoku irei no kokochi tote, todomaritamainu. Akaru nijūhachinichi yori jūbyō o uke tamae ri tote, kyōchū rokuhara" suwa shitsuru koto o. " to sasayake ri. Nyūdōshōkoku yamai tsuki tamai shi hi yori shite, mizu o dani nodo he ire tamawa zu, mi no uchi no atsuki koto hi o yaku ga gotoshi. Fushi tamae ru tokoro, shigoken ga uchi he iru mono ha, atsusa tae gatashi. Tada notamau koto tote ha," atāta" to bakari nari. Sukoshimo adagoto to ha mie zari keri. Hieizan yori, senjui no mizu o kumikudashi, ishi no fune ni tatahe te, sore ni kudashite hiyashi tamahe ba, mizu obitadakō wakiagatte, hodonaku yu ni zo narini keru. Moshiya tasukari tamau to kakehi no mizu o makase tare ba ishi ya tetsu nado no yaki taru sama ni mizu hotobashirite yoritsuki zu Onozukara ataru mizu ha honō to narite moekere ba kokuen denchū ni michimichite honō uzumaite nobori keri Kore ya mukashi hōzōsōzu to īshi hito en'ō no shō ni omomuite haha no shōsho o tazune shi ni en'ō awaremi tamai te gokusotsu o aisoe te shōnetsujigoku he tsukawasa ru Tetsu no mon no uchi he sashīreba, ryūsei nado no gotokuni, honō sora he tachiagari, tahyakuyujun ni oyobi ken mo, ima koso omoishirare kere.

[6.7.4] Nyūdōshōkoku no kitanokata, nīdono no yume ni mitamai keru koto koso osoroshikere. Tatoeba, mōka no obitadashiku moetaru kuruma o mon no uchi he yarīretari. Zengo ni tattaru mono ha aruiha uma no omote no yōnaru mono mo ari, aruiha ushi no omote no yōnaru mono mo ari. Kuruma no mae ni ha, mu to iu moji bakari zo mietaru tetsu no fuda o zo tattari keru. Nīdono yume no kokoro ni," are ha nani yori zo. " to otazune are ba," enma no chō yori heike daijōnyūdōdono no omukae ni maite sō. " to mōsu. " sate sono fuda ha nani toiu fuda zo. " to toise tamae ba," nan'enbudai no kondō jūrokujō no rushanabutsu shōbōshi tamae ru tsumi ni yotte, muken no soko ni ochitamau beki yoshi, enma no chō ni onsadame sō ga, mu o ba kaka re te, ken no ji o ba imada kakare nu nari. " to zo mōshi keru. Nīdono uchiodoroki, asemizu ni nari, kore o hito ni katari tamae ba, kiku hito mina minoke yodachi keri. Reibutsureisha ni, kingin shippō o nage, bān gaichū kyūsen tachikatana ni itaru made, toridashi hakobidashite inorare keredomo, sono shirushi mo nakari keri. Nannyo no kindachi, atomakura ni sashitsudohite, ikani sen to nagekikanashimi tamahe domo kanaubeshi to mo mie zari keri.

[6.7.5] Urūnigatsu futsuka, nīdono atsū taegatakeredomo, mimakura no ue ni yosete, nakinaki notamaeru ha" goarisama mitatematsuru ni, hini soete tanomoshū koso mie sase tamahe." Konoyo ni oboshioku koto ara ba, sukoshi mono no oboe sase tamau toki, ōseoke. " to zo notamai keru. Nyūdōshōkoku, sashimo higoro ha yuyushigeni mashi kadomo, makotoni kurushigenite, ikinoshitani notamai keru ha," ware hōgenheiji yori irai, tabitabino chōteki o tairage, kanshō mini amari, katajikenakumo teisodaijōdaijin ni itari, eiga shisonni oyobu. Konjō no nozomi, ichiji mo nokoru tokoro nashi. Tadashi omoioku koto tote ha, izunokuni no runin sakinōhyōenosuke yoritomo ga kubi o mi zari tsuru koso yasukara ne. Ware ikanimo naranan nochi ha dōtō o tate kōyō o subekarazu Yagate utte o tsukawashi, yoritomo ga kashira o hanete, waga haka no mae ni kakubeshi Sore zo kōyō nite aranzuru " to notamai keru koso tsumibukakere

[6.7.6] Dō yokka, yamai ni semerare, semetenokoto ni, ita ni mizu o sosogite, sore ni fushimarobi tamae domo, tasukaru kokochi mo shitamawazu Monzetsu biyaku chi shite, tsuini atsuchijini zo shi tamai keru. Basha no hasechigau oto ten mo hibiki daichi mo yurugu hodo nari. Itten no kimi banjō no nushi no, ikanaru onkoto imasu tomo kore niha sugiji to zo mie shi. Kotoshi ha rokujūshi ni zo nari tamau, rōshi to iu beki niha ara ne domo, shukūn tachimachini tsuki tamae ba, daihō hihō no kōken mo naku, shinmei sanbō no ikō mo kie, shoten mo yōgo shi tamawa zu. Iwan'ya bonryo ni oite o ya. Inochi ni kawari mi ni kawara n to chū o zonze shi sūman no gunryo ha, dōjō dōka ni narabī tare domo, kore ha me ni mo mie zu chikara ni mo kakawara nu mujō no sekki o ba, zanji mo tatakaesa zu. Mata kaeri ko nu shide no yama, mitsusegawa, yomi chūu no tabi no sora ni, tadahitotokoro koso omomuki tamai keme. Higoro tsukuriokare shi zaigō bakari ya, gokusotsu to natte, mukaeni ki ken. Awarenari shi kotodomo nari. Satemo ari beki nara ne ba, dō nanuka ni, atago nite kemuri ni nashi tatematsuri, hone o ba enjitsuhōgen kubi nikakete, settsunokuni he kudari, kyōjima ni zo osameke ru. Sashimo nihon'isshū ni na o age i o furushi hito nare domo, mi ha ichiji no kemuri to natte, miyako no sora ni tachiagari, shikabane ha shibaraku yasuraite, hama no masago ni tawamuretsutsu, akitsuchi to zo naritamau.

[6.8.1] Yagate sōsō no yoru fushigi no koto amata ari. Tama o migaki kingin o chiribamete tsukurare shi nishihachijōdono, sonoyo niwakani yakenu. Hito no ie no yakeru ha tsune no narai nare domo, asamashikari shi kotodomo nari. Nanimono no shoi ni ya ariken, hōka to zo kikoeshi. Mata sono yo rokuhara no minami ni ate, hito nara ba nisanjūnin ga koe shi te" ure ya mizunari ha taki no mizu" to iu hyōshi o dashi te, maiodori, doto warau koe shi keri. Inuru shōgatsu ni ha jōkō kakusase tamai te, tenka ryōan ni nari nu. Wazukani naka ichiryōgetsu o hedate, nyūdōshōkoku kōzerare nu. Ayashino no shizunōtoko shizunōnna ni itaru made, ikaga urehe zaru beki. Kore ha ikayōnimo tengu no shoi to iu sata nite, heike no samurai no naka ni ha yariono wakamonodomo, hyakuyonin warau koe ni tsuite, tazuneyukite mireba, in no gosho hōjūjidono ni, kono nisannen ha in mo watara se tamawa zu, goshoazukari bizenzenji motomune to iu mono ari. Kano motomune ga aishiri taru mono domo, nisan jūnin yoru ni magire kitari atsumari sake o nomi keru ga, hajime ha kakaru orifushi ni oto nase so tote nomu hodo ni, shidaini nomiyoi te, kayōni maiodori keru nari Hato oshiyose te, sake ni yoi taru mono domo hitori mo morasa zu sanjūnin bakari karame te, rokuhara he mote mairi, sakinōdaishō munemori kyō no ohashi keru tsubo no uchi ni zo hikī taru Koto no shisai o yokuyoku tazunekiki tamai te geni mo sonohodo ni yottara nzuru mono o ba kiru beki ni mo ara zu tote mina yurusare keri. Hito no usenuru ato ni ha, ayashino mono mo asayū ni kane uchinarashi, reiji senbō yomu koto ha, tsune no narai nare domo, kono zenmon kōzerare nuru nochi ha, kubutsu sesō no ei to iu koto mo nashi. Asayū ha tada ikusa kassen no saku yori hoka ha, taji nashi.

[6.8.2] Ōyoso ha saigo no shorō no arisama koso utatekere domo, tadabito tomo oboenu koto domo ōkari keri. Hiyoshisha he mairi tamai shi ni mo, tōke take no kugyō ōku gubu shi te, setsuroku no omi no kasuga gosankei, ujīri nado iu mo tomo, kore ni ha ikadeka masaru beki to zo hito mōshi keru. Mata nanigoto yori mo fukuhara no kyōjima kizui te ima no yo ni itaru made, shōka ōrai no fune no wazurai naki koso medetakere. Kanoshima wa saru ōhō gannen nigatsu jōjun ni tsukihajime rare tari keru ga, dōnen no hachigatsu ni niwakani ōkaze fuki ōnami tate, mina yonageushinai te ki. Dō sannen sangatsu gejun ni, awa minbu shigeyoshi o bugyō nite, tsuka se rare keru ga, hitobashira tate raru beshi nado, kugyō sengi ari shika domo, zaigō nari tote, ishi no omote ni issaikyō o kai te, tsukare tari keru yue ni koso, kyōjima to wa nazuke tare.

[6.9.1] Furui hito no mōsare keru ha, kiyomorikō ha akunin to koso omoe domo, makoto ha jikeisōjō no saitan nari. Sono yue ha, settsunokuni kiyosumidera to iu yamadera ari. Kanodera no jūsō jishinbōsonge to mōshi keru ha moto ha eizan no gakuryo, tanen hokke no jisha nari. Saruni dōshin o hosshi rizan shite, konotera ni toshitsuki o okuri kere ba minahito kore o kie shi keri. Inuru jōanninen jūnigatsu nijūninichi no yoru, kyōsoku ni yorikakari hokekyō yomi tatematsuri keru ni, ushinokoku bakari ni yume tomo naku utsutsu tomo naku, toshi gojū bakari naru otoko no jōe ni tateeboshi ki te, waraji habaki shitaru ga, tatebumi o mote kitare ri. Son'e" are ha izuku yori no hito zo. " to tokere ba," enmaōkyū yori no mitsukai nari. Senji sōrō. " tote, tatebumi o son'e ni watasu. Son'e kore o hiraite mire ba,Kutsushō, enbudai dainihonkoku settsunokuni kiyosumidera no jishinbō sonkei, kitaru nijūrokunichi, enmarajō daigokuden ni shite, jūmannin no jikyōsha o motte jūmanbu no hokekyō o tendoku se raru beki nari.Yotte sankin se raru beshi.En'ō sen ni yotte kutsushō nyoken.
[6.9.2] Jōan ninen jūnigatsu nijūninichi enmachō.

[6.9.3] To zo kaka re taru. Sonne inami mōshi beki koto nara ne ba, sō nau ryōshō no shōmon o kaki te tatematsuru to oboe te, oboe ni keri. Hitoeni shikyo no omoi nashite, inju no kōyōbō ni kono koto o kataru. Minahito kidoku no omoi o nasu. Sonne kuchi ni ha mida no myōgō o tonae, kokoro ni injō no higan o nenzu. Yōyō nijūgonichi no yain ni oyobite jōjū no butsuzen ni itari rei no gotoku kyōsoku ni yosekakete nenbutsu dokyō su. Nenokoku ni oyobite nemurikirinaru ga yueni jūbō ni kaerite uchifusu. Ushinokoku bakari ni mata sakinogotokuni jōeshōzokunaru oni futari kite, hayahaya mairarubeshi to susumuru aida, en'ōsen o jisentosureba, hanahada sonōsoreari. Sankeisentosureba, sarani ehatsu nashi. Konōmoi o nasu toki, hōe shizenni minimatoite katanikakari, ten'yori kinnohachi kudaru. Futarinodōji, futarinojūsō, jūninnogesō, shichihōnōoguruma, jibōnomaeni genzu. Sonkei nanomenarazu yorokobite sokujini kuruma ni noru. Jūsōra seihoku no hō ni mukite sora o kakete, hodonaku enmaōkyū ni itarinu.

[6.9.4] Ōkyū no tei o miru ni, gaikaku byōbyōtoshite, sonōchi kōkōtari. Sonōchi ni shippō shojō no daigokuden ari. Kōkō konjiki nishite, bonbu no homeru tokoro ni arazu. Sonohi no hōe owatte nochi, shōsō mina kaeru toki, sonkei ha nanpō no chūmon ni tate harukani daigokuden o miwataseba, myōkan myōshu, mina enmahōō no gozen ni osoru. Sonkei arigataki sankei nari. Kono tsugini goshō no koto tazunemōsan tote, daigokuden he mairu. Sonoaida ni futari no dōji kai o sashi, futari no jūsō hako o mochi, jūnin no gesō retsu o hīte, zenzen hochikazuku toki, enmahōō, myōkan myōshu mina kotogotoku kudarimukau. Tamon jikoku futari no dōji ni genji, yakuōbosatsu yusebosatsu, futari no jūsō ni henzu. Jūrasetsunyo jūnin no gesō ni genji te, zuichiku kyūji shi tamae ri. En'ō toi te iwaku," yosō mina kikyo nu. Gobō kitaru koto ikan." " goshō no zaisho uketamawara n tame nari." " tadashi ōjō fuōjō ha, hito no shinfushin ni ari unnun." En'ō mata myōkan ni chokushite notamawaku," kono gobō no sazen no fumibako nanpō no hōzō ni ari. Toridashite isshō no gyō, keta no hi no mon mise tatematsure. Myōkan uketamawate, nanpō no hōzō ni ite, ichi no fumibako o totte mairitari. Soku futa o akete kore o kotogotoku yomikikasu. Son'e hitan teikyū shite," tada negawakuha ware o aimin shite shutsurishōji no hōhō o oshie, shōdaibodai no jikidō o shime tamae. Sono toki en'ō aimin kyōke shite shuju no ge o zusu. Meikan fude o somete ichīchi ni kore o kaku. Saishi ōi zai kenzoku shikyo mu ichi kitaru aishitashimu tsune shitagau gōki kebaku ware ku uku kyōkan muhenzai

[6.9.5] En'ō kono ge o zushi oete, sunawachi kano fumi o sonkei ni fuzoku su. Sonkei nanomenarazu yorokonde," nihon no daishōkoku to mōsu hito settsunokuni wadanomisaki o tenjite, shimen jūyochō ni ya o tsukuri, kyō no jūmansōe no gotoku jikyōsha o ōku kutsushōshite, bōgotoni ichimenni zanitsuki, seppō dokyō, teineini gongyō o itasare sōrō. " to mōshikere ba, en'ō zuiki kantan shi te," kudan no nyūdō ha, tadabito ni arazu, jiesōjō no keshin nari. Tendai no buppō goji no tame ni, nihon ni saitan su. Yue ni, mainichi ni sando kanohito o reisuru fumi ari. Sunawachi kono fumi o motte kanohito ni tatematsuru beshi. " to te,Kyōrai jie daisōjō tendaibuppō yōgosha jigen saisho shōgunshin akugō shujō dō riyaku

[6.9.6] Sonkei kore o tamawa te, daigokuden no nanpō no chūmon o izuru toki, kanshi ra jūnin mongai ni tate, kuruma ni nose, zengo ni shitagau. Mata, sora o kakete kaeri kuru. Yume no kokochi shite iki deki ni keri. Sonkei kore o motte, nishihachijō he mairi, nyūdōshōkoku ni sanse tari kere ba, nanamenara zu yorokobite, samazama motenashi samazama no hikidemono domo tamaide, sono kanshō ni risshi ni nasare keru to zo kikoe shi. Sate koso, kiyomorikō o ba, jikeisōjō no saitan nari to hito shiri te kere.

[6.10.1] Mata aruhito no mōshikeru ha, kiyomorikō ha tadamori ga ko ni ha arazu, makotoni ha shirakawain no ōji nari. Sono yue ha, saru eikyū no korohohi, gionnyōgo to kikoeshi kōjin owashikeru. Kudan no nyōbō no sumahidokoro ha, higashiyama no fumoto gion no hotori ni te zo ari keru. Shirakawain tsune ha miyuki nari keri. Arutoki tenjōbito ichiryōnin, hokumen shōshō meshigushite, shinobinogokō ari shi ni, koro ha gogatsu hatsukāmari no mada yoi no koto nare ba, me sasu tomo shiranu yami de ha ari, samidare sae kakikurashi, makotoni ibusekari keru ni, kudanno nyōbō no shukusho chikaku midō ari. Midō no katawara ni hikarimono shuttaishitari. Kubi wa gin no hari o migakitatetaru sama ni kirameki, sayū no te to oboshiki o sashiagetaru ga, katate ni wa tsuchi no sama naru mono o mochi, katate ni wa hikaru mono o zo mottarikeru. Kimi mo shin mo" ana osoroshi, kore wa makoto no oni to oboyuru. Te ni moteru mono wa, kikoyuru uchidenokozuchi naru beshi. Ikaga se n. " to sawagase owasu tokoro ni, tadamori sonokoro ha imada hokumen no gerō nite, gubushi tari keru o meshite," kononaka nite nanji zo aru ran, ano mono i mo koroshi, kiri mo todome nan ya. " to ōse kere ba, tadamori kashikomari uketamawate yukimukō. Nainai omoikeru ha, konomono sashimo takeki mono to ha mie zu. Kori nado nite zo aru ran. Kore o i mo koroshi, kiri mo koroshitara n ha mugeni nen nakaru beshi. Ikedori ni se n to omo te kakaru. To hakari ari te ha satto hikari, to hakari ari te ha satto hikari, nisando shi keru o, tadamori hashiriyo te, muzuto kumu. Kuma re te," koha ikani. " to sawagu. Henge no ha niteha nakari keri, haya hito nite zo ari keru. Sonotoki jōge tete ni hi o tomoite, kore o goranjimi tamau ni, rokujū bakari no hōshi nari. Tatoheba midō no shōjihōshi de ari keru ga, miakashisen tote, tebin to ifu mono ni abura o irete, katate ni ha kawarake ni hi o irete zo mochi tari keru. Ame ha ikani ite furu, nureji tote, kashira ni komugi no wara o kasa no yōni hikiyūde katsuidari, kawarake no hi ni komugiwara kagayaite, gin no hari no yōni ha mie keru nari. Koto no tei ichīchini araware nu. Kore o i mo koroshi, kiri mo koroshi tara n ha, ikani nennaku n. Tadamori ga furumaiyō koso shiryobukakere. Yumiya toru mi ha sugurekari keri. " tote, sono kanshō ni sashimo gosaiai to kikoe shi gion no nyōgo o tadamori ni koso tamawari kere.

[6.10.2] Sate kanonyōbō in no miko o harami tatematsuri shika ba," umaran ko, onnago nara ba chin ga ko ni se n. Nanshi nara ba tadamori ga ko ni shite yumiya toru mi ni shitate yo. " to ōseke ru ni sunawachi otoko o ume ri. Kono koto sōmon se n to ukagai kere domo shikarubeki bingi mo nakari keru ni arutoki shirakawain kumano he gokō nari keru ga kīnokuni itokasaka to iu tokoro ni mikoshi kaki oki sase shibaraku gokyūsoku ari keri. Yabu ni nukago no ikura mo ari keru o tadamori sode ni morīre te gozen he mairi,

lg.l: いもが子は這ふ程にこそ成にけれ。

div.p: [6.10.3] To mōshi tari kere ba in yagate gokokoroe ari te,

lg.l: たゞもりとりてやしなひにせよ。

div.p: [6.10.4] To zo tsuke sase mashi keru. Sore yori shite koso ako to ha mochinashi keru. Kono wakagimi amarini yonaki o shi tamai kere ba in kikoshimeshi sare te isshu no ei o asobashi te kudasa re keri.

lg.l: 夜啼すとたゞもりたてよ末の代は、清く盛る事もこそあれ。

div.p: [6.10.5] Sate koso kiyomori to ha nanora re kere. Jūni no sai hyōenosuke ni naru. Jūhachi no sai shihon shite shī no hyōenosuke to mōshi o, shisai zonchi senu hito ha" kazoku no hito koso kō ha. " to mōse ba, tobain mo shiroshimesa re te," kiyomori ga kazoku ha, hito ni otoji. " to zo ōsekeru.

[6.10.6] Mukashi mo tenjitennō harami tamaeru nyōgo o ōshokukan ni tamau tote" kono nyōgo no umaran ko onnago nara ba chin ga ko ni sen, otokogo nara ba shin ga ko ni seyo. " to ōsekeru ni sunawachi otoko o umi tamaeri. Tōnomine no hongan, jōekashō kore nari. Jōdai ni mo kakaru tameshi ari kere ba, matsudai ni mo heidaishōkoku, makotoni shirakawain no miko nite owashi kere ba niya, sabakari no tenka no daiji miyakōtsuri nado to iu tayasukara nu kotodomo, omoitata re keru ni koso.

[6.11.1] Dō urūnigatsu hatsuka, gojōdainagon kunitsunakyō use tama nu. Heidaishōkoku to, sashimo chigiri fukō kokorozashi asakara zari shi hito nari. Semete no chigiri no fuka niya, dōjitsu ni yamai tsuki te, dōgetsu ni zo use rare keru. Kono dainagon to mōsu ha kanesuke chūnagon yori hachidai no sueha, saki umanosuke morikuni ga ko nari. Kuraudo ni dani nara zu, shinji no zōshiki to te sōrawa re shi, konoein go zaī no toki, ninpei no koro oi, dairi ni niwakani shōbō dekitari. Shujō nanden ni shutsugyo mashika domo, konoezukasa ichinin mo sanze rare zu, akire te tatase ohashimashi taru tokoro ni, kono kunitsuna koshigoshi o kakase te mairi," kayō no toki ha, kakaru mikoshi ni koso mesa re sōrae. " to sōshi kere ba, shujō kore ni meshi te shutsugyo ari. " nanimono zo. " to otazune arikere ba," shinji no zōshiki fujiwaranokunitsuna" to nanori mōshi. " kakaru sakasakashiki mono koso are, meshitsukau beshi. " to sonotoki no denka hosshōjidono he mukaefukumerare kere ba, goryō amata tamai nado shite meshitsukaware keru hodo ni, dōtei no miyo ni hachiman he gyōkō mashi ni, ninjō ga sake ni yoite mizu ni taoreiri, shōzoku o nurashi, mikagura chichishitari keru ni, kono kunitsuna, shinmyōni koso sōrawa ne domo, ninjō ga shōzoku ha motasete sōrō. " tote, ichigu toridasare tare kere ba, kore o kite mikagura totonoe sōshi keri. Hodo koso sukoshimo utsuritari kere domo, uta no koe mo suminobori, mai no sode, hyōshi ni aite omoshirokari keri. Mono no mi ni shimi te omoshiro koto ha kami mo hito mo dōshin nari. Mukashi ame no iwato o oshihirakare ken kamiyo no koto waza made mo ima koso oboshimeshishirare kere.

[6.11.2] Yagate kono kunitsuna no senzo ni yamakagechūnagon to iu hito owashi ki. Sono ko ni nyomusōzu to te chie saikaku mi ni amari, tokugyō jiritsu no sō owashi keri. Shōtai no korōi, kanpyōhōō, ōigawa e gokō mashi ni, kanjuji no naidaijin takafujikō no miko, izumi no taishō sadakuni, ogurayama no arashi ni eboshi o kawa e fukīrerare sode nite motodori o osae, shikata nakute zo tachi tari keru ni, kono nyomusōzu san'ebako no naka yori eboshi hitotsu toridasare taru keru tokaya. Kano sōzu ha, chichi, yamakagechūnagon, dazainodaini ni natte chinzei he kudararekeru toki, nisai narishi o, mamahaha aku deakarasamani idaku yōnishite, umi ni otoshīre korosantoshikeru o, shinikeru makotonohaha, zonshōnotoki, katsuranōkaigaunoenisentote, kame o totte korosantoshikeru o kisetamaeru kosode o nugi, kame nikae, hanataretarishi ga, sonōn o hōzento, konowakagimi otoshīrekeru o mizunōeni ukabikite, kōninotte zo tasuketarikeru. Sore ha jōdai no koto nareba ikaga ariken. Matsudai ni kunitsunakyō no kōmyō arigataki koto tomo nari. Hosshōjidono no miyo ni chūnagon ni naru. Hosshōjidono kakuresasetamaite nochi nyūdōshōkoku zonzuru mune ari tote, konohito ni katarahiyoritamaheri. Daifukuchōja nite owashikere ba, nani nite mo kanarazu mainichi ni isshu oba nyūdōshōkoku no moto e okura re keri. Gense no tokui kono hito ni sugubekara zu tote, shisoku ichinin yōshi ni shite, kiyokuni to nanora se, mata nyūdōshōkoku no yonan, tōnochūjō shigehira wa ka dainagon no muko ni naru.

[6.11.3] Jishō yonen no gosechi wa fukuhara nite okonaware keru ni, tenjōbito chūgū no onkata e suisan ari shi ga, aru unkaku no" take shōho ni madaranari. " to iu rōei o se rare tari kere ba, kono dainagon tachigiki shi te," ana asamashi, kore wa kinki nari to koso uketamaware. Kakaru koto kiku tomo kika ji. " tote nukiashishite nigeiderarenu. Tatoheba, kono rōei no kokoro ha mukashi gyō no mikado ni futari no himemiya mashimashiki. Ane oba gakō to ī, imōto oba joei to iu. Tomoni shun no mikado no kisaki nari. Shun no mikado kakuretamaite nochi, kano sōgo no nobe he okuritatematsuri, kemuri to nashitatematsuru toki, futari no kisaki nagori o oshimitatematsuri, shōho toiu tokoro made shitagaitsutsu, nakikanashimitamaishini, sono namida kishi no take ni kakete madarani zo sometarikeru. Sononochi mo tsune ni ha kashiko ni owashite shitsu o hīte nagusami tamaeri Ima kashiko o miru nareba, kishi no take ha madara nite tateri Koto o shirabe shi ato ni ha kumo tanabī te, monoaware naru kokoro o tachibanashōkō no fu ni tsukure ru nari. Kono dainagon ha saseru bunsai shīka uruwashū owase zari shika domo, kakaru sakashiki hito nite kayō no koto made mo kikitogame rare keru ni koso. Konohito dainagon made ha omoi mo yora zari shi o, hahaue kamodaimyōjin ni ayumi o hakobi," negawaku ha, wagako no kunitsuna ichinichi demo sōrae, kurōdonotō he sase tamae." " to, hyakunichi kantan o kudaite inorimōsarekeru ga, aruyo no yume ni binrō no kuruma o ite kite, wagaie no kurumayose ni tachi to yume o mite, kore o hito ni katari tamaeba," sore ha, kugyō no kitanokata ni nase tamau beki ni koso. " to awase tarikereba," ware toshi sudeni taketari. Imasara sayō no furumai arubeshi tomo oboezu. " to notamaikeru ga, miko kunitsuna kurōdonotō ha koto mo yoroshi. Shōnī dainagon ni nobori tamau koso medetakere.

[6.11.4] Dō nijūninichi, hōō wa in no gosho hosshōjidono e gokō naru. Kano gosho wa inuru ōhō sannen shigatsu jūgonichi ni tsukuridasa re te, shinhiei, shinkumano nado mo majikō kanjōshi tatematsuri, sansui kodachi ni itaru made oboshimesumama nari shi ga, kono nisannen wa heike no akugyō ni yotte, gokō mo nara zu. Gosho no hakai shitaru o shuri shite, gokō nashi tatematsuru beki yoshi, sakinōdaishō munemorikyō sōse rare tari kere ba, nani no yō mo aru bekara zu, tada tōtō tote gokō naru. Sen kokenshunmon'in no onkata o goranzure ba, kishi no matsu, migiwa no yanagi toshi he ni keri to obo te, ki takaku nareru ni tsu te mo, taieki no fuyō, biō no yanagi, kore ni mukau ni ikaga namida susu zara n. Ka nandai seikyū no mukashi no ato, ima koso oboshimeshishire kere.

[6.11.5] Sangatsu tsuitachi nanto no sōgō ra, honkan ni fukushite matsuji shōen motonogotoku chigyōsubeki yoshi ōsekudasaru. Dō mikka daibutsuden tsukurihajime raru. Kotohajime no bugyō niha kurōdo sashōben yukitaka to zo kikoeshi. Kono yukitaka, sennen hachiman he mairi tsuyaseraretarikeru ga, yume ni gohōden no uchi yori binzura yuitaru tendō no idete" kore ha daibosatsu no tsukai nari. Daibutsuden bugyō no toki ha kore o motsubeshi. " to shaku o tamawaru to iu yume o mite, samete nochi mitamaeba, geni arikeri. " ana fushigi ya tōji nanigoto ateka, daibutsuden bugyō ni mairu beki. " tote kaichū shite shukusho he kaeri, fukō osamete okarekeru ga, heike no akugyō ni yotte, nanto enjō no aida, kono yukitaka, ben no naka ni erabarete, kotohajime no bugyō ni mairarekeru shukuen no hodo koso medetakere.

[6.11.6] Dō sangatsu tōka, minonokuni no mokudai, miyako he hayauma o motte mōshikeru ha, tōgoku no genji domo sudeni owarinokuni made semenobori, michi o fusagi, hito o tōsanu yoshi mōshitarikereba, yagate utte o sashitsukawasu. Daishōgun niha, sahyōenokami tomomori, sachūjō kiyotsune, komatsushōshō arimori, tsugō sono sei sanman'yoki de hakkōsu. Nyūdōshōkoku usetamaite nochi, wazukani gojun o danimo sugizaru ni, sakoso midataru yo to īnagara, asamashikarishi kotodomo nari. Genji no kata ni ha jūrōkurōdoyukīe, hyōenosuke no otōto kyōkōgien, tsugō sono sei rokusen'yoki, owarigawa o naka ni hedate, genpei ryōhō ni jin o toru.

[6.11.7] Dō jūrokunichi no yoru han bakari, genji no sei rokusen'yoki kawa o watatte, heike sanman'yoki ga naka he omeite kakeiru. Akereba jūshichinichi toranokoku yori yāwaseshite, yoru no akuru made tatakau ni, heike no kata ni ha isasakamo sawagazu. " teki ha kawa o wataitareba, umamonogu mo mina nuretaru zo, sore o shirushi ni shite ute ya." " tote, ōzei no naka ni torikomete," amasuna, morasuna. " tote seme tamaeba, genji no sei nokorisukunani uchinasare, taishōgun yukīe karaki inochi ikite kawa yori higashi he hikinoku. Kyōkōgien ha fukairishite utare ni keri. Heike yagate kawa o watatte, genji o oimonoini ite iku. Genji asoko koko de kaeshiawaseawase fusegeredomo, teki ha ōzei, mikata ha buzei nari. Kanau beshi tomo mi zari keri. Mizusawa o ushiro ni suru koto nakare. To koso iu ni, kondo no genji no saku, oroka nari. To zo hito mōshikeru.

[6.11.8] Saruhodo ni taishōgun jūrōkuraudoyukīe, mikawanokuni ni uchikoete, yahagigawa no hashi o hiki, kakitate kaite machikaketari. Heike yagate oshiyose seme tamahe ba, koraezu shite soko o mo, mata semeotosare nu. Heike yagate tsuzukite seme tamaha ba, mikawa tōtōmi no sei ha, shitagaitsuku bekari shi ni taishōgun sahyōenokami tomomori, rō arite mikawanokuni yori kaerinobora ru. Kondo mo wazukani ichijin o yaburu to ie domo, zantō o semene ba, shīdetaru koto naki ga gotoshi. Heike ha ototoshi komatsudaijin kōzerare nu. Kotoshi mata nyūdōshōkoku usetamai nu. Unmei no sue ni naru koto arawanarishikaba, nenrai onko no tomogara no hoka ha shitagaitsuku mono nakarikeri. Tōgoku ni ha kusa mo ki mo mina genji ni zo nabikikeru.

[6.12.1] Sonohodoni echigonokuni no jūnin, jōtarōsukenaga, echigonokami ni ninzu. Chōon no katajikenasa ni, kisotsuitō no tame ni, tsugō sanman'yoki dō rokugatsu jūgonichi kadode shite, akaru jūrokunichi no unokoku ni sudeni utatan to shi keru ni, yohan bakari, niwakani ōkaze fuki, ōame furi, kaminari obitadashiku natte, ten harete nochi kumoi ni dainaru koe no shiwagaretaru o motte," nan'enbudai kondō jūrokujō no rushanabutsu shōbōshi tatematsuru heike no kataudo suru mono kokoni ari, meshitore ya. " to, sansei sakende zo tōkeru. Jōtarō o hajime to shite, kore o kiku mono, mina mi no ke yodachi keri. Rōdōdomo," korehodo osoroshī ten no tsuge no sōrō ni, tada ri o magete todome tamae." " to mōshi kere domo," yumiya toru mono no, sore ni yoru beki yō nashi." tote, akaru jūrokunichi unokoku ni shiro o idete wazukani jūyochō zo yuki tari keru. Kurokumo hitomura tachi kite, sukenaga ga ue ni ōu to koso mie kere, niwakani mi sukumi kokoro horete, rakuba shite keri. Koshi ni kaki nose yakata he kaeri, uchi fusu koto sanji bakari shite, tsuini shini keri. Hikyaku o motte kono yoshi miyako he mōshi tari kere ba, heike no hitobito, ōini sawagare keri.

[6.12.2] Onaji shichigatsu jūyokka kaigen arite, yōwa to gōsu. Sonohi chikugonokami sadayoshi, chikuzen higo ryōgoku o tamawa te, chinzei no muhon tairage ni, saigoku he hakkō su, sonohi mata hijō no taisha okonaware te, inuru jishō sannen ni nagasare tamai shi hitobito, shōkansa ru. Matsudono nyūdō denka bizennokuni yori gojōraku, daijōdaijin myōon'in owarinokuni yori nobora se tamau. Azechidainagon sukekatakyō shinanonokuni yori kiraku to zo kikoe shi.

[6.12.3] Dō nijūhachinichi, myōon'indono goinsan su. Inuru chōkan no kiraku ni ha, gozen no sunoko ni shite, gaōon, genjōraku o dan se tama shi ni, yōwa no ima no kikyō ni ha, sentō ni shite shūfūraku o zo asobashi keru. Nanimo／＼ fuzei ori o oboshimeshi yora se tama ken mikokoro no hodo koso medetakere. Azechidainagon sukekatakyō mo, sonohi insan se raru. Hōō," ikani ya yume no sama ni koso oboshimeshi. Narai nu hina no sumai shite, eikyoku nado mo, ima ha atokata ara ji to oboshimese domo, mazu imayō hitotsu ari baya " to ōsekere ba, dainagon hyōshi totte," shinano ni ari naru kisojigawa. " to iu imayō o, kore ha mi tamai tari shi aida," shinano ni ari shi kisojigawa" to utaware keru zo toki ni totte no kōmyō naru

[6.13.1] Hachigatsu nanoka no nikkan no chō nite, daininnōe okonawa ru Kore ha masakado tsuitō no rei to zo kikoe shi Kugatsu tsuitachi, sumitomo tsuitō no rei tote tetsu no gaikō o isedaijingū he mairase raru. Chokushi ha saishu jingigonnodaifu ōnakatominosadataka, miyako o tate ōminokuni kōga no eki yori yamaizuki ise no rikyū ni shite, shini keri. Muhon no yakara chōbuku no tame ni, godan no hō uketamawatte okonaware keru gōzanze no daiajari, daigyōji no higanjo ni shite nejini shinu. Shinmei mo sanbō mo, gonaju nashi to iu koto ichijirushi. Mata daigenhō uketamawatte shuserare keru anshōji no jitsugen'ajari ga gokanju o shinji tari keru o, hiken serare kere ba, heike chōbuku no yoshi o chūshinshi tari keru zo osoroshiki. Ko ha ikani. " to ōsekere ba," chōteki chōbuku se yo to ōsekudasa ru. Tōsei no tei o mi sōrō ni, heike moppara chōteki to mie tamae ri. Yotte kore o chōbuku su, nani no toga ya sōrawa n. " to zo mōshi keru. Kono hōshi kikai nari. Shizai ka ruzai ka. " to ari shi ga, daishōji no sōgeki ni, uchimagire te sononochi sata mo nakari keri. Genji no yo to nari te nochi, kamakuradono" shinmyō nari. " to kanji oboshimeshi te, sono kanshō ni, daisōjō ni nasa re keru to zo kikoe shi.

[6.13.2] Dō jūnigatsu nijūyokka, chūgū ingō kōmurase tamai te, kenreimon'in to zo mōshi keru. Imada yōshu no ontoki, bokō no ingō kore hajime to zo uketamawaru. Saru hodo ni kotoshi mo kure te, yōwa mo ninen ni nari ni keri.
[6.13.3] Nigatsu nijūichinichi, taihaku bōsei o okasu. Tenmon'yōroku ni iwaku," taihaku bōsei o okase ba, shī okoru." " to ieri. Mata" shōgun chokurei o kōmurite kuni no sakai o ide. " to mo mietari.

[6.13.4] Sangatsu tōka, jimoku okonawarete, heike no hitobito tairyaku kankakai shi tamau. Shigatsu tōka, sakinogonnoshōsōzu kenshin, hiyoshisha ni shite, nyohō ni hokekyō ichimanbu tendoku suru koto arikeri. Gokechien no tame ni, hōō mo gokō naru. Nanimono no mōshīde tari keru yaran, ichīn sanmon no daishu ni ōsete, heike o tsuitō se raru beshi to kikoe shi hodo ni, gunbyō dairi he maitte, shihō no jintō o keigo su. Heishi no ichirui, mina rokuhara e haseatsumaru. Honsanmichūjōshigehirakyō, hōō no onmukae ni sono sei sanzen'yoki de hiyoshi no yashiro e sankōsu. Sanmon ni mata kikoekeru wa, heike yama semen tote, sūhyakki no sei o hikishite tozansu to kikoeshikaba, daishu mina higashisakamoto e kōkate," kowa ikani. " to sengi su. Sanjōrakuchū no sōdō naname nara zu. Gubu no kugyōtenjōbito iro ushinai, hokumen no mono no naka ni ha amari ni awate sawaide, kōzui tsuku mono ōkari keri. Honsanmichūjōshigehirakyō, anō no hotori nite, hōō mukaetorimairase te kangyo nashi tatematsuru. " kaku nomi aran ni ha kononochi ha onmonomōde nado mo ima ha mikokoro ni makasu majiki koto ya ran. " to zo ōsekeru. Makotoniha sanmon daishu heike o tsuitōsen to iu koto mo nashi. Heike yama semen to iu koto mo nashi. Kore atokata naki koto domo nari. " tenma no yoku arataru ni koso. " to zo hito mōshi keru. Dō shigatsu hatsuka, rinji ni kanpei ari. Kore ha kikin shitsueki ni yotte nari.

[6.13.5] Dō gogatsu nijūyokka kaigen arite, juei to gōsu. Sonohi mata echigonokuni no jūnin jōshirōsukemochi, echigonokami ni ninzu. Ani no sukenaga seikyo no aida, fukitsu nari tote shikirini jishi mōshi kere domo, chokurei nare ba chikara fukyū. Sukeshige o nagashige to kaimei su.

[6.13.6] Dō kugatsu futsuka, jōshirōnagashige kiso tsuitō no tame ni, echigo, dewa, aizu yongun no heidomo o insotsu shite, tsugō sonosei yonman'yoki, shinanonokuni he hakkō su. Dō kokonoka, tōgoku yokotagawara ni jin o toru. Kiso ha yodajō ni ari keru ga, kore o kikite yodajō o idete sanzen'yoki de, hasemukau. Shinanogenji, inōekurōmitsumori ga hakarigoto ni, niwakani akahata shichiryū tsukuri sanzen'yoki o nanate ni wakachi, asoko no mine, koko no hora yori akahata domo teniteni sashiagete yosekere ba, jōshirō kore o mi te," awaya konokuni ni mo heike no kataudo suru hito ari keri to, chikara tsuki nu. " tote, isami nonoshiru tokoro ni, shidaini chikō narikere ba, aizu o sadame te, nanate ga hitotsu ni nari, ichidoni toki o doto zo tsukurike ru. Yōi shitaru shirahata, sato sashiage tari. Echigo no sei domo, kore o mi te," teki nanjūmanki ara n. Ikaga se n. " to iro o ushinai, awatefutameki, aruiha kawa ni owamerare, aruiha akusho ni oiotosare, tasukaru mono ha sukunō, utaruru mono zo ōkari keru. Jōshirō ga tanomikittaru echigo no yamatarō, aizu no jōtanbō to iu kikoyuru tsuwamonodomo, soko nite mina utare nu. Wa mi teoi, karaki inochi ikitsutsu, kawa ni tsutaute echigonokuni he hikinoku.

[6.13.7] Dō jūrokunichi, miyako ni ha heike kore o ba koto tomo shi tamawazu mae udaishō munemorikyō, dainagon ni kanchakushite, jūgatsu mikka, naidaijin ni naritamau. Dō nanoka etsushin ari. Tōke no kugyō jūninin koshō shite, kurōdonotō ika, tenjōbito jūrokunin sakigake su. Tōgoku hokkoku no genji domo, hachi no gotoku ni okiai, tadaima miyako he semenoboran to suru ni, kayō ni nami no tatsu yaran, kaze no fuki yaran mo shiranu tei nite hanayakanarishi kotodomo, nakanaka iukainau zo mietarikeru.

[6.13.8] Saruhodoni, juei ninen ni narinikeri. Sechie ika tsune no gotoshi. Naiben o ba heike no naidaijin munemorikō tsutomeraru. Shōgatsu muika shujō chōkin no tame ni, ingoshohōjūjidono he gyōkō naru. Tobain rokusai nite, chōkin gyōkō, sorei to zo kikoe shi. Nigatsu nijūninichi, munemorikō juichī shi tamau. Yagate sonohi naidaijin o ba jōhyō se raru. Heiran tsutsushimi no yue to zo kikoe shi. Nantohokurei no daishu, kumanokinpusen no sōto, isedaijingū no saishushinkan ni itaru made, ikkō heike o somuite, genji ni kokoro o tōshi keru. Shihō ni senji o nashikudashi, shokoku ni inzen tsukawase domo, inzensenji mo mina heike no gechi to nomi kokoroete shitagaitsuku mono nakari keri.

[7.1.1] Juei ninen sangatsu jōjun ni, hyōenosuke to kisonokanja yoshinaka, fukai no koto ari keri. Hyōenosuke kiso tsuitō no tame ni, sono sei jūman'yoki de, shinanonokuni he hakkō su. Kiso ha yodajō ni ari keru ga, kore o kiki te, yoda no shiro o de te shinano to echigo no sakai kumasakayama ni jin o toru. Hyōenosuke ha dō shinanonokuni, zenkōji ni tsuki tamai. Kiso, menotogo no imainoshirōkanehira o shisha de, hyōenosuke no moto he tsukawasu. Ikanaru shisai no are ba yoshinaka utamu to ha notamau naru zo. Onhe ha tōhakkakoku o uchishitagae te, tōkaidō yori semenobori, heike o oiotosa mu to shi tamau nari. Yoshinaka mo tōzanhokurokuryōdō o shitagaete ima ichinichi mo sakini heike o semeotosa n to suru koto de koso are. Nan no yue ni, onbe to yoshinaka to naka o tagaete, heike ni waraware n to ha omō beki. Tadashi jūrōkurōdodono koso, onbe o uramuru koto ari tote, yoshinaka ga moto he owashitaru o, yoshinaka sae sugenō motenashi mōsa n koto, ikaga zo ya sōrae ba, uchitsuremōshitari. Mattaku yoshinaka ni oite ha gohen ni ishu omoi tatematsura zu. " to īyaru. Hyōenosuke no henji ni ha" ima koso sayō ni ha notamae domo, tashikani yoritomo utsu beki yoshi muhon no kuwadate ari to, mōsumono ari. Sore ni ha yoru bekara zu. " tote, doi, kajiwara o saki toshite, sudeni utte o sashimukera ruru yoshi kikoe shika ba, kiso shinjitsu ishu naki yoshi o arawasa n ga tame ni, chakushi shimizunokanja yoshishige tote, shōnen jūissai ni naru kokanja ni, unno, mochizuki, suwa, fujisawa nado iu kikoyuru tsuwamono domo o tsukete, hyōenosuke no moto he tsukawasu. Hyōenosuke wa" konōe wa makotoni ishu nakari keri. Yoritomo miseijin no ko o mota zu. Yoshiyoshi saraba ko ni shi mōsa n. " tote shimizunokanja o aigushi te kamakura e koso kaera re kere.

[7.2.1] Saruhodoni kiso, tōzanhokurokuryōdō o shitagae te goman'yoki no sei nite sudeni kyō e semenoboru yoshi kikoe shika ba heike wa kozo yori shite" myōnen wa uma no kusakai ni tsukite ikusa ari beshi" tote mōshi keru. " to hirō se rare tari kere ba, san'in, san'yō, nankai, saikai no tsuwamonodomo, unka no gotoku ni hasemairu. Tōsandō ha ōmi, mino, hida no tsuwamonodomo ha mai tare domo, tōkaidō ha tōtōmi yori higashi ha maira zu, nishi ha mina mairi tari. Hokurikudō wa wakasa yori kita no tsuwamonodomo hitori mo maira zu Mazu kisonokanja yoshinaka o tsuitō shi te sononochi hyōenosuke o utan tote, hokurikudō he utte o tsukawasu. Taishōgun ni ha komatsunosanmichūjōkoremori, echizennosanmimichimori, tajimanokamitsunemasa, satsumanokamitadanori, mikawanokamitomonori, awajinokamikiyofusa, samuraidaishō ni ha, etchūnozenjimoritoshi, kazusanotaifuhōgantadatsuna, hidanotaifuhōgankagetaka, takahashihōgannaganori, kawachihōganhidekuni, musashisaburōsaemonnojōarikuni, etchūjirōhyōemoritsugu, kazusagorōhyōetadamitsu, akushichibyōekagekiyo o saki to shite, ijō taishōgun rokunin, shikarubeki samurai sanbyakuyonjūyonin, tsugō sonosei jūman'yoki, jueininen shigatsujūshichinichi tatsunoitten ni miyako o tate, hokkoku he koso omomuki kere. Katamichi o tamahate kere ba, afusaka no seki yori hajimete, roji ni moteafu kenmonseika no shōzeikanmotsu o mo osorezu, ichīchi ni mina ubahitoru. Shiga, karasaki, mikawajiri, mano, takashima, shiotsu, kaizu no michi no hotori o, shidaini tsuibushite tohokere ba, jinmin korahezu shite, san'ya ni mina chōsansu.

[7.3.1] Taishōgun koremori, michimori ha susumi tamae domo, fukushōgun tsunemasa, tadanori, tomonori, kiyofusa nando ha imada ōminokuni shiotsu, kaizu ni hikie tari. Sonōchi ni mo tsunemasa ha shīkakangen ni chōji tamae ru hito nare ba, kakaru ran no naka ni mo, kokoro o sumashi, mizūmi no hashi ni uchīdete, harukani okinaru shima o miwatashi tomoni guse raretaru tōhyōearinori o meshite" are o ba izuku to iu zo. " to toware kere ba," are koso kikoe sōrō chikubushima nite sōrae. " to mōshi. " geni saru koto ari. Izaya maira n. " tote, tōbeearikata, yasumonmorikata ika, saburai gorokunin meshigushite, kobune ni nori, chikubushima he zo watara keru. Koro ha uzuki nakano yōka no koto nare ba, midorini miyuru kozue ni ha haruno jō o nokosu to oboe, kankoku no uguisu shita no koe oite, hatsune yukashiki kakkō, orishirigaoni tsugewataru. Matsu ni fuji nami sakikakatte makotoni omoshirokarikere ba isogi fune yori ori kishi ni nobotte konoshima no keshiki o mitamau ni kokoro mo kotoba mo oyobare zu. Kano shinkō kanbu aruiha dōnankanjo o tsukawashi aruiha hōshi oshite fushinokusuri o tazunetamaishi ni hōrai o mizuba inaya kaeraji to itte itazurani fune no naka nite oi tensui bōbōtoshite motomuru koto o ezariken hōraidō no arisama mo kakuya ariken to zo mieshi. Aru kyō no mon ni iwaku," enbudai no uchi ni mizūmi ari, sono naka ni konrinzai yori shōshutsutaru suishōrin no yama ari, tennyo sumu tokoro. " to ieri. Sunawachi kono shima no koto nari. Tsunemasa, myōjin no gozen ni tsuī tamai tsutsu" sore daibenkudokuten ha, ōko no nyorai, hosshin no daishi nari. Benzaimyōon niten no na ha, kakubetsu nari to ha ie tomo, honji ittai ni shite, shujō o saido shi tamau. Ichido sankei no tomogara ha shogan jōju enmansu to uketamawaru. Tanomoshū koso sōrae. " tote shibaraku hōse mairase tamaini zenzen higure imachi no tsuki sashīdete kaijō mo teriwatari shadan mo iyakagayakite makotoni omoshirokarikere ba jōjū no sōdomo" kikoyuru onkoto nari." to ī keri. " tote onbiwa o mairase tari kere ba tsunemasa ha kono o hiki tamau ni kamiharaishigami no hikyoku ni ha miya no naka mo sumiwatari, myōjin kannō ni taezu shite tsunemasa no sode no ue ni hakuryū genji te mie tamae ri. Katajikenaku ureshisa no amari ni nakunaku kō zo omoitsuzuke tamau.

lg.l: ちはやぶる神にいのりの叶へばや、しるくも色のあらはれにけり。

div.p: [7.3.2] Sareba onteki o menomaeni tairage, kyōto o tadaima semeotosa n koto mo utagai nashi to yorokonde, mata fune ni torinotte, chikubushima o zo iderare keru.

[7.4.1] Kisoyoshinaka ji ha shinano ni ari nagara, echizenkoku hiuchijō o zo kamae keru. Kano jōkaku ni komoru sei, heisenjichōrisaimyōigishi, inazushinsuke, saitōtarō, hayashirokurōmitsuaki, togashinyūdōbussei, tsuchida, takebe, miyazaki, ishiguro, nyūzen, sami o hajimetoshite, rokusen'yoki koso komori kere. Hiuchimoto yori kukkyō no jōkaku nari. Banjaku sobadachimegurite, shihō ni mine o tsuranetari. Yama o ushiro ni shi, yama o mae ni atsu. Jōkaku no mae ni ha nomigawa, shindōgawa tote nagaretari. Futatsu no kawa no ochiai ni, taiboku o kirite sakamogi ni hiki, saku o obitadashiku kakiagetareba, tōzai no yama no ne ni, mizu sekikōde mizūmi ni mukaeru ga gotoshi. Kage nanzan o hitashite aokushite kōyōtari. Nami nishibi o shizumete kurenainishite inrintari. Kano munetchi no soko ni ha, kingin no suna o shiki, konmeichi no nagisa ni ha, tokusei no fune o ukabetari. Kono hiuchijō no tsukīke ni ha, tsutsumi o tsuki, mizu o nigoshite, hito no kokoro o taburakasu. Fune nakushite ha tayasū watasu beki yō nakereba, heike no ōzei, mukae no yama ni shukushite, itazurani hikazu o okuru.

[7.4.2] 城の内に在ける平泉寺長吏齋明威儀師、平家に志深かりければ、山の根を廻りて、 消息を書き、蟇目の中に入れて忍びやかに平家の陣へぞ射入たる。「彼湖は往古の淵 に非ず、一旦山川を塞上て候。夜に入、足輕共を遣て柵を切落させ給へ、水は程なく 落べし。馬の足立好所で候へば急ぎ渡させ給へ。後矢は射て參らせむ。是は、平泉寺 長吏齋明威儀師が申状。」とぞ書たりける。大將軍大に悦び、やがて足輕どもを遣し て、柵を切落す。おびたゞしう見えつれども、げにも山川なれば水は程なく落にけり。 平家の大勢暫の[_][1]遲々にも及ばす、さと渡す。 城の内の兵共暫し支へて防ぎけれ共、敵は大勢也、御方は無勢也ければ、叶べしとも見えざりけり。 平泉寺長吏齋明威儀師、平家に附て忠をいたす。 稻津新介、齋藤太、林六郎光明、富樫入道佛誓こゝをば落て、猶平家を背き加賀國に引退き、白山河内に引籠る。 平家やがて加賀に打越て、林、富樫が城郭二箇所燒拂ふ。 Nani omote o mukau beshi tomo mi zari keri. Chikaki yadoyado yori hikyaku o tate, kono yoshi miyako he mōshi tari kere ba, daijindono ika nokori todomari tamau ichimon no hitobito yūetsu koto nanomenara zu.

[7.4.3] Dō gogatsu yōka, kaganokuni shinohara nite seita he ari. Gunbyō jūman'yoki o futate ni wakete ōte karamete he mukawa re keri. Ōte no taishōgun ha komatsunosanmichūjōkoremori, echizennosanmimichimori, samuraidaishō niha etchūnozenjimoritoshi o hajimetoshite, tsugō sono sei shichiman'yoki, kaga to etchū no sakai naru tonamiyama he zo mukare keru. Karamete no daishōgun wa, satsumanokamitadanori, mikawanokamitomonori, samuraidaishō ni wa, musashisaburōzaemon o saki toshite, tsugō sono sei sanman'yoki, noto etchū no sakai naru shiho no yama e zo kakara re keru. Kiso wa echigo no kokufu ni ari keru ga, kore o kiki te, goman'yoki de hasemukau. Wa ga ikusa no kichirei nare ba tote, nanate ni tsukuru. Mazu oji no jūrōhangan'yukīe, ichiman'yoki de shihoyama e zo mukeru. Nishina, takanashi, yamadajirō, shichisen'yoki de kitagurosaka e karamete ni sashitsukawasu. Higuchijirōkanemitsu, ochiaigorōkaneyuki shichisen'yoki de minamikurosaka he tsukawashi keri. Ichiman'yoki o ba tonamiyama no kuchi, kurosaka no suso, matsunaga no yanagihara, gumikibayashi ni hikikakusu. Imaishirōkanehira, rokusen'yoki de washinose o uchiwatashi, hinomiyabayashi ni jin o toru. Kiso wagami ha ichiman'yoki de, oyabe no watashi o shite, tonamiyama no kita no hazure hanyū ni jin o zo tori tari keru.

[7.5.1] Kiso notamai keru ha," heike ha sadamete ōzei nare ba, tonamiyama uchikoete, hiromi he ide kakeai no ikusa ni te zo aran zu ran." Tadashi kakeai no ikusa wa sei no tashō ni yoru koto nari. Ōzei kasa ni kakete torikomerare te wa warukari nan. Mazu hatasashi o sakidateゝ shirahata o sashiage tara ba heike kore o mi te『 awaya genji no senjin wa muitaru wa. Sadamete ōzei nite zo aran. Sōnau hiromi e uchīdete teki wa annaisha, warera wa muannai nari, torikomerare te wa kanamaji. Konoyama wa shihō ganseki de annareba, karamete e wa yomo meguraji, shibashi orī te uma yasuman. 』 tote, sanchū ni zo orīnzuran.
